To prove this method works, we attach a narrow parallel spatial stream (+4.4% weights) alongside unfrozen Qwen3-1.7B layers. In our two-dimensional tests, the model spawns and transforms multi-object scenes from English descriptions, transfers shapes to held-out nouns, and relies causally on the workspace to answer spatial questions.

</details>


### [151] [Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology via Topology-Informed Graph Attention and Gene-Semantics Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33792)
*Yuqi Cheng,Boshuai Zhang,Ziqi Zhang,Xiuwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 TIGEM，一种面向组织学图像到空间转录组推断的拓扑感知、基因条件化框架，用于从 H&E 图像预测基因表达，并支持未见基因的零样本预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组测序成本高，现有从 H&E 图像推断表达的方法存在三个问题：单一 patch 表征不足且邻域聚合易过度平滑边界；固定基因索引输出头无法支持未见基因的严格零样本预测；常用指标难以充分衡量空间模式保真度和边界分辨率。

Method: TIGEM 通过组织级拓扑与形态线索正则化图注意力，学习拓扑感知的 spot 表征以避免跨区域平滑；采用基因语义调制替代基因索引输出头，实现未见基因零样本预测；并提出图谱相关性 GSC 指标，补充 PCC/MSE 以评估空间模式保真度和边界分辨率。

Result: 在三个大规模空间转录组数据集上，TIGEM 取得整体最先进性能，并显著提升边界预测分辨率；同时展示了对训练中未见基因表达模式的预测能力。

Conclusion: TIGEM 通过拓扑感知空间传播和基于 PLM 的基因条件化，扩展了现有零样本组织学到空间转录组推断方法，在表达预测和边界解析方面表现更优。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression with spatial context but remains costly, motivating models that infer expression from H&E images. Existing approaches face three key limitations: (i) a single patch embedding is often insufficient: morphologically similar regions can exhibit distinct expression due to spatial context, while naive neighborhood aggregation can over-smooth boundaries; (ii) conventional fixed, gene-indexed output heads treat genes independently and cannot directly support strict zero-shot prediction for unseen genes; and (iii) common metrics under-measure spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution. To address these challenges, we propose TIGEM, a topology-informed, gene-conditioned framework for histology-to-ST inference. TIGEM learns topology-aware spot representations by regularizing graph attention with tissue-level topology and morphology cues to avoid cross-compartment smoothing, and uses gene semantic modulation to replace gene-indexed heads, enabling zero-shot prediction for unseen genes. We also introduce Graph Spectral Correlation (GSC) to evaluate spatial pattern fidelity and boundary resolution complement to PCC/MSE. Across three large-scale ST datasets, TIGEM achieves overall state-of-the-art performance and significantly improved boundary prediction resolution, and further demonstrates the ability to predict expression patterns for genes unseen during training, extending prior zero-shot histology-to-ST efforts with topology-aware spatial propagation and PLM-based gene conditioning.

</details>


### [152] [Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34126)
*Luoxi Zhang,Jiawei Liu,Yanlin Luo,Peiyang He,Junlin Zhu,Chun To Choi,Yang Xiong,Jiang Wu,Xingyu Zeng,Min Yang,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ClueProbe 诊断基准，用于评估 Video LLM 是否能根据证据充分程度作出回答、猜测或拒答，并发现主要问题在于模型缺乏分级证据充分性判断，而非感知失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实场景中视频证据往往只被部分捕获，可靠模型应区分证据充分、部分可见和完全缺失；现有基准仅做可回答/不可回答二分，无法衡量部分证据，也难以判断失败源于缺失证据还是充分性误判。

Method: 构建 ClueProbe，包含 598 个自然视频上的 1,721 个人工标注问题，分为 Answerable、Guessable、Unanswerable 三类，并加入措辞或视觉输入的受控扰动；评估 10 个开源与专有 Video LLM，并通过针对性微调验证诊断。

Result: 模型失败主要来自判断而非感知：能感知证据但缺乏分级充分性意识，倾向直接回答或拒答，很少从部分线索中猜测。微调监督 guess 层级可将适当猜测从 1.6% 提升至 40.4%，且不增加错误拒答；传统拒答微调则会拒绝 92% 的可猜测问题。

Conclusion: Video LLM 的分级证据充分性判断能力主要受限于缺少相应监督而非模型容量；ClueProbe 能分离感知证据与判断充分性，为提升模型在部分证据下的可靠行为提供诊断与改进依据。

Abstract: In real-world applications like egocentric recording, visual accessibility, and surveillance review, visual evidence for Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) is often only partially captured. A reliable model should match its response to the evidence: answering when sufficient, guessing from visible clues when partial, and abstaining when absent. Yet existing benchmarks enforce a binary answerable-or-unanswerable split, leaving partial evidence unmeasured and obscuring whether failures arise from missing evidence or misjudging sufficiency. We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning. ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input. Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues. Targeted fine-tuning shows that this reflects missing supervision rather than insufficient capacity: supervising the guess level lifts appropriate guessing from 1.6% to 40.4% without extra false refusals, whereas conventional refusal tuning rejects 92% of guessable questions. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/suat-llm/ClueProbe.

</details>


### [153] [SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33796)
*Ryosuke Watanabe,Tomoaki Konno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SprintGS，一个基于 FastGS 的快速 3D Gaussian Splatting 训练框架，通过优化光栅化与损失计算，在保持紧凑模型和可比质量的同时显著加速训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 可实时渲染逼真新视角，但逐场景训练仍较慢。FastGS 等快速方法虽通过减少高斯数量将训练缩短到几分钟，但仍存在两类成本：光栅化仍是最大开销且含冗余工作；损失计算成本不随高斯数量减少，因此在紧凑模型下占比上升。

Method: SprintGS 建立在 FastGS 上并保持模型紧凑。光栅化方面：采用调度式 tile 剔除，用粗粒度足迹限制每个高斯只作用于重要 tile，并在训练结束前退火到精确足迹；收敛感知剪枝移除已收敛且近乎透明的高斯；shuffle 高效反向传播减少 GPU 线程间数据交换。损失方面：融合损失在前向传播中直接计算损失及图像梯度，无需损失图，从而消除大部分损失计算开销。

Result: SprintGS 在可比质量下比 FastGS 训练快 2.15 倍，在高质量设置下快 1.81 倍；还能加速其他快速训练方法，并适用于动态、稀疏视角和表面重建场景。

Conclusion: SprintGS 通过同时降低紧凑模型中的光栅化冗余和损失计算开销，实现了显著的端到端训练加速，并具备较好的通用性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.

</details>


### [154] [DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34420)
*Hoang-Nhat Nguyen,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DocSEAM，一种插入视觉编码器与语言模型之间的轻量模块，用于向多页文档的视觉表示注入跨页局部上下文，在不增加视觉 token 数量的情况下提升多页文档理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多页文档视觉语言模型通常独立编码每一页，导致页边界处特征不连续：视觉 token 在形成时无法访问相邻页内容，语言模型也只能基于孤立页表示进行推理。

Method: DocSEAM 为每页构造包含左右相邻页的局部三元组，采用中心锚定的掩码自注意力与方向显著性门控融合邻居页信息，仅返回增强后的中心页 token，保持视觉 token 数不变；训练包括监督式跨页预热，并在冻结 DocSEAM 后进行多页微调。

Result: 9B 参数模型在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上，于评估的 10B 参数以内开放权重模型中取得最优结果；在受控重新分页下，DocSEAM 降低了对页边界位置的敏感性，并提升了跨页片段定位能力。

Conclusion: DocSEAM 能以轻量方式将局部跨页上下文归纳偏置注入视觉表示，在不改变视觉 token 数量的前提下改善多页文档 VQA 与跨页定位，并增强对分页边界的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization

</details>


### [155] [DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33797)
*Minyang Li,Siyu Xu,Yunke Wang,Ying-Cong Chen,Chang Xu,Daochang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DriftWAM，一种面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的少步蒸馏框架，通过将预测视频所诱导的动作信息融入视频生成学习，在保持机器人任务性能的同时降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型统一视频预测与动作生成，但迭代去噪导致推理成本高；现有少步蒸馏方法主要追求逐点轨迹一致和视觉保真度，未充分利用下游动作信息，且缺乏显式的分布级对齐。

Method: DriftWAM 将动作感知融入视频蒸馏：一方面采用动作感知视频漂移，通过联合视觉-动作相似度核进行视频分布匹配，并在诱导动作指导下引导样本演化；另一方面采用动作引导视频正则化，利用联合核识别的师生匹配将动作级梯度回传至视频生成器。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 基准及真实机器人操作任务上，DriftWAM 在相同推理速度的少步设置下持续优于先前的 Consistency Distillation 方法。

Conclusion: 将预测视频诱导的动作信息纳入少步 WAM 蒸馏，并结合分布级视觉-动作对齐，可在激进步数缩减下更有效地保持任务性能，为高效机器人控制部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.

</details>


### [156] [Neural Rendering Compiler: Generative Video Models as Programmable Renderers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34680)
*Yuxia Zhu,Xinglong Xu,Hao Liang,Linzhuang Sun,Caijun Jia,Qifeng Cai,Jincen Luo,Lei Li,Alden Cai,Asher Qin,Wentao Zhang,Cheng Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出神经渲染编译器NeurCo，通过自动探测冻结视频模型的能力手册，将用户意图编译为模型特定的执行策略，并发布VComBench基准，提升多需求视频生成的要求满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频模型正成为强大的渲染器，但缺乏类似HTML/CSS引擎或Blender的可预测控制接口；其能力隐式地来自训练，难以确定哪些语义要求能被可靠执行。

Method: NeurCo自动探测冻结视频模型，构建描述其可可靠满足语义要求的模型特定能力手册；用模型无关的中间表示表达对象、约束、事件和相机，再编译为模型特定执行策略：可靠要求保持不变，不可靠要求选择性重写或编译为替代策略。同时提出VComBench，包含380个组合式多要求任务，覆盖文本到视频、图像到视频和参考到视频生成。

Result: NeurCo将要求满足率在Wan上从46.8%提升到52.3%，在Minimax H3上从66.5%提升到69.3%；与提示增强器结合可进一步提升，包括在Seedance 2.5上。分析揭示了模型间控制能力差异以及可控性与照片真实感之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 能力引导的编译是通向可编程生成式视频渲染的有前景方法，NeurCo展示了通过探测模型能力并据此编译执行策略来提升视频生成可控性的有效性。

Abstract: Generative video models are becoming powerful renderers, yet lack the predictable control interfaces of conventional systems such as HTML/CSS engines or Blender. Their capabilities emerge implicitly from training, making it difficult to determine what they can reliably execute. We present Neural Rendering Compiler (NeurCo), which automatically probes frozen video models to construct model-specific capability manuals describing which semantic requirements they can reliably satisfy. NeurCo represents user intent in a model-agnostic intermediate representation of objects, constraints, events, and cameras, then compiles it into model-specific execution strategies. Reliable requirements remain unchanged, while unreliable ones are selectively rewritten or compiled into alternative execution strategies. We introduce VComBench, a benchmark of 380 compositional, multi-requirement tasks spanning text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. NeurCo improves requirement satisfaction from 46.8% to 52.3% on Wan and from 66.5% to 69.3% on Minimax H3, and achieves further gains when combined with prompt enhancers, including on Seedance 2.5. Our analysis reveals model-specific differences in control capabilities and trade-offs between controllability and photorealism, highlighting capability-guided compilation as a promising approach to programmable generative video rendering.

</details>


### [157] [Dynamic Forcing: Learning Action-Grounded Sparse Dynamic Representations with Dense Future Guidance for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33799)
*Ziqiang Li,Shisheng Chen,Yunnan Wang,Wenyao Zhang,Zili Lin,Yuyang Zhang,Xudong Yang,Fangzhuo Jin,Chenyu Zhou,Wenjun Zeng,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 CompactWAM，一种稀疏-稠密联合预测框架，用少量动态 token 表示未来与动作相关的变化，并以当前观测作为上下文锚点，从而避免稠密未来建模的冗余计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型通过视觉预测支持机器人控制，但稠密未来建模会重复编码当前观测中已有的静态上下文，而真正与动作相关的变化通常具有空间稀疏性。

Method: 提出稀疏动态表示学习：保留当前观测作为上下文锚点，用紧凑动态 token 表示预期变化；在视频监督共享骨干中联合学习稀疏与稠密预测，且稀疏路径不需要重建目标。引入 Dynamic Forcing，将直接动作监督与特权稠密未来引导结合，并通过动作功能引导和动态感知分布匹配提升动作相关性与动态保真度。推理时仅需一次视觉前向编码当前观测和动态 token 生成动作。

Result: CompactWAM 在 LIBERO 上达到 98.4% 成功率，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 77.9%；仅使用 9.2% 的稠密未来 token 预算时仍分别保持 98.3% 和 76.6%。在 RoboTwin 2.0 和真实世界操作任务上的评估进一步验证了所学稀疏预测表示的有效性。

Conclusion: 稀疏动态表示可以在不进行稠密未来建模的情况下有效支持机器人动作生成，在显著降低 token 预算的同时保持高性能，说明聚焦动作相关动态变化是提升世界动作模型效率与实用性的有效方向。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) support robot control through visual prediction, but dense future modeling repeatedly encodes static context already available in the current observation, while action-relevant changes are often spatially sparse. We study sparse dynamic representation learning, retaining the current observation as a contextual anchor and using a small set of compact dynamic tokens to represent anticipated changes. We develop CompactWAM, a sparse-dense joint predictive framework that enables sparse representation learning within a video-supervised shared backbone, without requiring a reconstruction objective for the sparse pathway. Since a limited token budget alone does not specify which information to retain, we introduce Dynamic Forcing, which pairs direct action supervision with privileged dense future guidance to promote action relevance and dynamic fidelity. While action prediction gradients directly drive compact tokens to capture control-relevant cues, dense future guidance further shapes them via action functional guidance that matches sparse and dense contributions to the action expert, and dynamics-aware distribution matching, which aligns temporal relational changes relative to a static reference. At inference, a single visual forward pass encodes current observations and compact dynamic tokens for action generation, eliminating dense future modeling. CompactWAM achieves 98.4\% success on LIBERO and 77.9\% on LIBERO-Plus, retaining respective success rates of 98.3\% and 76.6\% with only 9.2\% of the dense future token budget. Evaluations on RoboTwin~2.0 and real-world manipulation further demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned sparse predictive representations.

</details>


### [158] [EvoVAU: Tool Evolution for Video Anomaly Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33808)
*Benfeng Wang,Chao Huang,Yudong Cheng,Chengliang Liu,Wei Wang,Wenqi Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EvoVAU 框架，通过演化可复用工具库来增强冻结视频求解器在视频异常理解任务中的多轮推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频异常理解需要推理事件进展、交互和上下文条件，但现有视频智能体的预定义分析操作难以充分满足多样化推理需求。

Method: 由外部提议器根据任务结果和执行轨迹发现工具库局限并进行改进；采用跨版本对比反馈，将当前错误与历史修正/回归的配对执行轨迹结合；通过采用感知选择，仅在开发集整体准确率提升且新工具或修改工具相关问题上修正数多于回归数时接受候选工具库；在小开发集上交替进行工具改进、评估与选择，测试阶段固定演化后的工具库且不再使用提议器。

Result: 在多个视频异常理解基准上取得较强性能，并显示演化工具库可跨不同异常领域灵活复用。

Conclusion: EvoVAU 能通过经验驱动的工具库演化提升冻结视频求解器的异常理解表现，并具备良好的跨领域适应性。

Abstract: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) requires reasoning about event progression, interactions, and the contextual conditions that distinguish abnormal behavior from common activity across diverse scenes. Although video agents enable multi-round analysis, the predefined analytical operations may not adequately satisfy these diverse reasoning demands. In this paper, we present EvoVAU, a framework that evolves a reusable tool library for a frozen video solver. Guided by task outcomes and execution trajectories, an external proposer identifies potential limitations in the library and refines it, retaining task experience as analytical operations that can be reused across questions. Specifically, Cross-Version Contrastive Feedback guides tool refinement by combining current errors with paired execution trajectories from historical corrections and regressions. Adoption-Aware Selection accepts a candidate library only when overall development-set accuracy improves and corrections outnumber regressions among questions on which the solver invokes new or modified tools. Using a small development set, EvoVAU alternates tool refinement with candidate evaluation and selection. At test time, the evolved library remains fixed, with no further involvement from the proposer. Experiments on several VAU benchmarks demonstrate strong performance and the flexibility of the evolved library across anomaly domains.

</details>


### [159] [Probabilistic Monocular Biomechanical Reconstruction via Guided Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33809)
*R. James Cotton,Fabian Sinz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出生物力学流模型（BFM），一种用于从单目视频重建3D关节运动学的连续时间流匹配先验，可同时建模人体测量、关节角轨迹和虚拟标记，并在测试时由2D关键点引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单视频3D关节运动学重建存在深度与身高歧义、肢体遮挡和缺乏不确定性估计等问题，现有确定性轨迹优化方法难以提供可靠置信区间。

Method: 基于565名参与者的多相机临床记录训练连续时间流匹配先验，覆盖人体测量、解剖关节角轨迹和虚拟标记；测试时用单目2D关键点引导，无需配对视频训练，并与拟合相同骨架的先进确定性轨迹优化器进行同试验对比。

Result: 在步行和TUG中，BFM关节角精度与确定性优化器相当；在留出对照、假肢和神经科参与者上，步行和TUG平均绝对关节角误差分别为3.91度和4.97度，并提供可跨越时间及整肢遮挡的可信区间。关键点被遮挡时区间随误差增大且覆盖率接近名义值；个体人体测量校准可消除大部分单目骨盆深度误差。

Conclusion: BFM能提供具有不确定性量化的单目3D关节运动学重建，但面对分布外的小儿蹲伏步态时会出现有偏且过度自信的伸展预测，说明需要覆盖更病理性运动多样性的先验。

Abstract: Reconstructing 3D joint kinematics from a single video is ill-posed due to depth and stature ambiguity, limb occlusion, and missing uncertainty estimates. We introduce the Biomechanical Flow Model (BFM), a continuous-time flow-matching prior over subject anthropometry, anatomical joint-angle trajectories, and virtual markers, trained on multi-camera clinical recordings from 565 participants and steered toward monocular 2D keypoints at test time without paired video training. In a head-to-head comparison on the same clinical trials against a state-of-the-art deterministic trajectory optimizer fitting the identical skeleton, BFM achieves comparable joint-angle accuracy across walking and timed-up-and-go (TUG). Across held-out control, prosthetic, and neurologic participants, BFM reaches 3.91 deg and 4.97 deg mean absolute joint-angle error on walking and TUG while providing credible intervals that bridge temporal and whole-limb occlusions. Where keypoints are hidden, the intervals widen with the error and keep their coverage near nominal. Supplying individual anthropometric calibration removes most monocular pelvis depth error, whereas testing on out-of-distribution pediatric crouch gait produces biased, overconfident extension predictions, highlighting the need for pathologically diverse movement priors.

</details>


### [160] [Towards 360$^\circ$ Embodied UAV Tracking Without Turning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33934)
*Bingyu Li,Wu Du,Zhiyuan Zhao,Junyu Gao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出360UAV-ETrack仿真基准和360UAV-TVLA全景视觉-语言-动作框架，用于无需主动调整航向的全景感知无人机目标跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统具身无人机跟踪将目标可观测性与航向控制耦合，前视相机视角有限，目标容易离开视野；因此作者探索利用全球形感知跟随目标而不主动调整航向的互补范式。

Method: 构建包含2,652条序列、超173万条同步观测、8类跟踪任务和150个留出闭环场景的仿真基准360UAV-ETrack；提出360UAV-TVLA框架，集成持续视觉指代、压缩时序记忆和几何对齐轨迹监督，用于实例识别、运动推理与三维控制。

Result: 在两个VLA骨干网络上均优于标准微调：π0的归一化平均跟踪帧数从22.56%提升至35.28%，π0.5从25.68%提升至33.64%；基准还揭示了离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性之间的显著差距。

Conclusion: 研究表明全景VLA框架可有效支持无航向调整的无人机目标跟踪，并提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台以推动未来研究。

Abstract: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $π_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $π_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

</details>


### [161] [FlipVLA: Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action(VLA) Models Only Through Bit Flips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33810)
*Zexi Zhao,Zizhen Liu,Jing Justin Ye,Huawei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究无需重新训练、仅通过少量固定参数位翻转即可在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中植入物体触发后门，并提出FlipVLA方法，在多个模型和任务套件上实现高攻击成功率且几乎不影响干净场景性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型将视觉观察和语言指令转化为真实环境中的机器人动作，恶意篡改模型可能威胁物理安全。作者关注能否在不重新训练的情况下，通过少量参数位翻转植入物体触发后门。

Method: 提出FlipVLA，一种两阶段“选择器-放大器”方法，利用FC-GELU-FC结构中的现有视觉特征。选择器在选定通道中构造触发相关响应，并利用GELU衰减背景活动；放大器修改相连的下游权重，将该响应转化为与动作相关的扰动。通过通道筛选和离散位搜索，在有限修改预算下构造两部分。

Result: 在OpenVLA-OFT和GR00T N1.7上，跨四个LIBERO套件实验达到90.22%至100%的攻击成功率，同时干净场景任务成功率最多下降1.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过少量参数位翻转即可在VLA模型中植入高效的物体触发后门，并在保持干净任务性能的同时构成对物理安全的潜在威胁。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

</details>


### [162] [RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33957)
*Jaemin Kim,Christian Simon,Dongseok Shim,Wei-Yao Wang,Qiyu Wu,Masato Ishii,Shusuke Takahashi,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 RefMix，一种用于在线前向匹配生成模型的参考辅助端点提议方法，旨在缓解策略内反馈导致的高奖励模式聚集和视觉多样性下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线前向匹配通过反复生成、奖励并拟合模型产生的端点来对齐流式生成模型，但这会形成策略内反馈循环：高奖励模式越来越受偏好，其他模式在后续训练池中出现概率降低，导致视觉多样性持续下降。

Method: RefMix 在训练池中注入替代候选端点，同时保留原始任务奖励和前向匹配目标。具体地，在早期高噪声步骤使用参考模型暴露替代视觉模式，再由当前奖励调优模型完成端点生成。

Result: 在多种先进在线前向匹配方法上，RefMix 能一致提升视觉多样性，同时保持任务奖励表现。控制推理实验表明，训练时端点暴露对改善奖励与多样性权衡至关重要，其作用超过参考辅助推理本身。在可比奖励水平下，RefMix 相比前向匹配基线最高提升 44% 的多样性。

Conclusion: 通过重新思考训练端点的提议方式，RefMix 有效缓解在线前向匹配中的多样性退化问题，并在不牺牲奖励性能的情况下显著改善奖励与多样性之间的权衡。

Abstract: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In particular, RefMix uses a reference model during early high-noise steps to expose alternative visual modes, followed by the current reward-tuned model for endpoint completion. Across state-of-the-art online forward matching methods, RefMix consistently improves visual diversity while preserving task reward performance. Controlled inference experiments further demonstrate that training-time endpoint exposure is critical to improve reward--diversity trade-offs, beyond the impact of reference-assisted inference. By rethinking how training endpoints are proposed, RefMix achieves up to 44% higher diversity over forward matching baselines at comparable reward levels.

</details>


### [163] [MMotion: Collaborative Cross-Scale Memory for Text-to-Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33819)
*Zhaoxin Fan,Qingchen Yu,Kejian Wu,Jian Yang,Zeming Liu,wenjun wu,Lili Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MMotion，一个协作式多尺度记忆框架，用于文本到人体动作生成，联合利用语义、动态和历史上下文来提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法要么依赖动作样例检索，要么保留长程上下文，但很少利用记忆机制同时推理语义、动态和生成历史。

Method: MMotion 包含三类记忆：语义记忆提供不同生成尺度下的动作先验，动态记忆建模潜在状态转移，工作记忆保存已生成动作的因果上下文；并通过协作融合机制整合互补记忆。该框架与架构无关，可集成到扩散模型和下一尺度自回归模型中。

Result: 在标准基准和多种骨干网络上进行的大量实验表明，MMotion 相比强基线取得了一致性提升。

Conclusion: MMotion 通过多尺度记忆协作有效统一了语义检索、潜在动态建模和因果工作记忆，是一种可广泛集成的文本到动作生成框架。

Abstract: Text-to-motion generation aims to synthesize realistic human motions from natural-language descriptions, enabling applications in animation, virtual avatars, and embodied agents. Despite recent progress, existing methods either retrieve motion exemplars or retain long-range context, but rarely exploit memory to jointly reason about semantics, dynamics, and generation history. In this paper, we propose MMotion, a collaborative multi-scale memory framework that unifies scale-conditioned semantic retrieval, latent dynamics modeling, and causal working memory. Specifically, semantic memory provides motion priors at different generation scales, dynamics memory captures latent state transitions, and working memory preserves causal context from previously generated motions. A collaborative fusion mechanism integrates these complementary memories to determine what motion to generate, how it should evolve, and how it should remain consistent with its history. MMotion is architecture-agnostic and can be readily integrated into both diffusion-based and next scale autoregressive models. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines.

</details>


### [164] [Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33964)
*Yiheng Han,Ziang Chen,Zhuyong Fu,Yiqing Yin,Nan Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Embodied-VGGT，利用具身采集中的平台-环境几何与重复观测线索，在长序列重建中建立并选择性保留可靠的局部几何关系，从而抑制累积漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列重建需要纠正累积漂移，同时保持局部一致的几何结构；机器人/自动驾驶的具身采集提供了重复的平台-环境几何和场景结构、平台运动观测，可用于提升全局优化中的局部关系可靠性。

Method: 方法包括：记忆增强接地块（MAGC）基于全局上下文记忆，利用预测地面几何得到的相对尺度参考正则化测试时记忆更新；超点对齐（SA）平衡空间区域中的地面与非地面证据以估计块间平移；跨环优化（CL）利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性选择连贯块组，并对每组施加共享 Sim(3) 校正，以在全局优化中保留其内部相对变换。

Result: 在五个公开驾驶基准上取得一致且显著的长序列重建提升。KITTI Odometry 上平均绝对轨迹误差为 7.30 m，Chamfer 距离为 2.67 m，在相同评估协议下相较最先进基线分别降低 46.8% 和 23.3%。

Conclusion: Embodied-VGGT 能有效利用具身采集线索提升长序列重建的漂移校正与局部几何保持能力，并在多个驾驶基准上优于现有方法；代码已开源以促进复现。

Abstract: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.

</details>


### [165] [Revisiting Monocular In-Hand Object Scanning: Dataset, Pose Estimation, and Surface Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33824)
*Di Wu,Jeeeun Kim,Shu Kong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究基于普通智能手机单目视频的手持物体扫描（IHOS），构建了ToysRUs数据集，并提出结合分段SfM轨迹拼接与遮挡感知2D高斯泼溅的重建框架，在几何精度和光度保真度上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IHOS有望让非专家用户便捷地进行3D数字化，但受限于缺乏真实数据集和系统基准，相关研究不足；同时，单目视频中的小基线、长程稀疏特征匹配及动态手部遮挡给相机位姿估计和高质量重建带来挑战。

Method: 构建包含多样小雕像、由4K超高清单目视频采集的ToysRUs高质量数据集；从第一性原理分析SfM位姿估计难点；对按足够角度间隔采样的视频子序列分别做SfM，并迭代拼接子轨迹为统一全局轨迹；提出遮挡感知2D Gaussian Splatting，引入不透明度渲染并在手部区域省略不透明度损失以提升表面重建。

Result: 定量和定性实验表明，该框架在几何精度和光度保真度上显著优于现有方法，包括神经隐式表示和3D基础模型。

Conclusion: 该工作通过新数据集、面向IHOS的SfM策略和遮挡感知2D高斯泼溅框架，推动了单目手持物体扫描的系统研究与高质量3D重建。

Abstract: In-Hand Object Scanning (IHOS) from monocular video captured by a commodity smartphone holds immense potential to democratize 3D digitization for non-expert users, facilitating applications in digital archiving, augmented reality, and custom fabrication. Yet, IHOS remains largely understudied due to a lack of realistic datasets and systematic benchmarks. To bridge this gap, we introduce ToysRUs, a high-quality dataset featuring diverse figurines captured by 4K Ultra High-Definition (UHD) monocular videos. Studying IHOS from first principles, we examine structure-from-motion (SfM) for camera pose estimation, which is key to IHOS. We identify two key challenges: small baselines between consecutive frames, and sparse feature matches across large-view, long-range frames, further exacerbated by dynamic hand occlusions. Guided by these insights, we propose performing SfM on video sub-sequences sampled at sufficient angular intervals, and iteratively stitches the corresponding sub-trajectories into a unified global trajectory. Furthermore, for high-fidelity surface reconstruction, we introduce occlusion-aware 2D Gaussian Splatting, which incorporates opacity rendering and omits the opacity loss on hand regions. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing approaches, including neural implicit representations and 3D foundation models, in both geometric accuracy and photometric fidelity.

</details>


### [166] [Incorporating the Knowledge Distillation to Improve the EfficientNet Transfer Learning Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34025)
*Tjeng Wawan Cenggoro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探索将较大 EfficientNet 的知识迁移到较小 EfficientNet，并证明该方法能提升各规模 EfficientNet 的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习在计算机视觉中常以 ImageNet 上的先进架构作为骨干网络，而 EfficientNet 是通过从基线架构逐步扩展得到的。因此作者假设较小的 EfficientNet 能够容纳较大 EfficientNet 的知识，并研究从大模型向小模型迁移是否有益。

Method: 提出一种以知识蒸馏作为知识迁移机制的迁移学习方法，将较大 EfficientNet 架构的知识迁移到较小 EfficientNet 架构，并在多个 EfficientNet 架构上进行实验。

Result: 所提方法能够提升每个 EfficientNet 架构的性能，部分较小架构甚至能够超过使用标准迁移学习方法训练的大架构。

Conclusion: 从较大 EfficientNet 向较小 EfficientNet 进行知识蒸馏迁移是有效的，可提升小模型性能，并使部分小模型具备超越标准训练大模型的表现。

Abstract: Due to the Deep Learning requirement for a large training dataset, Transfer Learning has become a central method in the field of Computer Vision, which heavily used Deep Learning. Since the adoption of transfer learning in the field, the performance of the models in computer vision is significantly upgraded. The common transfer learning practice in computer vision research is to use state-of-the-art architectures in the ImageNet dataset as the backbone network. The best performing architecture in ImageNet is currently held by EfficientNet, which is a set of architectures that were progressively grown from a baseline architecture.
  By observing the EfficientNet development approach, it is natural to hypothesize that the smaller EfficientNet architecture is capable to contain the knowledge of the larger architecture. This hypothesis comes from the fact that the larger EfficientNet architecture was grown from the smaller architecture. Therefore, in this study, we experimented if it is beneficial to transfer the knowledge from the larger architecture to the smaller architecture of the EfficientNet. To achieve this goal, we proposed a transfer learning method that uses Knowledge Distillation as the knowledge transfer mechanism from the larger to smaller architecture. We found that the proposed method is able to upgrade the performance of each of the EfficientNet architecture. Several smaller architectures are even able to outperform the larger architecture that was trained using the standard transfer learning method.

</details>


### [167] [MotionODE: Enhancing Autoregressive Text-to-Motion Generation with Continuous-Depth Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33826)
*Zhaoxin Fan,Jian Yang,Kejian Wu,Zeming Liu,Wenjun Wu,Lili Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MotionODE，一种连续深度后训练框架，用于改进预训练自回归文本到动作生成器中隐藏状态的演化过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多通过改进动作表示或生成顺序来提升自回归文本到动作生成，但对条件动作表示的内部形成过程探索不足；同时局部动作预测需要协调跨时间文本要求与可用动作上下文。

Method: 将预训练 Transformer 中选定的残差分支重新解释为局部向量场，并用中点 Runge-Kutta（RK2）积分替换原始更新，同时保留动作表示和外部生成机制；提出混合一步/两步 RK2 后训练，在动作 token 监督下进行，并可选使用蒸馏和更新映射约束以保持预训练行为。该方法无需从头训练生成器，支持 next-token 和 next-scale 生成。

Result: 在 HumanML3D 上的大量实验表明，MotionODE 在 MoScale、BAMM 和 LMR 上均持续提升文本-动作对齐效果。

Conclusion: 内部表示更新的改进是提升自回归动作生成的一个互补方向；MotionODE 以最小侵入方式优化预训练生成器的隐藏状态演化，并能泛化到不同生成范式。

Abstract: Autoregressive text-to-motion generation requires local motion predictions to reconcile cross-temporal textual requirements with the available motion context. While existing methods primarily improve motion representations and generation order, the internal formation of conditioned motion representations remains less explored. We introduce MotionODE, a continuous-depth post-training framework that refines hidden-state evolution in pretrained autoregressive generators. MotionODE reinterprets selected Transformer residual branches as local vector fields and replaces their original updates with midpoint Runge--Kutta (RK2) integration, while preserving the motion representation and outer generation mechanism. To address the mismatch between pretrained update paths and newly introduced intermediate states, we propose mixed one-step/two-step RK2 post-training under motion-token supervision, with optional distillation and update-map constraints to preserve pretrained behavior. This minimally invasive framework supports both next-token and next-scale generation without training the generator from scratch. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D demonstrate consistent improvements in text--motion alignment across MoScale, BAMM and LMR, highlighting internal representation updates as a complementary direction for improving autoregressive motion generation.

</details>


### [168] [Counter-DECEIVR: Counterfactual Explanations for Deepfake Detectors using Detector-Guided Rectified Flow Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34032)
*Mariano V. Ntrougkas,Vasileios Mezaris,Ioannis Patras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Counter-DECEIVR，一种无需训练的反事实样本生成框架，用于解释深度伪造检测器的决策依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器常呈黑盒性，区域解释在生成质量提升后作用有限；反事实样本能揭示翻转检测器判断所需的最小变化，从而帮助判断检测结果是否可信。

Method: Counter-DECEIVR 利用现成深度伪造检测器的梯度，在 rectified flow 模型的速度场中引导潜变量，无需训练生成器、适配检测器或针对目标数据训练扩散模型；同时利用检测器解释图将编辑集中于显著区域，并用单一参数控制编辑强度。

Result: 在两个深度伪造检测器和两个常用取证数据集上，Counter-DECEIVR 优于此前的反事实生成方法，包括基于训练的方法。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，无需额外训练即可借助检测器梯度和解释图生成局部化反事实样本，为提升深度伪造检测器可信度与可解释性提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Deep-learning-generated media are increasingly passed off as real, driving an arms race between image generators and deepfake detectors. Trust in the latter is limited by their often black-box nature; and, while region-based explanations can sometimes be extracted, these become less useful as generation quality improves. Counterfactual examples, which show the minimal change that flips a detector's decision, reveal what evidence drives a verdict, helping analysts decide whether to trust it. This work introduces Counter-DECEIVR (DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals), a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual examples. Counter-DECEIVR steers latents in the velocity field of a rectified flow model using gradients from off-the-shelf deepfake detectors, without training a generator or adapting the detector; unlike prior methods, it requires no per-instance or per-detector fitting and no diffusion training on the target data. It also leverages the detector's explanation maps to concentrate editing to salient regions, turning low-level feature importance into localised counterfactual edits. A single parameter controls the strength of the edits. Across two deepfake detectors and two widely used forensics datasets, Counter-DECEIVR outperforms prior counterfactual generation methods, including training-based ones. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [169] [3D CoCa v3: Contrastive Learners with Scene Graphs for Urban Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33835)
*Nannan Zhang,Ting Huang,Zeyu Zhang,Haoyu Chen,Yanjie Zhu,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出场景图增强的对比与生成框架3D CoCa v3，用于城市3D场景理解，并构建City3D-9.6K数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D视觉-语言方法多关注全局语义对齐或对象级表示，在统一的对比与生成框架中缺乏对多尺度几何结构和结构化空间关系的建模。

Method: 采用金字塔视觉编码器学习多尺度几何表示，使用基于语言模型的解码器并结合问题引导的标题检索与视觉交叉注意力；引入基于MSG的关系描述增强对比式3D-语言对齐，并构建含多视角视觉-几何观测、场景标题和场景图的City3D-9.6K数据集。

Result: 在City-3DQA上句级和城市级划分的总体top-1准确率分别达88.35%和64.79%，较3D CoCa v2提升20.88和3.57个百分点；在GeoEval3D上取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 3D CoCa v3能有效提升城市空间推理与几何理解能力，验证了场景图增强和多尺度表示在统一对比生成框架中的有效性。

Abstract: Understanding large-scale 3D urban scenes requires representations that capture both multi-scale geometric structures and complex spatial relationships. However, existing 3D vision-language methods primarily emphasize global semantic alignment or object-level representations, leaving structured relational modeling underexplored within unified contrastive and generative frameworks. In this paper, we present 3D CoCa v3, a scene-graph-enhanced contrastive and generative framework for urban 3D scene understanding. Our framework features a Pyramid Vision Encoder for multi-scale geometric representation learning and a language-model-based decoder with question-guided caption retrieval and visual cross-attention. We further introduce MSG-based relational descriptions to enrich contrastive 3D-language alignment with structured spatial relationships. To support semantic and relational supervision, we construct City3D-9.6K, a multi-view urban vision-language dataset with aligned visual-geometric observations, scene captions, and scene graphs. Extensive experiments on City-3DQA demonstrate that 3D CoCa v3 achieves 88.35% and 64.79% overall top-1 accuracy on the sentence-wise and city-wise splits, surpassing 3D CoCa v2 by 20.88 and 3.57 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, 3D CoCa v3 achieves the best performance on GeoEval3D, demonstrating its effectiveness in urban spatial reasoning and geometric understanding. Code is available at https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/3DCoCav3.

</details>


### [170] [Hijacking 3D Generation: Targeted Adversarial Attacks against Image-to-3D Models via Prefix Trajectory Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34075)
*Yilong Yang,Jiale Teng,Yule Liu,Yang Liu,Xinlei He,Zhuo Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出针对Image-to-3D模型的定向对抗攻击PTA3D，通过前缀轨迹对齐和预处理感知优化，在黑盒在线服务中诱导生成违反策略的3D几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线Image-to-3D服务仅在生成前检查上传图像的可见内容，攻击者可利用视觉上无害的图像诱导生成受策略限制的3D几何；但黑盒场景下长DiT生成轨迹难以全局反传，且不同服务的图像预处理流程会降低迁移性。

Method: 提出PTA3D，包含前缀轨迹对齐（PTA）和预处理感知优化（PAO）。PTA逐步对齐对抗轨迹与目标轨迹的前缀DiT输出，在核心几何结构形成阶段控制最终几何，避免优化完整生成轨迹；PAO在多种图像变换而非单一预处理流程下优化对抗样本，以降低对代理服务与目标服务预处理不匹配的敏感性。论文还建立前缀到输出界和预处理感知迁移界进行理论刻画。

Result: 在三个开源Image-to-3D模型和三个在线服务上实验，PTA3D在线服务攻击成功率为41.5%-88.5%，白盒设置下为90.8%-94.6%，显著优于现有攻击。

Conclusion: PTA3D表明仅检查输入图像可见内容不足以保障Image-to-3D服务安全，攻击者可通过前缀轨迹对齐与预处理感知优化实现有效且可迁移的定向对抗攻击。

Abstract: Online services that deploy Image-to-3D models enable users to generate high-quality 3D assets from a single image. However, the generated 3D geometry can violate content policies and cause broader security risks. To prevent such content, these services typically use policy-restricted inspectors to examine uploaded images before generation. Since the inspector examines only the visible content of the input, a visually benign image can still induce the generation of policy-restricted 3D geometry. However, turning this vulnerability into an effective attack is non-trivial in the black-box setting: global backpropagation through the long DiT generation trajectory is difficult to fit, while different image preprocessing pipelines across services can substantially reduce transferability. In this paper, we present PTA3D, a targeted adversarial attack against Image-to-3D models that addresses these challenges through Prefix Trajectory Alignment (PTA) and Preprocessing Aware Optimization (PAO). PTA progressively aligns the prefix DiT outputs of the adversarial trajectory with those of the target trajectory, where the core geometric structure is formed, allowing the final geometry to be controlled without optimizing through the complete generation trajectory. PAO exposes adversarial optimization to diverse image transformations rather than a single preprocessing pipeline, reducing sensitivity to the mismatch between surrogate and target services. We establish a prefix-to-output bound and a preprocessing-aware transfer bound to theoretically characterize the effectiveness of the two designs. Experiments on three open-source Image-to-3D models and three online services show that PTA3D achieves 41.5%-88.5% ASR on online services and 90.8%-94.6% ASR in white box settings, substantially outperforming existing attacks.

</details>


### [171] [SPiXSeg: Rethinking MLLM-based Image Segmentation as Superpixel Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33842)
*Piyush Tiwary,Sohini Dutta,Prathosh A. P*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPiXSeg 将多模态大模型图像分割从逐 patch 预测改为逐 superpixel 标签分配，无需解码器或自回归生成，在参考分割和开放词汇语义分割上取得有竞争力结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 分割方法依赖解码器或 patch 级预测：粗网格会混合前景与背景像素，细网格需要大量预测，自回归掩码生成还带来顺序解码开销，难以兼顾边界精度与效率。

Method: 提出 SPiXSeg，用聚合 patch 级视觉特征形成的 superpixel token 进行逐 superpixel 标签分配；使用现成模型生成任务无关的固定 superpixel 划分并可跨任务复用；Spix-to-Mask 模块在单次 MLLM 前向中直接比较隐藏表示来给每个 superpixel token 打分，无需自回归生成或独立打分网络；选中的 superpixel 直接映射到像素，无需可训练解码头或后处理细化。

Result: 在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 上，使用 LLaVA-1.5-7B 平均 cIoU 为 80.5，使用 InternVL2.5-8B 为 81.9；仅在 COCO-Stuff 上训练后，开放词汇语义分割在 ADE20K、PASCAL Context、PASCAL VOC 上 mIoU 分别为 29.0、59.5、95.4，优于多个 SoTA MLLM 基线。

Conclusion: 实验表明，一个固定的、与查询无关的 superpixel 划分已足以实现准确的语言引导分割，并可避免复杂解码器与细化模块。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for image segmentation. However, existing methods either use a decoder or use patch-based approach which trades boundary precision against the number of decisions as coarse grid cells mix foreground and background pixels, while finer grids require many more predictions, and autoregressive mask generation adds sequential decoding overhead. We propose SPiXSeg, which shifts the output from per-patch to per-superpixel label assignment, using superpixel tokens formed by aggregating patch-level visual features. An off-the-shelf model partitions each image into task-agnostic superpixels, so the partition is computed once and reused across tasks. A Spix-to-Mask (S2M) module scores each superpixel token in a single MLLM forward pass by directly comparing the MLLM's hidden representations, without autoregressive generation or a separate scoring network, and the selected superpixels are mapped directly to pixels without refinement. Without any trainable decoder head or post-hoc refinement, SPiXSeg achieves an average cIoU of 80.5 with LLaVA-1.5-7B and 81.9 with InternVL2.5-8B on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg and, when trained only on COCO-Stuff, extends to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with mIoU of 29.0, 59.5 and 95.4 on ADE20K, PASCAL Context and PASCAL VOC, outperforming several SoTA MLLM baselines. Our results suggest that a fixed, query-agnostic superpixel partition is enough for accurate language-guided segmentation.

</details>


### [172] [WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34079)
*Weilong Yan,Jingyu Hu,Hongli Xu,Yifan Zhan,Beibei Lin,Anbang Wang,Qinqian Lei,Jingwei Huang,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 WorldBridge 框架，可从视觉重叠很少或没有重叠的散乱图像生成连贯、可控的 3D 世界，并构建相应评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何感知方法难以处理散乱且低重叠图像，而图像/视频生成方法虽能补全未见区域，却易产生跨视角几何不一致，因此需要兼顾连贯性与可控性的 3D 世界生成方法。

Method: 将散乱参考图像编码为全局场景上下文以引导跨视角几何与外观生成；设计时空参考注意力机制增强目标轨迹上的时序参考保真度并支持轨迹外空间参考；采用即插即用的潜在参考一致性策略，通过重投影引导的测试时优化提升参考保真度；同时提出 WorldBridge 基准套件。

Result: 定性与定量结果表明，该方法能够实现可控且连贯的 3D 世界生成，并优于现有最先进方案；同时填补了散乱、低重叠参考下 3D 世界生成评测的空白。

Conclusion: WorldBridge 有效弥合了几何感知方法与生成式方法之间的差距，为低重叠散乱图像输入下的可控、连贯 3D 世界生成提供了新框架与评测基准。

Abstract: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/.

</details>


### [173] [Continuous Foundation-Guided Pseudo-Label Weighting for Breast Ultrasound Domain Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33843)
*Xinyu Fan,Xinyi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探索基于基础模型的连续伪标签加权方法，用于乳腺超声分割的无监督域适应；EMA教师生成目标域伪标签，冻结的AutoSAMUS模型提供有界权重来调节像素级监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺超声分割模型在跨扫描仪、跨机构和跨患者群体时泛化能力较差，需要提升无监督域适应性能。

Method: 采用EMA教师生成目标域伪标签；利用冻结的超声分割基础模型AutoSAMUS，将先验确定性与教师概率一致性结合为[0.5,1]的有界权重，对每个目标像素进行连续加权监督；测试阶段无需基础模型推理。在5个公共乳腺超声数据集、3个源域和11个源到目标方向上评估，并与全像素EMA、原始BiRP及U-Net流程比较。

Result: 在TransUNet协议下，连续加权在4个BUSI源目标上均优于全像素EMA和原始BiRP；在4个BUS-BRA源目标上取得最高平均Dice和最低HD95。以BrEaST为源时结果混合：在BUSI上最佳，在OASBUD上与原始BiRP相当，但在BUS-UCLM上所有适应方法均未超过仅源域训练。U-Net流程中仅一致性加权与完整 formulation 表现相当，先验确定性的增量价值仍不明确。

Conclusion: 连续基础模型引导的伪标签加权在部分源-目标方向上有效，但收益依赖数据集和源域；由于加权规则在部分目标测试结果检查后提出，研究应视为探索性，需进一步验证。

Abstract: Breast ultrasound segmentation models often generalize poorly across scanners, institutions, and patient populations. We investigate continuous foundation-guided pseudo-label weighting for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher generates target-domain pseudo-labels, while a frozen ultrasound segmentation model (AutoSAMUS) modulates their contribution using a bounded weight that combines the prior's certainty with its probabilistic agreement with the teacher. In contrast to our earlier selective BiRP rule, the proposed formulation supervises every target pixel with a weight in [0.5, 1] and requires no foundation-model inference at test time. We evaluate the method on five public breast ultrasound datasets, spanning three source domains and eleven source-target directions. Under the TransUNet protocol, continuous weighting outperforms both all-pixel EMA and original BiRP on all four BUSI-source targets, and achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest HD95 among the compared methods on all four BUS-BRA-source targets. Results with BrEaST as the source are mixed: continuous weighting performs best on BUSI and comparably to original BiRP on OASBUD, whereas none of the adaptation methods surpasses source-only training on BUS-UCLM. In a separate U-Net pipeline, agreement-only weighting performs comparably to the full formulation, leaving the incremental value of prior certainty unresolved. Because the weighting rule was developed after some target-test results had been examined, we treat the study as exploratory and report adverse as well as favorable outcomes.

</details>


### [174] [FoundSurface: Feedforward Ray-Based 3D Scene Surface Reconstruction from Unposed Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34128)
*Shenxing Wei,Jinxi Li,Zihui Zhang,Ajay Kumar,Wei Wang,Bo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种从无位姿图像直接恢复连续高保真三维表面的可泛化流程，融合pointmap与ray表示，并在多个未见数据集上展现优异零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从无位姿图像进行准确三维表面重建仍是计算机视觉的基础难题；现有前馈pointmap方法虽无需相机位姿，但只能产生离散稀疏表示。

Method: 先利用预训练pointmap模型提取显式几何先验；通过以查询视角为中心的选择模块和surfel投票机制筛选几何相关参考视图；再用交叉注意力回归器将目标查询射线与参考特征关联，估计连续粗表面；最后用raylet模块聚合局部三维特征，恢复高频细节并估计解析法线。

Result: 在9个数据集上训练为单一基础模型，并在6个未见数据集上实现优异零样本泛化，在几何精度和细节保持方面明显超越现有最优基线。

Conclusion: 通过无缝整合pointmap与ray表示，可从未位姿图像直接重建连续、高保真的三维表面，并具备强泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurate 3D surface reconstruction from unposed images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Recent feed-forward pointmap methods eliminate the need for camera poses but inherently produce discrete, sparse representations. In this paper, we present a generalizable pipeline that directly recovers continuous, high-fidelity 3D surfaces from unposed images by seamlessly integrating pointmap- and ray-based representations. Our approach first extracts explicit geometric priors using a pre-trained pointmap model. A query-view-centric selection module then identifies geometrically relevant reference views via a robust surfel voting mechanism. Next, a cross-attention regressor bridges target query rays with reference features to estimate a continuous coarse surface. Lastly, a raylet-based module aggregates local 3D features to carve out high-frequency details and analytical normals. Trained as a single foundation model on 9 diverse datasets, our method demonstrates exceptional zero-shot generalization on 6 unseen datasets, clearly surpassing state-of-the-art baselines in geometric accuracy and detail preservation.

</details>


### [175] [Hybrid Reinforcement Learning for One-step Degraded Infrared and Visible Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33857)
*Hongwei Yu,Daoqing Zha,Jiawei Li,Yancheng Bai,Lei Sun,Xiangxiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种结合混合强化学习的一步式红外与可见光图像融合框架 OneHRL，用于在复杂退化条件下实现高质量、高效率融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有红外与可见光图像融合方法在复杂退化场景下性能受限；扩散模型虽能增强退化建模能力，但迭代推理计算成本高；一步蒸馏虽可加速，却容易产生过度平滑结果。

Method: 将退化输入视为生成轨迹中的中间噪声状态，使蒸馏后的一步生成器直接将其校正为清晰融合结果；引入 Flow-GRPO 范式为确定性一步生成增加随机性，恢复基于采样的强化学习所需探索；设计由全局语义奖励和对象级奖励组成的由粗到细混合奖励。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在融合质量和效率方面均取得更优表现，并兼顾自然性与细粒度纹理。

Conclusion: OneHRL 通过一步生成与混合强化学习相结合，在降低扩散模型推理成本的同时缓解蒸馏过度平滑问题，为复杂退化下的红外与可见光图像融合提供了高效高质量方案。

Abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) is essential for robust perception, yet existing methods remain limited under complex degradations. While diffusion models (DMs) offer powerful modeling capabilities to combat such degradations, their iterative process incurs high computational cost. One-step distillation effectively accelerates inference but typically leads to over-smoothed results. To resolve these limitations, we propose a one-step fusion framework with hybrid reinforcement learning, termed OneHRL. We treat degraded inputs as intermediate noisy states along a generative trajectory, enabling a distilled one-step generator to rectify them directly to the clean fusion results. Concurrently, to mitigate the over-smoothed results in distillation, we incorporate the Flow-GRPO paradigm to introduce stochasticity into the deterministic one-step generation. This restores the stochastic exploration necessary for sampling-based reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we design a coarse-to-fine reward that integrates a global semantic reward with an object-level reward. This hybrid reward ensures that the generator captures both naturalness and fine-grained texture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior fusion quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [176] [Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34152)
*Luoxi Zhang,Tianyi Tan,Jiawei Liu,Xingyu Zeng,Min Yang,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GridProbe，一个用于多模态大模型空间规划能力诊断的基准，通过端到端求解与多项探针结合，定位失败发生在视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划阶段，并用针对性微调验证诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格游戏基准多只报告端到端成功率，无法区分失败源于视觉感知、规则应用还是多步规划，难以指导模型改进。

Method: GridProbe 在 Sokoban 上结合端到端求解与四类探针：识别、定位、单步预测和状态跟踪；每个棋盘同时提供图像和等价文本网格；评估七个 MLLM，并在 Sokoban 和迷宫游戏中用针对性微调验证诊断。

Result: 相似成功率背后存在不同瓶颈：闭源模型主要受多步规划限制，开源模型受规则应用或视觉网格索引限制；规划失败会掩盖感知失败，规划变容易时同一模型的视觉成本从 7.6 增至 37.7 分；仅微调感知受限模型的视觉模块，可使交互式 Sokoban 成功率从 5.8% 提升到 20.4%（3.5 倍），并零样本迁移到未见迷宫游戏，单轮成功率从 13.8% 提升到 67.1%；该方法对规则受限模型无效，用求解器解训练也无增益。

Conclusion: GridProbe 能诊断 MLLM 空间规划中的具体瓶颈，并识别应训练的能力；针对性视觉微调可显著提升感知受限模型的表现并迁移到新任务，而错误定位瓶颈时训练无效。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. Evaluating seven MLLMs on Sokoban and a maze game reveals distinct bottlenecks behind similar success rates: proprietary models are limited by multi-step planning, whereas open-source models are limited by rule application or by visual grid indexing, i.e., counting rows and columns. Planning failures also hide perception failures: when planning is easier, the visual cost of the same model grows from 7.6 to 37.7 points. The diagnosis identifies what to train: fine-tuning only the vision module of the perception-limited model on board reading raises its interactive Sokoban success 3.5-fold (5.8% to 20.4%) and transfers zero-shot to the unseen maze game (single-turn success 13.8% to 67.1%), whereas the same data does not help a rule-limited model and training on solver solutions brings no gain. We will release the benchmark and code at https://github.com/suat-llm/GridProbe.

</details>


### [177] [Structured Noise Diffusion for Echocardiography Haze Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33860)
*Zike Luo,Hao Li,Mengxiao Wang,Qingya Li,Ching-Hui Sia,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结构感知扩散框架，用于去除超声心动图图像中空间结构化的雾状伪影，并在公开与私有数据集上取得最佳平均GCNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声心动图常受空间结构化雾状伪影影响，遮蔽解剖边界并妨碍临床分析；传统扩散模型使用像素独立高斯噪声，难以表征局部超声雾状伪影。

Method: 将超声雾状伪影建模为受超声扇形几何约束的局部高斯分量累积；前向过程通过采样分量位置和尺度生成空间相关退化；反向恢复中使用双头网络预测锚点概率图和高斯尺度参数，逐步去除结构化伪影并减少直接坐标回归的中心偏差。

Result: 在公开DehazingEcho2025基准和两个私有临床数据集上评估，且未在私有队列上重训练或微调；方法在三个数据集上均取得最高平均GCNR，公开基准达到0.715±0.090，同时保留组织边缘。

Conclusion: 所提结构感知扩散框架更能反映真实超声回声伪影的空间特性，可有效去除结构化伪影并表现出良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Echocardiographic images are frequently degraded by spatially structured haze artifacts that obscure anatomical boundaries and hinder clinical analysis. Conventional diffusion models typically employ pixel-independent Gaussian noise, limiting their ability to represent localized ultrasound haze. In this study, we propose a structure-informed diffusion framework that explicitly models ultrasound haze as an accumulation of localized Gaussian components constrained by the ultrasound fan geometry. The forward process generates spatially correlated corruption by sampling component locations and scales, providing a formulation that better reflects the spatial characteristics of real echo artifacts. During reverse restoration, a dual-head network predicts an anchor probability map and Gaussian scale parameters to progressively remove structured artifacts while reducing the center bias associated with direct coordinate regression. We evaluated the framework on the public DehazingEcho2025 benchmark and two private clinical datasets, without retraining or fine-tuning on either private cohort. Our method achieved the highest mean generalized contrast-to-noise ratio across all three datasets, reaching $0.715 \pm 0.090$ on the public benchmark while preserving tissue edges.

</details>


### [178] [Beyond Logits: Coherent Hallucination Mitigation via Attention Contrastive Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34207)
*Yujia Chen,Rui Sun,Huayu Mai,Wangkai Li,Zhangyu He,Bingzhou Wang,Aibing Li,Wenzhang Sun,Tianzhu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练、可即插即用的注意力对比解码方法ACD，将部分对比操作从logit层迁移到注意力机制，以更早、更平滑地抑制LVLM幻觉并保持生成连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对比解码方法主要在logit层对比业余与专家分支来缓解大型视觉语言模型幻觉，但这种logit级干预会破坏生成连贯性，并需要与幻觉抑制无关的限制性惩罚约束。

Method: 提出Attention Contrastive Decoding（ACD），在前向传播更早阶段对注意力机制进行对比操作；通过Adaptive Subtraction Strategy（ASS）进行平滑且语义保持的干预，削弱与幻觉相关的注意力模式并增强关键视觉信息；ACD无需训练，可与现有CD方法结合使用。

Result: 大量实验表明，将ACD与现有CD方法结合（如VCD+ACD）可显著提升输出连贯性，同时进一步减少幻觉，并消除限制性惩罚约束。

Conclusion: 将部分对比解码从logit层迁移到注意力层是有效且互补的方向，ACD能够在无需额外训练和限制性惩罚的情况下实现更可信的多模态生成。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive multimodal capabilities, yet suffer from hallucination - generating factually inaccurate content. Contrastive Decoding (CD) mitigates this by contrasting amateur and expert branches at the logit level. However, our investigation reveals that such logit-level interventions fundamentally compromise generation coherence, necessitating restrictive penalty constraints unrelated to hallucination suppression.
  We introduce Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD), a training-free plug-in that complements logit-level CD by relocating part of the contrastive operations to the attention mechanism. Operating at an earlier stage of the forward pass, ACD performs smooth semantic-preserving interventions through an Adaptive Subtraction Strategy (ASS), which attenuates hallucination-associated attention patterns while amplifying critical visual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that combining ACD with existing CD methods (e.g., VCD+ACD) produces substantially more coherent outputs with further reduced hallucinations, eliminating restrictive penalties while enabling trustworthy multimodal generation.

</details>


### [179] [OmniMeld: Enhancing Audio-Visual Understanding via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33861)
*Daili Hua,Yifan Dai,Bohan Zeng,Yuran Wang,Zihao Wu,Chengzhuo Tong,Guoqing Jiang,Liwei Chen,Zhiheng Qin,Xuanping Li,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 OmniMeld，一种多教师在线策略蒸馏方法，通过模态-响应引导的分布匹配整合不同领域教师能力，用于音视频理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频理解需要感知基础、时间理解和语义推理等多方面能力；多教师蒸馏可整合这些能力，但直接概率匹配难以显式捕捉教师预测在音视频条件下的变化。

Method: 训练四个覆盖不同能力域的教师模型；根据学生生成答案前缀将样本路由到对应教师；利用完整音视频输入下教师对共享候选词预测变化构建传输代价，并通过最优传输将学生预测与教师预测匹配；构建 OmniMeld-20K 数据集用于领域专家教师训练。

Result: 在音视频和通用视频理解基准上，同规模开源模型中教师表现具有竞争力；学生模型在所有评估基准上均优于基座模型，并在若干基准上超过教师的基座模型。

Conclusion: OmniMeld 能有效整合多教师领域专长，提升学生模型的音视频理解能力，并验证了基于模态响应引导的分布匹配蒸馏的有效性。

Abstract: Audio-visual understanding requires perceptual grounding, temporal understanding, and semantic inference. Multi-teacher distillation can consolidate these capabilities, but direct probability matching does not explicitly capture teacher prediction changes across audio-visual conditions. We introduce OmniMeld, a multi-teacher on-policy distillation method that integrates domain expertise through modality-response-guided distribution matching. We train four teachers covering grounding and correspondence, temporal dynamics and event structure, causal and inferential reasoning, and contextual and holistic understanding. Each sample is routed to its corresponding teacher for supervision conditioned on student-generated answer prefixes. We derive transport costs from teacher prediction changes over shared candidate tokens across audio-visual conditions, using optimal transport to match student predictions to those of the teacher under complete audio-visual input. We also construct OmniMeld-20K for domain-specialized teacher training. The dataset spans four capability domains, with responses structured into evidence, reasoning, and answer sections and verified through consistency checks and media-based review. Experiments on audio-visual and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate competitive teacher performance among similarly sized open-source models. The student improves over its base model across all evaluated benchmarks and surpasses the teachers' base model on several benchmarks.

</details>


### [180] [GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34218)
*Fadi Abdeladhim Zidi,Andrea De Salve,Giuseppe Celeste,Abdellah Zakaria Sellam,Paolo Spagnolo,Cosimo Distante*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GeoCAM，一个地理引导的跨模态自监督框架，用于在无语义标注情况下学习侧扫声呐与水下光学图像的共享嵌入空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法未充分利用真实光学-声学调查中一对多对应关系和地理元数据，限制了从大量无标注海洋数据中学习语义有意义且几何一致的表示。

Method: GeoCAM 包含三个组件：集合注意力聚合器，将多个光学观测自适应汇总为瓦片级表示；几何加权 InfoNCE 目标，将 GPS 推导的覆盖区域重叠转化为软正样本监督；可选的跨模态掩码重建分支，促进物理合理的跨模态对齐。

Result: 在 BenthiCat SSS-CAM 数据集上，GeoCAM 能有效学习哪些声呐和相机样本描述同一海底区域，并在跨模态检索和对齐上优于强对比学习基线。

Conclusion: 地理引导的跨模态自监督学习可有效利用无标注光学-声学配对数据，提升侧扫声呐与水下光学图像之间的表示学习和对齐能力。

Abstract: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. GeoCAM achieves its goal by combining three components: (i) a Set Attention Aggregator that adaptively summarizes multiple optical observations into a single tile-level representation; (ii) a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective that converts GPS-derived footprint overlap into soft positive supervision; and (iii) an optional cross-modal masked reconstruction branch that encourages physically grounded cross-modal alignment. Experiments on the BenthiCat SSS-CAM dataset show that GeoCAM can be effectively exploited to learn which sonar and camera samples describe the same seabed patch, improving cross-modal retrieval and alignment over strong contrastive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/FadiZidiDz/GeoCAM.

</details>


### [181] [A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34115)
*Jitai Hao,Liangxing Yang,Zhenyang Li,Fan Liu,Qiang Huang,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SimpleUAV，一种基于冻结现成视觉语言模型、无需训练的开放世界空中目标搜索智能体。它将当前视角目标评估与历史条件动作选择分离，结合局部几何、深度检查和执行反馈形成闭环，无需持久空间地图或任务特定训练，并在多个空中搜索与 VLN 基准上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放世界空中目标搜索方法常依赖持久空间地图、学习到的世界模型或任务特定策略训练，计算与工程复杂度较高。作者希望探究最小化、免训练设计能达到何种性能上限。

Method: SimpleUAV 使用冻结的现成 VLM，将当前视角目标判断与基于历史的动作选择解耦；融合新鲜候选证据与轻量搜索上下文；利用局部几何将视觉选择转化为有界直线运动，通过深度检查停止受阻路段，并用执行反馈指导后续决策，形成无需持久地图和任务训练的闭环搜索。

Result: 在 UAV-ON 上达到 41.61% 成功率，对比最强先前基线 23.80%；在 AerialDojo-200K 上达到 11.98%，对比 3.20%。经有限基准适配后，同一核心智能体迁移至 TravelUAV 的空中 VLN，在 L1 辅助下三个划分的 Full SR 均至少提升 19.66%。

Conclusion: SimpleUAV 以极简、免训练架构建立了强基线，表明无需复杂地图或任务训练也能有效进行空中搜索与导航；同时为评估何时需要额外架构复杂性提供了参照。

Abstract: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

</details>


### [182] [MAFNet-UR$^3$: Mask-Aware Fusion Network for Unified Raindrop and Reflection Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33866)
*Yeongjin Jeong,Hyunjin Cho,Minsang Kim,Jiwon Lee,Jae Woong Soh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MAFNet-UR$^3$，用于统一去除挡风玻璃上同时出现的雨滴与反射（UR$^3$），通过三阶段框架利用多观测信息实现场景一致恢复，并在 RDRF-testing 基准和 LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge 中取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雨滴和反射常同时出现在挡风玻璃上并共同遮挡场景内容，统一去除高度病态。现有扩散模型方法虽能生成视觉上合理的修复结果，但在严重损坏区域可能生成与场景不一致的结构。

Method: 提出三阶段 MAFNet-UR$^3$ 框架：Stage I 抑制雨滴并保留反射层；Stage II 进行先验引导的反射去除及图像空间细化；Stage III 从中间恢复结果估计退化掩码，提供退化线索，并在多观测间进行掩码感知的多尺度融合，以保留场景结构和细节。

Result: MAFNet-UR$^3$-L 在 RDRF-testing 基准上达到 state-of-the-art，PSNR 比 DiffUR$^3$ 高 2.33 dB，挑战赛分数高 2.7634；在 LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge 中排名第三，最终得分 41.1416。

Conclusion: 该三阶段、多观测融合的统一去除框架能够有效缓解扩散模型在严重损坏区域的结构不一致问题，并更好地保留场景结构与细节，验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Raindrops and reflections frequently co-occur on windshields and jointly obscure scene content, making their unified removal, referred to as UR$^3$, a highly ill-posed problem. Existing approaches are mainly based on diffusion models and thus can produce visually plausible restorations. However, they may generate scene-inconsistent structures in severely corrupted regions. To address this limitation, we propose MAFNet-UR$^3$, which adopts a three-stage framework to exploit multiple observations for scene-consistent unified raindrop and reflection removal. Specifically, Stage I suppresses raindrops while preserving the reflection layer, and Stage II performs prior-guided reflection removal followed by image-space refinement. Stage III estimates degradation masks from intermediate restoration results to provide degradation cues and performs mask-aware multi-scale fusion across observations to preserve scene structure and fine details. As a result, our proposed MAFNet-UR$^3$-L achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RDRF-testing benchmark, outperforming DiffUR$^3$ by 2.33 dB in PSNR and 2.7634 in the challenge score. Our method ranked third in the LoViF 2026 UR$^3$ Challenge, achieving a final score of 41.1416.

</details>


### [183] [Can Visual World Models See Force?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34422)
*Felix Tristram,Benjamin D. Killeen,Nassir Navab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文探究视觉基础模型表示是否感知机器人操作中的交互力，并用冻结表示加轻量读出在同步视频与力数据上评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型和视觉-语言-动作策略模型常被作为机器人操作基础，但成功操作不仅依赖可见轨迹，还依赖隐藏的交互力；人类具有对力的视觉先验，因此作者追问视觉基础模型表示是否也捕捉交互力。

Method: 作者将力感知定义为表示能判断接触力何时施加、跟踪交互中力如何变化、反映力的大小；在两个操作数据集的同步视频与力测量上，用轻量读出探测冻结的图像、视频、世界模型和策略模型表示。

Result: 实验显示多数模型能捕捉接触何时发生，但不能反映施加力的大小；出乎意料的是，机器人后训练也没有改善这一能力。

Conclusion: 当前视觉基础模型在交互力感知方面存在重要能力缺口，尤其是对力大小的表征不足。

Abstract: World models and vision-language-action policy models are increasingly proposed as foundations for robot manipulation. They predict how scenes evolve and which actions to take, yet successful manipulation depends not solely on following observable trajectories but also on the hidden variable of interaction force. Neurophysiology has shown that humans possess a visual prior for this hidden variable, motivating us to ask the question: Do the representations of visual foundation models also capture the forces involved in an interaction? We define force awareness as the ability of representations to (1) indicate when contact force is applied, (2) track how it changes during an interaction, and (3) reflect how large it is. We probe frozen image, video, world- and policy model representations with a lightweight readout trained on synchronized video and force measurements from two manipulation datasets. Our experiments show that most models capture when contact occurs but not how much force is being applied. Surprisingly, robot post-training does not improve this either, highlighting an important gap in current models capabilities.

</details>


### [184] [StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34290)
*Modi Jin,Xuying Zhang,Yijing Guo,Haoran Li,Yanwen Ma,Jing Wang,Chenyu Ge,Ming-Ming Cheng,Haoyang Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 StateWeaver，一种面向长视频生成的智能体工作流，通过主动状态与分层协作机制，提升跨镜头一致性和事件驱动状态变化的正确呈现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基础模型能生成高质量短视频，但长视频中跨镜头一致性差、事件驱动状态变化难以正确表达；已有智能体流程因持续规划与修复导致上下文累积，且参考更新受限。

Method: StateWeaver 结合主动状态（Active States）与分层协作（Hierarchical Collaboration）。主动状态将评审中发现的状态差异转化为具体视觉资产需求，指导参考构建、验证与再生成，在保留身份和已正确内容的同时修复目标属性；将确认的生成结果与资产状态、故事时间和参考版本关联，供后续镜头验证和复用。分层协作按任务、片段和修复轮次隔离执行上下文，并用分层记忆跨多组组织流程。

Result: 在多个基准上，StateWeaver 优于现有方法，并在预定义和自主规划的故事板下生成长视频，保持持续的跨镜头一致性。

Conclusion: StateWeaver 通过状态驱动的参考更新与跨镜头状态继承，有效缓解长视频生成中的一致性与状态变化问题，为长视频智能体生成提供可行方案。

Abstract: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. Confirmed generation results are linked to the corresponding asset states, story time, and reference versions for verification and reuse by subsequent shots. Hierarchical Collaboration isolates execution contexts by task, clip, and repair round, and uses hierarchical memory to organize this process across multiple sets. Across multiple benchmarks, StateWeaver outperforms existing methods and produces long videos with sustained cross-shot consistency under predefined and autonomously planned storyboards.

</details>


### [185] [Concept Generalization in Visual Brain Decoding via Encoder-Generated fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33870)
*Peter Yongho Kim,Juhyeon Park,Dongsheng Li,Yansen Wang,Dongqi Han,Mingqing Xiao,Taesup Moon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨fMRI到图像解码器对未见语义概念的泛化能力，发现解码器在语义留出概念上性能明显下降，而直接映射预训练视觉表征到体素的脑编码器更稳健；利用编码器生成合成fMRI数据加入解码器训练，可显著恢复未见概念上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉脑解码器通常在相似语义分布上训练和评估，其对未见概念的泛化能力尚不清楚；作者希望理解并改善解码器对留出语义概念的泛化。

Method: 从目标被试训练数据中留出语义概念，比较三种fMRI到图像解码器与脑编码器在概念泛化上的表现；使用将预训练视觉表征映射到体素的编码器为新图像生成合成fMRI响应，并将图像-fMRI对加入解码器训练；在三种解码器、四名被试和十二个语义概念上评估，并分析编码器训练条件、编码器设计和合成数据控制。

Result: 三种近期fMRI到图像解码器在留出概念上性能大幅下降，即使这些概念在多被试模型中仍可用；脑编码器对相同语义留出更稳健。合成数据能恢复未见概念上损失性能的相当一部分，且无需额外耗时fMRI采集，并在广泛数据预算下改善总体解码性能。增益依赖编码器泛化能力和合成监督的语义内容，而不仅是增加训练数据量。

Conclusion: 编码器生成的fMRI可以将语义泛化能力迁移给解码器，从而提升解码器对未见概念的泛化表现。

Abstract: Visual brain decoders are typically trained and evaluated on stimuli drawn from similar semantic distributions, leaving their ability to reconstruct unseen concepts poorly understood. We study this concept generalization problem by withholding semantic concepts from a target subject's training data. We find that three recent fMRI-to-image decoders degrade substantially for the held-out concepts, even when the concept remains available for multi-subject models. In contrast, brain encoders that map a pretrained visual representation directly to voxels are markedly more robust to the same semantic holdout. Motivated by this asymmetry, we use such an encoder to generate synthetic fMRI responses for new images and add the resulting image-fMRI pairs to decoder training. Across three decoders, four subjects, and twelve semantic concepts, synthetic data recovers a substantial fraction of the performance lost on unseen concepts without requiring additional, time-consuming fMRI acquisition. We further show that the same approach improves general decoding performance across a wide range of data budgets. Analyses of encoder training conditions, encoder designs, and synthetic-data controls show that the gains depend on both encoder generalization and the semantic content of the synthetic supervision, rather than merely increasing the amount of training data. Together, our results show that encoder-generated fMRI can transfer semantic generalization to decoders.

</details>


### [186] [ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34480)
*Lingxiang Hu,Zhenjun Zhao,Qi Shao,Naima Ait Oufroukh,Fabien Bonardi,Raymond Ghandour,Shenghai Yuan,Javier Civera,Baoru Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究如何将稠密前馈几何预测与稀疏度量尺度VIO锚点对齐，提出ProManO，通过概率流形优化在保持预标定内参的前提下估计Sim(3)之外的三个自由度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，相似变换无法表示随深度变化的畸变，而投影变换会改变预标定内参，因此需要一种既兼容内参又能对齐稠密预测与VIO锚点的方法。

Method: 作者证明与预标定内参兼容的变换构成十维流形；在Sim(3)之外存在三个定位无穷远平面的自由度。提出ProManO概率流形优化框架，在单一EM过程中按沿射线不确定性和内点概率加权每个锚点，认证相似变换同步，并仅在可观测处细化无穷远平面。

Result: 在EuRoC、CID-SIMS、Oxford Spires和KITTI-360上实验表明，ProManO取得最高平均F1，并在四个数据集上均优于Sim(3)对齐。

Conclusion: ProManO能够在不破坏预标定内参的情况下完成稠密前馈几何与稀疏度量VIO锚点的对齐，且保证目标值不劣于最优相似变换对齐。

Abstract: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at https://h0xg.github.io/ProManO/.

</details>


### [187] [X-Matte: VAE-Free Pixel-Space Flow Matching for Single-Step Image Matting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33874)
*Zanyi Wang,Jiaang Li,Dengyang Jiang,Ziru Wang,Chengzu Li,Davit Abrahamyan,Harry Yang,Serge Belongie,Mengmeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 X-Matte，一种无 VAE、像素空间的流匹配单步图像抠图框架，兼顾精度与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练生成模型用于抠图时多依赖 VAE，但 VAE 的空间压缩会损害 alpha 细节，并带来额外推理开销。
