Method: X-Matte 去除潜在空间压缩，在像素空间直接建模 RGB 到 alpha 的连续流；采用轨迹级 x-prediction 和过渡感知 alpha 监督，实现单次前向预测目标 alpha，无需 VAE 编解码和迭代采样。

Result: 在 P3M 基准上与先进无 trimap 抠图方法性能相当，并在 RWP-636 和 AIM-500 上展现良好零样本泛化；高分辨率下相较构造的单步潜空间对应方法最高实现 9.4 倍推理加速。

Conclusion: 无 VAE 的像素空间建模能够有效提升图像抠图的准确性与效率。

Abstract: Pre-trained generative models offer rich visual priors for image matting, but their adaptation often relies on variational autoencoders (VAEs), whose spatial compression can degrade fine alpha details and introduce additional inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose X-Matte, a VAE-free pixel-space flow matching framework for single-step image matting. By eliminating latent compression, X-Matte formulates the RGB-to-alpha transition as a continuous flow directly in pixel space. We adopt trajectory-wide x-prediction with transition-aware alpha supervision, enabling the model to learn from intermediate states while directly predicting the target alpha matte in a single forward pass. This design avoids both VAE encoding and decoding and iterative sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate performance competitive with state-of-the-art trimap-free matting methods on P3M benchmarks, together with promising zero-shot generalization to RWP-636 and AIM-500. Moreover, X-Matte achieves up to a 9.4x inference speedup over a constructed single-step latent counterpart at high resolution, demonstrating the effectiveness of VAE-free pixel-space modeling for accurate and efficient image matting.

</details>


### [188] [WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34292)
*Tianxiang Jiang,Sheng Xia,Yilin Long,Kanghui Tian,Linquan Wu,Yongheng Zhang,Daixian Liu,Di Yin,Yi Wang,Yu Qiao,Qinglong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 WebVibe 与 Interactive-SDPO 来训练 InteractiveCoder，用于从设计规格生成具备多页面路由和有状态组件交互的功能性网站。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型多将单张截图翻译为静态 HTML，生成交互式网站仍受多页面路由和状态化组件过渡困扰。现有训练流程有两个瓶颈：前向数据合成 X->Y 在代码执行前编写规格 X，会把未实现或被改动的需求作为监督噪声；强化学习中的标量奖励丢弃了回放中丰富的状态转移信息。

Method: WebVibe 将合成方向反转为 Y->X：先在浏览器中验证跨页面和页面内交互，再从回放确认的状态导出多模态输入，构建含 31,542 个网站的 WebVibe-32K 语料及可复用执行契约。Interactive-SDPO 让权重共享的自教师模型基于回放轨迹和 2x2 状态转移拼图提供 token 级监督，且推理时零额外开销。

Result: 在公开 Vision2Web L2 上，单次 InteractiveCoder-9B 的功能分数从基线的 20.2 提升到 55.2 FS，接近 3 倍，并在单次生成中匹配 1T 参数编码智能体，总参数少 111 倍、token 少 78 倍。在 WebVibeBench 上，InteractiveCoder-4B 和 9B 比所有评估基线高出 23 分以上。

Conclusion: 通过反转并验证数据合成过程，以及利用回放轨迹进行 token 级自监督，可显著提升交互式网站生成的功能正确性与效率。

Abstract: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. Interactive-SDPO then conditions a weight-sharing self-teacher on the replay trace and a 2x2 state-transition montage to provide token-level supervision at zero inference-time overhead. On the public Vision2Web L2, one-shot InteractiveCoder-9B nearly 3x its base model's functional score (20.2 to 55.2 FS) and matches a 1T-parameter coding agent in a single pass with 111x fewer total parameters and 78x fewer tokens. On our WebVibeBench, InteractiveCoder-4B and 9B further outperform all evaluated baselines by over 23 points.

</details>


### [189] [Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34489)
*Yifan Jin,Zheng Zhang,Tianwen Qian,Dong Wang,Bo Zhao,Yanwei Fu,Yuqian Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究第一人称（ego）图像中相机佩戴者识别问题，并将其扩展到机器人、车辆、动物和无人机等多类载体，同时涵盖佩戴者分割、缺失预测和ego-exo双视角相机互定位。作者构建FindEgo-1M数据集，提出基于极几何关系的EgoRay-ZS与EgoRay方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称图像只能说明相机看到了什么，不能说明谁或什么携带相机。现有研究多局限于人类佩戴者且范围较窄，因此需要更通用的方法回答“谁是ego”“ego在哪里”以及双视角相机相对定位问题。

Method: 构建FindEgo-1M数据集，包含116万对真实与模拟ego-exo图像、12类佩戴者、17个域和111种测试设置。利用ego相机在exo图像中的投影（极点）位于或靠近佩戴者的几何关系，提出无需训练的EgoRay-ZS，将冻结的前馈3D重建模型VGGT-Ω转化为佩戴者识别与分割方案；并通过姿态监督训练和候选掩码约束的无标签测试时自适应开发完整EgoRay模型。

Result: EgoRay-ZS在TF2023原始标签上达到78.0%识别准确率，高于数据集训练的PEN的52.9%。在FindEgo-1M上，EgoRay在已见和未见设置上分别取得87.1和77.7的 chance-corrected 准确率，达到state-of-the-art；在匹配查询上分别比GPT-6 Astra高31.6和21.3个百分点，且运行速度快18倍。

Conclusion: 研究表明，利用ego-exo视角间的极几何关系可有效实现通用相机佩戴者识别、分割与互定位。EgoRay在无需任务特定训练或有限监督下表现优异，并具备跨载体、跨域泛化能力。数据、代码和模型将公开。

Abstract: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.

</details>


### [190] [Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33878)
*Lena Wild,Christian Helten,Katie Z Luo,Jakob Thumm,Rafael Valencia,Patric Jensfelt,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Road-KSU 框架，将 HD 地图和参与者标注转化为道路中心场景图，并用道路问答、推理任务和轨迹合规指标，系统评估端到端驾驶策略是否真正内化了道路知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶策略在推理时越来越多地不依赖显式 HD 地图，因此需要弄清它们究竟学到了可泛化的道路知识，还是仅记住了训练中见过的道路几何。

Method: 构建 Road-KSU，将 HD 地图与 actor 标注自动转换为道路中心场景图，生成道路聚焦的问答与推理目标，并加入基于地图的轨迹合规指标；结合地理不相交划分，设计输出模态（语言 vs. 动作）与地点熟悉度（见过 vs. 未见过道路）的 2×2 评估，并在 NAVSIM 上分析已发表规划器、重训练与数据扩展实验。

Result: NAVSIM 中 95% 测试样本距训练样本不超过 10m，13 个已发表规划器在转弯上的得分随测试地点训练驾驶次数增加而陡升，显示道路几何记忆；地理不相交重训练后，动作空间性能在陌生转弯上下降最明显，失败主要来自几何合规，而道路中心 VQA 在直路和弯路上均下降、动态场景内容上保持稳定；数据扩展呈现双重分离：同地点更多驾驶提升未见过道路驾驶但道路问答不变，固定预算分散到更多地点的道路问答提升而驾驶性能变化很小。

Conclusion: 更高的驾驶分数并不必然意味着对未见过道路有更广的道路理解；地理多样性是获得可迁移道路知识的关键。

Abstract: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

</details>


### [191] [SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34414)
*Shuyuan Zhang,Changjian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SemProxy 轻量中间表示与 ProxyStudio 界面，用带标签的 3D 包围盒作为语义代理，连接人类直观交互与编码智能体的 3D 建模流程，实现可控的人机协作建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本提示和参考图像的 3D 建模工作流难以准确表达空间意图，往往需要反复迭代修正；用户难以有效控制编码智能体的建模过程。

Method: 将 SemProxy 实例化为带标签的 3D 包围盒，让用户直接指定物体部件和空间布局，而将几何细节交给编码智能体；代理可序列化为结构化文本并渲染为图像，使现有编码智能体无需额外训练或修改即可使用；开发 ProxyStudio，整合文本、图像参考和交互式 3D 代理编辑；在对象级和场景级任务中使用不同编码智能体验证通用性，并通过用户研究评估效果。

Result: 展示了 SemProxy 在对象级和场景级建模任务中、结合不同编码智能体的通用性；用户研究评估了其在支持可控的人机协作 3D 建模方面的有效性。

Conclusion: SemProxy 可作为直观人类交互与智能体 3D 建模之间的桥梁，更精确地表达空间意图并提升建模可控性，支持无需额外训练的人机协作 3D 建模工作流。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

</details>


### [192] [Motion Beyond Pixels: Learning Future Visual Representations for Object-Centric Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34644)
*Chengzhi Zhao,Juelin Li,Zhennan Wang,Sheng Wang,Zhuoman Liu,Yuhao Lu,Jiongxu Chen,Haitang Feng,Yanjie Li,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MotionRep，一种视觉表示世界模型，联合生成未来 DINO 表示与 3D 物体流，将语义与几何信息同以物体为中心的动态耦合起来，用于具身操作中的未来状态预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型多在面向 RGB 重建优化的潜空间中预测未来状态，未显式优先考虑与运动生成相关的物体级语义和几何信息。

Method: 提出 DINO-VAE，通过时间与通道压缩及潜变量正则化，将高维 DINO 特征压缩为紧凑潜变量并保留语义与几何信息；在初始观测、物体查询点和语言指令条件下，使用统一扩散 Transformer 通过联合注意力预测未来视觉表示和 3D 物体流；采用非对称模态特定噪声调度，使视觉流在联合去噪中领先于 3D 物体流，从而用逐步细化的未来视觉表示引导流生成。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界操作基准上，MotionRep 在 3D 物体流准确性和对未见场景的泛化上优于基于像素的基线，并且推理仅需 3 步去噪。

Conclusion: 预测性视觉表示可作为以物体为中心动态建模的有效未来状态空间。

Abstract: Many embodied world models predict future states in latent spaces optimized for RGB reconstruction, which do not explicitly prioritize object-level semantics and geometry relevant to motion generation. We present MotionRep, a visual representation world model that jointly generates future DINO representations and 3D object flow, coupling semantic and geometric information with object-centric dynamics. To make high-dimensional DINO features amenable to generative modeling, we introduce DINO-VAE, which combines temporal and channel compression with latent regularization to produce compact latents while preserving semantic and geometric information. Conditioned on an initial observation, object query points, and a language instruction, a unified diffusion transformer predicts future visual representations and 3D object flow through joint attention. MotionRep employs asymmetric modality-specific noise schedules to keep the visual stream ahead of 3D object flow during joint denoising, allowing progressively refined future visual representations to guide flow generation. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MotionRep outperforms pixel-based baselines in 3D object flow accuracy and generalization to unseen scenes, while requiring only three denoising steps for inference. These results support predictive visual representations as an effective future-state space for object-centric dynamics modeling.

</details>


### [193] [LayoutRecall: Preserving Appearance in Multi-Round 3D Layout-Controlled Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33885)
*Yankuan Chi,Xin Lin,Baihan Yang,Yuheng Liu,Jason Li,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 LayoutRecall，一种多轮 3D 布局控制图像编辑器，通过 3D 框局部坐标存储并复用物体外观，使物体在被遮挡或移出视野后再次出现时仍能恢复原有外观；同时发布多轮基准 LayoutLoop。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮编辑中，物体可能因遮挡或离开视野而丢失外观，而目标布局又要求其重新出现在指定位置，因此需要从早期观测中恢复并复用其外观。

Method: 使用 Box-Surface Latent Memory 在 3D 框表面保存图像潜变量，并在目标视角下沿射线检索；通过 Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning 将检索到的 token 以目标视角位置、共享框局部嵌入和物体级注意力注入 FLUX.2 编辑器；引入 correspondence loss 促使去噪时关注匹配观测；构建带校准布局和设计回访的 LayoutLoop 基准。

Result: 在 LayoutLoop 和真实场景数据上的大量实验验证了方法恢复物体外观并实现多轮 3D 布局控制编辑的能力。

Conclusion: LayoutRecall 能够在多轮编辑中持续保留并重用物体外观，有效应对遮挡和移出视野场景，并为多轮 3D 布局控制编辑提供了系统评估基准。

Abstract: 3D layout-controlled image editing gives users explicit control over object placement and camera viewpoint. In a sequence of edits, however, the latest image can lose the appearance of an object when it is occluded or leaves view. The target layout specifies where the object should reappear, while its appearance must be recovered from earlier observations. We introduce LayoutRecall, a multi-round editor that stores and reuses appearance in the local coordinate systems of 3D boxes. Box-Surface Latent Memory retains image latents on box faces and retrieves them along rays in the target view. Geometry-Aligned Memory Conditioning supplies the retrieved tokens to a FLUX.2 editor using target-view positions, shared box-local embeddings, and object-wise attention. A correspondence loss encourages the editor to attend to matching observations during denoising. We also introduce LayoutLoop, a multi-round 3D layout-controlled image editing benchmark with calibrated layouts and designed revisits. We conduct extensive experiments on LayoutLoop and real-scene data to verify the ability of our method. The project page is at https://ykchizs.github.io/layoutrecall.github.io/.

</details>


### [194] [One Representation to Rule Them All -- Open-Vocabulary Change Detection from Text or Visual Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34430)
*Blaž Rolih,Matic Fučka,Filip Wolf,Luka Čehovin Zajc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出无需训练的开放词汇变化检测框架OVTSID3，在DINOv3表示空间中统一区域分组、概念识别和时间比较，并支持文本查询或视觉示例提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇变化检测方法依赖文本描述，并将区域提议、语义识别和时间比较拆分为多个独立模型，限制了目标概念表达方式，且检测依赖多个中间预测结果。

Method: 提出无需训练的OVTSID3框架，在DINOv3表示空间中统一区域分组、概念识别与时间比较；支持零样本文本查询和基于掩码参考对的一次性视觉提示两种概念指定方式。

Result: 在两个建筑变化和两个自然灾害基准上，OVTSID3优于所有先前无需训练的开放词汇变化检测方法，平均F1提升8.9个点；同时支持语义变化检测，并在SECOND数据集上达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明，统一表示可灵活支持文本引导或示例引导的变化检测，无需针对特定任务进行模型训练。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) aims to localise user-specified changes without retraining for predefined categories. Existing approaches typically rely on textual descriptions and combine separate models for region proposal, semantic recognition, and temporal comparison. This limits how target concepts can be expressed and makes detection dependent on several intermediate predictions. We introduce OVTSID3, a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison in the representation space of DINOv3. OVTSID3 supports two complementary modes of concept specification: zero-shot textual queries or one-shot visual prompting through a masked reference pair. OVTSID3 outperforms all prior training-free OVCD methods on two building and two natural-disaster benchmarks, raising the average F1 by 8.9 points. OVTSID3 also supports semantic change detection and achieves state-of-the-art on SECOND. These results demonstrate the flexibility of a unified representation for text- or example-guided change detection without task-specific model training.

</details>


### [195] [Was the Model Given the Right Action? Auditing and Repairing Action Interfaces in Navigation World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34739)
*Ajmain Istiak Apon,Md Mehedi Hasan,Sejuti Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文审计了动作条件世界模型在评估时动作编码与训练不一致的问题，发现NWM训练与推演代码存在三种交互差异，修正后视觉预测误差显著降低，并提出检测与修复工具ActRosetta。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型评估通常假设推演时动作的准备方式与训练完全一致，但未检查的输入不匹配可能使模型看起来比实际更不准，从而影响模型比较与结论。

Method: 以Navigation World Models（NWM）为对象审计训练与rollout代码中的动作编码差异；在不重训练情况下修正输入并在RECON数据集上用DreamSim测量误差；分析检查点排名及替代模型表现；向两个替代模型故意引入编码错误；提出ActRosetta用于检测动作编码是否匹配训练、识别分歧原因并修复输入。

Result: 修正输入后NWM平均视觉预测误差降低42%；修正会改变NWM检查点排名，并消除或削弱两个替代模型测得的优势；仅修正归一化偏移反而增加误差，说明多种不匹配需联合检查；故意引入编码错误会使两个替代模型变差；ActRosetta的修复在预测对动作不敏感时帮助有限，诊断覆盖有限，控制改进尚未证实。

Conclusion: 任何动作条件世界模型在报告rollout误差前，都应验证评估阶段对动作的编码与训练阶段完全一致，否则模型精度比较和排名可能被输入准备不匹配所扭曲。

Abstract: World models are evaluated by predicting future observations from actions. These evaluations assume that actions are prepared the same way as during training, but an unchecked mismatch can make a model appear less accurate than it is. We audit this assumption in Navigation World Models (NWM) and find three interacting differences between its training and rollout code. Correcting the inputs, without retraining, reduces mean visual prediction error by 42%, measured with DreamSim on the RECON navigation dataset. The correction also changes the ranking of NWM checkpoints in an exploratory analysis and removes or reduces two alternative models' measured advantages. Correcting only the normalization offset instead increases error, showing why interacting mismatches must be checked together. To test whether sensitivity to input preparation extends beyond NWM, we deliberately introduce encoding errors into two alternative models; both become less accurate. We introduce ActRosetta, a tool that checks whether action encoding matches training, identifies supported causes of disagreement, and repairs inputs when sufficient information is available. Repair helps little where predictions barely respond to actions, the tool's diagnosis has limited coverage, and improved control remains unproven. For any action-conditioned world model, the lesson is the same: before reporting rollout error, verify that evaluation encodes actions exactly as training did.

</details>


### [196] [Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34435)
*Zanyi Wang,Xia Chen,Liu Liu,Xianglong Guo,Dengyang Jiang,Haodong Li,Tingyang Xiao,Wenhao Hu,Zhizhong Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Dianjing，一种基于强视频先验的动作条件世界模型最小适配方案，用极少参数训练将视频生成模型转化为机器人动作后果预测模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代视频生成器能生成语义上合理的未来，但不保证符合特定动作的物理后果；动作条件世界模型需要预测机器人动作导致的世界变化，而强视频先验下如何以最小适配实现这一目标尚不明确。

Method: 基于 33B 视频基础模型 MiniMax H3，冻结预训练主干，仅训练 0.34% 参数；采用统一物理动作条件、将训练集中在决定运动与布局的高噪声层级，并使用原生历史条件；使用约 65 小时、两种具身形态的机器人视频，无需额外机器人预训练或相机标定。

Result: 消融表明训练在噪声层级上的分配比动作如何输入网络更重要；在 WorldOracle 上，Dianjing 在五个评测赛道中四个取得最佳，在 AgiBot-Long 上排名第二。

Conclusion: 强视频先验已覆盖世界建模的大部分能力，轻量级物理动作接地即可释放其真实世界预测潜力。

Abstract: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning. Built upon MiniMax H3, a 33B video foundation model, Dianjing freezes the pretrained backbone and trains only 0.34% of its parameters using approximately 65 hours of robot video across two embodiments, without additional robot-specific pretraining or camera calibration. Controlled ablations show that where training is allocated across noise levels matters more than how actions enter the network. On WorldOracle, which evaluates predictions against paired real-world executions, Dianjing achieves the best scores on four of the five evaluation tracks and ranks second on AgiBot-Long. Our findings suggest that strong video priors already bring us most of the way to world modeling; lightweight physical action grounding can unlock their potential for real-world prediction.

</details>


### [197] [DeltaRAE: Derivative Tokenization for Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33886)
*Mingzhuo Yu,Shengcao Cao,Chengzhi Mao,Yong Cheng,Di Jiang,Lijun Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DeltaRAE，一种面向视频的因果表示自编码器，通过导数式分词减少视频 token 数量，使视频生成器能处理长达一分钟的视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在视频生成器通常只能训练几秒片段，瓶颈在于视频分词器对静态帧和运动帧花费相同 token，且生成时需要不存在的未来帧。

Method: DeltaRAE 采用因果编码器与解码器，并读取冻结的预训练图像编码器；其导数分词对周期性锚帧完整编码，对其余帧仅用少量 token 编码。

Result: 在 UCF-101 和 Kinetics-600 上，基于 DeltaRAE 潜变量的扩散 Transformer 与先进视频分词器竞争力相当；16 帧片段上分词器 GFLOPs 减半，一分钟视频 token 数减少 18.8 倍；可在完整一分钟视频上端到端训练，并在视频预测中生成完整一分钟视频；若 token 预算相同但无预训练编码器，生成器多数视频在 15 秒内崩溃。

Conclusion: DeltaRAE 通过因果且高效的视频分词显著降低长视频建模成本，并证明预训练图像编码器对长视频生成稳定性至关重要。

Abstract: Latent video generators are trained on clips of a few seconds, and much of this limit lies in their tokenizers, which spend as many tokens on a static frame as on a moving one and need future frames that do not exist during generation. We introduce DeltaRAE, a causal representation autoencoder for video. Its derivative tokenization encodes periodic anchor frames in full and all remaining frames with a few tokens each, and its causal encoder and decoder read a frozen pretrained image encoder. On UCF-101 and Kinetics-600, a standard diffusion transformer trained on DeltaRAE latents is competitive with state-of-the-art video tokenizers. DeltaRAE halves the tokenizer GFLOPs on 16-frame clips relative to keeping the same number of patch tokens for every frame, and it represents a minute of video with 18.8x fewer tokens. The tokenizer trains end to end on one-minute videos, and in video prediction a generator on its latents produces a full minute of video. The same generator collapses within 15 seconds in most videos when the tokenizer has the same token budget but no pretrained encoder.

</details>


### [198] [HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34811)
*Boxuan Dong,Yupeng Qian,Ying Wu,Heshuai Li,Junhao Tan,Zhenxiong Tan,Weijia Wu,Weihao Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HOG-WAM，在训练阶段引入未来 HOG 特征作为结构监督，以提升世界-动作模型在视觉损坏下的控制鲁棒性，推理时移除辅助模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界-动作模型联合预测未来观测与动作，但视觉损坏会干扰策略，因此需要一种不改变推理架构的鲁棒性增强方法。

Method: 使用演示图像直接提取未来 HOG 作为结构监督；增加辅助 HOG 扩散 Transformer（DiT）模块，通过非对称注意力读取 RGB 特征，使该目标影响控制所用视觉表示；模块仅训练时使用，推理时移除，保留 FastWAM 的 RGB-to-action 架构。

Result: 在 RoboTwin-Plus 四种受控视觉损坏下均取得最高成功率，混合噪声成功率从 78.86% 提升至 82.86%，干净场景性能相当；LIBERO Plus 总体成功率从 74.49% 提升至 75.26%，传感器噪声下从 74.14% 提升至 78.89%；四个 Franka 任务平均成功率在干净观测下从 40% 提升至 59%，噪声观测下从 17% 提升至 24%；消融表明 RGB 观测加辅助 HOG 预测优于用 HOG 替代 RGB。

Conclusion: 未来梯度预测可作为视觉鲁棒控制的互补监督，且物理任务上的绝对增益大于仿真环境。

Abstract: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

</details>


### [199] [SIA: Selective Image Analogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33894)
*Amirhossein Alimohammadi,Kian Izadpanah,Bardiya Kariminia,Yiorgos Chrysanthou,Ali Mahdavi-Amiri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出选择性图像类比（SIA）新设定：单个示例对包含多种编辑，用户可在推理时选择将哪些编辑应用到新查询图像B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像类比方法默认示例对（A, A'）中的所有变化都应完整迁移，当用户只想迁移部分编辑时缺乏灵活性。

Method: 构建包含全编辑和部分编辑目标的多编辑类比数据集；先训练模型迁移完整示例变换，再通过掩码对齐抑制机制实现选择性控制：使用token门控LoRA在去噪过程中限制适配器更新到被抑制的编辑token，并用概念抑制向量在去噪前削弱文本嵌入中的选定token。

Result: 定量、定性评估及用户研究表明，该方法能够抑制A'中残留但用户不想要的编辑，同时保留用户选择的编辑，且无需为每种编辑组合重新提供示例对。

Conclusion: SIA实现了在单个示例对下对编辑迁移进行选择性控制，提高了图像类比任务的灵活性和实用性。

Abstract: Image analogy transfers a demonstrated transformation from a before/after pair (A, A') to a new query image B. Existing methods assume all changes in (A, A') should be fully transferred, limiting flexibility when users want only a subset of the demonstrated edits. We introduce Selective Image Analogy (SIA), a new setting where a single demonstration pair encodes multiple edits, and the user selects at inference time which edits to apply to B. To support this, we curate a multi-edit analogy dataset with full-edit and partial-edit targets. We then train a model that first learns to transfer the complete demonstrated transformation, and then gains selective control through a mask-aligned suppression mechanism: a token-gated LoRA that restricts adapter updates to suppressed edit tokens during denoising, paired with a concept suppression vector that weakens the selected tokens in the text embeddings before denoising. Together, these components allow SIA to suppress unwanted edits that remain visible in A', while preserving the user-selected ones, all without requiring a new demonstration pair for each edit combination. We perform extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations along with user studies to demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.

</details>


### [200] [ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34457)
*Zhenchen Tang,Haolin Lu,Songlin Yang,Xiaotong Zhao,Ran Zhang,Bo Peng,Shuai Li,Haotian Fan,Haobin Zhong,Yanni Zhang,Songlian Li,Ning Zhang,Xun Gao,Alan Zhao,Jing Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ProxyGenBench，用于研究代理引导的视频生成需同时满足结构保持、缺失内容补全与代理伪影纠正、以及多模态条件正确绑定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成器能生成逼真视频，但难以控制场景如何展开；3D blockout 等结构代理虽可指定布局、运动、相机和事件顺序，但输入粗糙且可能含不应复现的伪影。

Method: 构建包含 60 个场景、312 个评估案例的 ProxyGenBench，覆盖三类场景任务，并控制代理保真度、文本细节和多模态输入变化；使用经核验的案例特定清单评估五种视频生成器。

Result: 实验表明代理能提升时空控制，但代理细节增加可能伴随补全效果下降；强结构遵循并不保证文本、图像、音频条件被正确绑定到对应实体和事件。

Conclusion: 成功的代理引导视频生成需在保持预期结构、补全缺失内容并纠正代理伪影、正确绑定多模态条件之间取得平衡；ProxyGenBench 揭示了这些交互需求及现有生成器的失败模式。

Abstract: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists. Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control, but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

</details>


### [201] [BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34862)
*Tomas Hodan,Vineet Bhat,Martin Sundermeyer,Jonathan Tremblay,Yash Patel,Médéric Fourmy,Stephen Tyree,Junwen Huang,Varun Burde,Martin Cífka,Eric Brachmann,Vincent Lepetit,Stan Birchfield,Jiri Matas,Carsten Rother*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 BOP-Refer，首个基于 9 个 BOP 数据集、面向日常与工业物体的单目 2D/3D 指代定位基准，并系统评测 17 个前沿视觉语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在指代定位中缺乏统一、可靠的 2D 与 3D 评测基准，尤其缺少来自真实物体、带准确 6DoF 位姿的日常和工业物体数据。

Method: 从 9 个 BOP 数据集构建图像与指代表达，表达由 VLM 生成并经人工校验；利用物体 3D 模型和 6DoF 位姿标注推导准确的 2D/3D 边界框真值；评测 Gemini、GPT、Claude、Qwen、Gemma 等 17 个前沿 VLM。

Result: 最佳模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 2D 上达到 72.6% AP_IoU2D，但 3D 仅 12.4% AP_IoU3D，尽管 3D IoU 阈值更宽松；预测 3D 框通常中心对准目标，但深度误差常超过物体尺寸。

Conclusion: 当前 VLM 的 2D 指代定位较强，但 3D 定位仍很弱；主要误差来源是度量尺度估计，而可靠尺度估计依赖准确的物体尺寸先验。

Abstract: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

</details>


### [202] [TWIST: Teacher-Weighted Initial-Noise Spherical Transform for Quality-Preserving Diversity in Distilled Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33895)
*Shayan Baghayi-Nejad,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TWIST 是一个轻量网络，通过变换初始噪声的低频分量来提升少步扩散模型的样本多样性，避免推理时反向传播优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步蒸馏扩散模型生成质量高但模式覆盖和多样性不足；现有推理时优化初始噪声的方法需要昂贵反向传播，且多样性目标只排斥样本而未考虑教师模型输出分布。

Method: 提出 Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform（TWIST），将初始噪声低频分量变换摊销到单个网络中，并用教师引导的行列式点过程（DPP）目标，使学生样本的特征空间多样性与教师对齐。

Result: 在 SDXL-Turbo 上，TWIST 以低于 MoNO 25% 的推理成本达到其多样性，并在匹配计算预算下获得更高召回及更好的 PickScore、ImageReward 和 CLIPScore；在 SDXL-Lightning 上以更低成本取得可比召回，且没有 MoNO 的 ImageReward 退化。

Conclusion: TWIST 能在保持少步生成效率的同时提升多样性，避免推理时反向传播，并在多个指标和模型上优于或媲美现有方法。

Abstract: Timestep-distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in one or a few steps, but often suffer from reduced mode coverage and limited diversity. Recent methods improve diversity by optimizing the initial noise at inference time, requiring costly backpropagation through the denoiser. Moreover, their diversity objectives typically repel generated samples without accounting for how the corresponding teacher model distributes its outputs. We introduce Teacher-Weighted Initial-noise Spherical Transform (TWIST), a lightweight network that transforms the low-frequency components of initial noise to improve diversity without inference-time optimization. TWIST uses a teacher-guided determinantal point process (DPP) objective to align the feature-space diversity of student samples with that of the teacher. By amortizing noise optimization into a single network, TWIST eliminates inference-time backpropagation while preserving the efficiency of few-step generation. On SDXL-Turbo, TWIST matches the diversity of MoNO at less than 25% of its inference cost, while achieving higher recall and better PickScore, ImageReward, and CLIPScore under matched compute budgets. On SDXL-Lightning, it achieves comparable recall at lower cost without the ImageReward degradation observed with MoNO.

</details>


### [203] [PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34521)
*Yuyao Sun,Hongli Yuan,Shuang Li,Tao Deng,Deqing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的视觉 token 剪枝方法 PURA，通过统一评估时空冗余来压缩视频大语言模型的视觉 token，在性能与推理效率之间取得较好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频大语言模型因长视觉 token 序列导致推理成本高；现有压缩方法常依赖预设处理顺序或固定的时空压缩比例，难以适应不同视频中时空冗余比例的变化。

Method: PURA 对每个 token 构建空间和时间参考候选，选择跨两个维度表示误差最低的参考；将表示误差与 token 重要性结合以确定移除成本；并提出 Coordinated Pruning，将相互兼容的低成本移除分批同时执行，每批后更新剪枝状态，直到达到目标预算。

Result: 在三个视频大语言模型和五个视频理解基准上的实验表明，PURA 在任务性能与推理效率之间取得了有利的权衡。

Conclusion: PURA 是一种无需训练、可自适应评估时空冗余的视频 token 剪枝方法，能够有效降低视频大语言模型的推理成本并保持较好性能。

Abstract: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [204] [RelPRM: Grounding Visual Process Reward Models in Relational Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33903)
*Zhaoxing Zhang,Ziqiu Gui,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出面向视觉关系验证的视觉过程奖励模型 RelPRM，并构建自动化数据管线与基准 RelProcessTrain、RelProcessBench，以提升多模态推理中步骤评分对视觉关系证据的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉过程奖励模型虽能检测计算错误，却可能给误读视觉关系的步骤高分；仅依赖后续答案成功进行监督，无法直接判断步骤中的关系性陈述是否成立。

Method: 作者先构建自动化管线，程序化验证每个关系陈述并识别所需对象、关系和图像区域，生成 RelProcessTrain 与 RelProcessBench（RPB），通过受控图像编辑和步骤改写测试评分是否合理响应关系证据。随后提出 RelPRM，包含关系证据自蒸馏和关系证据驱动的一致性训练：前者构造保留必要对象、关系与依赖的视图并将可靠判断迁移到全图；后者要求关系反转时评分合理变化、无关编辑下保持稳定、同义改写间评分一致。推理时仅用原图和推理上下文直接评分当前步骤。

Result: RelPRM 在 VisualProcessBench（VPB）上达到 66.2%，在 RPB 上达到 68.4%，分别比 VisualPRM-8B 提升 4.2 和 9.9 个百分点。

Conclusion: 针对视觉关系进行训练可同时改善关系验证与步骤评估，并有助于更广泛的多模态推理任务。

Abstract: Visual process reward models (PRMs) can detect calculation errors yet assign high scores to steps that misread visual relations. Supervision based on subsequent answer success does not directly establish whether a step's relational claim holds. To strengthen visual-relation verification, we first build an automated pipeline that programmatically verifies each claim and identifies the required objects, relations, and image regions. It produces RelProcessTrain and RelProcessBench (RPB), which tests whether scores respond appropriately to relational evidence through controlled image edits and step rephrasings. Building on this pipeline, we further introduce RelPRM, a visual-relation-oriented method for process reward modeling with two training mechanisms. Relation-evidence self-distillation constructs views preserving necessary objects, relations, and dependencies, reducing the burden of finding decisive evidence in complex scenes and transferring reliable evidence-assisted judgments to full images. Relation-evidence-driven consistency training encourages appropriate score changes when relation edits reverse a step's truth, stability under irrelevant edits, and similar score changes across paraphrases. At inference, RelPRM directly scores the current step using only the original image and reasoning context. RelPRM achieves 66.2% on VisualProcessBench (VPB) and 68.4% on RPB, gains of 4.2 and 9.9 percentage points over VisualPRM-8B. These results show that training for visual relations improves both relational verification and step assessment across broader multimodal reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [205] [Angular Interpolation in Sparse-View Low-Dose CT Reconstruction: Placement Effects and Data-Consistency Step-Size Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34508)
*Yitian Tang,Yuncheng Zhang,Hualiang Wang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文量化稀疏视角低剂量CT双域网络中角度插值位置的作用，区分正弦图初始化与图像残差基的影响，并给出NK归一化依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双域网络结合投影与图像处理，但学习前角度插值的贡献及其与网络架构的作用容易混淆，需要明确插值放置在不同环节的影响。

Method: 在合成平行束数据上使用无参数插值，比较零填充、插值FBP与联合学习完成正弦图的FBP；用DC-DuNet进行2x2配置消融，控制分支宽度、深度和训练计划，改变插值放置及输入通道；与仅图像U-Net比较，并在独立合成数据和CHAOS腹部CT模拟退化上验证；估计投影/反投影经验增益。

Result: 60视角下无参数插值将无噪声缺失视角MAE较零填充降低99.7%；联合学习完成正弦图的全视角FBP较插值FBP提高1.27 dB PSNR。20 epoch后，正弦图初始化对比为+1.98 dB，插值图像基为-2.16 dB，且图像基排序随训练反转。正弦图初始化变体在60视角10%剂量下比仅图像U-Net高0.96 dB，在独立合成数据上高1.28 dB；高视角数或共享插值图像基时U-Net领先。无重训练时在CHAOS上保留0.12 dB优势，图像基对比约等于零。投影/反投影经验主增益约0.85NK。

Conclusion: 结果可区分插值放置与网络架构的作用；正弦图初始化总体优于图像基，但优势依赖视角数、剂量和训练阶段；支持采用NK归一化进行步长校准。

Abstract: Dual-domain networks combine projection and image processing for sparse-view low-dose computed tomography (CT). We quantify the contribution of angular interpolation before learning and distinguish its roles in sinogram initialisation and the image residual base. On synthetic parallel-beam data, parameter-free interpolation reduces noise-free missing-view mean absolute error by 99.7% relative to zero filling at 60 views. Full-view filtered back-projection (FBP) of the jointly learned completed sinogram adds 1.27 dB of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) over interpolated FBP. In a data-consistency dual-domain network (DC-DuNet), a 2x2 configuration ablation controls branch width, depth and training schedule while varying these placements and their associated input channels. After 20 epochs, the PSNR contrasts are +1.98 dB for sinogram initialisation and -2.16 dB for the interpolated image base; the image-base ranking also reverses during training. The sinogram-initialised variant exceeds an image-only U-Net by 0.96 dB at 60 views and 10% dose, and by 1.28 dB on independently generated synthetic data. The U-Net leads at higher view counts and with a shared interpolated image base. Without retraining, the variant retains a 0.12 dB advantage on held-out CHAOS abdominal CT under simulated degradation; the image-base contrast rounds to zero. The implemented projection/backprojection pair has empirical dominant gain of approximately 0.85NK, where N is image-grid width and K acquired view count. These results distinguish interpolation placement from network architecture and support NK normalisation for step calibration.

</details>


### [206] [HAS: Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling for Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34544)
*Yuyao Sun,Daiqi Shi,Shuang Li,Liao Zhang,Yang Cai,Deqing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出分层自适应帧采样框架HAS，通过两阶段采样在有限帧预算下同时兼顾查询相关关键帧与局部/全局上下文，提升多模态大模型的长视频理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数多模态大模型受上下文长度限制，无法处理完整长视频，只能采样部分帧；现有均匀采样或相关性采样通常依赖单一原则，难以满足不同查询对全局时间理解与短时细粒度事件证据的异构需求。

Method: 提出两阶段帧采样框架HAS：第一阶段“骨干帧构建”使用行列式点过程DPP选取与查询相关且不冗余的帧作为骨干；第二阶段“自适应上下文丰富”根据骨干帧的时间分布推断查询需求，将剩余帧预算自适应分配给局部上下文和全局上下文，以补充细粒度时序动态、短程因果关系及全局整体理解。

Result: 将HAS集成到三个领先的多模态大模型中，在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和MLVU基准上均取得一致更优的性能。

Conclusion: 分层两阶段采样能够有效应对多样化的查询需求，在有限帧预算下提升长视频多模态理解效果，并具有良好的模型集成效果。

Abstract: Due to context-length constraints, most MLLMs cannot process full-length videos and therefore rely on sampling a subset of frames as input. However, existing sampling methods, ranging from uniform sampling to relevance-based selection, are often driven by a single sampling principle and thus struggle to accommodate the heterogeneous evidential requirements of different queries: some demand a holistic understanding of how the video unfolds over time, while others hinge on fine-grained events within a short temporal window. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Adaptive Frame Sampling (HAS)}, a two-stage frame sampling framework. In the first stage, \emph{Backbone Frame Construction}, we apply a Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to sample frames that are both query-relevant and non-redundant. These selected frames capture key moments across the video and form the backbone of the sampling set, providing a foundation for subsequent enrichment. In the second stage, \emph{Adaptive Contextual Enrichment}, we analyze the temporal distribution of the backbone frames to infer the query's requirements and adaptively allocate the remaining frame budget between Local and Global Context. The Local Context enriches the backbone with fine-grained temporal dynamics and short-range causal relations, whereas the Global Context connects temporally isolated evidence and provides a holistic view of the entire video to support global understanding. Through such a hierarchical two-stage process, HAS effectively addresses diverse query requirements. Incorporated into three leading MLLMs, it demonstrates consistently superior performance across the Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU benchmarks.

</details>


### [207] [Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34545)
*Cui Yakun,Tiantian Geng,Huixiang Kong,Xingqun Qi,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出流式视频问答基准 StreamRecall，要求模型在适当时机检索并推理分散在视频历史中的多段证据；同时提出证据利用级联诊断方法和免训练因果视觉记忆机制 EviStream。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频问答基准多面向离线场景，而真实流式场景需要模型基于视频历史中分散的证据回答上下文相关查询，当前评测与真实需求存在差距。

Method: 构建 StreamRecall 基准，包含 4,983 个问题、462 个视频，并提供上下文对齐的查询时间和细粒度时序证据标注；提出 Evidence Utilization Cascade，从证据定位、 grounding、链完成和答案推导诊断推理；提出免训练的因果视觉记忆机制 EviStream，在固定 KV 预算下保留推理关键证据。

Result: 实验表明当前视觉语言模型与真实流式视频问答需求之间存在显著差距，StreamRecall 能有效暴露模型在证据检索、关联和推理方面的不足。

Conclusion: StreamRecall 为发展具备证据感知能力的流式视频智能提供了基础，EviStream 为高效长时流式推理提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. To enable efficient long-term streaming reasoning, we present EviStream, a training-free causal visual memory mechanism that preserves reasoning-critical evidence under a fixed KV budget. Experiments reveal substantial gaps between current VLMs and realistic streaming requirements, establishing StreamRecall as a foundation for developing evidence-aware streaming video intelligence.

</details>


### [208] [Event-WAM: Learning to Act with Event-Derived Futures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33917)
*Jongseong Bae,Hyunwoo Kim,Yeongin Lee,Eubin So,Ha Young Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Event-WAM，将事件相机导出的视觉变化作为 RGB 之外的辅助未来监督，用于机器人动作学习，并在仿真与真实场景中验证其有效性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models 主要依赖 RGB 未来预测进行动作学习，作者希望引入更能反映视觉变化的额外监督信号，以提升机器人操作策略的学习效果和鲁棒性。

Method: Event-WAM 从 RGB 演示中构造时间结构化的事件表示，并使用冻结的预训练 RGB 视频 VAE 编码，无需训练事件专用 VAE；通过联合 RGB-Event 潜空间流匹配，提供外观与变化导向的监督，同时推理时不需要事件观测或显式未来生成。

Result: 在多个仿真基准上，Event-WAM 在标准条件下性能相当，扰动下的鲁棒性提升依赖基准，在 LIBERO-Plus 上有改进；真实世界实验在标准和未见扰动条件下均提升操作成功率。分析还发现策略提升并不总伴随更高的未来预测保真度。

Conclusion: 变化导向的监督可能对动作学习具有潜在价值，Event-WAM 为机器人策略学习提供了一种无需推理时事件输入的有效辅助监督思路。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage future visual modeling for robotic action learning, with recent studies exploring alternative or complementary objectives beyond conventional RGB prediction. We introduce Event-WAM, which incorporates event-derived visual changes as auxiliary future supervision alongside RGB. Event-WAM constructs temporally structured event representations from RGB demonstrations and encodes them using a frozen pretrained RGB video VAE, without training an event-specific VAE. Joint RGB--Event latent flow matching provides appearance- and change-oriented supervision without requiring event observations or explicit future generation at inference. Across simulated benchmarks, Event-WAM maintains comparable performance under standard conditions, while robustness gains under perturbations are benchmark-dependent, including improvements on LIBERO-Plus. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate improved manipulation success under both standard and unseen perturbation conditions. Further analyses show that policy improvements are not consistently accompanied by higher future prediction fidelity, suggesting the potential of change-oriented supervision for action learning.

</details>


### [209] [Tortho-Gaussian++: Suppressing Geometric Drift and Floaters for Robust Gravity-Aligned TDOM Generation in Large-Scale Aerial Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33905)
*Xiang Wang,Xin Wang,Zongqian Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Tortho-Gaussian++，一种面向无人机航拍场景的 3DGS 训练与 TDOM 渲染框架，通过抑制几何漂移和悬浮物、裁剪不可靠外围区域并实现稳健重力对齐，提高 TDOM 生成质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 在航拍场景重建中表现优异，但扩展到真实数字正射影像图（TDOM）生成时，仍面临几何漂移、悬浮物、外围区域几何支撑弱以及重力方向估计不稳定等问题，影响 TDOM 的准确性和渲染质量。

Method: 提出基于视线的几何可观测性分析，量化每个高斯点的可靠性并裁剪几何支撑较弱的外围区域；在致密化过程中改进新创建高斯点的优化器状态初始化，从本质上抑制漂移和悬浮物；设计稳健的重力方向估计方案，融合图像重力线索、相机分布先验和垂直下视视角，获得重力对齐的正交投影参考用于 TDOM 渲染。

Result: 在多个大规模 UAV 数据集上，Tortho-Gaussian++ 相较原始 3DGS 平均 PSNR 提升 0.5-3.5 dB，并与先验引导的 3DGS 方法性能相当或更优；训练时间、显存和高斯数量分别降低 45.5%、47.2% 和 58.6%。定性评估表明该方法能有效抑制漂移和悬浮物，稳健重力方向估计可减少 TDOM 中由倾斜引起的立面伪影。

Conclusion: Tortho-Gaussian++ 能有效提升航拍场景 TDOM 生成的几何稳定性和渲染质量，在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低训练成本和高斯冗余，并增强重力对齐 TDOM 渲染的稳健性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable performance in aerial scene reconstruction, motivating its recent extension to true digital orthophoto maps (TDOMs) generation. We propose Tortho-Gaussian++, a novel 3DGS training framework that suppresses geometric drift and floaters and automatically prunes unreliable peripheral regions, coupled with a robust gravity-aligned TDOM rendering solution. First, we explore geometric support via viewing-ray-based geometric observability analysis, quantitatively characterizing the reliability for each Gaussian and subsequently pruning peripheral regions with particularly weak geometric support. Second, the optimizer state initialization is refined for newly created Gaussians during densification, intrinsically suppressing drift and floaters without external priors. Lastly, a robust gravity direction estimation solution is designed, combining image-derived gravity cues, camera-distribution priors and nadir views, to achieve a gravity-aligned orthogonal projection reference for TDOM rendering. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) datasets demonstrate that our Tortho-Gaussian++ outperforms vanilla 3DGS by 0.5-3.5 dB in average PSNR and yields comparable or superior performance to prior-guided 3DGS methods. Notably, it reduces the training time, VRAM and Gaussian number by 45.5%, 47.2%, and 58.6%, respectively. Qualitative evaluations confirm that our method effectively suppresses drift and floaters, while robust gravity direction estimation reduces tilt-induced facade artifacts in TDOMs.

</details>


### [210] [UPP-Gauss: Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting for B-mode Novel-View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33920)
*Guil Jung,Seok-Hwan Oh,Myeong-Gee Kim,Young-Min Kim,Hyeon-Jik Lee,Sang-Yun Kim,Hyeok-Jun Kwon,Hyuk-Sool Kwon,Hyeon-Min Bae*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 UPP-Gauss，将超声传播声学交互融入显式高斯表示，用于 B 模式超声图像的新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B 模式超声新视角合成需要准确建模声波在组织中的传播以及不同探头位姿下的外观变化。

Method: UPP-Gauss 根据探头位姿和声束传播方向采样三个 3D 高斯场构建声学图，再按超声传播规律组合这些图以合成 B 模式图像。

Result: 在三个声学特性不同的数据集上，UPP-Gauss 取得最佳重建质量并实现高效渲染，相较各数据集最佳基线平均提升 1.43 dB PSNR。

Conclusion: 通过对超声传播进行显式高斯建模，可以实现准确且高效的 B 模式超声新视角合成。

Abstract: Accurate novel-view synthesis of B-mode ultrasound images requires modeling acoustic propagation through tissue and the resulting appearance variations across probe poses. We propose Ultrasound Propagation Physics-informed Gaussian Splatting (UPP-Gauss), which integrates these acoustic interactions into an explicit Gaussian representation. UPP-Gauss constructs acoustic maps by sampling three 3D Gaussian fields using the probe pose and acoustic beam propagation direction, then combines these maps according to ultrasound propagation to synthesize B-mode images. Across three acoustically diverse datasets, UPP-Gauss achieves the best reconstruction quality with efficient rendering, improving PSNR over the best baseline on each dataset by 1.43 dB on average. These results demonstrate accurate and efficient B-mode novel-view synthesis through explicit Gaussian modeling of ultrasound propagation.

</details>


### [211] [Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34575)
*Sage-Med Team,:,Ming Hu,Cheng Tang,Wei Li,Rongbin Li,Feilong Tang,Junru Hu,Hongze Zhu,Qiujuan Yan,Huanze Tang,Shaocong Wei,Siyuan Yan,Min Cen,Zhongxing Xu,Zhonghua Wang,Lie Ju,Zhen Yu,Wenjie Li,Shiyan Su,Jing Hao,Jingyong Liang,Diping Song,Fang Yan,Chenglong Ma,Junzhi Ning,Haochen Xue,Zanting Ye,Chenrun Wang,Jinjie Wei,Yi Xin,Jianghan Shen,Siqi Luo,Jiyao Liu,Huidong Xie,Jun Zhao,Rulin Zhou,Longquan Jiang,Ziyan Huang,Ying Chen,Hanxiao Zhang,Junyang Wu,Mouxiao Bian,Jiashi Lin,Chenyu Wang,Qi Qin,Jie Huang,Yiling Zhou,Jiawei Chen,Kefan Wang,Jingjing Hua,Yaoyu Liu,Huihui Xu,Tianbin Li,Jin Ye,Ziyang Chen,Shujian Gao,Zilin Lu,Jiangtao Yan,Changkai Ji,Wenhao Tang,Xinyi Zeng,Yuxing Chen,Hongwei Yang,Rongzhao Zhang,Jinru Ding,Yingcheng Wu,Zhenfei Yin,Jinzhe Li,Lu Lu,Yun Zhong,Zhishan Lin,Bingli Wang,Xiaohan Ren,Jianmin Qian,Penghao Zhao,Zhongbo Tian,Zhenbang Zhou,Peiling Dai,Mengjing Zhao,Jingyu Zheng,Pinan Liu,Shiwei Li,Victoria Mar,Cristina Vico-Alonso,Qiang Wu,Xianming Liu,Lingtong Huang,Dili Song,Minghui Zhang,Wenlong Zhang,Qipeng Guo,Yuqiang Li,Nanqing Dong,Yun Gu,Qi Duan,Hongliang Ren,Hongming Shan,Yin Xie,Xiang An,Benyou Wang,Yueming Su,Yefeng Zheng,Zongyuan Ge,Chun-Mei Feng,Jie Xu,Yu Qiao,Junjun He,Yirong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究医学多模态大模型的可扩展性，提出35B参数（3B激活）的Sage-Med-Preview，通过大规模数据筛选和渐进式训练课程提升医学多模态能力，并在多基准上取得领先开源医学模型的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学多模态大模型在多项医学任务上不如前沿通用多模态大模型；单纯扩大模型规模主要提升文本能力而非多模态感知，启用推理模式也无法弥补视觉差距，因此需要探索医学多模态智能如何在实际训练中扩展。

Method: 构建Sage-Med-Preview：从3.227亿候选记录中进行阶段特定数据筛选，采用涵盖医学预训练、分阶段监督微调和自适应强化学习的渐进式训练课程；并在77个竞争模型、238项临床任务、61个公开和13个私有多中心基准、40多种模态上进行评估。

Result: Sage-Med-Preview在31个公开多模态基准上平均得分58.26%，超过开源医学模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B的50.99%和通用科学模型Intern-S2-Preview的52.24%，在综合多模态理解、报告生成和视觉定位等任务上接近先进专有模型GPT-6.2-Sol；但在复杂医学推理和多步骤临床流程方面仍存在挑战。

Conclusion: 该研究为可扩展临床多模态智能提供了实证证据、可操作的数据与训练配方以及严格基准，表明渐进式监督优化和自适应强化学习能持续带来阶段增益，并显著推进专业视觉理解与医学语言能力。

Abstract: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [212] [VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34603)
*Jinwei Hu,Lai Wei,Zhuoyun Li,Youcheng Sun,Yi Dong,Xiaowei Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究“视觉认知合谋”威胁：协调发布的帖子用真实图片和局部真实字幕诱导VLM代理通过自身推理接受攻击者选定的目标主张，并提出基准与VisualMontage框架进行系统评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于视觉语言模型的代理越来越多地解读社交媒体内容，其分析错误可能为谣言提供可信度并放大传播，因此需要系统评估这种认知层面的攻击威胁。

Method: 构建包含544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像、覆盖8个应用领域的基准；提出VisualMontage多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像选择与排序、字幕分配及迭代审查模拟攻击；在12个视觉语言模型上实验，考察模态效应、制作团队组件和下游防御。

Result: 在相同攻击信息流且无受害者特定优化下实现跨模型迁移，专有模型平均攻击成功率为61.93%，开放权重模型为68.71%；92.65%的生成信息流通过独立模型有效性审计；下游审查后残余攻击成功率仍为35.3%至76.7%；字幕可提高模型评定的发布自然度但降低攻击成功率。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了社交媒体解读中的新型认知威胁，并呼吁设计能够评估真实帖子如何共同塑造代理推理与结论的防护措施。

Abstract: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

</details>


### [213] [BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33935)
*Bryan Wong,Xun Xu,Jongwoo Kim,Huazhu Fu,Nancy F. Chen,Mun Yong Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BayesPath 是一种无需训练的整张切片图像（WSI）智能体，将病理医生的扫描-观察-权衡-决策过程建模为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理，并在多个 MultiPathQA 任务上显著优于现有无需训练智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无需训练的 WSI 智能体缺乏显式推理框架，通常由大语言模型聚合多模态大语言模型生成的区域描述，但没有对候选诊断的信念表示，也未考虑描述可靠性，导致重复的模型错误被当作独立证据，从而支持错误诊断。

Method: 提出 BayesPath，将 WSI 诊断过程转化为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理：维护对候选诊断的显式信念，每次观察通过可靠性感知似然更新信念，并指导下一步观察位置与停止时机；该似然校正模型答案偏差、折减相关观察，并在无标签情况下估计诊断混淆。更新过程形成可解释的证据链。

Result: 在涵盖切片分类和切片视觉问答的五个 MultiPathQA 任务上，BayesPath 在无需训练智能体中取得最高平均准确率 58.6%，显著高于次优方法的 34.1%，在切片分类上提升尤其明显；在相同观察下，贝叶斯更新平均优于 LLM 聚合，即使后者使用更大的 LLM；其信念校准也优于朴素贝叶斯，可将不确定病例转交病理医生。

Conclusion: BayesPath 表明，将 WSI 智能体诊断显式建模为可靠性感知的贝叶斯推理，可提升准确性、可解释性与校准性，并为不确定病例的人机协作分流提供依据。

Abstract: Diagnosing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires hypothesis-driven reasoning: pathologists form a differential diagnosis, seek discriminative evidence, weigh its reliability, and stop once it suffices. However, existing training-free WSI agents lack an explicit framework for such reasoning. They typically use a large language model (LLM) to aggregate the region descriptions of a multimodal LLM (MLLM), without a belief over the candidates or regard for the descriptions' reliability. Consequently, a repeated model error counts as independent evidence for an incorrect diagnosis. We introduce BayesPath, a training-free WSI agent that casts the pathologist's Scan-Look-Weigh-Decide process as reliability-aware Bayesian reasoning. An explicit belief over the candidates is updated with each observation through a reliability-aware likelihood and guides where to look next and when to stop. This likelihood corrects for the models' answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and captures diagnostic confusions estimated without labels. The updates form an interpretable evidence trail of how each observation shapes the belief. On five MultiPathQA tasks spanning slide classification and slide VQA, BayesPath achieves the highest average accuracy among training-free agents, 58.6% against 34.1% for the next best, with large gains on slide classification. On identical observations, Bayesian updating outperforms LLM aggregation on average, even with a larger LLM. BayesPath's belief is also better calibrated than naive Bayes, so uncertain cases can be deferred to pathologists. Code is available at https://github.com/bryanwong17/BayesPath

</details>


### [214] [TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33940)
*Ying Jiang,Juntao Jiang,Linxuan Fan,Lingling Li,Yaqi Wang,Xiuzhen Yang,Yong Liu,Jiangning Zhang,Jingjing Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了TAT-Det，一个用于儿童睾丸附件扭转（TAT）的专家标注超声数据集，包含2,600张图像和1,203名患者，并提供检测与分割基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TAT是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的主要原因，但临床表现不特异且缺乏标准化儿科急诊超声数据集，导致诊断困难。

Method: 构建TAT-Det超声数据集，对TAT阳性图像提供病灶级边界框和像素级分割掩码；标注采用儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审核和细化等多阶段流程；并使用代表性深度学习模型建立目标检测和语义分割基线。

Result: TAT-Det包含来自浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院的2,600张超声图像和1,203名患者；检测基准中YOLO11m表现最佳，分割基准中RWKV-UNet表现最佳。

Conclusion: TAT-Det弥补了儿科急诊超声公开资源缺乏的问题，为自动TAT分析的人工智能方法开发与评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies.
  Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance.
  Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.

</details>


### [215] [Carrying Feature Ablations Across Sparse Autoencoder Seeds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34637)
*Karl Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文检验稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在不同随机种子间按方向匹配后，移除匹配特征是否会对视觉编码器输出产生几乎相同的改变，即“移除是否跨种子成立”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同随机种子训练的SAE会学到不同特征；已有工作仅按方向相似性做一对一匹配，但方向相似的特征可能响应不同图像区域，因此移除它们对编码器的影响可能不同，仅靠方向匹配不足以说明特征可迁移。

Method: 固定DINOv2或SigLIP的某一层及SAE特征数，分别移除一个特征和其在另一SAE中的匹配特征，在相同留出图像上比较编码器输出的变化；若第二次变化几乎复现第一次，则称该移除跨种子成立。设置随机方向SAE和打乱匹配作为对照，并比较用层贡献与用方向预测哪些移除会成立。

Result: 在三个设置中，12%到70%的匹配对在给定容差下移除成立；两个对照中该比例为0%。事后预测移除是否成立时，层贡献比方向更准确，但仍有一些错误预测，且其中一个在独立图像上持续存在。

Conclusion: 按方向匹配的跨种子SAE特征并不保证移除效果一致；可在层级别筛选匹配对，但筛选会漏掉一些错误，测量编码器输出能检测到这些遗漏。

Abstract: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.

</details>


### [216] [Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34681)
*Kyungmin Min,Soyeon Kim,Junseok Kim,Kyomin Jung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文分析思考型视觉语言模型在知识型视觉问答中的表现，发现实体识别是主要瓶颈，且识别依赖“实体回忆线索”。为此提出 ClueRL，通过强化学习引导模型关注图像中的关键细节线索，从而提升实体识别和下游知识型视觉问答表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识型视觉问答需要先识别图像中的实体，再回忆相关知识。尽管思考型视觉语言模型会进行长链推理，但其在实体识别和知识回忆两个步骤上的表现尚不清楚，尤其是识别瓶颈及错误来源缺乏系统分析。

Method: 作者在 ViQuAE 等任务上分析四个思考型 VLM 的错误来源，发现多数错误来自实体误识别，且提供实体名称后多数失败可解决；识别主要受“实体回忆线索”驱动。基于此提出 ClueRL，在 GRPO 基础上将优势信号定位到思维轨迹中的实体回忆线索，引导模型更关注视觉细节并利用已有知识，而非注入新实体知识。

Result: ClueRL 在三个实体识别基准上优于 GRPO 和感知奖励基线；其线索寻找行为可泛化到训练任务之外的实体识别，并因识别瓶颈的改善而提升知识型视觉问答表现。该方法还提升通用多模态推理，使 Qwen3.5-4B 在 MMStar 的 ScienceQA 和 MMMU 子集上分别提高 4.4 和 4.0 分。

Conclusion: 思考型 VLM 在知识型视觉问答中的关键瓶颈是实体识别，而非知识缺失；通过强化学习奖励思维轨迹中的实体回忆线索，可改善视觉细节关注和实体识别，并将收益迁移到知识型视觉问答及更广泛的多模态推理任务。

Abstract: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.

</details>


### [217] [A Computational Model of Continuous Recognition Memory for Natural Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33947)
*Sheng Zhao,Yijin Wang,Bei Xiao,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个用于连续识别记忆（CRM）的计算模型，统一刻画图像编码、记忆衰减和决策过程，并能逐试次预测人类识别表现及图像可记忆性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解人类连续识别记忆有助于机器视觉系统预测和生成更易记住的图像，也可用于记忆障碍诊断和记忆改善干预，因此需要可解释且高效的计算模型。

Method: 模型将每张图像编码为感知空间中的随机变量；随着记忆衰退，该变量分布发生漂移；判断当前图像是否见过时，观察者从已编码图像分布中采样并与当前图像比较，从而做出决策。

Result: 模型能在人类参与者变异范围内逐试次预测CRM任务反应；仅需4个共享参数和每个观察者2个参数，即以极少参数准确预测图像可记忆性，效果不劣于需数百万参数的先前方法。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个CRM计算模型，表明图像编码、记忆衰减和基于采样的决策机制可解释连续识别记忆，并实现高效预测。

Abstract: Recognizing an image we have seen before is a basic function of human visual memory. Understanding human continuous recognition memory (CRM) can help machine vision systems predict which images people are likely to remember and generate more memorable images. It can also inform the diagnosis of memory impairments and the development of interventions to improve memory. This paper proposes the first computational model for CRM. The model captures three key components of continuous recognition memory (CRM): image encoding, memory decay, and decision making. It encodes each image as a distinct random variable in a perceptual space. As the memory of an image fades, the distribution of its random variable drifts within that space. To decide whether the current image has been seen before, the observer retrieves samples from the distributions associated with previously encoded images and compares them with the current image. Our model predicts human observers' trial-by-trial responses in CRM tasks within the variability observed across human participants. Our model is parameter efficient, requiring only four shared parameters and two parameters per observer. It can accurately predict the memorability of an image no worse than prior methods that require millions of parameters.

</details>


### [218] [Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34813)
*Dezhi Luo,Fengyuan Yu,Haotian Zhang,Zehong Zhao,Ran Ji,Siyuan An,Huayi Qin,Qingying Gao,Zhongang Cai,Lei Yang,Ziqi Huang,Ruisi Wang,Maijunxian Wang,Hokin Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文在相同任务、输入、输出规范和评估器下，比较视频生成模型与代码智能体通过程序合成完成视觉推理的可靠性。结果显示，程序合成整体显著优于视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频生成模型常被当作视觉推理器，即根据首帧和自然语言提示生成执行任务的视频，并被认为视觉推理更原生。但这一“原生”路径是否比符号化替代方案更可靠，尚未在同等条件下得到验证。

Method: 在包含500个实例、覆盖五类认知任务且具有符号真值的VBVR-Pro-Bench上，让代码智能体仅获得与视频模型相同的首帧和提示，无真值、元数据或生成模型访问权限，每个实例仅尝试一次；智能体编写程序渲染答案视频，再由未修改的规则评估器评分。

Result: 三个闭源模型智能体Codex+gpt-6-astra、Claude Code+Fable 5.1、Gemini CLI+Gemini 3.1 Pro分别得分0.923、0.894、0.893，均比最强视频模型高0.22以上；23个可运行开源权重模型中最佳的GLM-5达到0.572，除RL训练的视频模型外高于所有视频模型。

Conclusion: 对于可由首帧和提示计算求解的任务，程序合成目前是比视频生成更可靠的视觉推理路径。论文还区分“描绘式程序”和“命题式程序”，揭示智能体编写程序中的视觉推理方式及其对推理本质的启示。

Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.

</details>


### [219] [Where to Approximate: Understanding and Accelerating Looped Multi-View Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33948)
*Siyuan Zhang,Yuhan Chen,Yangyang Ning,Nan Wang,Jun Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究循环多视角重建中近似误差如何影响后续细化，并据此提出一种更高效的重建方法：早期降低空间分辨率并池化键值，交替复用注意力输出与完整注意力，并结合轻量自蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环多视角重建通过重复应用共享Transformer块来细化场景特征，但降低每步更新成本需要理解某一步近似会如何影响后续细化及最终输出。

Method: 在Déjà View和堆叠重建Transformer中采用成对干预，分离近似注入的误差、误差传播及其对输出的影响；使用尺度调整的状态误差度量和局部雅可比分解分析通道门控与空间误差结构响应；据此提出降低早期空间分辨率、池化键值、交错注意力输出复用与完整注意力，并采用轻量自蒸馏适配的方法。

Result: 在Déjà View中，近似误差比匹配随机扰动更易被衰减；相同最终范数下，近似误差对预测旋转的影响是随机误差的1.55倍。所提平衡配置在五个重建基准上比官方16步Déjà View快1.63倍，平均姿态AUC@3°仅下降1.86点；在相同延迟下，其AUC@3°比使用完整细化块的训练基线插值曲线高4.73点，并改善相应几何指标。

Conclusion: 理解近似误差的注入、传播和输出影响可指导更高效的循环多视角重建设计；所提方法在速度与精度之间取得更好平衡，并在匹配延迟下优于完整细化基线。

Abstract: Looped multi-view reconstruction refines scene features by repeatedly applying a shared transformer block. Making these updates cheaper requires knowing how an approximation at one step affects the rest of the refinement. We study this with paired interventions in Déjà View and stacked reconstruction transformers, separating the error an approximation injects, how that error propagates, and how it affects the output. In Déjà View, approximation errors are attenuated more strongly than matched random perturbations under a scale-adjusted state-error measure, and a local Jacobian decomposition separates the contribution of channel gating from the response to spatial error structure. Spatial approximations made early benefit from subsequent refinement, whereas cross-step reuse depends on which quantity is cached and how reuse steps are spaced. At equal final norm, approximation errors change the predicted rotations 1.55 times as much as random errors. These findings guide our proposed method, which reduces spatial resolution and pools keys and values early in refinement, then interleaves attention-output reuse with full attention, and is adapted through lightweight self-distillation. Across five reconstruction benchmarks, the balanced configuration runs $1.63\times$ faster than the official 16-step Déjà View model with a 1.86-point reduction in average pose AUC@$3^\circ$. At matched latency, it exceeds the interpolated curve of a trained baseline using full refinement blocks by 4.73 points in AUC@$3^\circ$ and improves the corresponding geometry metrics.

</details>


### [220] [Probing Visual Idiosyncrasies in Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34843)
*Yongqian Peng,Hongjie Li,Yichao Zhou,Chi Zhang,Yixin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究前沿文生图模型生成的图像是否仍可被识别来源，并发现标准ResNet-50在四个顶级开源模型间可达100%分类准确率，而人类仅62.61%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着文生图模型视觉质量接近，仍需判断其输出是否保留模型特有特征，这对图像归因、模型比较以及假设匿名性的人类偏好评估都很重要。

Method: 使用ResNet-50对HiDream-O1-Dev、FLUX.2-dev、HunyuanImage-3.0和Qwen-Image-2512生成的图像进行来源分类；结合低层纹理统计、MLP、物体布局/深度/反照率、图像描述等分析区分线索，并进行人类实验、图像损坏和分布外提示测试。

Result: ResNet-50在留出提示上达到100.00%来源识别准确率，人类成对判断仅62.61%；低层纹理即可让轻量MLP匹配ResNet-50，布局、深度、反照率和描述中的风格/背景偏好均携带来源信号；一句提示可使人类准确率提高9.03个百分点。

Conclusion: 前沿文生图模型输出存在可检测的视觉特异性，可用于衡量模型间及真实/生成图像间相似性，并提醒在人类偏好评估中不应默认模型匿名。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models turn short text descriptions into images, and the leading models now produce images of comparable visual quality. Whether their outputs still carry model-specific characteristics matters for attribution, for model comparison beyond aggregate quality, and for evaluations that assume anonymity. We ask whether images from frontier T2I models can still be classified by source, and which visual properties make this possible. Here we show that a standard ResNet-50 identifies the source of an image among HiDream-O1-Dev, FLUX.2-dev, HunyuanImage-3.0, and Qwen-Image-2512, the four highest-ranked open-source models on the Text-to-Image Arena, with 100.00% accuracy on held-out prompts. Human participants reach only 62.61% on the pairwise version of this task, so the distinguishing cues are not visually obvious. They are also not tied to a particular classifier and survive severe image corruptions and out-of-distribution prompts. We trace them to visual idiosyncrasies at three levels. Low-level texture statistics alone let a lightweight multi-layer perceptron match ResNet-50. Object layout, depth, and albedo estimated from the images each carry a source signal. Image captions reveal model-specific preferences in style and background that the prompts never specify. A one-sentence hint about these cues raises human accuracy by 9.03 percentage points. These idiosyncrasies make source classification a tool for measuring similarity between models and between real and generated images, and they caution against assuming anonymity in human preference evaluation of T2I models.

</details>


### [221] [Where Does Free-Text 3D Grounding Fail? An Error Analysis of Report-Sentence Segmentation in Chest CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33958)
*Abdullah Arif Sheikh,Kamalaker Dadi,Raju S. Bapi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统分析自由文本3D医学图像定位模型VoxTell在CT报告句子定位任务中的失败模式，发现主要瓶颈是范围估计与小病灶敏感性，而非解剖位置理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由文本3D grounding可大规模连接放射报告与CT图像，但尚不清楚现有模型具体失败在哪里，因此需要细粒度错误分析以指导改进。

Method: 在ReXGroundingCT验证集全部200次扫描的381条findings上分析VoxTell，并在隐藏的300次扫描测试集上验证；统计失败类型，并消融位置词及基于句子的解剖规则。

Result: VoxTell定位53.5%的findings。失败很少是病灶或左右侧混淆：没有漏检位于命名对侧，findings之间几乎不混淆。主要问题是预测范围过大、落在同侧邻近病灶、小病灶漏检，弥漫性findings很少被定位。去除位置词使性能减半至仅标签提示水平，解剖规则从未改善完整句子输出；隐藏测试集呈现相同模式。

Conclusion: 未来进展应集中于范围估计和小病灶敏感性，而非解剖后处理。

Abstract: Free-text 3D grounding, segmenting in a CT volume the region described by one sentence of the radiology report, could link reports to images at scale, but it is unclear where current models fail. We analyse the publicly released VoxTell model on all 381 findings of the 200-scan ReXGroundingCT validation set, where it grounds 53.5% of findings. Its failures are rarely about which lesion or side is meant. No miss lies on the side opposite to the one named, and findings are almost never confused with one another. Instead, predictions are too large, land on a neighbouring lesion on the correct side, or are missing for small findings, and diffuse findings are rarely grounded. Removing location words halves performance, to the level of label-only prompting, and anatomical rules derived from the sentence never improve the full-sentence output. The same pattern holds on the hidden 300-scan test set. Further progress therefore depends on extent estimation and small-lesion sensitivity rather than on anatomical post-processing.

</details>


### [222] [Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34899)
*Rikard Vinge,Miguel A. Belenguer-Plomer,Isabelle Wittmann,Octavian Dumitru,Michele Lazzarini,Sergio Albani,Conrad M Albrecht*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作基于TerraMind地球观测基础模型，利用Sentinel-1 SAR图像的压缩潜空间嵌入开展海上态势感知，实现船舶检测、定位和类型分类，并发布约2000幅Sentinel-1图像与AIS信号配对的新海事遥感数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上态势感知的EO处理面临数据体量（data gravity）瓶颈，直接处理原始Sentinel-1影像成本高；研究旨在验证地理空间基础模型的压缩嵌入是否可用于高效、细粒度的MDA任务。

Method: 直接在压缩潜空间表示上操作，而非原始SAR影像；对压缩嵌入进行线性和非线性探测，用于从Sentinel-1 GRD图像中检测、定位和表征船舶；同时构建并人工校验Sentinel-1与时间对齐AIS信号配对数据集，并接入NeuCo-Bench神经压缩基准框架。
