Result: 船舶检测ROC-AUC达0.95；对长度超过100 m的船舶，定位中位误差约300 m；AIS类型码分类在主要类别上准确率为62%，且该性能与船舶长度高度相关。

Conclusion: 结果展示了GeoFMs在真实场景细粒度MDA理解中的潜力与当前局限；发布的约2000个样本数据集已公开，可用于后续神经压缩与下游任务基准评测。

Abstract: This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios.
  Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S1-single-ship-downstream .

</details>


### [223] [FasterGRN: Reducing the Refinement Redundancy for Accelerating Generative Refinement Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33982)
*Ziqian Zhang,Pengcheng Wang,Yulong Chen,Yaxing Wang,Senmao Li,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 FasterGRN，一种无需训练的生成式精炼网络加速方法，通过分析生成过程特征并减少精炼冗余，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升采样速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRN 通过迭代精炼实现高质量图像生成，但对整个视觉表示反复处理带来较大计算开销；同时其二值表示和全局精炼机制使其他生成模型的加速策略难以直接适用。

Method: 作者分析完整生成过程，发现阶段特性、双分支相似性以及精炼冗余等关键性质。基于此，FasterGRN 将 GRN 划分为语义建立阶段和细节精炼阶段，并针对细节精炼阶段的冗余提出自适应保留扩展（ARE）和选择性 token 冻结（STF），分别减少精炼步数和 token 计算量，且无需额外训练。

Result: 在 GenEval 和 DPG-Bench 基准上，FasterGRN 实现 2.03 倍采样加速，同时较大程度保持图像生成性能；在 COCO 数据集上的评估还表明，其图像保真度甚至优于原始 GRN。

Conclusion: FasterGRN 是一种有效的免训练 GRN 加速方案，能够利用生成过程的结构性冗余显著降低计算成本，并在多个基准上保持甚至提升生成质量。

Abstract: Departing from the paradigm of diffusion and autoregressive models, Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) enables high-quality image generation through iterative refinements. However, this repeated processing over the entire visual representations results in substantial computation overhead. Furthermore, the binary representations and global refinement mechanism in GRN disable the direct application of acceleration strategies developed for other generative models. To accelerate GRN model, we first observe several key properties by analyzing the entire generative process. That includes the stage characteristic, dual branch similarity and more importantly, the $\textbf{refinement redundancy}$. Motivated by the observations, we present $\textbf{FasterGRN}$, a training-free acceleration method for the Generative Refinement Network. $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ first divides the GRN into the semantic establishment stage and detail refinement stage according to its semantic establishment. For alleviating the refinement redundancy mainly resulting from the detail refinement stage, we propose Adaptive Retention Expansion ($\textbf{ARE}$) and Selective Token Freezing ($\textbf{STF}$) to shrink refinement steps and reduce token computations, respectively. In the experiments on GenEval and DPG-Bench benchmarks, our method $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ achieves a $2.03\times$ sampling speedup while largely preserving image generation performance. Our evaluation on COCO datasets additionally demonstrates that $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ even outperforms the original GRN in image fidelity.

</details>


### [224] [geo-eval-harness: An Evaluation Harness for Geospatial Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33990)
*Nils Lehmann,Caleb Robinson,Isaac Corley,Jennifer Marcus,Inbal Becker-Reshef,Juan M. Lavista Ferres,Hannah Kerner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出开源框架 geo-eval-harness，用于在受控设置下公平比较地理空间基础模型（GFM）与通用视觉模型，并系统评估了100个模型在6个分类和14个分割数据集上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GFM研究评估设置不一致（如预处理和探针不同），导致难以区分模型性能与评估选择的影响，因此需要标准化、可控且可复现的评估框架。

Method: 作者构建geo-eval-harness开源框架，在冻结编码器或低秩适配编码器上使用多种探针，对100个GFM和通用视觉模型在6个分类数据集与14个分割数据集上进行受控比较，并分析置信区间、推理FLOPs和大面积制图部署成本。

Result: 受控评估下，通用视觉骨干在RGB分类和高分辨率分割上具有竞争力，而GFM在多光谱任务上表现更优；前十分类模型在单数据集上两两比较时95%置信区间有73%重叠；模型更大不一定更好，推理FLOPs与分割性能相关性较弱；在SpaceNet2冻结编码器设置下，0.9个mIoU点差异对应5.9倍计算量和数天额外GPU时间。

Conclusion: 模型比较应在明确固定设置下进行，并同时报告不确定性和部署计算成本；geo-eval-harness使受控实验更简单、快速且完全可复现，代码、配置和结果已开源。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation model (GFM) research papers are plagued by inconsistent evaluation settings (e.g., different pre-processing and probes), making it difficult to separate performance from evaluation choices. We propose geo-eval-harness}, an open-source framework for controlled model comparisons. We use this harness to evaluate 100 GFMs and general vision models on 6 classification and 14 segmentation datasets, using multiple probes on frozen or low-rank-adapted encoders. We show that under controlled evaluation, general vision backbones are competitive on RGB classification and high-resolution segmentation, but GFMs shine on multispectral tasks. When we compare any two of the top-ten classification models on a single dataset, their 95% confidence intervals overlap 73% of the time. We show that bigger models are not always better: inference FLOPs correlate weakly with segmentation performance. Moreover, translating inference compute into large-area mapping workloads shows how small accuracy differences have outsized deployment cost differences: with frozen encoders on SpaceNet2, a 0.9-point mIoU difference corresponds to 5.9x the compute and days of additional projected GPU time. Our findings stress the importance of comparing models under explicit and fixed settings, and reporting uncertainty and deployment compute alongside accuracy. Our geo-eval-harness makes controlled experiments easy, fast, and fully reproducible. We release the code, configurations, and results at https://github.com/torchgeo/geo-eval-harness.

</details>


### [225] [ScaleCurve: From Constant Scale to Consistent Motion for World-Space Human Mesh Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34005)
*Sanghyeon Lee,Jong Taek Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 ScaleCurve 框架，从人体与地面几何关系中估计随时间变化的度量尺度校正，以改善世界坐标系人体网格恢复中的空间一致性和相机轨迹尺度失真问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界坐标人体网格恢复即使相机坐标人体估计准确，也可能丢失空间一致性。单一序列尺度只能解决全局尺度歧义，无法纠正重建相机路径上的局部尺度畸变。

Method: 通过比较预测脚部几何与局部拟合的地面平面构建尺度观测；联合时序优化对不一致观测降权并耦合相邻尺度估计；对相机平移增量进行缩放并积分得到校准轨迹；固定相机后，利用2D图像证据和预训练3D动态先验细化提升的人体运动，同时限制全局轨迹重缩放。

Result: ScaleCurve 在 EMDB-2 和 SLOPER4D 上大多数评估指标达到最先进性能；在三种 HMR 主干网络上均取得一致增益，表明无需重训练即可兼容多种人体估计方法。

Conclusion: 利用人体-地面几何估计时变尺度校正，可在保持相机轨迹校准的同时提升世界坐标人体运动恢复的空间一致性，并具有较好的骨干网络兼容性。

Abstract: World-space human mesh recovery can lose spatial consistency even when camera-space body estimates are accurate. A single sequence-wide scale resolves global scale ambiguity but cannot correct local scale distortion along a reconstructed camera path. We present ScaleCurve, a framework that estimates time-varying metric corrections from human-ground geometry. We construct scale observations by comparing predicted foot geometry with locally fitted ground planes. Joint temporal optimization downweights inconsistent observations and couples neighboring scale estimates, allowing calibration to adapt along the camera path without freely following measurement noise. We scale camera translation increments and integrate them into a calibrated trajectory. With this camera fixed, we refine the lifted body motion using 2D image evidence and pretrained 3D dynamics, while restricting global trajectory rescaling. ScaleCurve achieves state-of-the-art performance on most evaluated metrics on both EMDB-2 and SLOPER4D. Consistent gains across three HMR backbones demonstrate its compatibility with diverse body estimates without retraining. Code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [226] [Manga Page Parser: Comprehensive Visual Parsing through Local Story Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34006)
*Yingxuan Li,Jiafeng Mao,Arata Furukawa,Mayu Otani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出MangaParser，一个无需额外训练或微调的智能体阅读框架，通过局部故事理解对每张双页漫画独立解析，联合完成角色聚类、说话人分离和说话人-角色绑定，并生成可复用的结构化故事表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解漫画需要把出场人物、说话者与跨分镜展开的事件、角色状态和关系联系起来；研究旨在通过局部故事理解捕获并组织每张双页漫画的故事信息，形成可复用的结构化表示。

Method: 提出MangaParser智能体阅读框架，在共享多模态对话中联合执行角色聚类、说话人分离和说话人到角色的绑定；利用结构化故事记忆指导角色与说话人识别，在不确定时检查相关图像区域，并随证据积累共同优化预测和故事记录。

Result: 定量评估显示，该解析器在多个骨干模型上显著优于漫画专用模型；解析示例表明统一表示能将角色和说话人预测与叙事内容及支撑证据关联；进一步用问题提供前生成的输出进行故事问答，验证了输出的可复用性。

Conclusion: 该方法确认了输出可复用性，为漫画翻译、内容检索和问答提供了基础。

Abstract: Understanding manga requires connecting who appears and who speaks with the events, character states, and relationships that unfold across panels. We study manga visual parsing through local story understanding: analyzing each double-page spread independently to capture and organize its story information in a reusable structured representation. We propose MangaParser, an agentic reading framework that jointly performs character clustering, speaker diarization, and speaker-to-character binding within a shared multimodal conversation, without additional training or fine-tuning. The agent uses structured story memory to guide character and speaker identification, inspecting relevant image regions when uncertain and refining its predictions and story records together as evidence accumulates. Quantitative evaluations show that our parser substantially outperforms manga-specific models across multiple backbones. Parsing examples illustrate how a unified representation links the character and speaker predictions with narrative content and supporting evidence. We further test reusability through story question answering using outputs generated before the questions are provided. The results confirm output reusability, offering a foundation for manga translation, content retrieval, and question answering.

</details>


### [227] [Rethinking Unsupervised Cross-Modal Homography Estimation:Spatially Aware Representations and Geometric Consistency Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34021)
*Zhuoran Yang,Junchen Yu,Runmin Zhang,Linshan Li,Chenghao Zhang,Hui-liang Shen,Si-Yuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 GeoCo 框架，用于无监督跨模态单应性估计，通过几何感知特征与一致性约束减少模态差异对配准的影响，并进一步蒸馏出轻量模型 GeoCo-D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态图像存在显著外观差异，会掩盖共享几何结构；现有方法将模态转换与单应性估计分离，但仍需有效的几何表示和子任务间一致性约束，且缺乏跨模态转换标签。

Method: GeoCo 包含 RVHomo 单应性估计器，融合冻结视觉基础模型的分层特征与局部 CNN 特征；引入两个几何一致性约束，分别要求模态转换保持几何结构、单应性预测在合成几何变换下保持一致；再通过两阶段渐进蒸馏得到使用轻量 RVHomo-D 的 GeoCo-D，先学习无模态转换的跨模态匹配，再迁移预测与特征知识，从而免去在线 VFM 提取。

Result: 在 GoogleMap、OPT-SAR、FSD 和 VIS-IR 数据集上，GeoCo 相比各数据集最佳基线将平均角点误差降低 17.4% 至 46.7%；GeoCo-D 优于所有对比基线，同时相比完整 GeoCo 教师模型参数减少 98.5%，FLOPs 减少 70.4%。

Conclusion: GeoCo 通过几何感知特征融合和一致性约束有效提升无监督跨模态单应性估计性能；渐进蒸馏可在显著降低计算与参数成本的同时保持优于基线的效果。

Abstract: Unsupervised cross-modal homography estimation is challenging because appearance differences obscure shared geometric structures. Separating modality transfer from homography estimation helps reduce these differences, but accurate alignment still requires effective geometric representations and consistency constraints on the two subtasks. We propose GeoCo (Geometry-Aware and Consistency-Constrained Homography Estimation), a framework that addresses these two requirements without cross-modal transformation labels. Its homography estimator, RVHomo, adapts hierarchical features from a frozen vision foundation model (VFM) and fuses them with local CNN features to capture structural context and spatial detail. Two geometric consistency constraints encourage modality transfer to preserve geometry and homography predictions to remain consistent under synthetic geometric transformations. Through two-stage progressive distillation, we further obtain GeoCo-D, which uses the lightweight RVHomo-D estimator. An intermediate model first learns to perform cross-modal matching without modality transfer, then transfers prediction and feature knowledge to the student, eliminating online VFM extraction. Experiments on GoogleMap, OPT-SAR, FSD, and VIS-IR show that GeoCo reduces mean average corner error by 17.4-46.7% relative to the best-performing baseline on each dataset. GeoCo-D also outperforms all compared baselines while using 98.5% fewer parameters and 70.4% fewer FLOPs than the complete GeoCo teacher.

</details>


### [228] [MoSk: A Unified Motion-Skeleton Foundation Model for Human Motion Understanding and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34022)
*Yun Chen,Munchurl Kim,Jeonghyeok Do*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MoSk，首个融合运动数据集与骨架数据集的运动-骨架基础模型，通过自监督掩码运动建模学习共享表示，并在动作识别与运动生成任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在视觉理解与生成中表现突出，但在人体运动领域的作用尚未充分探索；大规模运动数据缺乏动作标签，骨架数据便于评估但规模和多样性有限，因此需要整合二者优势。

Method: MoSk融合运动与骨架数据，采用自监督掩码运动建模学习共享表示；引入关节名称嵌入以统一不同骨架格式的解剖参考；使用交叉注意力解码器，根据关节名称嵌入指定目标关节并重建被掩码的运动。

Result: 在线性评估和微调等多种设置下取得较强的动作识别性能；通过表示对齐显著提升多种骨干网络的运动生成效果，在MotionMillion上无条件下FID最多降低9.75，文本到运动生成最多降低3.83。

Conclusion: MoSk表明融合运动与骨架数据并采用自监督掩码建模可有效学习可迁移的人体运动表示，同时促进动作识别和运动生成任务。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) have advanced visual understanding and generation by providing semantically rich representations. However, this role of FMs remains underexplored in human motion. Large motion datasets offer diverse movements at scale, but often lack action labels for systematically evaluating learned representations on understanding tasks. Skeleton datasets enable such evaluation through established recognition protocols, yet are typically smaller and focus on predefined actions captured in controlled environments. To combine these strengths, we present MoSk, to the best of our knowledge, the first Motion-Skeleton foundation model to integrate motion and skeleton datasets. MoSk learns shared representations through self-supervised masked motion modeling. We incorporate joint-name embeddings to provide a common anatomical reference across various skeleton formats. A cross-attention decoder reconstructs masked motion from the encoder's features, with joint-name embeddings specifying the target joints. Experiments demonstrate strong action-recognition performance across diverse settings, including linear evaluation and fine-tuning. MoSk also substantially improves motion generation across multiple backbones through representation alignment, reducing FID on MotionMillion by up to 9.75 for unconditional generation and 3.83 for text-to-motion generation.

</details>


### [229] [ContextHands: Completing Hand Motion with Learned Context and Joint-Specific Body Kinematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34027)
*Taewoo Kim,Seunghun Koh,Hyosup Shin,Sungho Jo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ContextHands，根据身体动作序列与文本描述生成/补全手部动作，并在 OakInk2 上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部细节能提升生成人体动作的真实感与表现力，但从身体动作和语言推断手部关节运动需要将动作上下文与手部关节衔接起来。

Method: 学习由文本描述和身体运动得到的手部概率特征，并通过辅助手部预测将特征映射到手部关节；身体编码器在多时间尺度保留关节和身体部位特征，使每个手部关节可查询关节特定身体信息；扩散生成器融合这些信息与手部上下文，编码器和生成器联合训练。

Result: 在 OakInk2 数据集上，ContextHands 生成更准确的手部动作，Fréchet Hand Distance 低于适配该任务的手部动作生成和通用人体动作生成方法；在抓取和工具使用示例中更接近参考动作的细节手部姿态。

Conclusion: ContextHands 能有效结合身体动作与文本上下文来补全细节手部动作，代码和预训练模型将公开以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Detailed hand motion contributes to the realism and expressiveness of generated human motion. Completing these details from body motion and language requires connecting the context of an action to the articulation of the hands. We introduce ContextHands, which completes hand motion from an observed body sequence and text descriptions assigned to hands and time intervals. Our approach learns probabilistic hand features from the descriptions and body motion, using auxiliary hand prediction to connect these features to hand articulation. A body encoder preserves joint and body-part features across multiple temporal scales, allowing each hand joint to query these features for joint-specific body information. The diffusion generator combines this joint-specific body information with the learned hand context. Both encoders and the generator are trained jointly, so the final generation objective also shapes the context features. Experiments on the OakInk2 dataset show that ContextHands generates more accurate hand motion and achieves lower Fréchet Hand Distance than existing hand-motion and general human-motion generation methods adapted to the task. In qualitative examples of grasping and tool use, ContextHands more closely reproduces the detailed hand poses in the reference motion. We will release our code and pretrained models to support further research.

</details>


### [230] [Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34056)
*Xiaofeng Mao,Fu-yun Wang,Le Zhuo,Zhengkai Jiang,Shaohao Rui,Weijie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文综述并比较扩散与流生成模型的推理加速方法，围绕蒸馏、一致性训练、采样方法和去噪器设计，分析图像与视频生成中的质量—成本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散和流生成模型采样通常需要数十到数百次去噪器评估，随分辨率、视频长度或模型规模增加成本更高，影响交互式和边缘应用的延迟与能耗。

Method: 文章考察四类加速推理方法：蒸馏、一致性训练、采样方法和去噪器设计；用统一记号表达训练目标、转移映射和数值更新，以比较学习目标、采样轨迹及单次去噪器计算量，并结合已发表图像和视频基准进行分析。

Result: 结果展示了单步与少步生成的质量—成本权衡、求解器与时间步调度之间的交互、特征缓存的影响，以及首帧延迟与持续流式吞吐之间的差异。

Conclusion: 文章指出开放问题包括视觉原生架构、压缩后蒸馏、求解器感知的少步训练，以及结合因子化分布匹配的语义轨迹对齐。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.

</details>


### [231] [Surf-Style: Surface-Based Scene Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34062)
*Wanrong Hong,Ancheng Lin,Mukesh Prasad,Jun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Surf-Style，一种基于表面的场景风格化方法，通过重建 3D 物体表面并在 3D 空间上定义可学习外观模型，实现跨视角一致且可控的 3D 风格化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 风格化需要跨视角一致性，但独立对每个渲染视角应用 2D 风格化会导致视角间不一致；现有基于隐式辐射场的方法因像素外观与可学习场景参数之间是间接依赖，优化时颜色更新存在歧义，难以保证一致风格化。

Method: Surf-Style 先重建 3D 场景中的物体表面，并利用这些表面实现几何一致性和局部化风格化；随后在 3D 空间上定义可学习外观模型，并通过参考图像修改该模型以复制其视觉风格。

Result: 与最先进方法相比，Surf-Style 实现了更优的一致性，并在可控风格化方面具有更高灵活性，包括针对特定表面区域进行风格化以及组合不同风格。

Conclusion: 基于表面的场景风格化能够有效解决 3D 风格化中的跨视角一致性问题，并支持更灵活、更局部的可控风格编辑。

Abstract: Consistent and controllable 3D stylization is critical for visual computing applications such as immersive visualization, augmented and virtual reality content creation, and artistic scene rendering. While 2D image stylization has advanced significantly, extending these methods to 3D remains challenging due to the need for cross-view consistency, where stylized renderings must align across all viewpoints. Applying 2D stylization independently to each rendered view often results in inconsistencies across perspectives. Existing methods attempt to improve consistency by leveraging implicit radiance field representations, which model scene appearance as a function of spatial locations. However, these methods struggle with ambiguity in updating colors, as the indirect dependence between pixel appearance and learnable scene parameters makes it difficult to enforce consistent stylization during optimization. This work presents Surface-based Scene Stylization (Surf-Style), which reconstructs object surfaces in a 3D scene and uses these surfaces to achieve geometric consistency and localized stylization. Surf-Style defines a learnable appearance model over 3D space, which is modified to replicate the visual style of a reference image. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior consistency and offers greater flexibility in controllable stylization, including the ability to target specific surface regions and combine different styles.

</details>


### [232] [SPARC: Geometry-Guided Attention Pruning for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34064)
*Zesong Yang,Weikai Chen,Liyuan Cui,Yuan Li,Jiaxin Huang,Lutao Jiang,Runze Zhang,Yingda Yin,Xiaoyang Huang,Kai Yan,Keyang Luo,Xin Wang,Hujun Bao,Zhaopeng Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPARC 是一个几何引导的注意力剪枝框架，将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 的原生自注意力统一用于相机控制和持久场景记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建已观测内容与合成新区域对上下文的需求不对称；现有方法通常需要额外的可学习控制或记忆模块，且注意力计算开销大。

Method: 利用注意力连通性同时作为相机控制的几何条件和历史记忆检索的空间寻址；对已观测 token 仅保留几何对应的历史 token 与局部时空上下文，对未观测区域保留稠密注意力；并引入对应感知注意力偏置和顺序不变历史定位以实现长时序稳定检索。

Result: 无需额外可学习控制或记忆模块，即可实现精确相机跟随和忠实场景重访，同时显著降低注意力计算；结合四步蒸馏可实现超过 50 倍的推理加速。

Conclusion: 实验表明激进注意力剪枝能有效提升相机 adherence、重访一致性和视觉保真度，验证了 SPARC 的有效性。

Abstract: We present SPARC, a geometry-guided attention pruning framework that turns the native self-attention of pretrained video diffusion transformers into a unified mechanism for camera control and persistent scene memory. Our key insight is that attention connectivity can simultaneously serve as geometric conditioning for camera control and spatial addressing for historical memory retrieval. Motivated by the asymmetric contextual requirements of reconstructing observed content and synthesizing novel regions, SPARC restricts observed tokens to geometrically corresponding historical tokens and local spatiotemporal context, while preserving dense attention for unobserved regions. Correspondence-aware attention biasing and order-invariant historical positioning further enable stable retrieval across long temporal gaps. Without introducing additional learnable control or memory modules, SPARC achieves precise camera adherence and faithful scene revisitation while substantially reducing attention computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of aggressive attention pruning in improving camera adherence, revisit consistency, and visual fidelity, with an inference speedup of over 50x when combined with four-step distillation. Project page is available at https://zju3dv.github.io/SPARC.

</details>


### [233] [When to Respond, Where to Ground: Streaming 3D Affordance Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34067)
*Wenting Luan,Weilong Yan,Siqi Lu,Ming Li,Beibei Lin,Yongbin Zheng,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 StreamAff，用于连续 RGB-D 流和语言请求下的流式 3D 可供性定位，同时决定何时响应以及在哪里定位功能部件，并引入 StreamFun3D 基准和 StreamIoU 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 可供性定位方法通常假设已有完整场景观测，而流式视觉语言模型又缺乏细粒度 3D 功能部件定位能力，因此需要在连续观测中联合解决响应时机和功能部件定位问题。

Method: StreamAff 利用定位模型自身的视觉证据进行决策：对已读取帧的视觉 patch 打分，以综合支持度与等待选项比较来决定何时响应，并以最高分 patch 选择定位帧；采用条件回看策略决定立即基于早期观测回答还是等待新证据；通过 zoom-and-refine 在所选帧的 3D 点上分割答案中的部件。论文还构建 StreamFun3D 基准，覆盖 Current、History、Future、Unobserved 四种证据设置，并提出 StreamIoU 指标。

Result: StreamAff 在 15 秒流上达到 30.14% StreamIoU，相比最强基线取得 40.6% 的相对提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在连续场景观测中联合决定响应时机与功能部件定位是可行且有效的，StreamAff 优于离线 3D 可供性定位方法和外部决策器基线。

Abstract: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder. StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

</details>


### [234] [TaCo: Rethinking Correlation for Visual Tracking on Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34084)
*Qingmao Wei,Fagui Liu,Quan Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出TaCo（Target-aligned Correlation），在轻量跟踪器中用目标对齐的相关操作替代注意力交互，在边缘NPU和CPU上实现更高速度与更高精度的折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量跟踪器用注意力替代互相关，但注意力中的softmax、归一化和reshape等内存受限操作在低功耗边缘硬件上开销很大；而相关跟踪器虽快，却因缺乏目标条件化能力而精度不足，除非采用ViT骨干又把注意力带回。

Method: 作者在统一数值验证协议下评测边缘NPU和Arm CPU上的高效跟踪器，并重新审视相关操作缺失的能力：模板-搜索交互应同时包含目标条件化和空间匹配。TaCo让模板仅以每视频计算一次的算子进入逐帧网络：用目标描述符在骨干内对搜索特征逐通道缩放和偏移，并用由模板预测权重的目标框对齐卷积核通过一次矩阵乘法完成相关。

Result: TaCo-T在Rockchip RV1126B NPU上达到62.3% LaSOT AUC和184 FPS，在Raspberry Pi 5 CPU上达到96 FPS，分别为HiT-Tiny和AsymTrack-T NPU速度的3.0倍和3.5倍且精度更高；TaCo-B在NPU上达到65.6%和50 FPS，速度超过HiT-Base、AsymTrack-B和LightFC-vit两倍以上且精度更高。

Conclusion: 在骨干固定时，TaCo的相关机制仍然关键且NPU额外开销可忽略，相比测试的注意力交互提供更好的速度-精度权衡，说明无需注意力也可补齐相关跟踪器缺失的目标条件化能力。

Abstract: Lightweight trackers have replaced cross-correlation with attention, and on low-power edge hardware they pay for it, since memory-bound softmax, normalization and reshaping operators of attention cost far more time than their arithmetic suggests. Benchmarking efficient trackers on an edge Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and an Arm CPU under one numerically validated protocol, we find that correlation trackers are the fast ones, but they lag in accuracy unless they adopt a ViT backbone, which brings attention back. We revisit what correlation lacks. Template--search interaction serves two roles: conditioning the search features on the target and matching them against it spatially. Attention does both, whereas correlation only matches, and does so on features extracted without knowledge of the target. We present TaCo (Target-aligned Correlation), which supplies the missing conditioning without attention by letting the template enter the per-frame network only as operands computed once per video. A descriptor of the target scales and shifts the search features channel by channel inside the backbone, and kernels aligned with the target box, each with a weight predicted from the template, correlate with them in one matrix product. With the backbone fixed, our correlation remains essential while incurring negligible NPU overhead, offering a better speed-accuracy trade-off than the attention-based interactions we tested. TaCo-T achieves 62.3% LaSOT AUC at 184 FPS on the Rockchip RV1126B NPU and 96 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU, 3.0x and 3.5x the NPU speed of HiT-Tiny and AsymTrack-T at higher accuracy. TaCo-B reaches 65.6% at 50 FPS on the NPU, more than twice the speed of HiT-Base, AsymTrack-B and LightFC-vit, again at higher accuracy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/TsingWei/TaCo-Tracker.

</details>


### [235] [Projector Subspace Optimization for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34078)
*Hao Yu,Quan Cheng,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PROUD，一种面向多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）的持续子空间优化框架，仅终端的 vision-language projector 线性层进行高效适配，在不增加推理或路由开销的情况下提升持续准确率并缓解遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无回放方法通过扩展提示或路由 LoRA 专家来适配序列任务，带来较重的参数与路由开销，并改变内部特征分布；作者发现 projector 最后一层线性层是坐标稳定的高容量接口，顺序更新易导致历史视觉 token 位移而产生接口漂移。低秩子空间适配虽紧凑，但仅依赖历史统计或任务梯度选择方向会牺牲可塑性或稳定性，且无约束多步更新仍会累积漂移。

Method: 提出 PROUD（Projector Refinement through Optimized Update Directions），对终端 projector 层进行持续子空间优化。任务开始时，结合保留的输入统计与初始梯度，解析地提取一个度量正交子空间，在漂移预算下最大化一阶任务增益；训练中通过精确 Frobenius 惩罚将更新约束在该固定子空间内，并在训练后无损合并，实现零推理与零路由开销。

Result: 在 UCIT 和 CoIN 数据集、多种 MLLM 骨干上的实验表明，PROUD 在持续准确率上优于近期无回放基线，同时以更少可训练参数抑制遗忘。

Conclusion: 对 vision-language projector 终端层进行受约束的持续子空间优化，是兼顾稳定性、可塑性与效率的有效 MCIT 方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet adapting them to sequential tasks requires Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Existing replay-free methods expand prompts or routed LoRA experts across multi-layer decoders, incurring heavy parameter and routing overhead while shifting internal feature distributions. Instead, we identify the final linear layer of the vision-language projector as a high-capacity, coordinate-stationary bridge, where sequential updates easily induce interface drift by displacing historical visual tokens. While low-rank subspace adaptation offers a compact remedy, selecting directions solely from historical statistics or task gradients sacrifices plasticity or stability, and unconstrained multi-step updates still accumulate large drift. To resolve both issues, we propose Projector Refinement through Optimized Update Directions (PROUD), a continual subspace optimization framework for the terminal projector layer. At task onset, PROUD combines retained input statistics with initial gradients to analytically extract a metric-orthonormal subspace maximizing first-order task gain under a drift budget. During training, it regularizes updates within this fixed subspace via an exact Frobenius penalty before losslessly merging them with zero inference or routing overhead. Experiments on UCIT and CoIN across MLLM backbones show that PROUD outperforms recent replay-free baselines in continual accuracy while curbing forgetting with a fraction of trainable parameters.

</details>


### [236] [From Diagnosing Alignment to Joint Supervision in Multimodal Draft Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34091)
*Haozhe Du,Runze Liu,Jiaming Fan,Yitong Tao,Shuxia Lin,Chonghan Liu,Daming Cao,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究多模态草稿模型在多模态与纯文本监督下的对齐差异，并提出 MNRS-Joint 方法，根据草稿的组件风险分布配置多模态与纯文本监督比例，以提升推测解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态草稿可同时接受多模态和纯文本监督，但二者对草稿-目标对齐的影响以及如何组合尚不明确，尤其文本条件对齐相近的草稿在视觉响应风险与接受率上可能差异显著。

Method: 通过有无视觉输入的成对预测诊断草稿-目标对齐，将分布误差分解为文本条件与视觉响应两个组件；用受控续训实验比较不同风险组的训练表现，并据此提出 MNRS-Joint，利用组件风险分布及模态特定平均风险确定多模态与纯文本的混合比例。

Result: 高风险组在受控续训中优于随机组和低风险组，视觉响应风险比聚合风险更能指导多模态训练；MNRS-Joint 在三次预热中的混合比例均落在比例扫描的高性能区域。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，贪婪树解码下平均接受长度由 3.35 提升至 3.53，平均加速比由 2.04× 提升至 2.16×，且在随机链式解码下收益仍成立。

Conclusion: 多模态草稿的对齐应分别考虑文本条件与视觉响应风险，依据组件风险配置多模态与纯文本联合监督可有效提升推测解码的接受长度和加速效果。

Abstract: Multimodal drafts learn from multimodal (MM) and text-only (TXT) supervision, yet their effects on alignment and how to combine them remain unclear. We diagnose draft-target alignment through paired predictions with and without visual input, decomposing distributional error into text-conditioned and visual-response components. Drafts with similar text-conditioned alignment can still differ markedly in visual-response risk and acceptance. Controlled continuation training shows that high-risk groups outperform random and low-risk groups, and visual-response risk guides MM training more effectively than aggregate risk. Building on these diagnostics, we propose MNRS-Joint, which configures joint supervision from a given draft's component-risk distributions, using modality-specific mean risks to determine the MM:TXT mixture. Across three warm-ups, its distinct mixtures fall in high-performing regions of the ratio sweeps. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, MNRS-Joint improves mean accepted length from 3.35 to 3.53 and mean speedup from $2.04\times$ to $2.16\times$ over composition-matched random training under greedy tree decoding. The gains also hold under stochastic chain decoding.

</details>


### [237] [FoMNet: Adaptive Kernels Meet Contextual Matching for Cross-Modal Homography Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34096)
*Zhuoran Yang,Zhenyu Yi,Runmin Zhang,Linshan Li,Yiming Li,Xiaokai Bai,Xiaohan Zhang,Hui-liang Shen,Si-Yuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出FoMNet，通过将视觉基础模型特征的自适应空间聚合与上下文对应估计结合，提升跨模态单应性估计精度，并给出低延迟版本FoMNet-D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态单应性估计需要在外观差异下获得可靠对应关系；多尺度细化虽能缩小搜索范围，但匹配特征区分近邻候选的能力有限。现有VFM特征通过固定插值融合，空间聚合与图像内容和对应目标无关。

Method: 提出FoMNet：用Patch Feature Upsampling（PFU）逐步预测位置特定卷积核，在上采样网格上聚合邻域特征，为VFM特征与CNN特征在不同匹配尺度融合做准备；再用Contextual Correlation Refinement（CCR）结合空间上下文联合处理源描述子和局部相关性，在每次单应性更新前细化候选得分。为降低开销，提出FoMNet-D，用双三次插值替代PFU，并通过多尺度特征关系蒸馏恢复精度。

Result: 在五个跨模态数据集上，FoMNet取得所评估方法中最低的平均角点误差（MACE），相对MCNet降低10.6%-72.7%。FoMNet-D保持有竞争力的精度，同时相对FoMNet降低34.0%推理延迟。

Conclusion: 学习式空间自适应VFM特征聚合与上下文对应细化能有效提升跨模态单应性估计；通过插值替代和蒸馏可在较小精度损失下显著降低计算延迟。

Abstract: Cross-modal homography estimation requires reliable correspondences despite appearance differences between sensing modalities. Multi-scale refinement progressively reduces the search range, but its accuracy remains limited by the ability of matching features to distinguish nearby candidates. The vision foundation model (VFM) provides complementary representations, yet integrating these features through fixed interpolation leaves their spatial aggregation independent of image content and the correspondence objective. We propose the Foundation Model-Enhanced Matching Network (FoMNet), which combines learned spatial adaptation of VFM features with contextual correspondence estimation. Patch Feature Upsampling (PFU) progressively predicts location-specific kernels to aggregate neighboring features on upsampled grids, preparing VFM representations for fusion with CNN features at different matching scales. Contextual Correlation Refinement (CCR) then jointly processes source descriptors and local correlations with spatial context to refine candidate scores before each homography update. To reduce upsampling overhead, we develop FoMNet-D, which replaces PFU with bicubic interpolation and uses multi-scale feature-relation distillation to recover accuracy. Experiments on five cross-modal datasets show that FoMNet achieves the lowest mean average corner error (MACE) among the evaluated methods, reducing MACE by 10.6%-72.7% relative to MCNet. FoMNet-D retains competitive accuracy while reducing inference latency by 34.0% relative to FoMNet.

</details>


### [238] [Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34093)
*Mang Ning,Le Zhang,Albert Ali Salah,Itir Onal Ertugrul,Jintao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 EiT，一种像素空间扩散 Transformer，通过通道瓶颈式 U 形架构、表示动态分析和频域等价性分析改进像素扩散生成质量，并可扩展到视频像素扩散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受去噪自编码器通过瓶颈进行去噪的启发，研究像素空间扩散的关键设计因素，包括模型架构、表示和频域，以提升像素扩散相对潜空间扩散的生成效果。

Method: 构建 U 形像素扩散 Transformer，在通道维度显式压缩；分析像素与潜空间扩散 Transformer 在各层和时间步上的三阶段表示动态；从频域建立像素空间与频率空间扩散在网络仍于像素空间运行时的等价关系；通过将 patch 扩展到时间维将 EiT 用于视频像素扩散。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 和 512×512 上，EiT 的 FID 分别为 1.61 和 1.73，优于 JiT 的 1.85 和 1.99；在 Kinetics-600 256 分辨率上，EiT 视频像素扩散在相近总网络参数下 FVD 优于视频潜空间扩散。

Conclusion: EiT 通过通道瓶颈和更深网络自然实现更早去噪与更长基提升阶段，从而提升生成质量；其在图像和视频像素扩散上均表现出优势，说明像素空间扩散经合理设计可有效竞争甚至优于潜空间扩散。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/forever208/EiT

</details>


### [239] [What Makes a Gavagai? Learning Visual Concepts from One Positive and Few Negatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34105)
*Katsuya Ogata,Kazuya Nishimura,Yuta Nakashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Gavagai Benchmark，用于评估视觉语言模型能否利用正例和负例识别定义新概念的关键视觉属性，并区分视觉感知与推理的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能从少量观察中识别新概念，但单一观察对应多种可能解释；受Quine的gavagai问题启发，需要检验模型能否利用负例消除歧义并推断概念定义属性。

Method: 构建包含合成图像（新属性组合）和真实图像（新描述物种）的基准；让模型从正负示例中识别新概念，并通过提供正确属性与使用模型预测属性进行诊断比较，分析感知和推理能力。

Result: 多个模型即使在提供正确属性时仍表现困难；另一些模型在将真实属性替换为模型预测后出现明显性能差距。

Conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在属性感知以及从有限证据中进行推断方面仍面临挑战。

Abstract: Humans can recognize novel concepts from only a few observations by identifying defining visual attributes and eliminating alternative interpretations. However, a single observation is consistent with multiple possible concepts, and accurate visual perception alone is insufficient to determine the intended interpretation. Negative evidence can reduce this ambiguity by eliminating competing hypotheses. Inspired by Quine's gavagai problem, we introduce the Gavagai Benchmark to evaluate whether vision-language models can identify the attributes defining a novel concept from positive and negative examples. The benchmark consists of synthetic images depicting novel combinations of visual attributes and real images of newly described species. Using these datasets, we examine how models use negative examples to identify novel concepts and analyze the respective roles of visual perception and reasoning. Several models struggle even when correct attributes are provided, while others show large gaps when ground-truth attributes are replaced with model predictions. These diagnostic comparisons highlight challenges in both attribute perception and inference from limited evidence.

</details>


### [240] [When Position Favors the Wrong Part: Evaluating Left-Right Discrimination in Semantic Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34100)
*Pingan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究图像位置与正确双侧部件冲突时，密集描述符能否区分正确部件，以及其判别分数能否用于选择匹配坐标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 总体部件判别准确率可能掩盖图像位置偏向错误双侧部件时的失败，因此需要在位置一致与冲突条件下分别评估判别能力。

Method: 在同一目标图像和标注部件对上评估位置一致/冲突，用边界框侧别分数定义条件；比较原始描述符及其水平反射下的偶/奇分量；在骨干和适配器固定时考察特征上采样；测试基于奇分数的候选选择规则。

Result: 在SPair-71k上，冻结DINOv2的奇判别准确率从一致时86.66%降至冲突时19.63%，MARCO为95.27%至86.16%。MARCO输入几何固定时，框侧冲突下奇准确率原生网格为34.12%，学习上采样并池化回原网格后为88.84%。奇分数规则整体改善DINOv2/DINOv3硬峰值匹配器及MARCO冲突查询；MARCO软解码器固定时重排余弦峰值使平均每对PCK提高0.47个百分点。GeoAware-SC用奇分数选择定位窗口中心仅净增15个正确匹配，包含330次纠正和315次引入错误。

Conclusion: 在位置冲突下评估判别能力可揭示总体准确率掩盖的失败；分别报告纠正数与引入错误数，可判断判别分数是否产生有用的匹配决策。

Abstract: Overall part-discrimination accuracy can conceal failures when image position favors the wrong bilateral part. We examine whether dense descriptors distinguish the correct part under this conflict and whether their discrimination scores help select matching coordinates. We evaluate position agreement and conflict within the same target images and annotated part pairs, using a bounding-box-side score to define the conditions. We compare the original descriptors with their even and odd components under horizontal reflection, examine feature upsampling with the backbone and adapters fixed, and test candidate-selection rules based on odd scores. On SPair-71k, odd discrimination accuracy falls from 86.66% under agreement to 19.63% under conflict for frozen DINOv2, compared with 95.27% to 86.16% for MARCO. With MARCO's input geometry fixed, odd accuracy in box-side conflict was 34.12% on the native grid and 88.84% after learned upsampling and pooling back to that grid. Odd-score rules improve on the original hard-peak matchers overall for DINOv2 and DINOv3 and on conflict queries for MARCO. With MARCO's soft decoder fixed, reranking the cosine peaks changes mean per-pair PCK by +0.47 pp. For supervised GeoAware-SC, using the odd score to select the localization window center yields only 15 net additional correct matches, with 330 corrections and 315 introduced errors. Evaluating discrimination under position conflict reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Reporting corrections and introduced errors separately also shows whether a discriminative score produces useful matching decisions.

</details>


### [241] [Detectable by Design: Learning a Continuous 3D Saliency Field from 2D Detector Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34108)
*Han Sun,Jun Li,Christy Jie Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出DetField，一种连续3D显著性场，将3D显著性定义为图像可检测性，并用2D兴趣点检测器响应反投影监督，从而为稀疏地图选择更易被重新检测的3D点，提升相机定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D关键点检测器通常按语义、可重复性、重建质量或描述子可匹配性定义显著性，但没有直接考虑该点是否会在图像中被实际检测到，导致选出的许多3D点在图像中无法再次被检测。

Method: 将3D显著性定义为表面点在所有可见视角中2D兴趣点检测器响应的聚合；提出DetField，以点云为输入，在3D空间任意位置连续预测可检测性；监督信号来自2D检测器响应反投影到点云；在每个查询点将多尺度曲率不变量传入解码器，绕过编码器的体素池化。

Result: 在隔离3D点选择的定位基准上，DetField在物体和真实室内场景中优于Harris-3D及五种学习型3D关键点方法；在未见房间上，定位成功率比最强基线Harris-3D提高7.4个百分点；在物体上使用未参与训练的2D检测器时仍领先；在稀疏地图上于物体和真实场景中均保持对Harris-3D的优势。

Conclusion: 以图像可检测性作为3D显著性定义是有效的，DetField能选择更易被图像检测器重新检测的3D点，并在稀疏地图和未见场景中显著改善定位表现。

Abstract: The 3D points kept in a map decide whether a camera can be localized against it, and this choice matters more as the map becomes sparser. Existing 3D keypoint detectors usually define saliency by semantics, repeatability, reconstruction or descriptor matchability. None of these definitions asks whether a point will actually be detected in an image, and as a result most of the points they select are not detected again in images.
  In this paper, we define 3D saliency as image detectability: the response of a 2D interest-point detector at a surface point, aggregated over all views in which the point is visible. We propose DetField, a continuous field over 3D space that takes a point cloud as input and predicts detectability at any location around it. The supervision is the response of a 2D detector, back-projected from images onto the point cloud. Multi-scale curvature invariants are passed to the decoder at every query point, bypassing the voxel pooling of the encoder.
  In a localization benchmark that isolates the choice of 3D points, DetField outperforms Harris-3D and five learned 3D keypoint methods on objects and on real indoor scenes. On unseen rooms, it improves localization success by 7.4 points over Harris-3D, the strongest baseline. On objects, it also leads under a 2D detector not used in training. On sparse maps, it stays ahead of Harris-3D on both objects and real scenes.

</details>


### [242] [An Image Detectability Field as a Viewpoint Utility for 2D-3D Localization in Sparse Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34139)
*Han Sun,Jun Li,Christy Jie Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究在2D-3D定位中，是否可利用仅基于地图几何的可检测性场作为视角选择工具，以提升手持或机器人相机的定位成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手持相机或机器人相机在拍摄前通常可以选择视角，因此需要一种不依赖图像、仅根据3D地图局部几何预测2D图像检测器是否容易检测到地标的视角效用，用于规划更有利于定位的拍摄视角。

Method: 构建并查询图像可检测性场：在表面附近任意3D点，根据局部几何预测2D检测器在该点投影处触发的概率。直接使用训练好的场而不针对视角选择微调，并结合固定的SuperPoint与EPnP-RANSAC定位器。在ShapeNet合成稀疏点图和SceneFun3D真实室内场景中评估，并与地标计数、Harris-3D秩求和、LWL学习视角评分器及学习式逐地标规划器比较。

Result: 在ShapeNet稀疏点图上，对可见地标求和可检测性场比计数提升2.0个定位成功率点，95%区间为[+0.7,+3.2]；比Harris-3D秩求和提升2.2点[+0.8,+3.5]。在SceneFun3D真实室内场景中，学习视角评分器LWL在测试房间上低于计数；将可检测性场加入学习式逐地标规划器后，在稀疏地图测试房间上比无该场的同一规划器提升1.8点，比用Harris-3D或曲率替代分别提升1.0和0.8点，三个房间聚类区间均高于零。

Conclusion: 可检测性场在稀疏地图中能有效改善视角选择与定位成功率，在稠密地图中与Harris-3D相当；但在真实场景中单独作为学习式视角评分器并不占优，更适合作为学习式逐地标规划器的附加信息。

Abstract: In 2D-3D localization, a camera estimates its pose by matching an image to a 3D map. A camera held in a hand or mounted on a robot can often choose its viewpoint before it takes the image. In this work, we ask whether an image detectability field is a useful viewpoint utility when the planner reads only the geometry of the map. The field can be queried at any 3D point near a surface. From the local geometry around the point, it predicts how likely a 2D image detector is to fire at the projection of the point. We use the trained field as it is, without fine-tuning it for view selection. A fixed SuperPoint and EPnP-RANSAC localizer then estimates the pose from the chosen view. We answer in two settings, each with a test registered before the runs. On synthetic ShapeNet objects with sparse point maps, summing the field over the visible landmarks beats counting them by +2.0 points of localization success rate (object-clustered 95% interval [+0.7, +3.2]). It also beats summing Harris-3D ranks by +2.2 [+0.8, +3.5]. On real indoor scenes from SceneFun3D, our adaptation of the learned view scorer LWL falls below counting on the test rooms. We therefore add the field to a learned per-landmark planner. On the test rooms with sparse maps whose landmarks the field also selects, the planner with the field beats the same planner without it by +1.8 points. It beats the planner with Harris-3D or curvature in its place by +1.0 and +0.8 points. All three room-clustered intervals lie above zero. In both settings, the field helps in sparse maps and is on par with Harris-3D in dense maps.

</details>


### [243] [A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34134)
*Yiwen Chen,Shengming Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出一个四步评估协议，用于在匹配部署预算下比较参考库压缩方法，并以校准参考的决策一致性衡量压缩对工业图像异常检测的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参考库可压缩以适配部署预算，但异常决策同时受压缩分数和运行阈值影响，因此需要在匹配部署规模下评估压缩方法及其阈值校准稳健性。

Method: 四步协议：在匹配部署尺寸下比较压缩方法；用200次重校准建立参考分布；针对两个校准基准评估决策分歧；按与全库阈值的距离度量变化。实验使用WideResNet-50和ResNet-18，在VisA与MVTec AD上比较PQ、int8标量量化等方法。

Result: WideResNet-50下，10%预算的产品量化PQ在五个匹配方法中决策分歧最低，包括int8标量量化；其他四个预算下int8分歧低于PQ。MVTec AD较低运行水平下，PQ在34/39单元达到校准中位数、39/39达到上分位数；AUROC损失为0.0003至0.0037。VisA 1%预算和1%运行水平下，近阈值异常分歧达28.12%，正常留出集为1.30%。10%预算PQ在ResNet-18、干净参考库及正常目录探针阈值下仍保持最低分歧。

Conclusion: 该协议将部署规模与校准参考的决策度量联系起来，并能识别对检查最有信息量的评估人群；10%预算匹配PQ在多种设置下表现稳健。

Abstract: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

</details>


### [244] [Benefit of Structured Representations: When Equivariance Helps in Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34140)
*Florian A. Hölzl,Daniel Rueckert,Georgios Kaissis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉编码器何时能从几何等变性中获益，提出旋转等变的 ConvNeXt-C4，并在图像分类任务上系统比较其与基础 ConvNeXt 的性能、效率和样本利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变神经网络具有结构保证，但主流视觉编码器很少融入大多数几何对称性的等变约束；图像包含丰富对称结构且数据规模大，适合研究几何归纳偏置的实际价值。

Method: 采用离散四分之一转旋转群 C4，该变换无需插值且不产生边界伪影；以图像分类作为受控的不变目标，构建维度等价但方向结构化的旋转等变 ConvNeXt-C4，并从零训练与预训练等设置下与基础模型对比。

Result: C4 变体在所有任务上优于基础模型，同时参数量少 6 倍、FLOPs 少 1.6 倍；训练集越小，性能优势按对数线性增长；预训练对两个模型带来类似提升；分类头分析表明表示结构中的方向信息被主动利用，使所有数据集性能提升 4.90%。

Conclusion: 结果凸显等变性带来的样本效率优势以及保留方向信息的价值，并鼓励将研究拓展到图像分类之外。

Abstract: Equivariant neural networks promise improved representation learning through structural guarantees. However, mainstream vision encoders rarely incorporate equivariance for most geometric symmetries. Images are a particularly interesting modality with many such symmetries and extensive datasets from which to learn this structure. In this work, we investigate when vision encoders benefit from geometric inductive biases. We study the discrete rotation group of quarter-turns (C4) which acts losslessly without interpolation or boundary artifacts. Combined with image classification as a controlled invariant objective, this allows for a principled empirical investigation into the role of structural guarantees. We introduce ConvNeXt-C4 as a rotation equivariant ConvNeXt with dimension-equivalent yet orientation-structured representations. Training from scratch, our experiments show, that the C4 variant outperforms its base model across all tasks while operating with 6x fewer parameters and 1.6x fewer FLOPs. Its performance advantage increases log-linearly with decreasing training set size, with pre-training providing a similar improvement across both model variants. Analyzing the classifier head reveals that orientation information from the representations' structure is actively used, improving performance by 4.90% across all datasets. Our results highlight the sample-efficiency benefits of equivariance and the value of retained orientation information, motivating further investigation beyond image classification. Code is available at https://github.com/hlzl/equivariant-convnext.

</details>


### [245] [Spe3DUp: Faithful Trajectory Distillation for Fast Image-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34141)
*Liangchao Xu,Jiaye Fu,Youtian Lin,Feihu Zhang,Yao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Spe3DUp粗到细框架，通过Faithful Trajectory Distillation加速高质量、参考一致的3D网格生成，在保持几何质量和输入对应性的同时显著提升推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高质量3D生成模型依赖长多步采样和反复大网络评估，推理时间长；而游戏资产重建、产品数字化等参考驱动任务要求生成几何忠实对应输入图像，因此需要在减少采样计算的同时保持重建能力。

Method: 提出基于Faithful Trajectory Distillation（FTD）的粗到细框架Spe3DUp，用教师模型输入条件去噪轨迹直接监督少步学生模型，并分别应用于粗几何生成和几何细化；同时采用高效几何解码和并行重网格化加速完整网格生成流程。

Result: 实验表明Spe3DUp保持接近教师模型的几何质量和输入对应性，粗生成与细化DiT分别加速10.0倍和19.9倍，端到端相比原始教师流程加速7.7倍。

Conclusion: Spe3DUp能够在保持参考一致性和几何质量的同时显著加速3D生成，为快速且忠实的3D生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Recent 3D generative models can produce high-quality meshes with complex structures and fine geometric details, with broad applications in games, film, and digital design. However, high-quality generation typically relies on long multi-step sampling processes that repeatedly evaluate large networks, leading to long inference times. At the same time, reference-driven tasks such as game-asset reconstruction and product digitization demand close correspondence to the input image: generated geometry must faithfully reconstruct the specific reference object. Acceleration must therefore reduce sampling computation while preserving the model's ability to reconstruct that object. To enable fast and faithful 3D generation, we introduce Spe3DUp, a coarse-to-fine framework based on Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD). FTD directly supervises few-step students with the teacher's input-conditioned denoising trajectories to preserve its generation behavior. We apply FTD separately to coarse geometry generation and geometric refinement, compressing both sampling processes while maintaining correspondence to the reference input. We further accelerate the complete mesh-generation pipeline with efficient geometry decoding and parallel remeshing. Experiments show that Spe3DUp maintains geometric quality and input correspondence close to those of the teacher, accelerates the coarse and refinement DiTs by 10.0x and 19.9x, respectively, and achieves a 7.7x end-to-end speedup over the original teacher pipeline.

</details>


### [246] [HSTTA: Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34153)
*Hongzhou Chen,Yuhao Wei,Lianghua He,Yihang Liu,Zengqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出分层选择性测试时自适应框架HSTTA，用于解决跨被试EEG到图像检索中的被试偏移问题，并通过分层伪标签、置信度校准和互惠分层回退提升适应性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨被试EEG-to-image检索在新被试上因subject shift性能显著下降；现有测试时自适应方法难以根据每个查询的预测置信度匹配监督粒度，导致许多查询缺乏可靠伪标签。

Method: 提出HSTTA：在 gallery 图像嵌入上构建层次结构，用分层选择性预测为每个EEG查询分配与其当前预测置信度匹配的监督粒度，并据此构建适应目标；提出无监督的Cross-Session Consistency Calibration（CSCC）校准全局置信度阈值以目标化分层预测准确率；提出Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff（RHB），将缺乏反向匹配支持的查询移至更粗节点以缓解错误强化。

Result: 在两个公开基准和消融实验中验证了HSTTA及关键组件的有效性。在THINGS-EEG2上，余弦（CSLS）排序下，Top-1/Top-5准确率分别比最强EEG专用TTA基线高17.9（13.4）和8.9（3.7）个百分点；分析表明HSTTA在适应过程中产生更准确的伪标签，支持更可靠的模型更新。

Conclusion: HSTTA通过分层选择性测试时自适应、置信度校准和分层回退机制，有效缓解跨被试EEG-to-image检索中的subject shift，并提升伪标签可靠性和最终检索性能。

Abstract: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval suffers from substantial performance degradation on new subjects due to subject shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this shift by adapting pretrained models with unlabeled target-subject EEG. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to match supervision granularity to each query's prediction confidence, leaving many queries without reliable pseudo-labels. To address this, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation (HSTTA). HSTTA builds a hierarchy over gallery image embeddings, uses hierarchical selective prediction to assign each EEG query a supervision granularity matching its current prediction confidence, and constructs adaptation objectives accordingly. We further propose Cross-Session Consistency Calibration (CSCC), an unsupervised method that calibrates the global confidence threshold to target a predefined accuracy level for hierarchical predictions. Moreover, we introduce Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff (RHB), which moves queries lacking reverse-matching support to coarser nodes to mitigate error reinforcement. Experiments on two public benchmarks and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of HSTTA and its key components. On THINGS-EEG2, HSTTA outperforms the strongest EEG-specific TTA baseline by 17.9 (13.4) and 8.9 (3.7) percentage points in Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, respectively, under cosine (CSLS) ranking. Further analyses show that HSTTA yields more accurate pseudo-labels during adaptation, supporting more reliable model updates.

</details>


### [247] [Non-Linear Motion from Two Frames: Cubic Hermite Trajectories for Video Frame Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34143)
*Md Rifat Ur Rahman,Md Abtahi Majeed Chowdhury,Md Sakib Hossain Shovon,Jaesik Choi,Mohammad Ali Moni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HermiteVFI 用逐像素显式连续轨迹替代查询时刻的独立运动预测：端点位移固定轨迹两端位置，网络学习两个潜在端点导数控制中间路径，并用三次 Hermite 曲线以闭式形式在任意 t 求值；轨迹系数每帧对预测一次，监督鼓励多时刻约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两帧视频插帧通常按查询时间重采样端点光流，这隐含恒定速度直线运动假设；但相同端点位移可对应多种中间轨迹，导致非均匀运动和高插帧倍率下表现受限。

Method: 提出 HermiteVFI：为每个像素建立三次 Hermite 连续轨迹，端点位置由测得位移固定，两个潜在端点导数由帧对学习；采用残差形式精确包含线性运动并结构上保持端点位移；利用外观方向线索推断不可由端点位移唯一确定的导数；证明单个内部查询时间对两个自由轨迹系数是秩亏约束，而两个不同内部时间在表示层面满秩，从而引入多时间监督；轨迹系数每帧对预测一次并在任意 t 闭式求值。

Result: 在 X4K1000FPS、SNU-FILM 和 Vimeo90K-Septuplet 上取得提升，最大增益出现在困难非均匀运动和高插帧倍率场景。

Conclusion: 显式连续轨迹表示能更好处理两帧插帧中的运动歧义与非均匀运动；轨迹系数预测可摊销，但下游反转、细化和合成仍依赖查询时间。

Abstract: Two-frame video frame interpolation commonly resamples endpoint optical flow by the query time, which selects a constant-velocity straight-line path even though the same endpoint displacement is compatible with many intermediate trajectories. We present HermiteVFI, which replaces independent query-time motion prediction with one explicit continuous trajectory per pixel. The measured endpoint displacement fixes the two trajectory positions, while two latent endpoint derivatives learned from the frame pair control the interior path. A cubic Hermite curve is the minimum-degree polynomial that can independently satisfy these two position and two derivative boundary quantities. Its residual form contains linear motion exactly, structurally preserves the measured displacement endpoints for any network output, and has coefficients that are predicted once per frame pair and evaluated in closed form at arbitrary t. We further show that one interior query time gives a rank-deficient constraint on the two free trajectory coefficients, whereas any two distinct interior times are full rank at the representation level, motivating multi-time supervision. Appearance-derived directional cues help infer the latent derivatives that endpoint displacement alone cannot identify. On X4K1000FPS, SNU-FILM, and Vimeo90K-Septuplet, the largest gains occur for difficult non-uniform motion and high interpolation ratios. The amortization applies to trajectory-coefficient prediction; downstream reversal, refinement, and synthesis remain query dependent.

</details>


### [248] [OceanFix: Reference-Guided Diffusion for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34155)
*Gen Li,Maoxin Chen,Yao Xiao,Xinyang Li,Yu Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OceanFix 是一个面向稀疏视角水下三维重建的参考引导框架，结合扩散式视角修复与高斯场景细化，以缓解稀疏观测、光衰减和背散射导致的欠约束区域及新视角伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅虽能高效进行水下重建，但在稀疏观测、光衰减和背散射条件下，部分场景区域约束不足，容易产生新视角渲染伪影。

Method: 提出 OceanFix：采用两阶段训练，先基于参考观测和估计介质特征学习水下外观，再利用相机位姿和参考深度对齐参考特征，并以相对深度监督进行结构修复；同时提出介质感知蒸馏，根据几何修复需求和通道相关光学可观测性将修复视角迁移到三维场景中，通过迭代渲染、修复和蒸馏细化欠约束区域。

Result: 在水下数据集上的实验表明，OceanFix 提升了稀疏视角三维重建的渲染质量，减少了可见伪影，并恢复了更精细的场景细节。

Conclusion: OceanFix 通过参考引导的扩散视角修复与介质感知的高斯场景蒸馏，有效改善稀疏视角水下重建中的欠约束问题和渲染伪影，同时保留观测视角的监督信息。

Abstract: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient underwater reconstruction, but sparse observations, light attenuation, and backscatter still leave scene regions underconstrained and cause novel-view artifacts. We present OceanFix, a reference-guided framework for sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction that combines diffusion-based view repair with Gaussian scene refinement. Our repair model follows a two-stage training strategy that separates underwater appearance adaptation from geometric refinement. The first stage learns underwater appearance from reference observations and estimated medium features. The second uses camera poses and reference depth to align reference features, with relative-depth supervision guiding structural repair without requiring target-view depth at inference. We further propose medium-aware distillation that transfers repaired views into the 3D scene according to geometric repair demand and channel-specific optical observability. Through iterative rendering, repair, and distillation, OceanFix refines underconstrained regions while retaining supervision from the observed views. Experiments on underwater datasets demonstrate that OceanFix improves rendering quality in sparse-view 3D reconstruction, reducing visible artifacts and recovering finer scene details.

</details>


### [249] [Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding for Temporally Grounded Audio-Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34162)
*Minyeong Jeong,Yeonju Kim,Yong Man Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文探究音视频大模型是否有效利用时间对齐信息，发现其对齐敏感性有限，并提出无需训练的解码方法 MSCD，通过对比保持与扰乱时间对齐时的 logits 来增强音视频时间对齐理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AV-LLM 被设计用于表示音视频时序结构，但其是否能利用时间信息将声音与视觉事件关联仍不清楚。初步探测发现，即使移动音频使其与新视觉事件重叠，模型仍偏向原本对齐的事件，说明对音视频时间对齐变化不敏感。

Method: 作者在音视频同步任务上探测 AV-LLM：移动音频使其与不同视觉事件重叠。随后提出 Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding（MSCD），一种无需训练的解码方法；它通过临时移动音频或视频、保持另一模态不变来破坏时间对齐，并对比保持对齐与破坏对齐条件下的 logits，从而偏向由对齐音视频支持的预测。

Result: 实验表明模型对音视频时间对齐变化敏感度有限。MSCD 在两个 AV-LLM 和三个基准上有效提升时间接地的音视频理解；在 Daily-Omni 上，OmniVinci 和 video-SALMONN 2+ 的准确率分别提升 2.2 和 2.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: 强调解码阶段的时间对齐可以改善音视频模型的时间接地理解，并可能惠及更广泛的音视频理解任务。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are designed to represent the temporal structure of audio and video, yet it remains unclear how effectively they use this temporal information to relate sounds to visual events. To examine this, we probe an AV-LLM on an audio-visual synchronization task by shifting the audio so that the queried sound overlaps a different visual event. We observe that the model still favors the originally aligned event over the newly aligned one, indicating limited sensitivity to changes in audio-visual temporal alignment. To address this, we propose Modality-Shift Contrastive Decoding (MSCD), a training-free decoding method that emphasizes audio-visual temporal alignment in model predictions. MSCD contrasts logits under preserved and disrupted temporal alignment to favor predictions supported by aligned audio and video. We disrupt this alignment by temporally shifting either the audio or the video, while keeping the other modality fixed. Extensive evaluations with two AV-LLMs across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MSCD for temporally grounded audio-visual understanding. In particular, MSCD improves accuracy over the base models on Daily-Omni by 2.2 and 2.8 percentage points for OmniVinci and video-SALMONN 2+, respectively, suggesting that emphasizing temporal alignment can also benefit broader audio-visual understanding.

</details>


### [250] [Admoab-DETR: Resolution-Tiered Fusion for Infrared-Visible Object Detection with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34163)
*Wenchao Li,Haoran Jia,Shuyuan Wen,Keyan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Admoab-DETR，一种支持红外单模态、可见光单模态和双模态输入的实时目标检测器，通过分辨率分层融合与模式匹配特征蒸馏，在缺失模态和配对模态场景下实现精度与效率的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外与可见光图像可互补实现全天候目标检测，但实际传感器掉线会导致单模态缺失，使依赖配对输入的检测器性能下降；同时现有模态自适应方法在各尺度统一使用重型跨模态注意力，在高分辨率特征图上产生过高计算开销。

Method: 提出统一权重的 Admoab-DETR。核心包括：分辨率分层融合（RTF），按空间 token 密度和特征粒度分配融合能力，高分辨率尺度用轻量空间模态门控实现局部融合与零成本单模态直通，粗语义尺度用通道压缩的可变形 Admoab neck 捕获跨模态对应；模式匹配特征蒸馏（MMFD），以可用性同步的全融合教师对齐多尺度编码器特征，避免不合理的跨模态幻觉；并构建严格配准的 20,000 对红外-可见光基准 Admoab。

Result: 实验表明 Admoab-DETR 在缺失模态和配对模态基准上取得当前最优的精度-效率权衡；方法减少 18.1% 参数、降低 39.6% 配对延迟，且不增加推理开销。

Conclusion: Admoab-DETR 以单一权重统一支持多种输入模式，在真实传感器缺失场景下保持鲁棒检测，并通过分层融合与蒸馏实现实时、高效的跨模态目标检测。

Abstract: Infrared and visible images offer complementary cues for all-weather object detection, yet real-world sensor dropouts can leave one stream unavailable and degrade paired-input detectors. Meanwhile, existing modality-adaptive methods apply heavy cross-modal attention uniformly across scales, incurring prohibitive token overhead on high-resolution maps. We propose Admoab-DETR, a unified real-time detector supporting infrared-only, visible-only, and paired inputs with a single set of weights. Specifically, \emph{Resolution-Tiered Fusion} (RTF) allocates fusion capacity by spatial token density and feature granularity: a lightweight Spatial Modality Gate governs fine local fusion at the highest-resolution scale with zero-cost single-view pass-through, while channel-compressed deformable Admoab necks capture cross-modal correspondence at coarser semantic scales. Furthermore, \emph{Mode-Matched Feature Distillation} (MMFD) aligns multi-scale encoder features with an availability-synchronized full-fusion teacher, avoiding ill-posed cross-modal hallucination while cutting parameters by 18.1\% and paired latency by 39.6\% at zero inference overhead. We also construct Admoab, a strictly registered 20,000-pair infrared--visible benchmark across diverse scenes. Experiments show Admoab-DETR achieves state-of-the-art accuracy--efficiency trade-offs across missing-modality and paired benchmarks. Our code will be available at https://github.com/liwenchao0615/Admoab-DETR.

</details>


### [251] [Loop4D: Embodied World Modeling with 4D VAEs and Looped Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34199)
*Gen Li,Fan Luo,Mengjun Lin,Shu Han,Bohan Li,Hao Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Loop4D框架，通过保持运动的4D表示和循环生成细化，预测机器人操作中的RGB外观与3D几何演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作结果预测需同时建模视觉外观和动态3D几何，但视频压缩会模糊细微机器人运动，联合预测RGB与几何又需要足够生成能力。

Method: 4D VAE将RGB和点图序列编码为紧凑时空潜变量；RGB VAE结合几何引导监督与预测重建减少压缩伪影；几何VAE用轻量适配器适配预训练RGB表示；Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer采用外观与几何双流、共享Transformer权重和跨模态连接，并循环复用Transformer块以增加有效深度。

Result: 实验实现高质量4D生成，并在模拟机器人操作任务中验证了Loop4D的有效性。

Conclusion: Loop4D表明，运动保持的4D表示与循环扩散细化能够缓解压缩导致的信息损失，并以较少参数改进RGB-几何联合预测。

Abstract: Predicting the outcomes of robotic manipulation requires modeling both visual appearance and evolving 3D geometry. This poses two challenges: video compression can obscure fine-grained robot motion, while jointly predicting RGB and geometry demands sufficient generative capacity. We introduce Loop4D, a framework that addresses these challenges through motion-preserving 4D representations and recurrent generative refinement. Our 4D VAE encodes RGB and pointmap sequences into compact spatiotemporal latents while preserving motion details and geometric structure. Our RGB VAE combines geometry-guided supervision with predictive reconstruction to reduce compression-induced motion artifacts. Our geometry VAE uses lightweight adapters to adapt pretrained RGB representations while preserving their priors. Building on these representations, our Dual-Stream Looped Diffusion Transformer maintains separate appearance and geometry streams with shared Transformer weights and cross-modal connections. By reusing Transformer blocks across loops, we increase effective depth without replicating backbone parameters, enabling models with fewer parameters to improve joint RGB-geometry prediction through additional computation. Experiments demonstrate high-quality 4D generation and validate Loop4D in simulated robotic manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [252] [Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34220)
*Yang Liu,Qianqian Xu,Peisong Wen,Siran Dai,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向视频自监督表征学习的VT-CoRe框架，通过构建可靠的时间对应关系并联合建模语义一致性与时间变化，在16个基准的8类下游任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有掩码视频建模方法多沿用掩码图像建模，但视频中目标位置、外观和运动状态持续变化，因此需要在恢复掩码内容时既保持语义一致性又捕捉时间变化。核心挑战是建立跨帧可靠的时间对应关系，以及设计能同时建模语义一致性和时间变化的表征学习目标。

Method: VT-CoRe针对第一个挑战提出三明治采样策略构造双侧时间参考，并设计Patch Registration Module建立块级对应关系；针对第二个挑战，通过自蒸馏架构对配准后的表征施加潜空间语义对齐，并提出时间变化建模来约束表征随时间的轨迹。

Result: 在16个基准上的8个下游任务中，VT-CoRe在像素级、帧级、视频级和视觉机器人学习场景均表现出有效性与适用性；补充表征分析显示其学习到更结构化的潜空间，有利于变化感知的时间对应学习。

Conclusion: VT-CoRe通过可靠时间对应构建与语义一致性/时间变化联合建模，为视频自监督表征学习提供了有效框架，并在多类下游任务和表征分析中验证了其价值。

Abstract: Self-supervised video representation learning has achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale unlabeled video data. Recent methods commonly extend Masked Image Modeling (MIM) to Masked Video Modeling (MVM), where video representations are learned by capturing semantic information from temporal contexts during masked content recovery. Unlike static images, videos exhibit inherent temporal variation, as visual objects continuously change their positions, appearances, and motion states across frames. Therefore, MVM needs to preserve semantic consistency while capturing temporal changes of corresponding regions, which raises two central challenges: 1) how to establish reliable temporal correspondence across frames, and 2) how to formulate an appropriate representation learning objective for modeling both semantic consistency and temporal variation. To address these challenges, we propose Variation-aware Temporal Correspondence for video Representation learning (VT-CoRe) framework. For challenge 1), VT-CoRe introduces a sandwich sampling strategy to construct two-sided temporal references and a Patch Registration Module (PRM) to establish reliable patch-level correspondence. For challenge 2), VT-CoRe imposes latent-space semantic alignment on registered representations through a self-distillation architecture and further proposes temporal variation modeling to constrain representation trajectories over time. Experiments on 8 downstream tasks across 16 benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of VT-CoRe across pixel-level, frame-level, video-level, and vision-based robotic learning scenarios. Complementary representation analysis shows that VT-CoRe learns a more structured latent space for variation-aware temporal correspondence learning.

</details>


### [253] [EgoMyo: Physical Hand State Estimation from Egocentric Video and Wrist Electromyography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34224)
*Guanglong Sun,Kanglei Zhou,Ziteng Wang,Nana Wang,Hengkai Tan,Xiaolong Liu,Hang Su,Yi Zhong,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究从第一视角视频与手腕表面肌电联合估计物理手部状态，构建了EgoMyo基准并提出MyoBridge融合方法，在姿态与力估计上优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部物理交互依赖构型、接触和力，但外观几乎相同的手势可能对应不同接触状态与发力大小，仅靠视觉难以准确恢复这些耦合因素。

Method: 构建EgoMyo基准，包含575万视频帧、50名参与者、34种接触构型及重复佩戴，并同步3D手部姿态、接触与法向力；分析视觉与sEMG的互补性；提出MyoBridge，以手部区域为视觉-sEMG融合单元，由各区域门控sEMG贡献，并在推理时将区域力幅值分配到预测接触顶点。

Result: 受控分析表明视觉擅长空间结构、sEMG更擅长力幅值估计，sEMG增益集中在视觉最不可靠区域，接触定位限制力估计精度；在留出试验中，MyoBridge相较最强基线将姿态误差和力误差分别降低39.8%和18.5%，并在未见会话和受试者上取得最低姿态误差。

Conclusion: 融合视觉几何与神经肌肉证据可有效估计第一视角下的物理手部状态，区域化视觉-sEMG融合与接触约束的力分配是关键，EgoMyo为相关研究提供了基准。

Abstract: Physical hand interaction depends on configuration, contact, and force, yet nearly identical appearances can conceal different contact states and exerted forces. We therefore formulate physical hand state estimation from egocentric video and wrist surface electromyography (sEMG), combining visual geometry with neuromuscular evidence to jointly recover these coupled components. To support this task, we introduce EgoMyo, a benchmark spanning 5.75M video frames, 50 participants, 34 contact configurations, and repeated donnings, synchronizing these inputs with 3D hand pose and with contact and normal force registered onto the hand surface from bare-hand pressure. Controlled analysis reveals that vision resolves spatial structure while sEMG better estimates force magnitude, that sEMG's gains concentrate in regions where vision is least reliable, and that contact localization limits force accuracy. Guided by these findings, we propose MyoBridge, which makes the hand region the unit of vision-sEMG fusion, lets each region gate its own share of sEMG, and distributes regional force magnitudes only over predicted contact vertices at inference. On held-out trials, MyoBridge reduces pose and force error by 39.8% and 18.5% over the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest pose error on unseen sessions and subjects.

</details>


### [254] [AnyCam4D: Ray-Based 4D Gaussian Rendering for Arbitrary Camera Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34223)
*Sascha Kirch,Rafael Pagés,Jan Ondřej,Clara Pérez-Molina,Sergio Martin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnyCam4D 提出基于光线栅格化的原生 4D 高斯泼溅训练方法，可直接在广角/鱼眼原始视频上训练，避免去畸变造成的视场和细节损失，并通过数值稳定的 4D 协方差平方根条件化恢复高斯的方向与尺寸。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数动态高斯泼溅假设相机为针孔模型，因此需先去畸变，导致广角和鱼眼视频丢失视场或细节。静态高斯泼溅已通过光线渲染解决该问题，但原生 4D 高斯无法直接使用，因为每个高斯的方向和尺寸难以从协方差中可靠恢复。

Method: 提出 AnyCam4D，对原生 4D 高斯使用基于光线的栅格化，在原始视频上训练；核心是对 4D 协方差的平方根进行条件化，以数值稳定地获得高斯的方向和尺寸；方法无需相机特定推导，每步成本约与标准投影相当。

Result: 在合成 170 度鱼眼相机上，使用原始图像训练使 PSNR 提升 3.0-8.1 dB；在真实视频上，与适配各相机的标准投影相比，在可比 PSNR 下具有更低感知误差且无需相机特定推导；当合成相机相对采集装置视角旋转 60-80 度时，相对真值领先 6.2 dB。

Conclusion: AnyCam4D 使原生 4D 高斯泼溅可直接适用于任意相机，保留视场和分辨率，并支持通过其他相机渲染，包括滚动快门、景深或色差等情况，且无需针对相机模型进行专门推导。

Abstract: Real cameras are not pinholes, yet most dynamic Gaussian splatting assumes they are. Footage is therefore undistorted first, losing field of view or detail, especially with wide-angle and fisheye cameras. Static Gaussian splatting has largely solved this with ray-based rendering, which suits any camera. Native 4D Gaussians, which model motion in space-time, cannot use it directly: each Gaussian's orientation and size cannot be recovered reliably from its covariance. We present AnyCam4D, which trains native 4D Gaussians on original footage by ray-based rasterization, preserving field of view and resolution at about the per-step cost of standard projection. Our key contribution is a numerically stable way to obtain orientation and size: we condition a square root of the 4D covariance. Trained models render through other cameras, with rolling shutter, depth of field or chromatic aberration. With a synthetic 170-degree fisheye camera, training on original images improves peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) by 3.0-8.1 dB. On real footage, AnyCam4D has lower perceptual error than the standard projection adapted to each camera, at comparable PSNR and without camera-specific derivations. With the synthetic camera rotated 60-80 degrees away from the capture rig's view, it leads by 6.2 dB against ground truth.

</details>


### [255] [LiveRelight: Sub-Second Global Illumination Editing for Gaussian Interiors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34226)
*Noah Rothenberger,Dor Verbin,Serge Belongie,Bernhard Kerbl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种混合重光照方法，可在重建的3D室内场景中交互式、高保真地更新直接与间接光照，无需逐次编辑优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建3D场景的重光照因光传输复杂而困难；现有方法视觉反馈慢或近似，限制用户精细调整。

Method: 预计算几何光交换而非光照响应，保留低成本传输求解；在重建2D Gaussians上对单侧发光体进行可见性感知采样计算直接光照；在三角代理上用稀疏辐射度传播漫反射互反射；通过Gaussian alpha合成的稀疏投影将代理解转移到重建；支持灯具变换和发光体插入时快速重算光源注入。

Result: 在合成测试套件的8种重光照条件下，亚秒级编辑较先前路径追踪编辑平均提升5 dB PSNR，编辑延迟最多降低三个数量级；定性结果展示真实场景的交互式真实感重光照。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了房间尺度、近实时反馈的高保真重光照编辑，避免每次编辑优化，适用于直接和间接室内光照调整。

Abstract: Relighting reconstructed 3D scenes remains challenging due to the complex nature of light transport: slow or approximate visual feedback restricts the editor's ability to fine-tune the results to satisfaction. We present a hybrid relighting approach that enables interactive, high-fidelity updates of direct and indirect indoor illumination without per-edit optimization. Our approach permits the editor to make a wide range of relighting edits at room-scale, with near-instant feedback. Our key insight is to precompute geometric light exchange rather than illumination responses, retaining an inexpensive transport solve that accommodates changes in emission and surface reflectance. We evaluate direct illumination on reconstructed 2D Gaussians using visibility-aware sampling of one-sided emitters, while propagating diffuse interreflection through sparse radiosity on a triangle proxy. A sparse projection fitted through Gaussian alpha compositing transfers the proxy solution to the reconstruction. Our formulation further supports fast fixture transformations and emitter insertion by recomputing light source injection. Across eight relighting conditions of our synthetic test suite, our sub-second edits improve relighting fidelity over prior path-traced editing by an average of 5\,dB PSNR, while reducing editing latency by up to three orders of magnitude. Qualitative results further demonstrate realistic, interactive relighting of real-world captures.

</details>


### [256] [OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34232)
*Hui Shen,Yunta Hsieh,Jianing Ma,Zhuoran Yin,Zhuhan Bao,Ziyuan Liu,Qi Han,Xiuqi Xu,Xianbang Wang,Wenhao Chai,Sihan Xu,Chenyang Zhao,Yanheng Shang,Dongfu Jiang,Rui Sun,Xingzhi Li,Chenqi Yin,Zesen Zhao,Boyuan Zheng,Jisen Li,Xiaoxia Wu,Ruoyan Zhang,Ruiyao Liu,Jing Xiong,He Xiao,Nan Zheng,Hangxiang Chen,Shengyang Tao,Deyang Luorong,Yifeng Liu,Jingxuan Zhang,Chaofan Tao,Yuren Wang,Jiaqi Mo,Rui Hu,Xing Wei,Xiaofeng Liu,Xin Xu,Han Wu,Mengyao Wen,Guobin Zhang,Shatong Zhu,Hei Ting Una Chan,Sicheng Chen,Kai Zhang,Mengkang Hu,Zhongwei Wan,Xin Wang,Chuanyang Zheng,Ziheng Zhang,Hengyuan Zhang,Zunhai Su,Kanzhi Cheng,Dehan Kong,Yian Wang,Hanrong Zhang,Jiawei Lu,Yifan Zhang,Junnan Li,Changyi Yang,Jintao Qu,Wenyao Gao,Jiaxuan Luo,Jiaxin Deng,Yuhao Chen,Xuesong Ye,Jingwen Gu,Yichi Zhang,Qun Lou,Shen Yan,Ben Athiwaratkun,Qiushi Sun,Mi Zhang,Ping Luo,Wenhu Chen,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OS-Omni跨平台实时基准与执行环境，用于评估计算机使用代理在Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android和Web上的长时程任务；v1包含每平台48个任务和12个桌面-Android跨平台工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准通常隔离Web、移动或桌面环境，难以判断单一通用代理能否完成跨多个操作系统和持久应用状态的长时程工作流。

Method: 构建OS-Omni基准与执行环境，提供可复现初始化、平台特定适配器、轨迹日志和可执行终态评估器，并加入账户、购物车、预算、日历、消息等有状态服务应用；通过人工研究测量任务交互步数。

Result: OS-Omni任务平均需67.54个交互步骤，远高于OSWorld的15.0步；v1上最强代理Claude Opus 5.5平均成功率68.5%，低于人类参考77.3%约8.8个百分点；平台差异明显，前沿模型在Linux上超过人类，但在iOS和macOS上落后人类超过25个百分点。

Conclusion: 当前代理仍远未实现平台鲁棒的长时程计算机使用，尤其在需要持续状态跟踪和持久终态变更的任务上表现不足。

Abstract: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps.
