Once a behavior that maximizes the reward is discovered, the controller ceases to learn. While generally stable, reference tracking methods focus on motor control separately from motion generation. Self-play has been proven as an effective technique for superhuman performance on several multiagent games like Go, Starcraft, hide-and-seek, and capture-the-flag. We train neural networks to play the game of multiagent tag in a physics simulator to study if new motion generation and control strategies can emerge through sparse feedback and competitive self-play. We present MJTag, a task suite for role-conditioned locomotion during competitive pursuit-evasion. Our model is a role-conditioned policy for a low-level locomotion controller and optional planar velocity commands. MJTag's league-based play with sparse feedback enables a locomotion controller to adopt new strategies, including dodging, sprinting, and tackling.

</details>


### [400] [OnCue: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios under Occlusion with Temporal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33439)
*Kailang Ma,Li Song,Weining Ren,Zirui Li,Xianjie Dai,Jingguang Li,Zuyi Guo,Benwang Chen,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 OnCue 框架，在真实驾驶日志中生成满足指定暴露时间与参考接触时间的安全关键遮挡场景，并用于评估和改进自动驾驶规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遮挡危险中可见性出现时机决定可采取的避让动作，但现有场景生成器只控制危险物运动，无法联合指定暴露时间和参考接触时间，难以系统评估规划器对时序的响应能力。

Method: OnCue 利用场景几何为行人、骑行者、车辆轨迹生成隐藏起点和定时路点；用离线响应 oracle 将遭遇标注为 Reactive（暴露后可避）或 Anticipatory（需更早可见才可避），并存储安全机动作为训练示范。

Result: 在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，90.1%–96.6% 的有效轨迹在 ±0.2 s 内满足两个请求时间；共享车辆请求中 92.8% 匹配请求反应窗口，而适配对抗生成器最高仅 42.1%。匹配骑行者场景中，反应窗口变长使 PDM-Closed 碰撞率从 59.1% 降至 5.5%，但 LatentDriver 呈相反趋势。OnCue 示范使 LatentDriver 在留出 Reactive 测试中的目标碰撞降低 54.8 个百分点，但整体无目标进度减少 12.7 m。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对遮挡场景进行时间控制对评估和改进规划器具有重要价值，同时揭示了不同规划器对可见性时序的差异化响应及安全与进度之间的权衡。

Abstract: Occluded hazards challenge autonomous driving because visibility timing determines available avoidance actions. Existing scenario generators control hazard motion without jointly specifying exposure and reference-contact times. We propose OnCue, a framework that generates safety-critical encounters in real driving logs with these temporal conditions. Scene geometry provides hidden starts and timed waypoints for pedestrian, cyclist, and vehicle trajectory generation. An offline response oracle labels encounters as Reactive (avoidable after exposure) or Anticipatory (avoidable only with earlier visibility) and stores safe maneuvers as training demonstrations. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 90.1-96.6% of valid trajectories meet both requested times within +/-0.2 s. OnCue matches the requested reaction window between them in 92.8% of shared vehicle requests versus at most 42.1% for adapted adversarial generators. Across matched cyclist encounters, longer windows lower PDM-Closed collision from 59.1% to 5.5%, while the learned planner LatentDriver shows the opposite trend. OnCue demonstrations reduce LatentDriver target collision by 54.8 points on held-out Reactive tests, but reduce overall no-target progress by 12.7 m. These results highlight the value of temporal control for evaluating and improving planners under occlusion.

</details>


### [401] [Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33514)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究比较了多旋翼无人机吊挂负载MPC中三种优化初始化方式：零初始化、移位初始化和基于Transformer的热启动，并在相同控制器设置下进行数值实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPC优化计算耗时较长，学习型热启动可能加速求解，但需要与传统重用前一时刻解的方法进行公平比较。

Method: 采用含弹性缆绳和双摆负载的耦合动力学模型，构建带移动阻塞控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题和输入可行性投影的SCP-MPC控制器；用专家SCP解训练Transformer预测初始控制序列，再与零初始化、移位初始化对比。

Result: 对独立求解的MPC问题，Transformer初始化较零初始化减少计算时间；在序贯闭环仿真中，移位前一优化控制序列计算时间最低，而三种方法的跟踪表现相似。实测优化时间超过控制采样周期。

Conclusion: 学习型热启动应与重用前一MPC解的传统初始化方法对比；本研究中移位初始化在闭环中更高效，且当前计算速度尚不足以支持实时实现。

Abstract: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated.
  Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.

</details>


### [402] [Skeptic: Grounding Failure Diagnosis for Robot Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33560)
*Wenfang Sun,Jianghao Deng,Wenzhe Yin,Yingjun Du,Cees G. M. Snoek*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究机器人智能体在程序修订与技能复用中，因把失败程序误判为任务物理不可行而提前停止探索的问题，并提出无需训练的 Skeptic 协议改进失败诊断与技能入库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体本应通过执行反馈修订程序并积累可复用技能，但可能把一次不成功的程序当作任务物理不可行的证据，在仍有修订预算时终止探索。作者在 Qwen3.8-27B 中研究该失败，并关注两个关键决策：执行失败如何诊断，以及哪些经验进入共享技能库。

Method: 提出 Skeptic，一种无需训练、冻结模型权重的协议：用实测动作结果指导修复，用实测任务成功控制技能入库；构建 grounded event log，从深度图像和本体感知报告动作效果与物体最终状态，区分传感器观察与推断诊断；在独立复现检查之外加入源程序的开发成功要求，即 verified promotion。

Result: 在 60 个审计任务中，每次 campaign 的平均虚假不可行判断任务数从 19.5 降至 8.5；在 80 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务和 7 个 Robosuite 任务上，held-out 成功率分别提升 14.9 和 11.7 个百分点，且模型权重冻结、程序修订预算相同。

Conclusion: 以实测动作结果指导修复、以实测任务成功把关技能入库，可减少虚假不可行判断，并在不增加训练和修订预算的情况下提升技能发现与复用表现。

Abstract: Robot agents discover reusable skills by revising programs from execution feedback and retaining experience for later tasks. This process can fail when an agent treats an unsuccessful program as evidence that the task is physically impossible, ending exploration with revision budget remaining. We study this failure in Qwen3.8-27B and examine two decisions that shape skill discovery: I) how execution failures are diagnosed, and II) which lessons enter the shared skill library. Failure diagnosis requires the agent to reconstruct physical action effects from multimodal traces, while independent reproduction of a proposed repair does not require adequate task performance from its source program. We introduce Skeptic, a training-free protocol that uses measured action outcomes to guide repair and measured task success to govern skill admission. A grounded event log reports action effects and object end states from depth images and proprioception, separating sensor observations from inferred diagnoses. Verified promotion adds a development-success requirement on the source program to the existing independent reproduction check. Across 60 audited tasks, the mean number of tasks with false impossibility judgments decreases from 19.5 to 8.5 per campaign. On 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and seven Robosuite tasks, Skeptic improves held-out success by 14.9 and 11.7 percentage points, with frozen model weights and the same program-revision budget.

</details>


### [403] [DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33579)
*Wongyun Yu,Honggeun Kim,Donguk Lee,Minchan Kim,Kyoung Whan Choe,Minsu Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexEngine 是一个将人类手-物体操作数据转换为可训练、物理可执行的机械臂-机械手轨迹的仿真流水线，可规模化生成数据并提升策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将人类手-物体演示重定向到机器人手时，若要训练整机策略，重定向运动必须满足运动学可行性、物理可执行性，并能高效大规模生成。

Method: DexEngine 先将每段手-物体运动放置到机械臂可及范围，求取跟随人手的臂运动，再用残差强化学习在物理仿真中修正运动。基于9个人手-物体数据集，为4种灵巧手各生成约5200段片段，扩充为65000条轨迹（116小时）和325000个回合（578小时）。

Result: 即使附加机械臂，DexEngine 的物体跟踪精度仍优于先前浮动手方法，且比基于RL的方法快10倍以上。用其数据训练的策略显著优于未做物理修正或仅在浮动手修正后附加机械臂的数据所训练的策略；在相同微调预算下，用其数据做中期训练还能在仿真和真实机器人上进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: 面向微调的数据需要物理修正；DexEngine 能高效规模化生成物理可执行的整机操作数据，并有效提升仿真与真实机器人策略表现。

Abstract: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. From nine human hand-object datasets, we generate about 5,200 clips for each of four dexterous hands, augmented into 65,000 trajectories (116 h) and 325,000 episodes (578 h) in total. Even with arms attached, DexEngine tracks objects more accurately than prior floating-hand methods and runs over 10x faster than RL-based ones. Policies trained on our data far outperform those trained on the same clips without physics correction or with the arms attached after a floating-hand correction, showing that fine-tuning data need physics correction. Mid-training on our data further improves them at equal fine-tuning budget, in simulation and on a real robot.

</details>


### [404] [DFLAT: Model-based Diffusion on Differentially Flat Spaces for Long-Horizon Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33586)
*Ege Yuceel,Taekyung Kim,Keyvan Majd,Hideki Okamoto,Bardh Hoxha,Sayan Mitra,Georgios Fainekos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 DFLAT，一种基于微分平坦轨迹表示的扩散规划算法，通过在平坦输出空间对 Hermite 曲线参数去噪来生成动力学可行轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程、动力学约束下的扩散规划需要兼顾可扩展性与可行性，但现有扩散规划器往往只能牺牲其一。

Method: DFLAT 不直接在时间离散控制量上扩散，而是对一组紧凑的 Hermite 曲线参数进行去噪，包括中间路点及每段端点切线；每个去噪样本都映射为动力学一致轨迹，从而由构造保证可行性。

Result: 在拖拉机-拖车规划基准上，DFLAT 以更低规划时间达到或超过现有基线成功率，尤其适用于需要多次前进-倒车机动的长时程问题；在 kinodynamic RRT 需超过100秒的场景中，DFLAT 可在亚秒级完成规划。

Conclusion: DFLAT 通过微分平坦表示将可行性内嵌于扩散过程，在保持可行性的同时提升规划效率，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Long-horizon diffusion-based planning for kinodynamically constrained systems requires both scalability and feasibility, yet existing diffusion planners typically sacrifice one for the other. We present DFLAT, a diffusion-based planning algorithm that operates directly on a differentially flat trajectory representation. Instead of diffusing over time-discretized controls, DFLAT denoises a compact set of Hermite curve parameters in the flat-output space, consisting of intermediate waypoints together with the endpoint tangents of each segment. Every denoised sample maps to a dynamically consistent trajectory, so feasibility holds by construction rather than being restored afterward. Experiments on challenging tractor-trailer planning benchmarks show that DFLAT matches or exceeds the success rates of existing baselines at consistently lower planning times, particularly on long-horizon problems requiring multiple forward-reverse maneuvers. In cases where kinodynamic RRT requires over 100 seconds, DFLAT plans in subsecond time, enabling practical deployment.

</details>


### [405] [Greedy Decoding Hides Good Plans: Sample-and-Verify Planning for Vision-Language Driving Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33621)
*Zhipeng Bao,Wenjie Zhao,Yiping Li,Haohua Que,Qianwen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出现有端到端驾驶VLM规划通常只评估贪心解码出的单条轨迹，可能错过输出分布中更优的候选轨迹；为此提出Sample-and-Verify（SaV），冻结VLM规划器并采样多条候选轨迹，再用轻量级验证器选择最终轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM用于端到端驾驶规划时，性能常基于单条贪心解码轨迹评估，但贪心解码可能忽略模型输出分布中更好的轨迹。在WOD-E2E和NAVSIM上的实验显示，贪心轨迹与最佳采样候选之间存在持续性能差距，说明规划错误可能来自轨迹选择而非轨迹生成本身。

Method: 提出Sample-and-Verify（SaV）：保持VLM规划器冻结，采样多个候选轨迹；利用真实未来轨迹训练轻量级验证器，基于轨迹运动学、候选集一致性、候选似然和自车运动特征估计候选相对质量，并选择最终轨迹。

Result: 在WOD-E2E验证集上，SaV使三个VLM规划器的ADE和FDE降低约15%；RFS变化较小，两个规划器在val-456上略降，而Alpamayo-1.5在官方测试集上RFS从7.74提升到7.81，同时ADE@5s降低11%。在NAVSIM上，三个规划器的ADE@4s降低10-24%，但PDMS变化不一致。

Conclusion: 结果表明，轨迹选择可显著提升位移精度，且无需额外训练规划器；但RFS/PDMS等综合指标收益不稳定，说明选择机制主要改善轨迹精度而非全面提升所有驾驶评分。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted for end-to-end driving planning, yet their performance is typically evaluated based on a single greedily decoded trajectory. However, greedy decoding may overlook better trajectories within the model's output distribution. Experiments on WOD-E2E and NAVSIM reveal a consistent performance gap between greedily decoded trajectories and the best sampled candidates, showing that planning errors can arise from trajectory selection, rather than trajectory generation alone. On WOD-E2E, when the ego vehicle should start moving, the model often assigns probability to different possible start times, causing greedy decoding to repeatedly favor waiting and produce a stationary plan even though moving trajectories are available. Motivated by these findings, we propose Sample-and-Verify (SaV), which keeps the VLM planner frozen and samples multiple candidate trajectories. A lightweight verifier is trained from ground-truth futures to estimate the relative quality of these candidates. It uses trajectory kinematics, candidate-set agreement and likelihood, and ego-motion features to select the final trajectory. On WOD-E2E, SaV reduces ADE and FDE by approximately 15% across three VLM planners on the validation set. Changes in RFS are smaller: two planners show slight decreases on val-456, while Alpamayo-1.5 improves from 7.74 to 7.81 RFS on the official test set as ADE@5s decreases by 11%. On NAVSIM, SaV reduces ADE@4s by 10-24% across three VLM planners, while PDMS changes are less consistent. These results show that trajectory selection can substantially improve displacement accuracy without additional planner training. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/hzxbzp/sample-and-verify.

</details>


### [406] [FreshVLA: Frequency-Regularized Time Scale Hierarchical Latent Actions for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33635)
*Jiaming Liang,Yifeng Zhan,Rongyi He,Mu Li,Jiaqi Fan,Zhiyuan Zhang,Qiwei Liang,Zhengjie Zhang,Boyang Cai,Ningyuan Zhang,Xingjian Jing,Qiang Nie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FreshVLA 提出一种频率引导、动态敏感的可复用连续潜在动作学习框架，从无动作视频中学习时间分层潜在动作，并将其用于视觉-语言-动作策略控制，在多个仿真与真实机器人任务上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从无动作视频学习潜在动作的方法多以重建为目标，容易编码与任务无关的静态外观和场景身份，或在有限离散编码中混淆缓慢变化的任务进度与细粒度执行动态，从而不利于策略学习。

Method: FreshVLA 采用高通先验引导视觉变化编码关注动态区域，减少静态外观依赖；通过跨时间尺度采样和频域正则，将潜在动作组织为粗粒度任务进度与细粒度执行动态的时间分层连续表示；策略训练时冻结预训练潜在动作编码器，并通过潜在动作与机器人动作的联合流匹配迁移到机器人控制。

Result: FreshVLA 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达 98.2%，LIBERO-Long 达 98.0%，后者比 GR00T-N1.6 高 3.6%；CALVIN 平均序列长度 4.52；零样本 LIBERO-PLUS 总体成功率 80.4%；对视觉扰动更鲁棒；35 步动作回归中相对误差降低比分层离散对应方法高 51.3 个百分点；真实世界实验中平均成功率比 π0.5 高 7.5%。

Conclusion: 频率引导与动态敏感的时间分层连续潜在动作能够更有效地从无动作视频中提取可迁移控制表示，并显著提升 VLA 策略在长时程、零样本和真实场景中的表现与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Learning reusable latent actions from action-free videos offers an effective route to improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction-oriented latent actions do not necessarily benefit policy learning: as they may encode task-irrelevant static appearance with scene identity, or entangle slowly varying task progress with fine-grained execution dynamics in limited discrete code. We propose FreshVLA, a VLA framework built on a frequency-guided, dynamics-sensitive learning paradigm for acquiring temporally hierarchical continuous latent actions. FreshVLA uses a high-pass prior to guide visual transition encoding toward dynamical regions, thereby reducing reliance on static appearance cues. It further organizes latent actions into coarse-grained task progress and fine-grained execution dynamics through cross-timescale sampling and frequency-domain regularization, enhancing their capacity to represent long-horizon behaviors. During policy training, we freeze the pretrained latent action encoder and transfer its representations to robot control through joint flow-matching of latent and robot actions. FreshVLA achieves 98.2% average success on LIBERO and 98.0% on LIBERO-Long, exceeding GR00T-N1.6 on the latter by 3.6%. It also reaches an average sequence length of 4.52 on CALVIN and strong overall success rate of 80.4% in the zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS evaluation. Furthermore, FreshVLA exhibits greater robustness to visual perturbations and a more distinct division of roles between two branches in modeling low- and high-frequency motion, respectively. In 35-step action regression, it achieves a 51.3-percentage-point higher relative error reduction than its hierarchical discrete counterpart. Real-world experiments demonstrate that FreshVLA improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 7.5%. The FreshVLA project page is available at https://freshvla.github.io/.

</details>


### [407] [Lab2Sim: Agentic Generation of Interactive Laboratory Equipment from Operation Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33705)
*Yuxin Lin,Pei Ren,Yirong Yang,Xuxin Lv,Xingchuang Liao,Diyuan Hou,Jiale He,Zhengping Che,Yongfei Zhang,Wenjun Wu,Zhaoxin Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Lab2Sim 是一个由多个智能体组成的框架，可从自我中心或多视角操作视频生成可编辑、可直接用于仿真的实验室设备资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资产生成方法难以直接从真实设备操作视频中生成仿真资产，也难以忠实复现真实设备的外观、关节运动和内部空腔，因此需要更有效的实验室资产生成方案。

Method: Lab2Sim 包含四个专门智能体：Evidence Agent 结合视频观察与实验室知识，明确设备部件、材料和功能需求；Asset Agent 据此构建可编辑的 Blender 资产；独立 Verifier 对照证据与需求检查几何和外观并给出修订反馈；Simulation Integration Agent 将验证后的 Blender 资产转换为带物理属性和关节机构的仿真实例，并利用执行反馈优化行为。

Result: 在人类和机器人实验室场景实验中，Lab2Sim 相比编码智能体和 real-to-sim 基线（包括使用相同底层模型的 Codex 基线）取得更高的视觉保真度和更强的交互能力；还展示了阀门控制排水，并利用生成的资产库在 RoboTwin 中复现实验室场景和操作。

Conclusion: Lab2Sim 能有效生成可编辑、仿真就绪的实验室设备资产，并支持构建可复用的机器人实验室仿真环境。

Abstract: Generating laboratory assets that faithfully reproduce the appearance, structure, and joint motions of real equipment remains challenging. Existing asset generation methods struggle to directly generate simulation assets for all equipment observed in operation videos and to faithfully reproduce the appearance, joint motions, and internal cavities of the real equipment. To address the challenge, we present Lab2Sim, an agentic framework that generates editable, simulation-ready laboratory equipment assets from egocentric or multi-view operation videos. Lab2Sim comprises four specialized agents. The Evidence Agent combines video observations with laboratory knowledge to specify equipment parts, materials, and functional requirements, which guide the Asset Agent in constructing editable Blender assets. The independent Verifier checks the generated geometry and appearance against the evidence and requirements, providing targeted feedback for revision. The Simulation Integration Agent converts verified Blender assets into simulation instances with physical properties and articulated mechanisms, using execution feedback to refine their behavior. Experiments on human and robot laboratory scenes show that Lab2Sim achieves higher visual fidelity and stronger interaction capability than coding-agent and real-to-sim baselines, including a Codex baseline using the same underlying model. We further demonstrate valve-controlled drainage and use the generated asset library to reproduce laboratory scenes and operations in RoboTwin, supporting reusable simulation environments for robotic laboratory tasks.

</details>


### [408] [$\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM: Efficient Hierarchical Memory Across Modalities and Timescales for World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33710)
*Xiaopeng Zhang,Weiqi Yuan,Xin Zhu,Jiaxi Huang,Yueqi Hu,Yin Zhang,Jian Yao,Yanjie Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出M²-WAM世界-动作模型，通过分层视觉记忆与交互记忆实现高效长时程机器人操作，并在仿真与真实任务中显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人操作需要历史上下文，但保留大量视觉历史会带来存储与检索成本，过度压缩又会丢失细粒度信息；同时，已执行动作历史包含稀疏视觉观测可能遗漏的中间行为，因此需要高效且模态特定的记忆机制。

Method: M²-WAM采用分层视觉与交互记忆：近期视觉观测存入密集短期记忆，被逐出条目通过门控delta更新整合到固定大小联想长期记忆；交互记忆将已执行动作前缀编码为紧凑时间表示。两类记忆通过逐层检索集成到世界-动作建模中，实现在线内存占用有界且不随回合长度增长的动作生成。

Result: 在依赖记忆的仿真基准MIKASA-Robo和RMBench上，M²-WAM相比Fast-WAM平均成功率分别绝对提升53.2%和61.2%；在三个真实机器人任务中，相比LingBot-VA平均成功率绝对提升29.3%。

Conclusion: 结果表明M²-WAM为高效记忆增强的世界-动作建模提供了一种有前景的方法。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires historical context, yet retaining extensive visual histories incurs growing storage and retrieval costs, while aggressive compression risks losing fine-grained information needed for subsequent decisions. Moreover, executed action histories capture intermediate behaviors that sparse visual observations may miss. Preserving this complementary context efficiently calls for modality-specific memory mechanisms that balance recent detail with long-term retention. To this end, we introduce $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM, a world-action model equipped with hierarchical visual and interaction memories. $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM preserves recent visual observations in dense short-term memory while consolidating entries evicted from this window into fixed-size associative long-term memory through gated delta updates. Within the same short- and long-term hierarchy, interaction memory encodes executed action prefixes into compact temporal representations, complementing visual observations with behavioral context. These complementary memories are integrated into world-action modeling through layer-wise retrieval, enabling memory-augmented action generation with a bounded online memory footprint independent of episode length. On the memory-dependent simulation benchmarks MIKASA-Robo and RMBench, $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves +53.2% and +61.2% absolute improvements in average success rates over Fast-WAM, respectively. These gains extend to real-world manipulation, where $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM achieves a +29.3% absolute improvement over LingBot-VA in average success across three tasks. These results suggest that $\mathrm{M}^{2}$-WAM offers a promising approach to efficient memory-augmented world-action modeling.

</details>


### [409] [A general-purpose safe manipulator planning framework for diverse environments without retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33721)
*Mingkang Long,Rong Su,Luhang Hong,Qingqing Wang,Ruochen Tai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种通用机械臂任务规划框架，使机器人无需重新训练控制器即可在不同环境中安全完成抓取等操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人运行环境变化时通常需要重新训练，训练成本过高，阻碍日常使用；因此需要一种无需大量训练数据和算力、且能安全抓取不同物体的方法。

Method: 构建与原系统动力学双相似的有限状态抽象模型，用于描述机器人手臂和夹爪前方空间的可达性；提出块保守规范生成方法，将不同环境下的操作任务转化为抽象模型的状态可达性规范；在抽象模型上证明可行且安全的任务可保证在真实机器人上安全可实现，并结合视觉反馈的通用任务规划器执行。

Result: 在 Unitree G1 U1 人形机器人上的真实案例表明，抓取物体、按电梯按钮、捡浆果等日常操作任务可在该框架内完成；抽象模型只需构建一次，不同任务仅需生成特定规范，无需重建模型或重新训练控制器。

Conclusion: 该框架通过一次抽象建模和任务规范生成，使机器人能够在不同操作环境中安全、通用地完成多种操作任务，降低训练与建模成本。

Abstract: Nowadays, robots need to be retrained whenever their operating environment changes, and this prohibitive training cost keeps them far from daily use. The community is calling for innovations that bestow on a robot the ability to safely grasp different objects under different conditions without excessive training data and computing power. In response to this call, we present a general-purpose manipulator mission-planning framework, allowing a robot to safely perform manipulation tasks, such as grasping objects that fit in its gripper, across different operating environments without retraining its controllers. The framework rests on two innovations: a finite-state abstracted model, bisimilar to the original system dynamics, that describes accessibility of the space in front of the robot under its given arm and gripper, and a block-conservative specification generation method that turns each manipulation task under any specific operational environment into specifications about state accessibility of the abstracted model. A task proven feasible and safe on the abstracted model is guaranteed to be safe and achievable by the robot. Real-world case studies conducted on a Unitree G1 U1 humanoid show that manipulation tasks commonly encountered in daily life, such as grasping an object, pressing an elevator button or picking up a berry, can be handled within this framework, where an abstracted model of the G1 U1 robot is built only once to avoid costly model reconstructions, and different tasks are simply captured by specific block-conservative specifications, achievable by a generic mission planner with vision-based feedback control.

</details>


### [410] [Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33722)
*Minseok seo,Hee-Seon Kim,Changick Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 FLUENT，使循环模型通过训练学会在更少迭代下完成任务，并在多个任务和真实机器人上提升效率与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类通过练习会更快完成任务，但模型即使随经验提升性能，也未必学会减少计算量。循环模型可通过中间预测提前退出，但共享权重更新可能提升早期预测却损害最终预测，且退出门需随早期预测质量变化调整。

Method: FLUENT 无需额外任务标签或奖励：将初始模型最终循环预测蒸馏到早期预测，并将当前最终循环预测锚定到同一冻结教师；同时训练退出门，在偏离当前最终预测与计算成本之间进行权衡。

Result: 在新 Crafter 世界中提升浅层深度性能；以更少动作头迭代提高 LIBERO 成功率；在更低选择深度下保持语言模型准确率；真实机器人成功率从 62.3% 升至 74.6%，成功回合平均时间从 69 秒降至 31 秒。

Conclusion: FLUENT 能让循环模型通过实践学习计算效率，在保持或提升性能的同时减少迭代次数和运行时间。

Abstract: People become faster at a task through practice, but models that improve with experience do not necessarily learn to use less computation. We train looped models, whose intermediate predictions allow earlier exits, to perform tasks with fewer iterations through practice. This is difficult because shared-weight updates can degrade the final-loop prediction while improving early ones, and the exit gate must track early predictions as their quality changes. We propose FLUENT, which requires no additional task labels or rewards: it distills the initial model's final-loop prediction into early predictions, anchors the current final-loop prediction to the same frozen teacher, and trains the exit gate to balance disagreement with the current final-loop prediction against computation cost. FLUENT improves performance at shallower depth in new Crafter worlds, raises LIBERO success with fewer action-head iterations, and maintains language-model accuracy at lower selected depth. On a real robot, success rises from 62.3\% to 74.6\% while mean time over successful episodes falls from 69\,s to 31\,s. The project page is available at https://msseok96-cpu.github.io/FLUENT/.

</details>


### [411] [RoboJackVR: Turning Robot Tasks into VR Games for Scalable Demonstration Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33731)
*Ben Ma,Jixuan Cai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RoboJackVR：一个在 VR 头显本地运行 MuJoCo 的独立游戏，让玩家通过操作模拟机器人完成战斗技能并贡献演示数据，并用任务契约、配置和绑定机制复用游戏流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展机器人演示数据集需要更多参与者和多样任务，但遥操作门槛高、任务适配成本大，限制了数据收集规模。

Method: 构建 standalone VR 游戏 RoboJackVR，在头显本地进行 MuJoCo 仿真与演示记录，无需外部 PC 或仿真服务器；通过教程、技能选择、战斗后果和角色成长组织重复尝试；用任务契约声明资源、控制、重置、成功标准和记录语义，用游戏配置指定引导、尝试组、技能效果和关卡放置，并用共享绑定连接任务执行、结果处理和记录；辅以批处理工具打包资源、生成配置，并对新接口和不支持谓词进行人工适配与审查。

Result: 在 SO101-Nexus 派生任务和 LIBERO 任务上实例化；在收集数据覆盖的 66 个 LIBERO-90 任务上，仅用 VR 演示训练的 ACT 策略在留出初始状态上的成功率约为完整标准仿真演示基线的 91%（四个训练种子平均）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，游戏化收集的 VR 演示可用于该设定下的策略学习，支持其作为扩展机器人演示数据收集的可行途径。

Abstract: Scaling robot demonstration datasets requires collection systems that accommodate more participants and diverse tasks, yet teleoperation barriers and task-adaptation effort limit this expansion. We present RoboJackVR, a standalone virtual reality (VR) game in which players manipulate simulated robots to execute combat skills and contribute demonstrations. MuJoCo simulation and demonstration recording run locally on the headset, removing the need for an external PC or simulation server during collection. Tutorials, skill selection, combat consequences, and character progression organize repeated task attempts within a continuing game. Task contracts declare assets, controls, resets, success criteria, and recording semantics; separate game configurations specify guidance, attempt groups, skill effects, and course placement. Shared bindings connect these declarations to task execution, outcome handling, and recording, allowing tasks to reuse the game flow while retaining their control and success semantics. Batch tools package supported resources and generate configurations, with manual adaptation and review for new interfaces and unsupported predicates. We instantiate the approach with SO101-Nexus-derived and LIBERO tasks. On the 66 LIBERO-90 tasks covered by the collected data, ACT policies trained solely on VR demonstrations retain approximately 91% of the full-standard simulation-demonstration baseline's success rate on held-out initial states, averaged over four training seeds. These results support the utility of play-collected VR demonstrations for policy learning in this setting.

</details>


### [412] [PROVE: Predict-to-Specify and Observe-to-Verify for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33733)
*Bowen Lyu,Yunan Liu,Liaoyuan Fan,Qinchuan Cheng,Jiafei Duan,Cheston Tan,Shijie Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出开放世界机器人操作的成功判定方法 PROVE：先根据指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图和生成目标图明确成功条件，再观察结果进行验证；并蒸馏出无需参考图、约快38倍的4B评估器 PROVE-Lite。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界机器人操作中布局、铰接设施和有效目标配置变化大，模拟器谓词与人类判断仅一致69.09%，前沿VLM裁判仅86.12%，现有成功判定不可靠。

Method: PROVE 从指令、初始场景、目标物体参考图像和生成的目标图像中细化成功条件，生成目标图仅用于锐化条件而非作为证据；随后观察结果验证。进一步将 PROVE 蒸馏为 PROVE-Lite，单次前向预测各任务条件的结果和终态，并映射为严重度感知奖励用于PPO后训练。

Result: 在65个原子动作、6500条人工标注rollout上，PROVE与人类判断一致率达96.83%；用于开源策略时成功率显著低于原生检查并改变策略排名。PROVE-Lite达到91.20%一致率，运行速度约快38倍；其诊断奖励在PPO后训练中优于模拟器和二值奖励。

Conclusion: 先指定成功条件再验证结果的评估范式能更准确判断开放世界机器人操作成功；PROVE-Lite在保持较高一致率的同时大幅降低评估开销，并可有效用于策略学习奖励。

Abstract: Judging open-world robot manipulation is hard because layouts, articulated fixtures, and valid goal configurations vary widely. On RoboCasa365, simulator predicates agree with human judgments on only 69.09\% of rollouts, and a frontier VLM judge on 86.12\%. We present \textbf{PROVE} (Predict-to-Specify, Observe-to-Verify), which first specifies what success should look like and then checks the outcome. PROVE refines success conditions from the instruction, the initial scene, a target-object reference image, and a generated goal image. The goal image only sharpens the conditions and never serves as evidence. On 6,500 human-annotated rollouts over 65 atomic actions, PROVE reaches \textbf{96.83\%} agreement. Applied to open-source policies, it reports far lower success than native checks and changes their ranking. To reduce evaluation overhead in policy learning, we distill PROVE into \textbf{PROVE-Lite}, a 4B evaluator that needs no reference images. In one forward pass, PROVE-Lite predicts the outcome and the terminal state of each task condition. It reaches \textbf{91.20\%} agreement while running about 38$\times$ faster than PROVE. Mapped to a severity-aware reward, its diagnoses improve PPO post-training over both simulator and binary rewards.

</details>


### [413] [RegHarness: Regulating What Code-as-Policy Agents Keep from Steps to Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33739)
*Shengming Liu,Yunyi Gao,Xinyi Wang,Jianyong Sun,Shuai Wang,Yi Deng,Li Chenye,Mingcai Zhou,Sim Kuan Goh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RegHarness，一种面向 Code-as-Policy 智能体团队 RATs 的两级治理框架，分别控制单次试验内的步骤提交和跨运行间的代码/技能修订，从而提升机器人任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Code-as-Policy 智能体虽能生成、执行和修订机器人程序，但缺乏显式机制治理跨执行过程的持久性：哪些动作在试验内保留、哪些代码修改延续到后续运行，导致步骤级执行和跨运行适应难以充分控制。

Method: RegHarness 采用两级 harness，不依赖 VLA 策略或演示。试验内运行时治理从重置场景评估每个候选步骤，并重放已提交步骤；固定规则控制器仅在 RATs 验证器和任务级 LLM 审计器均批准时提交该步骤。运行间由编码智能体利用日志中的失败来开发并测试对技能、原语和规则的修订，但这些修订默认禁用，需作者显式启用。所有运行时角色使用单一低成本模型。

Result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 配对试验中成功率达 87.8%（158/180），RATs 为 39.4%；在 MolmoSpaces 试验中成功率为 72.0%。2×2 消融显示：仅技能细化使 RATs 成功试验从 71 增至 135；仅运行时治理达到 105；RATs 原生逐步重置重放模式仅 46。

Conclusion: 对于使用低成本模型的 Code-as-Policy 智能体，任务成功不仅取决于生成程序如何执行，还取决于其调用的可复用技能质量以及这些技能跨运行如何演化。

Abstract: Code-as-Policy agents generate, execute, and revise robot programs, but often lack explicit mechanisms to govern what persists across executions: which actions are retained within a trial and which code modifications carry over to subsequent runs. This leaves two critical aspects of agent behavior insufficiently controlled: step-level execution and cross-run adaptation. We present RegHarness, a two-level harness that governs both forms of persistence for the RATs agent team, without relying on a vision-language-action (VLA) policy or demonstrations. Within each trial, run-time governance evaluates each proposed step from a reset scene, replaying the committed steps, while a fixed-rule controller commits the step only when both RATs' verifier and a task-long LLM auditor approve it. Between runs, a coding agent uses logged failures to develop and test revisions to skills, primitives, and rules, which remain disabled by default until explicitly enabled by the authors. Using a single low-cost model across all run-time roles, RegHarness achieves an 87.8% success rate (158/180) on paired LIBERO-PRO trials, compared with 39.4% for RATs, and a 72.0% success rate on MolmoSpaces trials. A $2\times2$ ablation study of RegHarness's two levels shows that its skill refinement alone increases RATs' successful trials from 71 to 135, whereas run-time governance alone achieves 105 and RATs' native stepwise reset-and-replay mode achieves only 46. These findings suggest that, for Code-as-Policy agents operating with low-cost models, task success depends not only on how generated programs are executed, but also on the quality of the reusable skills they invoke and how those skills evolve across runs.

</details>


### [414] [FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33769)
*Zirui Li,Yujie Yan,Jingxuan Qian,Yangang Ren,Haizhou Yin,Haoran Xu,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 FailPoint-X 基准，用于在离线 VLA 后训练中评估人类接管数据的价值，并在固定 π0.5 检查点、可恢复失败状态和统一评估器下比较行为克隆、基于价值的离线学习与继续训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类接管可为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供纠正性监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献需要与持续优化区分开来，因此需要一个可控、可复现的基准来单独评估接管数据的作用。

Method: 构建 FailPoint-X：标注失败发生区间并在其中采样接管起始帧；从固定 π0.5 检查点出发，在 10 个 LIBERO-X 任务族、最多 5 个难度级别上收集 629 个自然失败和 2823 次接管尝试，其中 2400 次为接受恢复、2320 次用于后训练；评估从 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点重启。在匹配 actor 更新次数下，比较恢复行为克隆、基于恢复与失败轨迹的价值型离线学习，以及在现有示范上的继续训练。

Result: 在 240 个 L1-L3 留出失败上训练 1200 步内，行为克隆相对仅示范对照组将恢复率提高 29.4 个百分点；价值型学习器未带来进一步增益（1.5 个百分点）。在相同时间范围的 L1-L5 名义起点探索性评估中，克隆相对基础策略成功率下降 30.0 个百分点；混入示范后将损失降至 16.5 个百分点，但在更严格的预设时间范围下该缓解效果缩小。

Conclusion: 人类接管恢复数据对离线 VLA 后训练有价值，但朴素克隆恢复可能损害名义成功率；混入示范可缓解性能下降，而价值型离线学习未显示额外收益。可恢复失败状态与共享评估器支持从相同起点公平比较各方法。

Abstract: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

</details>


### [415] [Triage Before Fine-Tuning: Feasibility-Gated Selection and Monitored Adaptation of Embodied Foundation Models for a Fixed Physical Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33772)
*Zilin Huang,Zhengyang Wan,Zihao Sheng,Boyue Wang,Ruolin Yang,Yuhao Luo,Sikai Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出TRIAGE，用于在固定机器人/车辆平台上选择并适配公开具身基础模型：先按感知与延迟可行性筛选，再用少量本地数据探测、排序、微调和闭环验收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中常按基准排名选择公开检查点，再在本地数据上微调，但平台在选模型前已固定且本地数据很少；需要区分检查点在固定平台上的损失哪些可由本地数据修复。

Method: 将差距分为感知差距、延迟差距和分布差距，仅分布差距适合微调修复；TRIAGE分五阶段：传感器契约与端到端延迟的可行性门控、十分钟本地日志探测、通过门控候选的目标相关排序、受监控微调、发布前闭环检查。

Result: 驾驶基准中，截止时间低于领先闭环模型延迟会使其在80%至90%路线碰撞；同等像素下丢失视野比丢失分辨率对规划影响大2.2至5.7倍；本地帧可弥补75%稳定性差距但小预算下增加扰动敏感性；按分数选择在4种部署配置中2种违反门控。实车中工厂相机未通过感知门控，增加相机后修复；延迟门控剔除两个最高分候选且二者均未完成闭环行程；选中模型5次闭环行程通过4次；闭环检查扣留了离线指标提升的微调模型。

Conclusion: TRIAGE可帮助无法从零训练基础模型的组织判断公开检查点能否运行在其自有机器人或车辆上，并明确不能运行时应修复什么。

Abstract: Embodied foundation models are increasingly deployed by selection: a practitioner picks a public checkpoint by benchmark rank and fine-tunes it on local data. The platform is fixed before the model is chosen, with little or no local data. We ask what such a checkpoint loses on a fixed platform and which part of the loss local data can buy back. We split the gap by what can repair it. A sensing gap, information the sensors do not capture, cannot be closed with their data; a latency gap, output arriving after the control loop needs it, belongs to the loop, not the weights; only a distribution gap is fine-tuning's to repair. TRIAGE turns this into feasibility-gated selection and monitored adaptation in five stages: gates on the sensor contract and on end-to-end latency that no score can override, probes on ten minutes of local logs, a ranking by target-relevant score among the candidates that pass, and fine-tuning that is monitored and checked in closed loop before release. On driving benchmarks, a deadline below a leading closed-loop model's latency makes it collide on 80 to 90% of routes, and losing field of view moves plans 2.2 to 5.7 times more than losing resolution at equal pixels. Local frames close 75% of a stability gap but raise perturbation sensitivity at small budgets, and picking by score violates a gate in two of four deployment profiles. On a full-scale vehicle, the factory camera failed the sensing gate and an added camera repaired it. The latency gate removed the two highest-scoring candidates, neither of which completed a closed-loop trip. The selected model passed acceptance in 4 of 5 closed-loop trips, and the closed-loop check withheld a fine-tuned model that had improved offline. TRIAGE lets organizations that cannot train foundation models from scratch find out whether a public checkpoint can run on the robot or vehicle they own, and what to fix if not.

</details>


### [416] [Recoverability policy editing for closed-loop safety in autonomous driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34403)
*Yang Guan,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种状态级策略编辑技术，在复用神经网络驾驶模型原有能力的同时，保证存在可恢复扰动时的闭环安全性，并在nuPlan仿真中显著减少安全事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络驱动的自动驾驶模型缺乏安全保障，需要在不牺牲原有驾驶能力的情况下提升闭环安全性。

Method: 引入策略可恢复性概念，用于刻画车辆能否在有限时间内安全返回原策略可行集；识别原策略下长期不安全但可恢复的状态区域，并仅在该区域选择性编辑策略输出，使车辆进入该区域时纠正动作，恢复后继续使用原策略。

Result: 在nuPlan城市驾驶场景的闭环仿真中，该方法使原策略下的安全事件减少48%，同时基本保持其驾驶性能。

Conclusion: 状态级策略编辑能够在复用现有驾驶模型能力的基础上提供闭环安全保证，是一种有效的自动驾驶安全保障方法。

Abstract: Autonomous driving powered by neural network models lacks safety guarantees. We propose a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities. Closed-loop safety means that the vehicle remains free of collisions at all future times. We introduce the concept of policy recoverability to characterize whether a vehicle can safely return to the original policy's feasible set in finite time. Our method identifies states that are unsafe in the long term under the original policy but recoverable, and selectively edits policy outputs within this region. The vehicle corrects its actions upon entering this region and resumes the original policy upon recovery. Closed-loop simulations on nuPlan urban driving scenarios show a 48% reduction in safety incidents under the original policy while largely preserving its driving performance.

</details>


### [417] [LSRP*-LA: Scalable and Anytime Multi-Agent Path Finding for Large Agents with Asynchronous Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33793)
*Dachuan Liu,Shizhe Zhao,Zhongqiang Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 LSRP*-LA，用于解决大智能体且动作异步的多智能体路径规划问题（LA-MAPF-AA），其中每个智能体可占据多个格子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数 MAPF 算法假设智能体只占据单个顶点且所有动作同步，这限制了实际应用；现有去除这些假设的规划器要么只能处理少量智能体，要么无法持续改进解。LSRP* 虽可扩展且支持异步动作，但仍假设单顶点智能体。

Method: 在 LSRP* 基础上扩展出 LSRP*-LA，以支持占据多个格子的大智能体与异步动作，并分析其性质；在不同地图上与多个基线方法进行实验比较，规模最高达 800 个智能体。

Result: LSRP*-LA 可扩展且完备，并在获得初始解后持续改进解质量直至运行时间预算耗尽。实验表明，它能处理的智能体数量约为基线方法的两倍，且解成本约为近期同步大智能体规划器的一半。

Conclusion: LSRP*-LA 能有效求解大智能体异步动作 MAPF，在可扩展性和解质量上优于相关基线，适合更大规模的实际场景。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their start locations to their goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most MAPF algorithms assume that each agent occupies a single vertex and that the actions of all agents are synchronized. These assumptions may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. Existing planners that get rid of both assumptions either handle only a few agents or cannot improve their solutions. Recently, a planner called LSRP* was proposed, which is scalable and anytime with asynchronous actions, but still limited by that each agent occupies a single vertex. This paper develops a new planner called LSRP*-LA for MAPF for large agents with asynchronous actions (LA-MAPF-AA), where an agent can occupy several cells. LSRP*-LA is scalable and complete, and it keeps improving solution quality after the initial solution is obtained until the runtime budget depletes. We analyze the properties of LSRP*-LA and test it against several baselines with up to 800 agents on various maps. LSRP*-LA can handle twice as many agents as baseline methods and its solution cost is about half that of recent synchronous planners for large agents.

</details>


### [418] [$μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34597)
*Devesh Nath,Glen Chou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 μMPC：利用学习到的 Koopman 线性化动力学和预计算的控制到输出映射，将 MPC 在线计算转化为仅含动作变量的 KC-QP，从而实现快速、可扩展的约束 MPC，并支持控制感知的动力学学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 MPC 在线计算成本高，尤其在学习型 Koopman 提升维度较高时，状态轨迹优化和约束变化会导致计算与重构开销大；研究旨在降低在线求解时间，同时支持变化的目标与约束，并能将 MPC 嵌入训练流程。

Method: μMPC 使用学习到的 Koopman 线性化动力学，预计算有限时域的控制到输出映射，消除提升状态轨迹，形成仅有 H n_u 个决策变量且与提升维度无关的 action-only Koopman-Compiled QP（KC-QP）。采用固定预计算的原算子，通过仅需矩阵-向量乘法和投影的原对偶迭代求解，无需因目标或约束变化而重新分解。利用可微 KC-QP 在训练循环中进行控制感知动力学学习，并结合批处理 DAgger 式数据聚合。

Result: μMPC 在桌面 CPU 上求解时间低至 23 μs，在 168 MHz Crazyflie 微控制器上为 24 ms；可扩展到 4096 维四足控制（<5 ms）、2048 维世界模型的视觉规划（0.4 ms），并在 GPU 上以超过 30 Hz 完成 200 架四旋翼的避碰规划。相比对比方法，约束 MPC 最高快 108 倍，视觉运动规划最高快 1907 倍。

Conclusion: μMPC 通过 Koopman 编译 QP 和预计算原算子显著降低在线 MPC 计算量，在嵌入式、高维控制、视觉规划和多智能体场景中实现快速可扩展的约束 MPC，同时支持控制感知的动力学学习。

Abstract: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

</details>


### [419] [$\widetilde{\varepsilon}$: Does Initial Noise Induce Directional Bias in Vision-Language-Action Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33816)
*Junmyeong Lee,Dongmin Shin,Wooseok Jeon,JunGyu Lee,Seunghyun Shin,Hae-Gon Jeon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究VLA模型中扩散式动作生成对初始噪声敏感的问题，提出在训练和推理阶段同时干预以提升动作生成鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA采用扩散式动作生成实现连续机器人控制，但性能高度依赖初始噪声，动作误差会导致执行中难以恢复；已有方法仅搜索有利噪声初始化，动作专家本身仍对噪声敏感。

Method: 作者发现初始噪声会在动作空间引入与噪声时间均值一致的方向偏差。为此，训练时对反义噪声对(ε, -ε)施加一致动作预测约束；推理时去除噪声的时间均值。

Result: 该方法在仿真基准中显著降低动作偏差并提升任务性能；真实机器人实验中，将π0.5的平均任务成功率从40%提升到68%，执行更稳定一致。

Conclusion: 通过在训练和推理阶段对初始噪声进行简单有效干预，可显著增强扩散式VLA动作生成的噪声鲁棒性和实际任务表现。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(ε, -ε)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

</details>


### [420] [Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33828)
*Rikuto Hidaka,Tsung-Yuan Chen,Kento Kawaharazuka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种单一强化学习策略，联合协调人形机器人的踏步、平衡控制与物体操作，实现枢轴行走搬运箱子，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人形机器人枢轴行走研究多依赖分开规划的操作与步态序列，物体在连续旋转之间需要停顿，且缺少单一学习型控制器。

Method: 使用强化学习训练单一策略，奖励促进交替枢轴运动，并采用随物体位移推进的相位参考；部署时将策略微调为不直接感知物体的版本，以周期时钟替代进度参考。

Result: 仿真中人形机器人能够枢轴搬运箱子；真实机器人五次试验均将箱子向前搬运超过1米，每次试验均以基座倾斜安全停止结束，且无需直接物体状态感知。

Conclusion: 研究表明，协调的人形机器人枢轴行走可以通过强化学习获得，并可迁移到物理人形机器人，而无需直接物体状态传感。

Abstract: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all five trials; each trial ended at a base-tilt safety stop. These results demonstrate that coordinated humanoid pivot walking can be learned with reinforcement learning and transferred to a physical humanoid robot without direct object-state sensing.

</details>


### [421] [Measuring the Value of One Shared Image at Robot Handoffs in Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33865)
*Yuze Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究机器人交接时领航机器人应发送什么信息以帮助队友完成路线。通过在106个环境中重放3,920次自主出发并比较不同消息，发现除已执行动作外加入最后一次动作块之前的视角图像能显著提高接收者成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当领航机器人无法继续任务时，需要把信息传递给必须完成路线的队友；核心问题是交接时应发送什么消息最有效。

Method: 在每个接触点用冻结接收者在替代消息下重放；比较仅发送已执行动作与额外发送领航者最后动作块之前的视角；用领航者继续模拟定义全历史上限Solo；分析帧数、消息大小、进度线索、近距离目标接收者表现，以及随机传输与学习发送器的对比。

Result: 在RxR和SAGE交接中，加入最后动作块之前的视角使每次交接成功率分别提高7.51和8.54个百分点，按每次出发分别提高2.23和1.44个百分点。接触时领航者中位积累41帧；发送一帧可恢复SAGE中24%、RxR中30%的全历史相对仅动作优势。SAGE中图像相较估计进度线索挽救100条路线并逆转54次成功；接近目标接收者最终落在目标外比例从63.1%降至51.7%。较早视角比接触时视角每次交接高6-7个百分点。约7 kB/交接即可检测收益；同尺寸分箱内随机传输几乎等同学习发送器的团队成功率。

Conclusion: 在必要交接时，发送通往最后机动动作的接近视角能帮助接收者完成路线；关键信息在于最后动作前的视觉上下文，而非单纯动作历史。

Abstract: When the lead robot cannot continue, what should it send the teammate that must finish the route? We replay a frozen receiver at each contact under alternative messages. Across 3,920 autonomous departures in 106 environments, adding the view before the lead's last action block to its executed actions raised success by 7.51 percentage points (pp) per RxR handoff and 8.54 pp per SAGE handoff. Per departure the gains were 2.23 and 1.44 pp, respectively. The lead continuing in simulation defines the empirical full-history ceiling (Solo). At contact, the lead had accumulated a median of 41 frames. Sending one frame when available recovered 24% of the full-history advantage over actions alone in SAGE and 30% in RxR. Over an estimated progress cue in SAGE, the image rescued 100 routes and reversed 54 successes. Near-goal receivers finished outside less often (63.1% to 51.7%, post hoc). In secondary comparisons the earlier view outperformed the contact view by 6-7 pp per handoff. Exact-route specificity and image gains at controlled starts with mostly unknown progress or outside the goal region remained unresolved. Gains were detectable from about 7 kB per handoff. Random transmission matched within size bins nearly equaled the learned sender's team success. At a required handoff, a view of the approach to the last maneuver helps the receiver finish.

</details>


### [422] [Integration of Vision-Language-Action Control for Autonomous Forklift Unloading with Limited Real-World Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33880)
*Koshi Oishi,Seigo Ito*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型用于自主叉车卸货任务，在有限真实数据条件下完成系统集成与真实场景验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 叉车在仓储物流中很关键，但现有自动化系统难以处理需要顺序决策的复杂任务；VLA模型在多步决策方面有潜力，但尚未用于叉车控制，且缺少公开叉车数据集。

Method: 使用主要基于机械臂数据预训练的VLA模型，通过低成本仿真构建叉车训练数据集，并结合9.38小时仿真数据和0.8小时真实演示数据进行适配，真实数据约占收集叉车数据时长的8%。

Result: 在四种模型变体上进行了72次真实世界试验，结果表明该系统能够在有限真实数据下完成叉车卸货任务。

Conclusion: VLA控制可应用于叉车自主卸货，仿真数据可低成本扩展训练数据，减少对大规模真实数据的依赖，为叉车自动化提供可行路径。

Abstract: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

</details>


### [423] [CoTAMP: Cooperative Task and Motion Planning for Quadruped Robots with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33911)
*Woojin Kim,Jemin Hwangbo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种面向多足机器人协作任务与运动规划的框架，结合大语言模型与代码模块，先规划任务并发明未预先定义的动作，再生成关键帧并通过运动学综合与轨迹优化得到可执行轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单个四足机器人无法通过某些环境，例如需要借助同伴攀爬的岩架或需要用箱子搭桥的间隙，这类任务需要协作任务与运动规划；已有工作多局限于单机器人运动或从预定义技能集中选择动作。

Method: 框架分为任务规划和运动生成两部分，均由基于LLM的模块和代码模块组成。任务规划将整体轨迹划分为多个步骤并固定步骤边界处的机器人位姿；运动生成产生描述各步骤运动的关键帧，并通过运动学综合转换为连续轨迹；代码模块检查计划和运动并将失败反馈给LLM模块修正；最后用轨迹优化细化整体轨迹以满足动力学约束。

Result: 在两个RAIBO2机器人模型和三个仿真课程上，该框架在全部30次试验中生成运动学有效的参考轨迹，且均在轨迹优化中收敛；与多个基线相比，在成功率、动态可行性、执行时间、生成时间和成本方面具有优势。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将LLM用于发明未预定义动作并与代码检查、运动学综合和轨迹优化结合，可有效解决需要协作的任务与运动规划问题，并生成动态可行的机器人轨迹。

Abstract: Some environments cannot be traversed by a single quadruped robot, for example a ledge that one robot can climb only from its partner's back or a gap that must be bridged with boxes. Solving them requires cooperative task and motion planning (TAMP). Previous works are limited to the motions of a single robot or only select actions from a predefined set of skills. We propose a framework with two parts: task planning that invents motions not defined in advance, and motion generation that realizes the invented motions. Both parts consist of large language model (LLM)-based modules and code-based modules. Task planning divides the trajectory of the whole task into steps and fixes the robot poses at the step boundaries. Motion generation produces keyframes that describe the motion of each step and turns them into a continuous trajectory through kinematic synthesis. The code-based modules check every plan and motion and return failures to the LLM-based modules for correction. The whole trajectory is then refined by trajectory optimization to satisfy the dynamics. On three simulated courses with two RAIBO2 robot models, our framework produced kinematically valid references in all 30 trials, all of which converged in trajectory optimization. Compared with several baselines, our framework showed advantages in success rate, dynamic feasibility, execution time, and generation time and cost. Project page: https://woojin8098.github.io/CoTAMP/

</details>


### [424] [X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Cross-Embodiment Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33914)
*Chun Gu,Xiaofei Wei,Yiming Chen,Juntong Zhang,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: X-World 提出一种基于预训练视频扩散模型、适配多视角的闭环机器人操作策略，通过共享动作专家预测动作块，并在真实机器人上实现实时异步推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言指令操控需要稳健的闭环策略，但带动作标注的机器人轨迹成本高、覆盖有限；人类视频和机器人视频可提供互补的时空先验，用于跨本体控制。

Method: 将预训练视频扩散模型适配到可变视角；用 Q-Former 压缩隐藏状态为 token，输入共享的 flow-matching 动作专家预测动作块；采用数据集特定投影映射原生状态与动作；先在大规模机器人和人类视频上适配骨干，再冻结骨干对 Q-Former 和动作专家进行仅动作预训练，最后在目标平台后训练；推理时以 20 Hz 响应，并通过异步实时分块将更新与执行重叠。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上表现强，并在 LIBERO-Plus 的零样本偏移下表现良好；在真实硬件上，于侧装双臂 UR5e 的六个双臂任务中平均成功率为 81.7%，该平台是展示的三种真实机器人配置之一。

Conclusion: X-World 表明，利用大规模人类与机器人视频预训练视频扩散模型，并结合高效动作专家和异步实时分块，可构建跨本体、闭环且可实时部署的机器人操作策略。

Abstract: Language-instructed manipulation requires robust closedloop policies, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are costly and limited in coverage. Human and robot videos provide complementary spatiotemporal priors for crossembodiment control. We propose X-World, which adapts pretrained video diffusion to variable views. A Q-Former compresses hidden states into tokens for a shared flowmatching expert that predicts action chunks. Datasetspecific projections map native states and actions. We adapt the backbone on large-scale robot and human videos, freeze it for action-only pretraining of the Q-Former and action expert, then post-train on the target platform. At inference, X-World responds at 20 Hz and overlaps updates with execution via asynchronous real-time chunking. X-World performs strongly on LIBERO and under zero-shot shifts on LIBERO-Plus. On hardware, it averages 81.7% success across six bimanual tasks on the side-mounted dual-arm UR5e, one of three real-robot configurations presented.

</details>


### [425] [SEEK: Self-Evolution through Execution Knowledge for Agentic Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33915)
*Zeyang Guan,Qihao Zhao,Rui Gong,Zhang Haitian,Yalun Dai,Yangyu Huang,Lingao Xiao,Haozhe Du,Xuehui Yu,Ye Lu,Jianjun Gao,Ruoyu Wang,Haowen Bai,Hao Li,Scarlett Li,Kim-Hui Yap*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 SEEK 智能体框架，使机器人在不更新底层多模态基础模型的情况下，跨多次尝试保留并改进操作知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态基础模型可让机器人部署时适应，但学习仅停留在模型工作上下文中，任务结束后执行知识会丢失，导致下次重复犯错和耗时；仅回放动作又不足以应对当前条件变化。

Method: SEEK 采用自演化程序化策略 SEPP，将操作编码为可执行程序并根据当前观测决定动作；同时用持久动作-效果库 PAEB 记录成功与失败尝试的动作实测效果。已有程序适用时直接执行、无需请求模型，遇到未覆盖条件时利用证据修订程序。

Result: 在 RoboDojo 全部 42 个任务上，经过十次尝试保留知识后，SEEK 平均任务分从 27.0 提升至 54.4，成功率从 19.7% 提升至 48.0%。在使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 34 个任务上，五次尝试后达到 80.1，而同一模型直接执行为 49.6，并减少 77.6% 的模型请求。

Conclusion: 机器人需要同时保留可执行程序与动作效果证据，才能跨尝试改进；SEEK 在固定基础模型下实现了更高任务表现、更高成功率和更低模型调用成本。

Abstract: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

</details>


### [426] [iMFPO: Improving Mean Flow Policy Optimization with Drift-Aware Velocity Alignment for Embodied Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33922)
*Lisiyu Pan,Ting Huang,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 iMFPO，一种用于具身控制的一步生成式策略优化框架，通过解耦速度学习与漂移感知速度对齐，实现在线强化学习下高效的一步动作生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于流的生成策略表达能力强，但在奖励驱动策略优化中难以实现高效的一步生成；在线强化学习过程中动作分布不断变化，会导致瞬时速度学习与区间平均动作生成之间出现不一致。

Method: iMFPO 使用共享的区间条件 actor 同时支持瞬时速度监督和区间平均动作生成；联合优化 JVP 校正的速度回归与奖励驱动策略目标，并在训练中引入冻结 PPO 教师提供动作级指导；推理时通过区间平均速度预测直接生成动作，无需迭代流积分。

Result: 在 Go2、G1、H1 和 Spot 上，零潜变量评估的平均回报分别为 35.69、34.44、416.23 和 29.86；在 Go2 上，相比 64 步 RFPO，动作生成延迟从 15.57 ms 降至 0.41 ms。

Conclusion: iMFPO 能够缓解在线强化学习中速度学习与动作生成的不一致问题，在多个具身控制平台上实现有效的一步生成控制，并显著降低推理延迟。

Abstract: Flow-based generative policies offer expressive action modeling for embodied control, yet achieving efficient one-step generation under reward-driven policy optimization remains challenging. In particular, evolving action distributions during online reinforcement learning may introduce inconsistencies between instantaneous-velocity learning and interval-averaged action generation. To address this challenge, we propose iMFPO, a one-step generative policy optimization framework with decoupled velocity learning and drift-aware velocity alignment. A shared interval-conditioned actor supports instantaneous-velocity supervision and interval-averaged action generation. JVP-corrected velocity regression is jointly optimized with reward-driven policy objectives, with action-level guidance from a frozen PPO teacher during training. At inference, iMFPO directly generates actions through interval-averaged velocity prediction, achieving one-step control without iterative flow integration. Across Go2, G1, H1, and Spot, zero-latent evaluation yields mean returns of 35.69, 34.44, 416.23, and 29.86. On Go2, action-generation latency drops from 15.57 ms to 0.41 ms relative to 64-step RFPO. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/iMFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/iMFPO.

</details>


### [427] [Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33925)
*Zhiyue Zhao,Mingyu Liu,Bolin Zhang,Liyang Li,Guangyu Huang,Canyu Zhao,Jinchuan Shi,Haokai Zhang,Hao Chen,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出机器人世界模型主要依赖成功演示数据训练，在抓取失败、物体被推挤或滑落时预测严重退化；作者构建了含62k条扰动抓取轨迹的Reforge数据集，并提出WorldReforge训练方法，显著降低物体运动预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人训练数据以成功演示为主，世界模型在偏离正常流程的失败交互场景下预测会崩溃：五个预训练动作条件模型中，物体运动误差最多只比"直接复制首帧"的静态基线低10.4%，甚至有两个模型不如该基线。

Method: 构建Reforge数据集：对参考抓取在位置、朝向和闭合时机上施加扰动，仿真生成62k条包含推动、滑落、抓取失败的轨迹，并记录真实物体位姿、接触与表面点标注。基于这些真值设计两个无额外推理开销的训练信号：Interaction Alignment（将重建损失聚焦于小物体与接触区域）和Surface Correspondence（训练骨干特征跨帧跟踪同一物理表面点）。

Result: 在Cosmos3 Nano上，WorldReforge使物体轨迹误差整体降低28.2%，未见物体上降低35.0%，两动作结果差异预测误差降低43.3%；仅在仿真中训练，却也能提升DROID数据集与真实失败视频上的重建效果。

Conclusion: 失败接触与成功持握提供互补的物理知识：失败接触教会模型物体如何响应外力，持握教会模型抓取状态如何保持。将失败场景数据与针对性训练信号引入世界模型，可有效提升其鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. Across five pretrained action-conditioned models, object-motion error is at most 10.4% lower than that of a static baseline that copies the first frame, and two models are worse than this baseline. We present WorldReforge, which teaches world models what happens when manipulation goes wrong. We construct the Reforge dataset of 62k simulated trajectories by perturbing reference grasps in position, orientation, and closure timing, recording each resulting push, slip, or failed pickup with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface points. WorldReforge turns this ground truth into two training signals without additional inference cost. Interaction Alignment focuses reconstruction on the small object and contact regions that a global loss underweights, and Surface Correspondence trains backbone features to follow the same physical surface points across frames. On Cosmos3 Nano, WorldReforge reduces object trajectory error by 28.2% overall and by 35.0% on unseen objects, and it lowers the error in predicting how two actions' outcomes diverge by 43.3%. Although trained only in simulation, it also improves reconstruction on DROID and on real failure videos. Controlled data studies show that failed contact and successful holding teach complementary physics: failed contact teaches how objects respond, and holding teaches how a grasped state persists. Our code, data, and models are available at aim-uofa.github.io/WorldReforge/.

</details>


### [428] [Targeted Adaptation of World-Action Models via Interaction and Motion Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33963)
*Yuze Zhu,Jacky Li,Yusen Luo,Ken Jiankun Zheng,Chancharik Mitra,Trevor Darrell,Roei Herzig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HeadLight，一种面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的参数高效微调方法，通过联合适配与操作能力相关的 Next-Interaction Heads 和 Motion Heads，在仅更新 1.1% 参数的情况下提升机器人操作成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全量微调和 LoRA 等方法在适配 WAM 时，未显式选择与机器人操作关键能力相关的参数；而成功操作既需要定位交互位置，也需要建模机器人与物体的运动。

Method: 作者发现两类功能特化的注意力头：Next-Interaction Heads 用于定位即将发生的抓取/释放目标，Motion Heads 用于跟踪跨帧运动；并提出 HeadLight，联合适配这两类注意力头以实现参数高效精调。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 未见任务上，HeadLight 成功率为 62.28%，高于全量微调的 57.89% 和 LoRA 的 58.66%，且仅更新 1.1% 参数。推理时消融显示，去除 Motion Heads 使成功率从 57.89% 降至 0.94%，去除 Next-Interaction Heads 降至 40.61%，均显著高于随机消融同等数量注意力头。

Conclusion: 特定注意力头对 WAM 机器人操作能力具有关键功能作用；HeadLight 能高效适配这些头，并在多种 WAM 架构和真实机器人操作场景中有效。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) are a promising new paradigm of robot manipulation policies that jointly generate future video and actions. Successful manipulation requires both identifying where to interact and modeling how the robot and objects move. Yet standard adaptation methods, such as full fine-tuning and LoRA, do not explicitly select parameters aligned with these manipulation-specific capabilities. Motivated by this challenge, we discover two functionally specialized families of attention heads: Next-Interaction Heads, which localize upcoming grasp-and-release targets, and Motion Heads, which track movement across frames. Furthermore, we introduce HeadLight, a parameter-efficient refinement method that jointly adapts Next-Interaction Heads and Motion Heads. On RoboTwin tasks unseen during fine-tuning, HeadLight achieves 62.28% success, compared with 57.89% for full fine-tuning and 58.66% for LoRA, while updating only 1.1% of parameters. Inference-time ablations further validate the functional importance of these heads: ablating Motion Heads reduces manipulation success from 57.89% to 0.94%, while ablating Next-Interaction Heads lowers it to 40.61%, both substantially more than ablating equally many random heads. Finally, we show that our approach is effective across multiple WAM architectures and real-robot manipulation settings.

</details>


### [429] [QK-Bench: Benchmarking Quantitative Kinematic Understanding for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33991)
*Lennox Wei,Jiaqi Yao,Shixin Sun,Yuanzheng Zhang,Jianhua Han,Meng Tian,Shaohui Liu,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出定量运动学基准 QK-Bench，用于评估多模态大模型从单目视频中理解运动幅度、速率、参考系依赖和未来空间演化的能力，发现现有模型表现显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义正确的场景描述可能掩盖定量错误，例如能识别物体接近却无法判断接近速度或是否碰撞；这类错误对避障、轨迹跟踪和反应式抓取等任务至关重要。

Method: 构建 QK-Bench，包含来自 379 个视频的 2,341 个多选题问答对和 17 个任务，覆盖物体中心运动学、相机自运动运动学和多物体运动学关系；利用隐藏几何与时间信号构建和筛选轨迹，用固定运动学规则将物理量映射为可验证答案，并进行轨迹与问题验证；所有模型使用统一单目 RGB 输入。

Result: 评估专有、开源和空间 MLLM 后发现明显局限：最强模型总体准确率仅 41.2%，空间 MLLM 没有一致优势。

Conclusion: 当前空间智能的进展不能可靠迁移到定量运动学理解，MLLM 在运动幅度、速率、参考系和未来空间演化等定量推理方面仍存在重大不足。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence concerns both scene structure and its temporal evolution. Yet a semantically correct description can conceal a quantitative error: recognizing that objects are approaching does not determine their closing speed or whether they will meet. Such errors are critical in collision avoidance, trajectory tracking, and reactive grasping, where actions depend on motion magnitude, timing, and relative geometry. We study quantitative kinematic understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs): resolving motion magnitude, rate, reference-frame dependence, and future spatial evolution from visual evidence. We introduce the Quantitative Kinematics Benchmark (QK-Bench), comprising 2,341 multiple-choice QA pairs from 379 videos and 17 tasks spanning Object-Centric Kinematics, Camera Ego-Motion Kinematics, and Multi-Object Kinematic Relations. Hidden geometric and temporal signals support trajectory construction and filtering, while fixed kinematic rules map physical quantities to verifiable answers, including categorical labels. Trajectory and question validation ensure target reliability and sufficient visual support in the sampled frames. All models receive a unified monocular RGB input. Evaluations of proprietary, open-source, and spatial MLLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model achieves only 41.2\% overall accuracy, and spatial MLLMs show no consistent advantage. These findings indicate that current advances in spatial intelligence do not reliably transfer to quantitative kinematic understanding.

</details>


### [430] [Aegis-VLA: Reliability-Gated Action Refinement via a Trajectory World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33993)
*Lennox Wei,Jiaqi Yao,Shixin Sun,Yuanzheng Zhang,Jianhua Han,Meng Tian,Shaohui Liu,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Aegis-VLA，一种由世界模型引导的 VLA 框架，可生成预测性动作修正，并单独判断是否采用及采用强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态物体操作需要在推理和执行过程中持续与运动目标保持时空对齐；仅靠未来预测虽可辅助动作纠正，但准确预测并不能判断修改现有动作是否有益。

Method: 方法包含三部分：轨迹世界模型结合运动学外推与学习到的残差动力学预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性；差异引导动作细化通过比较仅历史条件与基础动作条件下的末端执行器预测来提出有界机械臂修正；可靠性门控基于示范相对改进学习何时接纳修正，并利用预测不确定性和预期物体—末端执行器接近度在推理时调节修正应用，拒绝时保留基础动作。

Result: Aegis-VLA 仅引入约 2.45M 可训练参数；在模拟动态物体操作 DOM 基准的 1800 次评估中达到 56.72% 成功率，比复现的 DynamicVLA 基线 45.44% 高 11.28 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将动作修正生成与修正应用决策分离，并利用世界模型预测和可靠性门控，可在轻量参数下有效提升动态物体操作性能。

Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. A Reliability Gate learns when to admit corrections based on demonstration-relative improvements over base actions, and regulates their application during inference using predictive uncertainty and anticipated object--end-effector proximity. Rejected corrections preserve the corresponding base actions. Aegis-VLA introduces only approximately 2.45M trainable parameters. On the simulated Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, Aegis-VLA achieves 56.72\% success over 1,800 evaluation trials, exceeding our reproduced DynamicVLA baseline of 45.44\% by 11.28 percentage points.

</details>


### [431] [Hetero-Associative Visuomotor Memory: Soft Recall as a Base for Learned Residuals in Few-Demonstration Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34014)
*Runcong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究检索-纠正策略中演示记忆应提供什么给纠正器，发现对整个记忆做平滑 softmax 加权召回比只取最近演示块更适合作为纠正基础，并提出 14M 参数的异联想视觉运动记忆 HAVM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索-纠正策略通常只修正最近检索到的演示块，但这种 top-1 读法未必是纠正器的最佳输入；作者希望明确演示记忆应如何供给纠正器，以提升少样本、快速适应场景下的操作成功率。

Method: 提出 HAVM（异联想视觉运动记忆），用动作感知键、候选与训练固定的设置，对整个记忆进行 softmax 加权软召回，并学习检索温度 β；离线训练约 5 分钟，推理 1.1 ms，在 ALOHA、robomimic Square、LIBERO 和真实 SO-101 上评估。

Result: 在 ALOHA cube transfer 上，软召回单独执行不优于最近块，但纠正后在新编码器新重置上提升 22.4 点，比闭环调优 top-1 纠正器高 7.4 点；robomimic Square 上分别领先 7.9 和 6.7 点。六个 ALOHA 编码器下 24 s 内达 76.4%，接近训练 6.7 h 的 264M Diffusion Policy（78.8%），高于 ACT（71.7%）和微调 VLA（65.2-75.2%）；8 s 限制内 74.6%，领先所有 40 演示基线。LIBERO 上 40 任务记忆达 92.2%，对改写更鲁棒；真实 SO-101 可 30 Hz 控制不卡顿。

Conclusion: 软召回整体记忆比最近块更适合作为纠正器基础，HAVM 能以小模型和低成本实现快速少样本适应；其优势在稀疏、多样、人类演示上成立，在密集、脚本化或生成数据上减弱甚至反转，且相比预训练基础策略牺牲广泛 OOD 泛化以换取对现有演示的快速适应。

Abstract: Retrieve-and-correct policies typically refine the nearest retrieved demonstration chunk, the
  readout that works best when executed directly. We study what a demonstration memory should
  supply to the corrector instead and find that a smooth, softmax-weighted recall over the whole
  memory is a much better base. On ALOHA cube transfer (40 human demonstrations), soft recall is
  no better to execute alone than the nearest chunk; however, with keys, candidates, and training
  fixed, correcting it raises success by 22.4 points on fresh resets with new encoders and by 7.4
  against a closed-loop-tuned top-1 corrector. On robomimic Square, it leads by 7.9 points with
  the two better operators and by 6.7 on a label-free draw of equal size. This gain holds on
  sparse, varied demonstrations under an action-aware key and leave-one-demonstration-out
  training, and fades or slightly reverses on dense, scripted, or generated data. Building on this
  finding, our hetero-associative visuomotor memory (HAVM, 14M parameters) trains offline in about
  five minutes, including a learned retrieval temperature $β$, and runs in 1.1 ms. Across six
  fresh ALOHA encoders, it reaches 76.4% within 24 s, comparable to a 264M Diffusion Policy
  trained for 6.7 h (78.8%) and ahead of ACT (71.7%) and fine-tuned VLAs (65.2-75.2%), while
  leading every 40-demonstration baseline within the benchmark's 8 s limit (74.6%; +6.5 over
  Diffusion Policy, +15.1 over ACT). On LIBERO, one 40-task memory reaches 92.2% and loses far
  less than SmolVLA to rewording; on a real SO-101 arm, it sustains 30 Hz control without
  stalling. Unlike pretrained foundation policies aimed at zero-shot generalization to unseen
  tasks and workspaces, HAVM trades broad out-of-distribution generalization for rapid adaptation
  to the available demonstrations.

</details>


### [432] [Ask to Land: Learning a Mask-Conditioned Open-Vocabulary Landing Policy via Differentiable Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34020)
*Fangyu Sun,Guanyan Wu,Yang Deng,Jiahao Cui,Fanxing Li,Yuxiang Huang,Wenxian Yu,Danping Zou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出“Ask to Land”框架，使四旋翼无人机能够根据自然语言描述选择并降落在用户指定的静态或随机移动平台上，无需针对特定目标微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机着陆系统通常依赖预设视觉标记、特定平台类别或结构化目标运动假设；开放词汇感知虽支持文本提示选择目标，但与学习型闭环着陆控制的结合仍不充分。

Method: 采用冻结的开放词汇感知前端（YOLO-World与MobileSAM）实时生成任务无关的语义分割掩码，并将掩码作为控制策略输入；策略通过可微分物理和BPTT训练，奖励设计兼顾与着陆目标的视觉对齐、高度自适应下降速度和稳定控制。

Result: 真实环境部署验证表明，该方法可在多种用户指定目标上完成着陆，包括静态平台和移动平台，并能在下降过程中持续跟踪动态目标运动。

Conclusion: 将开放词汇感知前端与可微分物理学习的闭环控制策略结合，可实现无需目标特定微调的自然语言指定平台着陆，并支持随机移动平台。

Abstract: Existing drone landing systems, whether model-based or learning-based, typically rely on predefined visual markers (e.g., ArUco tags) or are trained for specific platform categories, and often assume structured target motion. Recent open-vocabulary studies enable text-prompted target selection, but integrating this capability with learned closed-loop landing control remains underexplored. To this end, we present \textit{Ask to Land}, a mask-conditioned framework that enables a quadrotor to land on various platforms described by a user in natural language, including randomly moving platforms. The core of our approach is the integration of a frozen state-of-the-art open-vocabulary perception frontend (YOLO-World with MobileSAM) and a control policy learned by differentiable physics. By providing real-time, task-agnostic semantic segmentation masks as policy inputs, our framework enables the drone to land on prompt-selected targets without target-specific fine-tuning while continuously tracking dynamic target motion during descent. The frozen frontend processes the prompt, while the policy receives the mask without text embeddings or category labels. To efficiently optimize the control policy, we leverage differentiable physics learning via Backpropagation-Through-Time (BPTT), and employ a carefully designed reward that enforces visual alignment with the landing target and altitude-adaptive descent speed, together with stable control. Real-world deployments validate that our approach achieves landings on diverse user-specified objects, including static and moving platforms.

</details>


### [433] [WISER-RL: A Wake-Sleep Learning Mechanism for Robot Reinforcement Learning from One Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34043)
*Kwunhang Wong,Yang Bai,Qingyang Bao,Liudi Yang,Chenzhi Liu,Jiehong Lin,Wei Huang,Lin Li,Ziyuan Liu,Yujie Yang,Gitta Kutyniok,Zhongrui Wang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 WISER-RL 复合强化学习框架，通过“唤醒-睡眠”循环将辅助实践转化为自主控制，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上取得 100% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人仅从一次人类演示学习时很难独立成功，导致强化学习缺乏足够的奖励反馈，因此需要一种能利用辅助实践和少量经验提升自主策略的方法。

Method: WISER-RL 包含唤醒阶段与睡眠阶段：唤醒时 GPTDAgger 监测扩散策略采样动作间的不一致，超过阈值则由冻结 GPT 控制器利用检索经验继续执行；睡眠时 CAER 对比视觉匹配的成功轨迹，对冲突动作窗口降权；策略模仿重加权成功轨迹，并通过离线优势引导强化学习同时利用成功与失败经验，最后用在线 PPO 微调。

Result: 最终自主策略在六个 LIBERO 任务上均达到 100% 评估成功率，在两个真实机器人任务上均达到 100% 试验成功率。

Conclusion: WISER-RL 能有效把受辅助的实践转化为自主控制，显著提升从少量演示起步的机器人策略学习表现。

Abstract: A robot learning from one human demonstration may rarely succeed on its own, leaving reinforcement learning (RL) with little reward feedback. We introduce WISER-RL ({W}ake--sleep policy improvement loop, {I}mitation, and {S}elective {E}xperience {R}eplay), a composite reinforcement learning framework that turns assisted practice into autonomous control. During wake, GPTDAgger monitors disagreement among actions sampled by a diffusion policy. When disagreement crosses a threshold, a frozen GPT controller uses retrieved experience to continue the episode. During sleep, Conflict-Aware Experience Reweighting (CAER) compares visually matched successful trajectories and downweights conflicting action windows with more steps remaining to success. The policy imitates the reweighted successes and learns from both successes and failures through offline advantage-guided RL before collecting the next round. After final online PPO refinement, the autonomous policy succeeded in 100% evaluations on each of six LIBERO tasks and 100% trials on each of two real-robot tasks.

</details>


### [434] [End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34046)
*Simone Nascivera,Ismail Geles,Davide Scaramuzza*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向敏捷四旋翼的3D图像目标导航策略，直接输出推力与角速率，无需状态估计或独立速度控制器，在仿真和真实室内环境中均取得较高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D图像目标导航不仅要识别目标，还要估计3D位移并生成连续控制动作；仅靠单目图像难以获得尺度与机体运动信息，且相同视觉差异在不同速度下需要不同动作。现有图像目标策略多局限于平面动作空间并依赖状态估计，而直接图像到低层控制的策略尚未用于未知环境中的目标图像导航。

Method: 训练循环视觉策略，采用四阶段流程：几何与运动监督、特权教师蒸馏、端到端强化学习微调；策略直接输出推力和角速率，不依赖SLAM、VO、SfM等状态估计或单独速度控制器。

Result: 在1000次未见环境留出飞行中成功率达82.3%，成功飞行的平均终端位置误差为0.10米；零样本部署到真实四旋翼后，在未见室内环境中25次试验成功率达84%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，无需状态估计即可实现未知3D环境中的图像目标导航，并具备良好的仿真到现实泛化能力。

Abstract: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view.
