This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.

</details>


### [435] [xFORM: Accelerating Fixed-Lag LiDAR Odometry with Exact Factor Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34053)
*Ruogu Li,Easton R. Potokar,Michael Kaess*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出xFORM，一种加速LiDAR里程计FORM三阶段（特征提取、对应搜索、残差优化）的方法，通过因子压缩将数十万匹配降至每扫描对34个标量残差，并提供CPU和GPU两个变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR里程计处理大点云时计算开销大，尤其联合优化窗口位姿时，特征提取、对应搜索和残差评估/线性化带来显著延迟，影响控制与路径规划等下游任务。

Method: 采用因子压缩在精确算术下保持原目标和高斯-牛顿系统不变，将大规模匹配压缩为少量标量残差；集成到xFORM-CPU（CPU并行特征提取）和xFORM-GPU（GPU加速特征处理、对应搜索和因子压缩）。

Result: 在三个数据集共15条完整序列上，xFORM-CPU和xFORM-GPU相对FORM分别实现1.1-1.4倍和2.0-4.0倍整体加速，且与原始实现无显著数值差异。

Conclusion: xFORM能有效降低LiDAR里程计各阶段延迟，实现实时性提升，同时保持数值精度，适合对实时性要求高的下游任务。

Abstract: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are increasingly popular for state estimation because of their precision, long range, and high measurement rate. Unfortunately, LiDAR Odometry (LO) systems incur substantial computational cost when processing large point clouds, particularly those that jointly refine a window of scan poses. While our prior LO work FORM is real-time, the costs of feature extraction, correspondence search, and the evaluation and linearization of residuals during pose optimization can introduce significant latency. This latency makes downstream tasks such as control and path planning difficult. To overcome this, we present xFORM, which accelerates the three stages of FORM. xFORM uses factor compression to reduce an optimization problem involving hundreds of thousands of feature matches to 34 scalar residuals per scan pair, while preserving the original objective and Gauss-Newton system in exact arithmetic. We integrate this optimizer into two variants: xFORM-CPU, which additionally parallelizes feature extraction on the CPU, and xFORM-GPU, which accelerates feature processing, correspondence search, and factor compression on the GPU. Across fifteen complete sequences from three datasets, xFORM-CPU and xFORM-GPU achieve overall speedups of 1.1-1.4$\times$ and 2.0-4.0$\times$ over FORM, respectively, with no numerically significant differences to the original implementation.

</details>


### [436] [CoTacWAM: Joint Modeling of Vision and Touch for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34117)
*Lei Jin,Yiding Ma,Zhuohang Li,Jiachen Liu,Zibo Zhu,Kairui Liu,Chen Gao,Wei Wu,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoTacWAM世界-动作模型，通过学习手腕视觉与触觉之间共享的接触语义，提升真实机器人操作性能，并增强对缺失输入的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手腕图像提供附近几何信息，触觉记录物理接触，两种模态从不同信号观察同一局部交互，因此需要连接其共同接触含义，同时保留各自独有证据。

Method: 构建联合表示以连接视觉与触觉的共同接触语义并保留模态特有信息，结合头视角场景上下文进行预测性动作学习；在独立检测器确认失败尝试后，利用该表示条件化修正动作。

Result: 在四项真实世界任务中，CoTacWAM优于所评估基线，在名义操作和缺失输入评估中取得最佳观测性能，并对局部观测缺失表现鲁棒，自主重试还能带来进一步增益。

Conclusion: 共享接触语义的多模态世界-动作建模能有效提升机器人操作性能、缺失输入鲁棒性和失败后重试收益。

Abstract: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

</details>


### [437] [WAtcher: Watching Ahead for Safe Robotic Manipulation with Efficient World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34124)
*Ziyu Shan,Xiao Ma,Kangrui Yu,Changjie Wang,Gaoyuan Wu,Zaijia Yang,Chuanrui Zhang,Qirui Li,Yanbo Zhang,Duomin Wang,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 WAtcher，一种安全感知的世界-动作框架：在执行候选动作块前先想象其未来结果，并用 Safe-Guard 评估风险，高风险时触发有限退避。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAMs）会直接执行每个动作块，忽略潜在风险，缺乏执行前的安全评估机制。

Method: WAtcher 基于紧凑 WAM，用视频专家仅两步去噪快速想象候选动作块的视觉结果；提出轻量、可拆卸的 Safe-Guard 模块，在 WAM 外根据想象结果打分并在高风险时触发有界退避。通过自动管道扰动 RoboTwin、LIBERO 和真实机器人专家演示，并根据接触、失去支撑等物理事件标注候选动作块，构建约 25,000 个训练窗口。

Result: Safe-Guard 在盲测集达到 92.1% 平衡准确率，将训练任务闭环危险试验从 27.0% 降至 10.8% 且不降低成功率；在 300 题留出基准上得分 94.2%，高于零样本 GPT-6-Astra 的 72.5% 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的 63.3%。WAtcher 在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 ManiSkill3 上平均成功率分别为 90.4% 和 82.4%，在五个真实任务上开启 Safe-Guard 后达 74.0%，高于 π0.5 的 59.5%。

Conclusion: 执行前预览候选动作结果并进行风险评估能有效提升机器人操作安全性，同时保持或提升任务成功率；Safe-Guard 具有可拆卸性，可推广到其他 WAMs。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future imagination with action generation, but they execute every action chunk while ignoring the potential risk. To fill this gap, we present WAtcher, a safety-aware world-action framework in which the policy imagines the outcome of the candidate chunk before execution. For fast future preview, WAtcher builds on a compact WAM whose video expert imagines the visual outcome in only two denoising steps. In addition, we propose Safe-Guard, a lightweight module kept outside the WAM that scores each candidate chunk from its imagined outcome and triggers a bounded retreat when the risk is high. Safe-Guard is detachable and can be applied to other WAMs. To train Safe-Guard, we build an autonomous pipeline to collect hazard data from RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real robot. Specifically, the pipeline perturbs expert demonstrations and labels each candidate chunk from the physical events recorded when it is executed, such as contacts and losses of support. Using the ~25,000 labeled windows from this pipeline, Safe-Guard reaches 92.1% balanced accuracy on a blind set, and cuts hazardous closed-loop trials on training tasks from 27.0% to 10.8% without lowering task success. On a held-out 300-question benchmark, it scores 94.2%, against 72.5% and 63.3% for zero-shot GPT-6-Astra and Claude Opus 5.5. WAtcher also reaches 90.4% and 82.4% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ManiSkill3, on par with or above leading WAMs, and 74.0% on five real-world tasks with Safe-Guard on, against 59.5% for $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://zyshan0929.github.io/WAtcher

</details>


### [438] [WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34130)
*Ziyuan Chu,Mingzhi Zheng,Kaiyue Zhang,Jinan Zhang,Linchao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出面向机器人世界模型的细粒度物理合理性评测基准 WorldPhy，包含300个任务和超1.2万条人工标注，并训练 WorldPhyReward 从六个物理维度和指令遵循维度评分，系统评测13个前沿世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型对生成视频中的机器人运动、物体交互等物理约束要求更高，但现有基准容易忽略机器人特定物理细节，且难以准确评估这些细节。

Method: 构建 WorldPhy 基准：300个任务，每个包含初始帧图像和任务指令，覆盖多样机器人场景、任务类别、视角和机器人构型；收集超过12K高质量人工标注，训练 WorldPhyReward，对六个细粒度物理维度和一个指令遵循维度给出分数与原因；并系统评测13个前沿开源和闭源世界模型。

Result: WorldPhyReward 与人类评分的一致性优于通用视觉语言模型和现有奖励模型；对13个前沿世界模型的评测显示，当前模型难以在不同机器人场景中持续保持细粒度物理合理性。

Conclusion: 现有机器人世界模型在细粒度物理合理性方面仍有明显不足，WorldPhy 提供了更准确、面向机器人物理约束的评测手段，有助于推动更符合物理规律的世界模型研究。

Abstract: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dimensions and an instruction-following dimension. Comparisons with general VLMs and existing reward models show that WorldPhyReward better aligns with human ratings. We system- atically evaluate 13 frontier open and closed-source world models. The results reveal that current world models struggle to consistently maintain fine-grained physical plausibility across different robotics scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/chuziyuan139/ WorldPhy.

</details>


### [439] [Ground Your Steps: Optimizing Sampling Schedules in Flow Matching Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34148)
*Licheng Yang,Yonghao He,Lingfeng Qian,Xin Shi,Wei Sui,Hu Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出无需训练的 Ground Your Steps（GYS），通过优化流匹配机器人策略的采样调度，使有限 NFE 下生成的动作块分布更接近示教分布，从而提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配策略在推理时通过积分学习到的速度场生成动作块，但在固定神经函数评估次数（NFE）预算下，积分结果依赖采样调度；因此优化调度有望让生成动作分布更接近示教并提高任务成功。

Method: GYS 在每个观测下匹配生成动作块与示教动作块的分布来优化采样调度。它对每个机械臂关节的动作序列做截断分数阶差分，并比较两类成对差值分布：生成块与示教块的差值，以及两个独立生成块之间的差值；分数阶差分后，当生成分布与示教分布一致时两类分布重合。GYS 通过最小化二者间的能量距离，为每个任务和 NFE 预算获得改进的采样调度，且无需额外训练。

Result: 相比均匀网格调度，GYS 仅通过采样调度就使生成动作块分布更接近示教分布并提升成功率。在 RoboTwin 2.0 基准上，GYS 在几乎所有预算下均有提升，对 π0.5 和 GR00T N1.7 均提升 2.8 个百分点；增益也可迁移到三个真实世界操作任务，最高提升 3.3 个百分点。

Conclusion: 采样调度是固定 NFE 下提升流匹配机器人策略性能的有效因素；GYS 作为一种训练-free 的调度优化方法，可改善生成动作分布匹配度并提高任务成功率，且在仿真与真实任务中均有效。

Abstract: Flow matching robot policies generate action chunks by integrating a learned velocity field at inference. However, under a fixed budget of neural function evaluations (NFEs), the integration result depends on the sampling schedule. This motivates optimizing the schedule to bring the generated action distribution closer to the demonstrations and improve task success. We propose Ground Your Steps (GYS), a training-free method that optimizes the sampling schedule by matching the generated and demonstrated chunk distributions at each observation. GYS applies truncated fractional differencing along each arm joint's action sequence and compares two types of pairwise differences between action chunks at each observation: differences of a generated chunk against a demonstration, and differences of two independent generated chunks against each other. After fractional differencing, these two pairwise-difference distributions coincide exactly when the distributions of generated and demonstrated action chunks match. GYS minimizes the energy distance between these distributions to obtain an improved schedule for each task and NFE budget. Compared with the uniform grid, GYS brings the generated chunk distribution closer to the demonstrated distribution and raises the success rate through the sampling schedule alone. On RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks, GYS improves success rates at nearly every budget, with gains of 2.8 percentage points for both $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7. The gains also transfer to three real-world manipulation tasks, reaching up to 3.3 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/GroundYourSteps.

</details>


### [440] [Autonomous Vineyard Exploration using LiDAR Sensing: A Field Evaluation on Legged-Wheeled Quadruped Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34246)
*Spencer Sweeney,Hongbo Li,Michael Ziegltrum,Dimitra Koumoutsou,Andromachi Maria Delfaki,Taskin Padir,Dimitrios Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文评估了在Unitree Go2轮式四足机器人上部署的基于LiDAR的葡萄园自主探索系统，利用RANSAC直线检测识别葡萄行并采用有限状态导航策略完成行间自主跟随。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 葡萄园自主导航面临地形不平、植被稀疏以及葡萄行几何重复等挑战，需要验证LiDAR感知与导航策略在实际商业葡萄园中的可行性。

Method: 在Denbies葡萄园（英国）开展实地测试，采用迭代RANSAC直线检测流程识别葡萄行，并结合有限状态导航策略控制行选择与穿行。

Result: 系统实现了持续自主行跟随，在无人工干预下完成370米往返穿行；同时分析了稀疏植被下直线检测不稳定及空间滤波权衡等失效模式。

Conclusion: RANSAC可提供稳健的几何基元，但在商业葡萄园中实现可靠的行间转换仍需额外的时间滤波与自适应感知。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in vineyards presents significant challenges due to uneven terrain, sparse vegetation, and the repetitive geometric nature of vineyard rows. This paper evaluates a LiDAR-based autonomous exploration system deployed on a Unitree Go2 Wheeled quadruped robot. Our approach utilizes an iterative RANSAC-based line detection pipeline to identify vineyard rows and a finite-state navigation strategy to govern row selection and traversal. Field evaluations conducted at Denbies Vineyard (UK) demonstrate the system's ability to perform sustained autonomous row following, completing a 370m up-and-down traversal without intervention. We analyze the failure modes encountered, specifically focusing on line detection instability in sparse vegetation and the trade-offs of spatial filtering. The results suggest that, while RANSAC provides a robust geometric primitive, additional temporal filtering and adaptive perception are required for reliable lane-to-lane transitions in commercial vineyard environments. A video of the experimental results is available at: youtu.be/1om1HFGF4ps

</details>


### [441] [CamAct: Learning Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos via Camera Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34257)
*Haoming Gu,Yunpeng Qing,Zhi Hou,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出CamAct，利用无物体操作演示的野外视频中恢复的相机运动作为额外监督信号，与机器人演示一起微调VLA策略，从而提升机器人操作性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型需要大规模多样化数据，但机器人演示采集成本高。现有工作主要利用人类-物体交互的自中心视频，作者希望探索即使不包含物体操作演示的野外视频是否也能用于改进机器人操作学习。

Method: 从野外视频中恢复相机运动，并将其作为运动监督引入VLA策略的微调过程，与机器人演示共同训练，形成CamAct方法。

Result: 在LIBERO上成功率从96.40%提升到98.10%，在RoboCasa 365上从22.96%提升到29.32%；在LIBERO-Plus的分布外泛化和真实世界操作任务中也表现良好。

Conclusion: 野外视频中的相机运动可作为补充监督信号，即使视频不含物体操作演示也能提升机器人操作策略，扩展了人类视频在操作学习中的使用范围。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large, diverse datasets for robotic manipulation, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains costly. Recent work has explored egocentric videos as a source of supervision, primarily drawing on demonstrations of human-object interaction. We show that in-the-wild videos can improve robotic manipulation even when they contain no demonstrations of object manipulation. Specifically, camera motion recovered from these videos provides an additional source of motion supervision that complements robot demonstrations. Building on this finding, we introduce CamAct, which incorporates this camera-motion supervision into VLA policies alongside robot demonstrations, extending the use of human videos for manipulation learning beyond object interactions. Experiments show that incorporating this video supervision during fine-tuning improves success rates from 96.40% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 22.96% to 29.32% on RoboCasa 365. The resulting policy also demonstrates strong results in out-of-distribution generalization on LIBERO-Plus and real-world manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [442] [Escapingthe instruction blackhole of vision-language-action policies via optimal-transport wormholes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34280)
*Xuetao Li,Chen Liu,Jing Wu,Sheng Liu,Miao Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行中接收新指令失败的问题，提出免训练插件 Wormhole，通过将机器人迁移到新任务合适状态而非重复下指令，实现任务切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 策略通常按固定指令训练，但人类会在机器人执行过程中改变意图。一旦策略已投入旧任务，新指令会被“吸收”，机器人继续旧任务或冻结，作者称之为“指令黑洞”。静态模仿学习无法区分策略是否真的会听取新指令。

Method: 作者用传输比和事件视界量化该问题，并证明其是静态模仿的盲点。提出 Wormhole：一种免训练即插即用方法，利用最优传输选择新任务接近阶段的状态，通过限速遍历将机器人带到该状态，再由未修改的原策略接管执行。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上，Wormhole 将 π0 和 π0.5 的已承诺切换成功率从最高 1.2% 提升到 93.1%，达到或超过脚本化“撤退并重启”方法，同时动作不连续性仅为其五分之一。

Conclusion: VLA 策略在任务执行中切换指令存在系统性盲点，简单重新下指令无效；通过状态迁移而非重新指令，可在不训练模型的情况下显著提升任务切换成功率并降低动作突变。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained to follow a fixed instruction, yet people change their minds while the robot acts. We identify the instruction black hole: once a VLA policy commits to a task, new instructions are absorbed and the robot completes the old task or freezes. We quantify it with a transmission ratio and an event horizon and prove it is a blind spot of static imitation, which cannot distinguish a policy that listens from a deaf one once the execution state reveals the task. We propose Wormhole, a training-free plug-in that relocates the robot instead of re-instructing it: optimal transport selects an approach-phase state of the new task, a rate-limited traversal carries the robot there, and the unmodified policy takes over. On LIBERO,Wormhole raises committed-switch success of pi to and pi0.5 from at most 1.2% to 93.1%, matching or exceeding scripted retreat-and-restart with one fifth of its action discontinuity.

</details>


### [443] [DataForgeVLA: Fully Synthetic Manipulation Demonstrations for Vision-Language-Action Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34287)
*Sergei Kurchev,Iaroslav Kolomiets,Filipp Maksimov,Elizaveta Semenyakina,Miguel Altamirano Cabrera,Artem Lykov,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文构建了一个由真实种子数据生成的340条全合成操作演示数据集，用于VLA训练，并用初步实验验证合成数据微调策略的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 减少VLA训练对真实遥操作数据的依赖，探索利用合成演示数据降低数据采集成本的可行性。

Method: 从真实种子数据生成340条合成演示，共32,340帧，覆盖8类物体，采用LeRobot v2.1格式；使用LoRA微调的Cosmos-3生成操作视频，再由RoboHaMeR从RGB恢复机器人轨迹；经质量筛选保留300条用于策略微调。

Result: 仅用300条合成数据微调的GR00T N1.6策略在Oreo包装拾放任务上达到16/20（80%）真实世界成功率；用105条真实遥操作数据微调的策略为18/20（90%）。结果基于单一物体和每策略20次试验。

Conclusion: 合成演示数据用于VLA策略微调具有初步可行性，但当前结果仅为初步证据，尚不能作为普遍性能结论。

Abstract: We present a dataset of 340 fully synthetic manipulation demonstrations generated from real seed data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training. The corpus contains 32,340 frames with synchronized RGB and actions across eight object categories, represented as LeRobot v2.1 episodes with H.264 video, per-frame robot states and pose-valued action labels, language task annotations, summary statistics and quality decisions. Each synthetic demonstration is produced without additional teleoperation: a LoRA-fine-tuned Cosmos-3 model generates a manipulation video, and RoboHaMeR recovers the corresponding robot trajectory from RGB. Quality screening accepted 300 of 340 episodes for policy fine-tuning. As preliminary evidence of feasibility, a pretrained GR00T N1.6 policy fine-tuned exclusively on the 300 accepted episodes reaches 16/20 (80%) real-world pick-and-place success on the Oreo-package task. A policy fine-tuned on 105 real teleoperated episodes achieved 18/20 (90%) under the same protocol. These results are based on one object and 20 trials per policy and are therefore reported as preliminary evidence rather than a general performance claim.

</details>


### [444] [Rehearse in 3D, Render in 2D: Physically Consistent and Editable Robot World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34288)
*Guangyu Liu,Hanzhang Wang,Huijia Zhang,Hanbei Zhan,Linjie Hu,Bin Xiao,Xuan Zhou,Dong Zhang,Hanwei Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可编辑机器人世界模型 RehearsalWorld，基于 3D 交互排练（3DIR）预测既视觉真实又物理一致的未来交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身世界模型虽追求视觉真实与物理一致，但仅显式预测 3D 运动不能保证物体结构和接触关系被保留；3D 表示可提供显式状态空间以施加结构和物理约束。

Method: Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal（ICR）以预训练 3D 点流模型为运动先验，通过响应感知物体分组、持久抓取记忆和接触结构细化器优化轨迹；Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation（RAVG）将排练结果的几何投影作为时间条件，微调视频生成器合成交互视频；物理响应与视觉合成解耦，支持材质属性和相机视角独立编辑。

Result: 在真实 DROID 抓取序列上，相比 PointWorld，对可变形、铰接和刚性物体将夹爪相对偏移降低约 79% 至 84%，并降低参考运动误差；视频预测达到 PSNR 23.92 dB 和 FVD 149。

Conclusion: 将 3D 交互排练与视频生成解耦，可提升物体结构、接触关系和抓取附着的一致性，并增强世界模型的可编辑性。

Abstract: Embodied world models aim to predict future interactions that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. Yet explicit 3D motion prediction alone does not guarantee that object structure and contact relationships are preserved. Beyond motion prediction, 3D representations provide an explicit state space for imposing structural and physical constraints. Building on this insight, we introduce RehearsalWorld, an editable robot world model driven by 3D Interaction Rehearsal (3DIR). Given an initial RGB-D observation and robot actions, Interaction-Consistent Rehearsal (ICR) uses a pretrained 3D point-flow model as a motion prior. It refines the predicted trajectories through response-aware object grouping, persistent grasp memory, and contact structure refiner, preserving scene stability, object structure, and grasp attachments. Rehearsal-Aligned Video Generation (RAVG) then uses geometric projections of the rehearsal as temporal conditioning. We fine-tune a video generator on projection-video pairs to synthesize realistic interaction videos. Thanks to the decoupling of physical response from visual synthesis, RehearsalWorld also supports independent editing of material properties and camera viewpoints. Compared with PointWorld on real DROID grasping sequences, RehearsalWorld reduces gripper-relative offset by approximately 79% to 84% across deformable, articulated, and rigid objects and lowers reference motion error. For video prediction, it achieves a PSNR of 23.92 dB and an FVD of 149.

</details>


### [445] [BOT-Scale: A Traceable Evaluation Methodology for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34297)
*Yunfei Xue,Kemi Chen,Weiling Chen,Wei Gao,Tiesong Zhao,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种可追溯、可解释的机器人操作评分方法 BOT-Scale，并实现自动评分系统 BOTScorer，同时发布带八位评分者质量分数和因子事件标注的数据集 BOT-Events。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有操作评估器通常将任务中的物体掉落或放置偏差压缩为单一分数，或单独附加解释；分数本身既不说明依据，也不能指出需要修复的问题。

Method: 将操作分数定义为对保留的行为因子记录按结果条件惩罚求和，使解释与评分共享同一计算过程。BOT-Scale 借鉴医学行为评估量表，将十二个候选因子组织为四个评估层，每个因子绑定可观察证据和明确判定标准；通过参考校准固定每个因子的惩罚，并用闭式规则聚合为带各因子贡献的分数。基于数据驱动筛选保留七个因子，开发自动评分系统 BOTScorer 进行验证。

Result: 提出可追溯且可解释的评分框架，并构建 BOTScorer 自动评分系统；发布 BOT-Events 数据集，包含八位评分者的质量分数和因子事件标注，以及可追溯、可解释的分数。代码将公开。

Conclusion: 当操作分数被定义为行为因子级惩罚的聚合时，评分与解释合一，每个因子级扣分都对应一个可检查的偏差，从而提升操作评估的可追溯性和可解释性。

Abstract: A successful manipulation rollout can still involve a mid-task object drop or a placement deviation. Existing evaluators reduce such deviations to a single score or attach explanations computed separately; the score itself explains neither its basis nor what to fix. We show that a manipulation score becomes traceable when defined as the sum of outcome-conditioned penalties over retained behavioral-factor records. Explanation and score share the same computation, so each factor-level deduction names an inspectable deviation. BOT-Scale applies this principle by adapting behavioral assessment scales from medicine. It organizes twelve candidate factors into four assessment layers; each factor is tied to observable evidence and an explicit decision criterion. Reference calibration fixes a penalty per factor, and a closed-form rule aggregates the factor records into a score with per-factor contributions. We developed BOTScorer, an automatic scoring system based on the seven factors retained by data-driven screening, to validate this methodology. We provide BOT-Events, a dataset with eight-rater quality scores and factor-event annotations, alongside the traceable, interpretable score. The code will be released publicly.

</details>


### [446] [Co-World Model for Human-Video-to-Robot Transfer via Co-Constructed Shared Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34302)
*Xuetao Li,Xuan Jiang,Chen Liu,Zhongrui Rao,Yu Ling,Hui Wang,Sheng Liu,Miao Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-World Model（CoWM），一种联合优化未同步人类视频与机器人轨迹的预测框架，用于从单个人类演示实现零样本机器人技能迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视频丰富廉价，机器人轨迹稀缺昂贵；现有方法依赖人体几何重定向或仅匹配静态视觉目标，难以处理跨具身动力学不匹配与动作执行缺乏 grounding 的问题。

Method: CoWM 将观测解耦为共享物体关系状态与具身特定上下文；通过 effect-swap 与 action-sensitivity 目标对齐跨具身潜在动作，使动作按对物体产生的预测效果匹配而非按运动学匹配；并采用相位感知滚动时域控制器估计演示进度，将推断的人类动作先验投影到机器人动作支持密度上，再转化为可执行机器人指令。

Result: 在仿真和两个真实机器人平台上的实验表明 CoWM 有效，具备跨平台泛化能力，并验证了各组件贡献。

Conclusion: CoWM 通过对象效果对齐与 grounded 执行控制，为从单个人类演示进行跨具身零样本技能迁移提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Human videos are abundant and cheap to obtain, whereas robot trajectories remain scarce and costly, making zero-shot skill transfer from a single human demonstration an appealing route to scalable robot learning. Existing methods, however, either retarget human-specific geometry or match only static visual goals, and thus stumble over the cross-embodiment dynamics mismatch and the ungrounded action execution. We present the Co-World Model (CoWM), a predictive framework jointly optimized from paired yet unsynchronized human and robot streams. To bridge the cross-embodiment dynamics gap, CoWM disentangles each observation into a shared object-relation state and embodiment-specific context. It aligns latent actions across embodiments using effect-swap and action-sensitivity objectives,such that actions are matched by their predicted effects on the manipulated objects rather than by embodimentdependent kinematics. For grounded execution, a phase-aware receding-horizon controller estimates demonstration progress, projects the inferred human action prior onto the robot action-support density, and translates the resulting latent dynamics into executable robot commands. Extensive experiments in simulation and on two physical robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CoWM, its cross-platform generalizability, and the contribution of each component. See the demo video in the supporting information for details.

</details>


### [447] [LUDIUS: A Benchmark for Embodied Social Intelligence in Everyday Human-Robot Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34328)
*Chaewon Kim,Sangheon Lee,Seyeon Choi,Kangwook Lee,Yea Seul Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出LUDIUS基准，用于评估视觉语言模型如何通过机器人的语言回应和行动展现社会智能，覆盖15项社会智能技能和6个模拟家庭周场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人社会智能需要从相关人物视角理解情境，并判断何时以及如何行动；现有视觉语言模型是否具备这种判断能力需要系统评估。

Method: 构建LUDIUS基准，整合社会心理学、社会学和认知科学的15项技能；包含6个版本，每个版本为模拟一周的交互片段。三个版本在不同家庭覆盖全部技能，另三个分别聚焦多人互动、安全和情境规范。使用统一评估框架，向模型提供机器人摄像头视图、居民反应和交互历史，并将模型工具调用转换为机器人语言回应和行动；评估前沿模型及基于生成社会交互数据微调的小模型。

Result: 模型在需要推理居民此前看到或听到什么、协调相互竞争的利益、或在安全约束和家庭规则内完成请求时表现较差。

Conclusion: LUDIUS不仅评估家庭场景中的社会智能，其设计流程还可将社会智能技能转化为情境特定判断和可观察机器人行为，用于构建其他场景的社会智能基准。

Abstract: Social intelligence in a robot requires interpreting a situation from the perspectives of the people involved and using that understanding to decide when and how to act. We introduce LUDIUS, a benchmark for evaluating how vision-language models exercise this judgment through a robot's verbal responses and actions, organized around 15 social intelligence skills drawn from social psychology, sociology, and cognitive science. LUDIUS comprises six editions, each a collection of episodes spanning one simulated week. Three editions each cover all 15 skills in a different household. The other three focus on interactions involving multiple people, safety, and context-specific norms, respectively. We evaluate frontier models and a smaller model finetuned on social-interaction data we generated, using a common evaluation harness. The harness supplies each model with the robot's camera views and residents' reactions, retrieves relevant interaction history, and converts the model's tool calls into robot verbal responses and actions. Models tend to perform worse when they must reason about what a resident saw or heard earlier, reconcile competing interests, or fulfill a request within safety constraints and household rules. Beyond the home setting, LUDIUS's design pipeline offers a way to construct social intelligence benchmarks by translating social intelligence skills into context-specific judgments and observable robot behavior.

</details>


### [448] [Beyond Natural-Language Instructions: Temporal Logic as a Task Language for VLA Models with Visual-Logical Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34352)
*Zezhi Liu,Jingwen Sun,Hongjin Chen,Shaojie Ren,Peiyan Tu,Xin Jin,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 TL-VLA，用时序逻辑（TL）替代自然语言任务指令，构建视觉-语言-动作框架，并通过 TL 感知预训练提升机器人长时程任务规划与执行性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人任务同时包含物体关系、逻辑依赖和时间约束，而现有视觉-语言-动作方法多用自然语言指令，难以显式表达这些时空与逻辑结构。

Method: 提出 TL-VLA 框架：用 TL 作为任务规范，采用类型图编码器与视觉-逻辑融合来条件化连续动作；构建 TL 感知机器人预训练，包含冻结语言教师对齐任务语义、结构读出编码 TL 语法，以及自回归动作预测连接图表示与机器人行为；下游策略继承预训练主干和 TL 编码器，并学习新的融合与动作模块。

Result: 在 CALVIN ABC→D 上平均链长 3.800、五任务成功率 62.3%，优于 FAST 初始化的 3.578/54.5% 和 Qwen+NL 的 3.485；LIBERO-10 成功率从 91.2% 提升到 95.8%；LIBERO-Mem 无观测历史下达到 65.0%，高于 Qwen+NL 的 45.0%；在留出 Panda 规划规范上 Success@256 为 59.6%，高于 Qwen+TL 的 48.4% 和 Qwen+NL 的 37.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明显式逻辑任务条件化和可迁移的 TL 感知表示能够有效提升机器人动作学习、长时程任务执行与规划泛化能力。

Abstract: Robotic tasks combine object relations, logical dependencies, and temporal requirements, which robot planning and industrial control commonly specify in temporal logic (TL). We introduce TL-VLA, a vision--language--action framework that replaces natural-language task instructions with temporal logic, making this spatiotemporal structure explicit. A typed graph encoder and visual--logical fusion condition continuous actions on the task specification and the current observations. To prepare a general vision--language backbone for this interface, we develop TL-aware robot pretraining with separate semantic and structural readouts: a frozen language teacher aligns task semantics, the structural readout encodes TL syntax to support complex, long-horizon tasks, and autoregressive action prediction connects the graph representation to robot behavior. Downstream policies inherit the pretrained backbone and TL encoder and learn new fusion and action modules. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, our TL-aware initializer reaches \textbf{3.800} average chain length and \textbf{62.3\%} five-task success, compared with 3.578 and 54.5\% for a FAST initializer pretrained on the same data and 3.485 average chain length for a Qwen+NL baseline. On LIBERO-10, TL-aware initialization improves success from \textbf{91.2\% to 95.8\%}. On LIBERO-Mem, our policy reaches \textbf{65.0\%} success without observation history, compared with 45.0\% for a Qwen+NL reference. On held-out Panda planning specifications, it reaches \textbf{59.6\%} at Success@256 over three generation seeds, versus 48.4\% for Qwen+TL and 37.0\% for Qwen+NL. These results support explicit logical task conditioning and transferable TL-aware representations for robot action learning.

</details>


### [449] [Embodied Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance: Survey, Challenges, and Perspectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34408)
*Xiao-Yin Liu,Guotao Li,Robert Riener,Zeng-Guang Hou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该综述界定了具身下肢外骨骼，并从结构自适应、任务适应、用户特定适应和控制自调节四个维度系统梳理相关研究，分析关键挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有综述多围绕机械设计、控制策略或单一AI算法展开，缺乏对具身下肢外骨骼及其使能技术的系统覆盖。

Method: 综述定义具身下肢外骨骼，按四个维度组织文献，分类讨论代表性研究，并分析轻量化柔顺设计、数据采集与融合、复杂策略优化、鲁棒柔顺控制等挑战。

Result: 从具身视角建立了机械结构、传感与控制之间的闭环关系框架，用于分析下肢外骨骼性能与人机交互，并识别当前研究局限和未来方向。

Conclusion: 未来研究应指向轻量化、舒适且实用的物理辅助，并沿四个维度推进具身下肢外骨骼技术发展。

Abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has enabled lower-limb exoskeletons to adapt to complex tasks and assist diverse users. Existing reviews, however, are organized around mechanical design, control strategies, or individual AI algorithms, and provide little systematic coverage of embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and their enabling technologies. This review defines embodied lower-limb exoskeletons and organizes the literature around four dimensions: structural self-adaptation, task adaptation, user-specific adaptation, and control self-regulation. In each dimension, state-of-the-art and representative studies are classified and discussed in terms of the associated challenges, including lightweight and compliant design, data acquisition and fusion, optimization of complex policies, and robust, compliant control. The review then identifies the principal limitations of current research and outlines future directions along these dimensions. From an embodied perspective, this review sets out the closed-loop relationship among mechanical structure, sensing, and control as a framework for analyzing lower-limb exoskeleton performance and for research on human-robot interaction. The directions it identifies point toward lightweight, comfortable, and practical physical assistance.

</details>


### [450] [CHASE: Curiosity-Guided Skill Acquisition for Embodied Task Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34416)
*Zixuan Wang,Wei Zhang,Chenlei Zhu,Naiyu Chen,Xihua Wang,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CHASE框架，让机器人在部分可观测且技能不完整的环境中，通过好奇心驱动选择能降低任务不确定性并扩展可执行能力的探索行为，从而在执行任务过程中形成假设、收集证据并获取缺失技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在部分观测环境中执行任务时，既要解决环境不确定性，又可能缺少必要技能；受人类好奇心启发，研究如何让机器人在任务执行中提出任务相关假设、主动寻找证据并即时学习缺失技能。

Method: CHASE将好奇心操作化为选择能够解决任务不确定性并扩展可执行能力的研究/探索行为，包含四个模块：动态场景理解、假设驱动规划、按需技能获取和验证执行。规划器权衡信息价值、技能复用以及获取与执行成本；缺失技能触发有界探索、从验证片段中学习，并在获取阶段进行留出准入；分别检查物理效果和已获取证据。新准入技能会扩展可执行探索集合，形成解决不确定性与获取能力之间的闭环。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人实验中评估了探索、技能获取和任务执行。CHASE在同时存在信息缺口和能力缺口时取得50%至80%的任务成功率，证据解决率达到70%至90%。

Conclusion: CHASE能够将好奇心驱动的证据寻求与按需技能获取结合，在信息与能力双重不足条件下有效支持机器人任务执行，并通过验证机制和技能准入扩展可执行能力。

Abstract: Robots executing tasks in partially observed environments must resolve uncertainty while operating with incomplete skills. Inspired by human curiosity, we investigate how robots can formulate task-relevant hypotheses, seek evidence, and acquire missing skills during task execution. We propose CHASE, a Curiosity-guided Harness for Acquiring Skills from Evidence, which operationalizes curiosity as selecting investigations that resolve task uncertainty and expand executable capabilities. Four modules connect dynamic scene understanding, hypothesis-driven planning, on-demand skill acquisition, and verified execution. The planner balances information value, skill reuse, and acquisition/execution cost. Missing skills trigger bounded exploration, learning from verified segments, and held-out admission during acquisition; separate checks verify physical effects and acquired evidence. Newly admitted skills expand the executable investigation set, closing the loop between resolving uncertainty and acquiring capabilities. Simulation and real-robot experiments evaluate investigation, skill acquisition, and task execution. CHASE achieves 50-80% task success under combined information and capability gaps, with 70-90% evidence resolution.

</details>


### [451] [Calibration of Neuromusculoskeletal Models Using Differentiable Physics: Recommendations for Improving Model Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34428)
*Philip Sanderink,Yingfan Zhou,Shuzhen Luo,Cheng Fang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文在同一可微分上肢模型上系统比较多种校准模块，以寻找提升神经肌肉骨骼模型精度的最优校准流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究分别评估了不同可微分NMS模型校准模块，但尚未在同一研究中直接比较，因此需要确定哪些模块及组合最有利于提高校准精度。

Method: 构建包含3自由度肩、2自由度肘、11块浅层肌和5块深层肌的可微分上肢模型，比较肌肉协同、可学习骨骼参数、包裹几何优化和约束力矩等模块；设置16种校准配置，在4名受试者的9种测试动作上，以前向与逆向动力学计算的两类关节力矩误差评估效果。

Result: 使用肌肉协同外推估计深层肌肉活动可使力矩损失平均降低23.6%；骨骼动态参数优化可使力矩损失平均降低10.9%。

Conclusion: 肌肉协同外推和骨骼动态参数优化均能显著提升可微分NMS模型校准精度，建议纳入校准流程，以形成更优的校准管线。

Abstract: Differentiable physics has shown potential to usher in a new paradigm in human neuromusculoskeletal (NMS) model calibration. Early results from pioneering works have demonstrated that auto-differentiable NMS models can greatly reduce NMS model calibration time while achieving comparable accuracy compared to traditional calibration methods. The efficient gradient-based optimizers have enabled calibration of increasingly sophisticated human models with a large number of parameters, which seek to narrow the gap between simulation and reality. Several modules have been evaluated separately in different studies, but have never been directly compared within the same study. In this work, these modules are compared on the same differentiable upper limb model with a 3-DoF shoulder, a 2-DoF elbow, and 11 superficial and 5 deep muscles in the calibration to find an optimal pipeline for improving model accuracy. The considered modules include muscle synergy, learnable bone parameters, optimizable geometry of wrap objects, and constraint torque of the differentiable arm model. To evaluate the effect and interplay between the modules on calibration accuracy, one or more modules were used in each of 16 calibration configurations, which were compared in terms of the error between two joint torques calculated by the forward and inverse dynamics with the calibrated model on 9 distinctive testing movements across 4 subjects. Results showed that torque loss was reduced by 23.6% on average using muscle synergy extrapolation to estimate deep muscle activities, and by 10.9% on average through bone dynamic parameter optimization, which are both recommended to be incorporated in the calibration.

</details>


### [452] [HoloBrain-0.5 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34449)
*Xuewu Lin,Jiahao Wang,Jiawei Li,Mengdi Li,Zhengmao Sun,Yiwei Jin,Hongyu Xie,Zhengyang Feng,Kun Wu,Zihao Chen,Lianzhou Zhang,Lichao Huang,Zhizhong Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HoloBrain-0.5 系列视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享动作空间和标准化机器人运动学描述，实现跨多种机器人本体的操作策略学习，并比较连续扩散策略与离散 FSQ 自回归策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨机器人本体的操作策略需要统一不同机器人的关节轴、坐标系、工具中心点和运动学结构，以便在共享动作空间中学习并迁移。

Method: 标准化 URDF 中的关节轴、坐标框架和工具中心点，并将运动学图编码为共享 3D 表示；HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous 使用扩散生成动作块，HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete 使用残差有限标量量化与延迟自回归；两者在超过 10000 小时真实机器人、仿真和人类操作数据上预训练，覆盖 15 类本体。

Result: 在六个闭环仿真设置中，离散策略收敛更快且平均成功率达 56.77%，高于连续策略的 49.71%；在七个真实机器人任务上无任务后训练达到 87.76% 平均进度分。后训练后，连续策略在七任务基准上以 94.52% 超过 π0.5 的 86.25%，在 11 任务双臂基准上以 79.07% 超过 69.41%。离散初始化连续策略可从 Piper 零样本迁移到 Piper-X，平均 63.28%；有目标机器人示范时，Franka Panda 达 89.2%，移动双臂平台达 92.94%。虽预训练未含 Unitree G1 数据，有限 G1 示范后训练在三项人形任务上平均进度分为 70.24%，而 π0.5 为 11.00%。

Conclusion: 共享动作空间与标准化运动学表示的 VLA 模型能有效支持跨本体操作；离散预训练可加速收敛并初始化连续策略；后训练后连续策略在多种真实平台和少样本人形任务上表现突出。

Abstract: We present HoloBrain-0.5, a family of vision-language-action (VLA) models for manipulation across robot embodiments. The policies plan in a shared action space using robot state, kinematic structure, and calibrated camera observations. We standardize joint axes, coordinate frames, and tool-center points in robot descriptions (URDFs) and encode their kinematic graphs in a shared 3D representation. HoloBrain-0.5-Continuous generates action chunks by diffusion, while HoloBrain-0.5-Discrete uses residual finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and delayed autoregression. We pretrain both policies on over 10,000 hours of real-robot, simulation, and human-manipulation data spanning 15 embodiment categories.
  Across six closed-loop simulation settings, the discrete policy converges faster and reaches a higher mean success rate than the continuous policy (56.77% vs. 49.71%). On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves a mean progress score of 87.76% without task-specific post-training. After post-training, the continuous policy outperforms $π_{0.5}$ on the seven-task benchmark (94.52% vs. 86.25%) and an 11-task dual-arm benchmark (79.07% vs. 69.41%). The discrete-initialized continuous policy transfers five tasks zero-shot from Piper to Piper-X, scoring 63.28% on average. With target-robot demonstrations, the continuous policy scores 89.2% on Franka Panda and 92.94% on a mobile dual-arm platform. Although pretraining includes no Unitree G1 data, post-training with limited G1 demonstrations yields a mean progress score of 70.24% across three humanoid tasks, compared with 11.00% for $π_{0.5}$.

</details>


### [453] [DynaRC: Dynamics-Robust 4-D Radar Relocalization with Rate-Adaptive Sequence Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34453)
*Chuan Cao,Xingyi Li,Tianchen Deng,Jingchuan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出面向四维毫米波雷达的动态鲁棒地点识别与重定位框架 DynaRC，包括单帧检索与序列重定位 Seq_DynaRC，在动态室内外场景中提升2米内定位成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四维毫米波雷达可在单次扫描中测径向速度且受恶劣天气和能见度影响小，但方向性回波稀疏、运动物体和遮挡会导致地点匹配歧义，因此需要动态鲁棒的地点匹配方法。

Method: 提出 DynaRC 框架：利用多普勒证据分离静态回波并在极坐标描述子中掩蔽受运动影响的单元，使用中值环键检索候选；序列版本 Seq_DynaRC 结合端点锚定速率对齐、候选索引投票和有序验证，在无需里程计或点云累积的情况下关联最新扫描。

Result: 在四组室内外地图—查询对上，Seq_DynaRC 在测试方法中取得最高的2米内条件定位成功率；在交通变化的校园道路重访中成功率达91.8%，当各方法保留其全部已发表输出时，比描述子匹配的 SeqSLAM 高55.0个百分点，输出可用性另行报告。

Conclusion: DynaRC/Seq_DynaRC 能有效应对动态环境和稀疏雷达回波带来的地点匹配歧义，实现鲁棒的序列重定位；代码及室内外动态四维雷达数据已公开。

Abstract: Four-dimensional millimeter-wave radar measures radial velocity within a single scan and remains resilient under adverse weather and visibility. Yet sparse directional returns, moving objects and occlusion make place matching ambiguous. We propose DynaRC, a dynamics-robust framework encompassing single-frame retrieval and sequence relocalization. Doppler evidence separates static returns and masks motion-affected cells in a polar descriptor; median ring keys retrieve candidates. Its sequence variant, Seq_DynaRC, couples endpoint-anchored rate alignment and candidate-index voting with ordered verification to associate the latest scan under unequal map/query advancement, without odometry or cloud accumulation. Across four indoor and outdoor map--query pairs, Seq_DynaRC achieves the highest conditional localization success within 2m among tested methods. On a campus-road revisit under changing traffic, success reaches 91.8%, exceeding descriptor-matched SeqSLAM by 55.0 percentage points when each method retains all its published outputs; output availability is reported separately. Code and indoor/outdoor dynamic 4D radar data are available.

</details>


### [454] [Least Restrictive Halfplane Control Barrier Functions for an Autonomous Hydrofoil Boat with Moving Obstacles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34463)
*Mattias Trende,Petter Ögren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对具有Dubins车动力学且受执行约束的智能体，提出一种基于支撑半平面的控制障碍函数（CBF）方法，通过优化半平面方向和使用多个半平面近似复杂障碍，降低保守性并提升避障效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性系统在执行约束和复杂环境中难以找到有效的控制障碍函数；将障碍物表示为支撑半平面可便于解析构造CBF，但半平面CBF往往过于保守，会高估障碍物并限制智能体运动。

Method: 为Dubins车动力学智能体构造半平面CBF；优化单个障碍物支撑半平面的方向，以寻找尽可能接近期望控制的安全控制输入；使用多个半平面近似复杂几何形状，并给出处理半平面交集的规则。

Result: 对比仿真表明，该方法比现有CBF技术更不保守，可实现更紧的障碍间距和更快到达目标，延迟降低超过33%；在自主水翼船上的实验验证了实际可行性。

Conclusion: 通过优化半平面方向和多半平面近似，可以缓解半平面CBF的保守性，并在真实系统中实现有效的安全避障控制。

Abstract: Finding valid Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) is difficult for non-linear systems subject to actuation constraints and moving in complex environments. One way to enable analytically derived CBFs is to represent obstacles as supporting halfplanes, allowing the agent to move safely on one side. In this paper, we propose such a CBF for an agent with Dubins car dynamics. A potential drawback of halfplane CBFs is that they can be highly conservative, overestimating the obstacles and thereby restricting the agent's motion. To address this problem, we make the CBF halfplanes less restrictive as follows. First, the orientation of the supporting halfplane for a single obstacle is optimised to find a safe control input as close as possible to the desired one. Second, we use multiple halfplanes to better approximate complex geometries, and derive rules for handling halfplane intersections. Comparative simulations show that our method reduces conservatism compared to existing CBF techniques, enabling tighter obstacle clearance and faster goal arrival, with delays reduced by more than 33%. Finally, experiments on an autonomous hydrofoil boat demonstrate successful real-world implementation.

</details>


### [455] [SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34485)
*Giacomo Vianello,David Morilla-Cabello,Juan Dendarieta Serrano,Ruggero Carli,Eduardo Montijano*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SkySearcher，一种面向大型户外场景的无人机空中语义搜索导航方法，结合机载VLM推理与轻量概率表示来引导信息驱动探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的无人机搜索多沿用低空策略，依赖近距离迭代探索、存储密集的3D度量语义重建，或依赖云端VLM并假设持续联网，难以适用于高空大型非结构化环境。

Method: 在高空利用VLM提取目标或其位置线索的语义信息，并通过相机视锥将信息投影到地面，而非依赖有限深度传感器；随后将语义线索存在与否集成到概率地图中，建模查询目标的空间信念，维护任务驱动的记忆并引导探索至语义上更可能区域。

Result: 在公开基准的Aerial Object Goal Navigation仿真中，SkySearcher在成功率、飞行时间和导航精度上显著优于现有基线；全机载部署实验验证了方法的实际可行性。

Conclusion: SkySearcher能够在大型户外场景中实现机载无人机语义搜索导航，减少对密集3D重建和持续云端服务的依赖，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.

</details>


### [456] [An Exact Branch-Price-and-Cut Algorithm for the Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34490)
*Michał Paradowski,Anoop Bhat,Zhongqiang Ren,Howie Choset*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究带有浮动目标的车辆路径问题（VRPFT），提出基于分支定价切割的精确算法，并设计利用轨迹成本闭式上下界的支配准则以加速定价子问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VRPFT 是容量约束车辆路径问题的推广，目标可主动以有限速度离开初始位置，因此需要同时决定车辆访问顺序和各目标的时空会合点，求解难度较高。

Method: 采用分支定价切割算法精确求解 VRPFT；核心是面向定价标记算法的支配准则，利用固定目标序列下车辆轨迹成本的闭式下界和上界；证明该准则不损失最优性，并进一步给出更激进的松弛准则形成启发式。

Result: 精确算法在相同硬件上计算时间短于先前工作的精确动态规划；松弛准则形成的启发式速度更快，并在基准测试上匹配所有已认证最优解。

Conclusion: 基于轨迹成本闭式界的支配准则能有效加速 VRPFT 的精确求解，且松弛版本在测试中表现出兼顾速度与最优性的潜力。

Abstract: The Vehicle Routing Problem with Floating Targets (VRPFT) is a generalization of the capacitated vehicle routing problem where targets may actively move to locations ''convenient'' for the vehicles. In particular, each target may leave its home location at a bounded speed. A solution to the VRPFT is a sequence of targets for each vehicle to visit and a meeting point in space-time for each target. In this paper, we solve the VRPFT exactly with a branch-price-and-cut algorithm. Our key contribution is a dominance criterion for the pricing labeling algorithm that utilizes closed-form lower and upper bounds on a vehicle's trajectory cost given a fixed sequence of targets. We prove that the criterion preserves optimality, and the algorithm has smaller computation time than the exact dynamic program of prior work on identical hardware. We also provide a relaxed criterion that prunes more aggressively; the resulting heuristic is faster than our exact algorithm and matched every certified optimum on the benchmark.

</details>


### [457] [Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34509)
*Syed Nazmus Sakib,Abdul Monaf Chowdhury,Peizhen Li,Nafiul Haque,Chandak Chakma,Md Mehedi Hasan,Zehong Cao,Shifat E. Arman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文分析潜在世界模型中基于潜在距离的规划失效问题，并提出无需训练的 Graph Anchors 规划器，通过将远期目标替换为轨迹上附近节点来提升闭环规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通常在紧凑潜在空间中预测动作结果，并用预测末状态与目标图像的潜在距离评价计划；作者发现该距离在远离目标时缺乏方向信号，且在接触操作时更关注机械臂而非被操作物体，导致远距离目标和操作任务失败。

Method: 作者用排序测试在记录数据上检验更小的潜在距离是否代表真实接近目标，覆盖5个环境、6种视觉表示（含原始像素和V-JEPA 2）及9个Meta-World任务；并提出Graph Anchors：在冻结潜在世界模型的训练帧上一次性构建稀疏图，每一步规划瞄准通往目标最短路径上向前数步的节点，使路径尽量沿记录到的真实转移。

Result: 排序测试能清晰区分两类失效，且目标在图上的距离可预测闭环规划何时失败。Graph Anchors 在远至400步目标上显著提升成功率：PointMaze-Medium 从13%到85%，PointMaze-Large 从8%到87%，Push-T 从5%到71%；而在这些场景中，更强的目标搜索会失败，已有免训练规划器也会因缺失步长、子采样捷径或接触碎片化而失效。

Conclusion: 潜在距离目标在远距离和接触操作中存在系统性缺陷；用记录轨迹上附近目标替代远期目标可同时缓解两类失败。Graph Anchors 作为面向冻结潜在世界模型的免训练规划器，能有效改善长程导航和接触丰富操作任务。

Abstract: Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its
  predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the
  goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure
  both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five
  environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two
  failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. Both failures share a single remedy: replacing the distant
  goal with a nearby target that lies on a recorded trajectory. We realize this principle with Graph Anchors, a training-free planner for frozen latent
  world models. It builds a sparse graph once over the model's own training frames and aims each planning step at a node a few moves ahead along the
  shortest path to the goal, keeping paths on recorded transitions wherever contact matters. On goals up to 400 steps away, Graph Anchors raise LeWM's
  success from 13% to 85% on PointMaze-Medium, from 8% to 87% on PointMaze-Large, and from 5% to 71% on Push-T, where stronger search toward the goal
  fails and where prior training-free planners break down under missing step horizons, subsampling shortcuts, or fragmented contact.

</details>


### [458] [AGLR: Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement for Fine-Grained Humanoid Motion Generation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34519)
*Shuai Yuan,Yuwei Gui,Mingshuang Luo,Zhuo Li,Siyuan Meng,Wenhao Cui,RuiBing Hou,Bingpeng Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出AGLR统一框架，用于细粒度人形运动生成与编辑，通过源锚定潜空间精炼实现局部几何约束下的单次校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形运动生成需适应不断变化的任务要求，局部调整应满足新的几何约束且不破坏原有运动细节；但语言控制缺乏几何精度，关节级约束又需显式空间目标，且局部几何约束欠定，难以同时满足目标与保留源运动。

Method: 提出AGLR（属性引导潜空间精炼）框架，提供紧凑几何接口，可组合、时变地控制肢体范围、躯干朝向和根轨迹；给定生成或编码的基础潜变量，由属性残差适配器预测单次校正，并用属性级与运动坐标级双重监督实现目标匹配和选择性保留。

Result: 在HumanML3D-G1上，AGLR在可控生成和保留约束编辑成功率上均优于评估方法；对缓存500帧运动编辑仅需9.1 ms，无需额外采样或测试时优化；在BONES-SEED-G1上的零样本评估显示无需微调即可迁移。

Conclusion: AGLR能够以高效的单次潜空间精炼实现精确、可组合且保留源细节的人形运动生成与编辑，并具备跨数据集零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: Humanoid motion generation must accommodate evolving task requirements, where localized adjustments should satisfy new geometric constraints without disrupting desired motion details. However, language-based control lacks geometric precision, while joint-level constraints require explicit spatial targets. Local geometric constraints are also underdetermined, complicating target satisfaction and source preservation. We present AGLR (Attribute-Guided Latent Refinement), a unified framework for fine-grained humanoid motion generation and editing through source-anchored refinement. A compact geometric interface supports composable, time-varying control of limb extents, torso orientation, and root trajectories. Given a generated or encoded base latent, an Attribute Residual Adapter predicts a single-pass correction, with dual-level supervision enforcing target matching and selective preservation across attributes and motion coordinates. On HumanML3D-G1, AGLR achieves the highest controllable-generation and preservation-constrained editing success rates among evaluated methods. Editing take only 9.1 ms for a cached 500-frame motion, without additional sampling or test-time optimization. Zero-shot evaluation on BONES-SEED-G1 further demonstrates transfer without fine-tuning.

</details>


### [459] [Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench): Evaluating Runtime Task Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34538)
*Yanran Jiang,Cécile Paris,Dana Kulić,Leimin Tian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出动态任务更新基准DTU-Bench，用于评估VLA策略在机器人执行过程中对指令变化的适应能力；结果显示现有VLA在固定指令任务上表现很好，但执行中改变操作对象时成功率骤降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略多在固定指令的机器人操作基准上评估，其在执行过程中适应指令变化的能力研究不足，固定指令基准和任务成功率指标可能掩盖真实局限。

Method: 构建DTU-Bench，基于LIBERO仿真机器人操作基准，覆盖7种更新类型、3个执行阶段和40个任务修订；比较执行前与执行中给出新指令的表现，并测试13种代表性VLA配置；还进行受控诊断，并测试一个简单脚本控制器（释放已抓取物体并将机械臂移回）对指令变化响应的影响。

Result: 13种VLA配置在原始物体操作任务上平均成功率为95.8%，但当执行中指令改变操作对象时仅1.6%。诊断表明策略常先完成原任务再处理更新任务，且响应依赖机器人物理状态。脚本控制器将π0.5成功率从2%提升到38%，DM0.5从8%提升到48%，但可能造成不期望的物体运动。

Conclusion: 当前VLA策略在执行中动态更新任务方面存在显著局限；固定指令基准和单纯任务成功率指标会忽略这些不足，评估机器人操作能力时需关注指令变化下的适应性与物理状态影响。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform well on fixed-instruction robotic manipulation benchmarks, but their ability to adapt to instruction changes during execution remains understudied. We introduce the Dynamic Task Update Benchmark (DTU-Bench), evaluating 40 task revisions across seven update types and three execution stages using LIBERO, a simulated robotic manipulation benchmark. We compare performance when a new instruction is given before execution starts versus during execution, and examine whether the new task instructions are followed. Across 13 representative VLA configurations, average task success is 95.8% on the original object-manipulation tasks, compared with only 1.6% when the instruction changes which object to manipulate during execution. Controlled diagnostics show that policies often complete the original task before the updated one, and that their responses depend on the robot's physical state. We further test whether a simple scripted controller that releases the grasped object and moves the arm back helps robots respond to instruction changes. This improves success from 2% to 38% for π0.5 and from 8% to 48% for DM0.5, but can cause unwanted object motion. These findings reveal limitations that fixed-instruction benchmarks and task-success metrics alone can overlook in evaluating robotic manipulation. Project page: https://dtu-bench.github.io/

</details>


### [460] [Reference-Model-Guided Distributed MPC for UAV Swarm Formation Flying Under Switching Directed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34540)
*Yiming Wang,Yenan Wu,Junda Wu,Yanke Sun,Huizhe Li,Ke Yu,Youmin Gong,Guangfu Ma,Jie Mei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种参考模型引导的分布式模型预测控制框架，用于复杂环境下无人机集群的分布式编队控制，并通过仿真和真实飞行实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机集群在复杂环境中面临切换的通信拓扑、有限通信、外部扰动和碰撞避免等挑战，需要一种兼顾预测规划、约束处理、通信效率和可扩展性的分布式编队控制方法。

Method: 每架无人机利用邻居相对位置信息输入局部参考模型，生成编队引导信号供机载MPC使用；采用卡尔曼滤波预测邻居运动，仅依赖瞬时相对状态构建机间避碰约束；利用扰动观测器进行前馈补偿，并在基于控制障碍函数的避障约束中显式考虑有界残余扰动；将MPC优化与分布式协调解耦，避免交换邻居预测轨迹。

Result: 该框架在保持MPC前瞻规划和约束处理能力的同时，增强了集群对切换有向图的适应性，降低了通信带宽需求，并提升了大规摸集群的可扩展性；仿真和真实飞行实验验证了方法的有效性，飞行验证在无外部全局定位的全分布式多无人机平台上完成。

Conclusion: 参考模型引导的分布式MPC框架能够有效应对复杂环境下无人机集群编队中的通信、扰动和避碰问题，并具备较好的鲁棒性、安全性和实际部署能力。

Abstract: Distributed formation control of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms in complex environments faces several challenges, including switching inter-agent connectivity, limited communication, external disturbances, and collision avoidance. To address these challenges, we propose a reference-model-guided distributed model predictive control (MPC) framework for UAV swarm formation. Each UAV uses relative-position information from its neighbors as input to a local reference model, whose output serves as the formation guidance for the onboard MPC controller. Meanwhile, a Kalman filter is utilized to predict neighboring UAV motions, enabling the construction of inter-UAV collision-avoidance constraints solely from instantaneous relative-state information. By decoupling MPC optimization from distributed coordination, this control architecture preserves the look-ahead planning and constraint-handling capabilities of MPC while enhancing the swarm's adaptability to switching directed graphs. Moreover, eliminating the exchange of neighbors' predicted trajectories reduces communication bandwidth demands, offering strong scalability for large-scale UAV swarms. To improve robustness and safety, disturbance-observer-based feedforward compensation is employed, while the bounded residual disturbance is explicitly considered in the control barrier function (CBF)-based obstacle-avoidance constraints. Finally, the proposed framework is validated through both simulations and real-world flight experiments. Specifically, the flight verification is conducted on a fully distributed multi-UAV platform without external global localization.

</details>


### [461] [M$^{2}$AdaptVLA: Multimodal Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model with Predictive Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34560)
*Liufan Tan,Tong Wang,Yuehao Yin,Jian Chen,Yihang Yin,Ying Qu,Wenyu Li,Ruyi Gan,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 M2AdaptVLA，一种融合视觉记忆、力/扳手记忆与预测式测试时适应的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于提升机器人在接触动力学变化下的操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有策略通常只保留视觉或力/扳手历史，容易遗漏另一模态的关键线索；即使有力/扳手记忆，固定策略在部署时接触条件变化下仍难以适应。

Method: 视觉记忆方面，使用测试时训练（TTT）将观测历史编码到快速权重中，并通过有界TTT库结合当前帧特征与权重读出；力/扳手记忆方面，引入上下文门控控制动作专家对力/扳手历史的利用，并联合去噪未来动作与力/扳手；测试时适应方面，利用辅助力/扳手预测损失提供在线自监督，以实测力/扳手为目标，仅通过最终去噪步骤反向传播更新低秩策略适配器。

Result: 真实世界实验表明，TTT库在进度跟踪、场景回忆和示范跟随上优于视觉记忆基线；在接触敏感任务中，上下文门控成功率高于直接注入或门控交叉注意力；预测式测试时适应提升了对接触动力学变化的鲁棒性。在8个需要视觉与力/扳手记忆的任务上，M2AdaptVLA平均成功率为82.71%，比最强基线绝对提升31.46%。

Conclusion: 融合多模态记忆与预测式测试时适应能有效提升机器人在接触敏感和动力学变化场景中的操作性能。

Abstract: Effective robotic manipulation calls for multimodal memory and rapid adaptation to shifts in contact dynamics. However, many existing policies, which retain either visual or wrench history, may miss key cues from the other modality. Moreover, even with wrench memory, fixed policies can struggle when contact conditions shift at deployment. To this end, we introduce M$^{2}$AdaptVLA, a vision-language-action model that integrates visual and wrench memories with predictive test-time adaptation. For visual memory, the model uses test-time training (TTT) to encode observation history in fast weights. Each entry in the bounded TTT bank combines the corresponding frame's features with a readout from these weights, preserving cues that predate the oldest retained frame. For wrench memory, a context gate controls how much the action expert draws on wrench history as it jointly denoises future actions and wrenches. For predictive test-time adaptation, the auxiliary wrench prediction loss also provides online self-supervision. Using measured wrenches as targets, we update low-rank policy adapters by backpropagating only through the final denoising step. Real-world experiments show that the TTT bank outperforms visual memory baselines on progress tracking, scene recall, and demonstration following. On contact-sensitive tasks, the context gate yields higher success rates than direct injection or gated cross-attention. Predictive test-time adaptation improves robustness to shifts in contact dynamics. On eight tasks requiring visual and wrench memory, M$^{2}$AdaptVLA achieves a mean success rate of 82.71%, a 31.46% absolute gain over the strongest baseline. The project page is available at https://tlf-tlf.github.io/M2AdaptVLAPage/.

</details>


### [462] [Compact Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environmentsvia On-Policy Training and Route-Bearing Output](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34561)
*Reshad Ul Karim,Syeda Maliha Tabassum,Md. Khalilur Rhaman,Md Rashad Al Hasan Rony*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅依赖单目RGB、参数量为2B的连续环境视觉语言导航策略\paper，基于Qwen3-VL-2B和LoRA适配，通过八帧记忆与当前视角单次前向推理，预测智能体本体坐标系下的航向角并由确定性控制器转为运动，从而提升小模型导航的成功率并降低训练与推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令跟随机器人需要高精度且可在单块GPU上低成本训练和运行的导航策略；现有连续环境高精度VLN策略常依赖40亿至80亿参数语言模型、长观测历史和大规模辅助语料。标准训练设置存在两个限制：模仿学习标签只覆盖专家访问状态，而运行策略会到达自身错误产生的状态；图像平面路点仅在路线位于相机视野内时存在。

Method: \paper采用2B参数的单目RGB策略，基于Qwen3-VL-2B并加入低秩适配器LoRA，在一次前向传播中处理八帧记忆和当前视角。策略预测本体坐标系中的航线方向，即航向角，该表示对任意朝向均有定义，再由确定性控制器将航向角转换为运动。该设计支持对策略自身访问状态进行重标注和在线策略纠正。作者比较了航向解码与图像平面路点扫描，并在相同权重下评估不同起始朝向。

Result: 在线策略纠正提升了成功率；在相同权重下，航向解码在所有评估起始朝向上均优于图像平面路点扫描。在VAL-UNSEEN划分上，\paper在R2R-CE上三次种子平均成功率为\rFinSR\%，在RxR对应任务上为\rRxFinSR\%。推理需\rDecMs\,ms和\rInferGB\,GiB内存，训练在单块12\,GB消费级GPU上耗时\rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours。

Conclusion: 通过本体坐标系航向预测、在线策略纠正和轻量适配，本文实现了面向连续环境的低成本、高精度2B参数VLN策略，在单块消费级GPU上可训练和推理，并优于图像平面路点扫描方案。

Abstract: Instruction-following robots need navigation policies that reach high accuracy and remain inexpensive to train and to run on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The most accurate vision-language navigation policies for continuous environments rely on language models with 4 to 8 billion parameters, long observation histories, and large auxiliary corpora. Two properties of the standard training setup limit smaller policies. Imitation labels cover the states that an expert visits, whereas the running policy reaches states that its own errors produce. In addition, an image-plane waypoint exists only while the route lies inside the camera view. We present \textbf{\paper}, a monocular red-green-blue (RGB) policy with 2 billion (2B) parameters that addresses both limitations. \paper adapts Qwen3-VL-2B with low-rank adapters and processes an eight-frame memory and the current view in one forward pass. The policy predicts the route direction as a bearing in the body frame of the agent, which remains defined for every heading, and a deterministic controller converts this bearing into motion. This design allows training to relabel the states that the policy itself visits. On-policy correction improves success, while bearing decoding outperforms image-plane waypoint scanning across all evaluated start headings with identical weights. On the \valunseen split, \paper achieves \rFinSR\% success on Room-to-Room in Continuous Environments (\rtor), averaged over three seeds, and \rRxFinSR\% on its Room-Across-Room counterpart (\rxr). Inference requires \rDecMs\,ms and \rInferGB\,GiB of memory, while training takes \rCostTrainTyp\ GPU-hours on one 12\,GB consumer GPU.

</details>


### [463] [Riding the Wave: Sim-to-Real Humanoid Control on Elastic Terrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34569)
*Yinglei Zhu,Qin Li,Honghao Pan,Bozhao Wang,Binghui Xu,Jie Lu,Wentao Song,Xiyu Wang,Xinyu Zhu,Wei Liu,Xinjun Liu,Kai Lu,Huichan Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 RIPPLE，一个面向大变形弹性地形的人形机器人仿真到现实学习框架，通过建模地形空间耦合形变与回弹，并结合分阶段训练，实现仅依赖本体感知的平衡、连续跳跃和蹦床进入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形弹性地形的位置与运动在时空上耦合：接触间存在持续形变与回弹，一处落脚负载会影响其他支撑点，因此训练必须捕捉每次接触如何改变后续支撑；现有刚性地形或接触柔顺性训练难以有效迁移。

Method: 提出 ElasticMembrane，一种预张力质量-弹簧网格，用于建模空间耦合形变、能量存储与回弹，并集成可变形接触到 MJLab 进行 GPU 并行策略学习；采用分阶段训练，将刚性地形技能迁移到弹性地形上的平衡与跳跃，仅使用本体感知，不用视觉或力传感。

Result: 零样本部署使 MagicBot Z1 人形机器人实现平衡、连续跳跃以及从刚性平台进入蹦床；仿真中 ElasticMembrane 训练在 0.3 m/s 扰动下于 ElasticMembrane、IndependentSprings 和 BouncyPlate 上保持至少 98.7% 站立成功率，而刚性地形或接触柔顺性训练迁移较差；固定策略可容忍训练刚度 0.35 至 2.8 倍、最宽 7 m 的床面及七种额外仿真支撑场景，无需针对蹦床刚度校准。

Conclusion: 对弹性地形空间耦合形变与回弹进行显式建模，并结合分阶段本体感知训练，可使人形机器人在大变形弹性地形上实现鲁棒控制与零样本仿真到现实迁移，且无需视觉、力传感或刚度校准。

Abstract: Humanoid robots on deformable elastic terrains face a surface whose position and motion are coupled in space and time: deflection and rebound persist between contacts, and load at one foothold alters the support at others, so training must capture how each contact changes the support that follows. We present RIPPLE (Robust Interaction via Proprioceptive Policies on Large-deformation Elastic terrain), a simulation-to-real learning framework for humanoid control on such terrains. RIPPLE integrates ElasticMembrane, a pretensioned mass-spring mesh that models spatially coupled deflection, energy storage, and rebound, together with deformable contact into MJLab for GPU-parallel policy learning. Staged training then transfers rigid-ground skills to balance and jumping on these terrains using only proprioception, without vision or force sensing. Deployed zero-shot, the policies enable a MagicBot Z1 humanoid to balance, jump consecutively, and enter a trampoline from a rigid platform. In simulation, ElasticMembrane training holds standing success of at least 98.7% (mean over three seeds) on ElasticMembrane, IndependentSprings, and BouncyPlate under 0.3 m/s perturbations, whereas rigid-ground or contact-compliance training transfers poorly to the first two. A fixed policy tolerates stiffness from 0.35 to 2.8 times the training value, beds up to 7 m wide, and seven further simulated support scenarios, so transfer needs no calibration to the trampoline's stiffness. We plan to release the code soon. The interactive browser demo, videos, and scene configurations are available on the project page: https://fly-pigTH.github.io/wave_rider/

</details>


### [464] [Geometric Acceleration Obstacles: Physical Boundary Structure and Affine Safety Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34586)
*Xuheng Gao,Yuhan Pang,Bi-Ke Zhu,Ronghao Chen,Lingxiao Meng,Jiankun Wang,Max Q. -H. Meng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出几何加速度障碍（GAO），统一表征加速度空间中的碰撞障碍几何及其支撑结构，并据此构建仿射安全约束与QP实时导航方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中机器人导航需兼顾碰撞避免、运动约束和计算效率；现有VO/AO方法受限于特定速度跟踪模型、保守近似或缺乏几何对应验证。

Method: 在加速度空间推导配置相关的半平面以全局支撑碰撞集，证明其紧致性，分离认证无碰撞加速度输入与碰撞输入，形成统一仿射安全约束，并结合执行器限制构建二次规划（QP）。

Result: 实验显示GAO成功率具竞争力且控制 effort 最低，计算延迟为毫秒级；圆交换仿真验证可扩展至1000个智能体；物理实验验证行人相遇、互惠多智能体导航和高速机动场景。

Conclusion: GAO提供了首个统一且经物理验证的AO几何及支撑结构表征，为动态环境中的实时安全导航提供了有效、可扩展的QP框架。

Abstract: Safe robot navigation in dynamic environments requires collision avoidance that respects motion constraints while remaining computationally efficient. Conventional velocity-obstacle (VO) methods characterize collision-inducing motions in velocity space. Although some formulations account for acceleration-limited velocity transitions, their collision constraints remain tied to specific velocity-tracking models. Acceleration obstacles (AO) address this limitation by representing collision-inducing inputs directly in acceleration space. However, existing AO methods either rely on conservative approximations or derive analytical structure expressions without verifying their geometric correspondence. To address this gap, this paper presents Geometric Acceleration Obstacles (GAO), which provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first unified and physically validated characterization of AO geometry and its supporting structure. Specifically, we derive configuration-dependent half-planes that globally support the collision set and establish their tightness, thereby separating certified collision-free acceleration inputs from collision-inducing parts. These geometric results yield unified affine safety constraints. Combined with actuator limits, these constraints define a quadratic program (QP) for real-time navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAO achieves competitive success rates and the lowest control effort among the evaluated methods, with millisecond-level computational latency. Further circle-interchange simulations demonstrate scalability to 1,000 agents. Physical experiments validate the approach in pedestrian encounters, reciprocal multi-agent navigation, and high-speed maneuvering.

</details>


### [465] [Nav4Manip: From Navigation to Dexterous Mobile Manipulation through Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34655)
*Yusen Feng,Zixi Kang,Zhijun Yin,Changxiao Liu,Tianhong Gao,Jiazhao Zhang,Jiahang Liu,Libin Liu,Zhizheng Zhang,He Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Nav4Manip，一个面向长时程灵巧移动操作的双向耦合协同进化系统，包含导航模块 Nav4Manip-N 和操作世界动作模型 Nav4Manip-M，并在公开 VLN 基准与新建 Nav-N-Manip 基准及真实环境中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人系统在复杂非结构化环境中难以完成长时程灵巧移动操作：导航粒度较粗，无法为下游操作提供精确基座位置与接近方向；导航与操作通常分开训练，缺乏相互反馈与协同进化机制。

Method: 提出 Nav4Manip 双向耦合协同进化框架。Nav4Manip-N 通过三阶段训练：多任务协同微调学习导航行为与操作感知可供性预测；拒绝采样微调过滤低质量路径；基于 AI 反馈的强化学习利用反事实偏好改进导航决策。Nav4Manip-M 训练世界动作模型用于下游灵巧操作。同时构建 Nav-N-Manip 基准和 Nav4Manip-Pairs 配对轨迹与可供性监督数据。

Result: 在公开视觉语言导航基准和 Nav-N-Manip 上取得最先进性能；真实世界评估表明 Nav4Manip 能完成多种灵巧移动操作任务。

Conclusion: 通过导航与操作的双向反馈和协同进化，并引入精细导航与配套基准，Nav4Manip 能更可靠地执行长时程灵巧移动操作任务，验证了耦合训练与协同进化范式的有效性。

Abstract: Dexterous mobile manipulation is essential for robots to perform useful tasks in complex, unstructured environments. However, existing systems face two challenges. First, navigation remains too coarse for downstream manipulation, which often requires a precise base position and approach orientation rather than merely reaching a meter-scale goal region. Second, navigation and manipulation are commonly trained in isolation, lacking a feedback loop that enables the two capabilities to co-evolve. These limitations prevent current systems from reliably executing long-horizon dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks in real-world environments. To address them, we introduce Nav4Manip, a bidirectionally coupled co-evolution system for long-horizon dexterous mobile manipulation. It comprises two complementary architectures: Nav4Manip-N learns long-horizon navigation and refines its policy through manipulation feedback, while Nav4Manip-M trains a world-action model (WAM) for downstream dexterous manipulation. We train Nav4Manip-N in three stages: multi-task co-tuning learns navigation behavior and manipulation-aware affordance prediction; rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) rejects low-quality policy-generated paths and fine-tunes the model on retained trajectories; and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) uses counterfactual preferences to further improve navigation decisions. To support this framework, we establish the Nav-N-Manip benchmark and construct Nav4Manip-Pairs from benchmark rollouts, providing large-scale paired navigation--manipulation trajectories and affordance supervision. Extensive experiments on public vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks and Nav-N-Manip demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while real-world evaluations show that Nav4Manip completes diverse dexterous mobile-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://nav4manip.github.io/.

</details>


### [466] [FeaXDrive2: Body-Scene Spatial Grounding for Feasibility-Aware Generative Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34658)
*Bo Leng,Baoyun Wang,Wenxin Wen,Ming Liu,Weiqi Zhang,Ran Yu,Chongfeng Wei,Zhuoren Li,Lu Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FeaXDrive2 是一个端到端生成式驾驶规划框架，通过车身-场景空间接地提升车辆整体空间可行性，并在 NAVSIM 上显著降低事故率、提升规划指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式驾驶规划器在参考点处轨迹看似可行，但完整车身可能违反环境约束，因此需要增强车辆整体与场景之间的空间可行性。

Method: 构建基于真实车身角点的空间查询，并随 Flow 步中轨迹估计动态更新视觉采样位置；用检索到的局部视觉特征条件化 Action Flow-DiT 速度预测，使轨迹生成引导空间信息检索；采用 Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning（RC-F）结合高风险轨迹监督与参考行为保持，并进行规划监督的 VLM-Action 对齐；还通过车辆几何反事实分析评估安全性差异。

Result: 在 NAVSIM 上，相比基础规划器，FeaXDrive2 将使自身责任碰撞减少 36.5%，PDMS 从 87.0 提升到 88.8；在 NAVSIM v2 下 EPDMS 从 86.5 提升到 88.3；消融和车身间隙分析进一步证明车身-场景空间接地的安全收益。

Conclusion: 车身-场景空间接地能有效提升生成式规划的整体空间可行性与安全性，减少因仅考虑参考点而忽略完整车身约束导致的风险。

Abstract: Generative driving planners may produce trajectories that appear feasible at their reference points but violate environmental constraints over the full vehicle body. We propose FeaXDrive2, an end-to-end generative planning framework that enhances vehicle-embodied spatial feasibility (VESF) through body-scene spatial grounding. The proposed method constructs spatial queries from actual vehicle-body corners and dynamically updates visual sampling locations using evolving trajectory estimates across Flow steps. Retrieved local visual features condition subsequent Action Flow-DiT velocity predictions, allowing trajectory generation to guide spatial information retrieval. Rollout-Consistent Safety Fine-Tuning (RC-F) combines high-risk trajectory supervision with reference behavior preservation, followed by planning-supervised VLM-Action Alignment. Vehicle-geometry counterfactual analysis reveals safety differences under identical trajectories but varying vehicle geometry. On NAVSIM, FeaXDrive2 reduces at-fault collisions by 36.5% relative to the base planner and improves PDMS from 87.0 to 88.8. Under NAVSIM v2 evaluation, EPDMS increases from 86.5 to 88.3. Ablation and body-clearance analyses further demonstrate the safety benefits of body-scene spatial grounding.

</details>


### [467] [Autonomous Ergodic Robotic Palpation for Elastic Mapping of Curved Soft Tissues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34670)
*Luca Beber,Cem Bilaloglu,Edoardo Lamon,Matteo Saveriano,Daniele Fontanelli,Luigi Palopoli,Sylvain Calinon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于曲面点云的遍历式机器人触诊框架，用于复杂曲面软组织中的刚度包块定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主机器人触诊方法常依赖先验网格模型或平面表面假设，难以适用于复杂人体解剖曲面。

Method: 方法以Laplace-Beltrami算子刻画曲面内蕴几何，结合Unscented Kalman Filter估计局部黏弹性参数，并融合到表面感知高斯过程；再由扩散式遍历运动规划器生成连续探索轨迹，形成闭环采样，同时用混合力-阻抗控制器维持接触并调节交互力。

Result: 在仿真中与现有方法对比，并在不同几何形状和黏弹性性质的硅胶组织仿体中开展物理实验，实现了几何一致的映射和接触丰富条件下的刚度包块定位。

Conclusion: 该框架无需平面假设或先验网格，可直接在复杂曲面上进行自主触诊，并有效定位刚度包块。

Abstract: Autonomous robotic palpation offers repeatable, quantitative
  estimates of tissue properties for stiff inclusion
  localization. However, existing methods often rely on prior mesh
  models or planar surface assumptions that do not generalize to
  complex human anatomy. We propose an ergodic palpation framework that
  operates directly on curved soft surfaces using point cloud
  data. Central to our approach is the Laplace--Beltrami operator,
  which grounds both online estimation and exploration in the surface
  intrinsic geometry. We estimate local viscoelastic parameters using
  an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) and fuse them into a surface-aware
  Gaussian Process (GP). This probabilistic model drives a
  diffusion-based ergodic motion planner, generating a continuous
  exploration trajectory that feeds the new informative samples back
  to the GP in a closed loop. Throughout this process, a hybrid
  force-impedance controller regulates interaction forces to maintain
  contact. We evaluate the approach against existing methods in
  simulation and validate it in physical experiments on
  tissue-mimicking silicone phantoms with varying geometries and
  viscoelastic properties, demonstrating geometry-consistent mapping
  and stiff inclusion localization under contact-rich conditions.

</details>


### [468] [DemoFoundry: Toward Scalable Photorealistic Robot Data with Coding Agents and Generative Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34671)
*Ruixiang Wang,Xinyue Yao,Xuanning Zhou,Yueci Deng,Yongyi Su,Kui Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 DemoFoundry，一个结合编码智能体与生成式渲染的自动化框架，用于合成兼具照片级真实感和物理可靠性的机器人演示数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习规模化依赖高质量演示数据，但仿真数据存在视觉真实感差距，纯视频生成又难以保证物理一致性并提供对齐的动作标签。

Method: 让编码智能体从已有机器人片段构建对齐的真实-代理视频对以训练视频渲染器，并根据场景参考和任务指令重建几何、编写可执行交互程序；在物理仿真器中执行生成带对齐机器人状态与动作的代理视频，再经渲染器转换为照片级真实观测，最后通过自动任务执行检查筛选成功轨迹用于策略学习。

Result: 实验显示生成演示的视觉质量和动作-视频一致性均提升；基于生成演示训练的策略优于原始仿真训练，并在使用等量真实演示时接近真实数据训练的性能。

Conclusion: DemoFoundry 能自动合成物理可靠、视觉逼真的机器人演示，有效缩小仿真到现实的差距，为机器人策略学习提供可扩展的数据来源。

Abstract: Scaling robot learning requires demonstrations that combine realistic visual observations with reliable action supervision. Simulation-based synthesis faces a substantial visual gap relative to real environments, while video-only generation struggles to maintain physically consistent interactions and provide aligned action labels. We present DemoFoundry, an automated framework that couples coding agents with generative rendering to synthesize photorealistic and physically grounded robot demonstrations. Coding agents both construct aligned real--proxy video pairs from existing robot episodes to train a video renderer and write executable interaction programs to generate new demonstrations. Given a scene reference and task instruction, an agent reconstructs task-relevant geometry and writes a control program without requiring target-task human demonstrations. Program execution in a physics simulator produces proxy videos with aligned robot states and actions. The video renderer translates these proxy videos into scene-consistent, photorealistic observations, reducing the need for detailed appearance modeling in each scene. Automated task-execution checks select successful trajectories for rendering and policy learning. Experiments show improved visual quality and action--video consistency. Policies trained on the generated demonstrations outperform raw-simulation training and approach the performance of training on an equal number of real demonstrations.

</details>


### [469] [RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34675)
*Chenzhi Liu,Jiehong Lin,Wei Huang,Xuzhao Huang,Haoyuan Li,Yang Zhang,Junchao Huang,Chenyeyang Cai,Bo Wang,Kazuhiro Kosuge,Zhongrui Wang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出RoboEvo²框架，通过递归的harness与策略协同进化，使机器人无需额外人类演示即可适应新环境并高效掌握新技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略控制高效但面对陌生场景常需额外演示；基于推理的智能体可利用先验知识和机器人API发现解法，但反复推理与修复成本高。研究受人类“推理+练习”学习方式启发，试图结合二者优势。

Method: 提出递归harness-policy协同进化框架：Policy-to-Harness阶段利用策略失败引导编码智能体搜索Code、Code+ICL、Code+Policy路径，并将验证方案固化为可复用技能、路由策略和经验记忆；Harness-to-Policy阶段用验证轨迹进行监督训练，并通过反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD）让策略偏好同一初始状态下的成功修正而非失败。改进策略再为后续搜索提供更强运动能力，剩余失败继续驱动harness进化。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO上，无需额外人类演示，单独策略成功率从11.0%提升至84.1%，混合成功率从30.4%提升至90.5%；在RoboTwin C2R上取得类似增益并降低智能体成本。进一步实验展示自主任务获取、跨具身harness迁移，以及在Unitree G1-D上达到95.0%混合成功率。

Conclusion: RoboEvo²通过策略与harness的递归协同进化，有效结合推理搜索与策略练习，减少对人类演示和反复推理修复的依赖，并提升陌生环境适应、技能复用和跨具身迁移能力。

Abstract: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R.
