### [483] [One Neural Operator for Re-planning Low-Thrust Cislunar Transfers after Thrust Outages, at the Original or a Later Arrival](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33188)
*Selim Olgu Pilav*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文训练神经算子，将带有停机剖面的标称轨迹映射为重新规划轨迹及恢复存在概率，用于低推力NRHO到DRO转移的漏推力裕度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电推进任务中安全模式导致的推力中断很常见，而漏推力裕度研究需对数千个中断场景进行精确重规划，计算成本高，因此需要快速且较准确的替代方法。

Method: 针对270个低推力NRHO到DRO转移、允许最多10天到达滑移，训练神经算子联合预测重规划轨迹和给定滑移下的可恢复性；并与廉价重规划基准比较，还使用带求解器输入的算子变体做不确定性集成。

Result: 在未见转移且零滑移时，严重中断半区的中位控制误差为1.20%，最佳廉价重规划基准为14.0%；引入到达滑移后为1.67%对23.2%。可恢复性预测AUC达0.997；84个需滑移的检查中断中仅6个最小可恢复滑移预测乐观超过半天。集成离散度与实际误差秩相关0.91，对最不确定的31%严重中断做精确求解可将90百分位误差从8.5%降至2.3%，单次查询仅需毫秒级。

Conclusion: 该神经算子无需在线求解器即可快速预测重规划轨迹和恢复概率，适合大规模中断场景研究，尤其当数千次精确求解成本高于训练算子时。

Abstract: Safe-mode events causing thrust outages are common in missions with electric propulsion. To demonstrate mission feasibility in such an event, missed-thrust margin studies are performed where thousands of outage scenarios need an exact re-plan solved. We train a neural operator that maps a nominal trajectory with an outage profile to a re-planned trajectory and to the probability that the recovery exists, for 270 low-thrust near-rectilinear halo orbit (NRHO) to distant retrograde orbit (DRO) transfers, at an allowed slip of up to 10 days. On unseen transfers and zero slip, its median control error on the severe half of outages is 1.20% compared to 14.0% for the best cheap re-planner benchmark. With the arrival slip as an input, the error is 1.67% against 23.2%. It also predicts the recoverability of an outage for a given arrival slip with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.997, while the minimum recoverable slip prediction is optimistic by more than half a day on only 6 of the 84 checked outages needing slip. At the original arrival, the ensemble spread of an operator variant with solver inputs has a rank correlation of 0.91 with the actual error, and performing exact solves on the 31% most uncertain severe outages reduces the 90th-percentile error from 8.5% to 2.3%. A query takes milliseconds without a solver, making this a useful tool for large outage studies where the cost of thousands of exact solves outweighs the time to train the operator.

</details>


### [484] [Voltage-Feedback Backoff and Restoration for Priority-Based EV Charging Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33300)
*Eyad Alsulayhim,Ning Lu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种集中式电压反馈退避与恢复框架，用于协调居民电动汽车充电，以缓解配电网持续欠压问题，并在不依赖负荷预测、在线潮流计算或优化的情况下改善充电服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 居民电动汽车无序充电可能导致配电网持续欠压，现有方法往往依赖预测、在线计算或复杂优化，因此需要一种简单、可实施且能兼顾电压安全与充电需求的协调控制方法。

Method: 提出电压反馈退避与恢复（VFBR）框架，将并发充电数量控制与电动汽车选择分离；根据关键母线电压调整允许充电数量，先暂停初始充电以缓解欠压，再按电压条件分组恢复和退避；并采用结合充电紧迫性与离线预计算电压敏感性的优先级评分进行车辆分配。

Result: 在含500辆电动汽车的不平衡IEEE 123节点馈线上一周仿真显示，充电时段母线电压低于0.95 p.u.的样本比例从15%降至不足1%；在评估策略中，紧迫性与敏感性权重分别为0.75和0.25的组合分配比随机分配多提供25%的能量，并获得最高的平均离站荷电状态和公平性。

Conclusion: 简单的电压反馈控制结合基于紧迫性和电压敏感性的分配策略，可有效缓解欠压并提升充电服务，说明该框架在居民电动汽车充电协调中具有实际有效性。

Abstract: Uncoordinated residential electric vehicle (EV) charging can cause sustained undervoltage in distribution networks. This paper proposes a centralized voltage-feedback backoff and restoration (VFBR) framework that separates concurrent charging-count control from EV selection. The controller adjusts the allowable charging count using monitored critical-bus voltages, without load forecasts, online power-flow calculations, or optimization. Initial charging suspension relieves undervoltage, followed by group-wise restoration and backoff as voltage conditions permit. A complementary priority score combines charging urgency with voltage sensitivity precomputed offline to balance time-critical requests against their location-dependent voltage impacts. One-week simulations on the unbalanced IEEE 123-bus feeder with 500 EVs show that VFBR reduces the proportion of charging-period bus-time samples below 0.95 p.u. from 15% to less than 1%. Among the evaluated strategies, combined allocation with urgency and sensitivity weights of 0.75 and 0.25 delivers 25% more energy than random allocation and achieves the highest mean departure state of charge and fairness. These results demonstrate that simple voltage-feedback control, coupled with urgency- and sensitivity-based allocation, effectively mitigates undervoltage while improving charging service.

</details>


### [485] [Fuel-Efficient Formation Flying via Constrained Extremum Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33305)
*Kwang Hak Kim,Luis G. Crespo,Michael J. Acheson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无模型的自主制导架构 APOGEE，用于尾随飞机在编队飞行中最小化阻力并安全跟踪时间变化的涡流，从而节省燃油。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编队飞行可节省燃油，但需要学习并跟踪随时间变化的涡流，同时避免飞机遇到突滚力矩扰动的位置，因此需要兼顾学习、跟踪、飞行品质与安全的制导方法。

Method: 提出 APOGEE（Adaptive Plateau-seeking Optimal Guidance with ModulatEd Excitations）。其关键包括：阈值门控激励调制以在目标函数足够好时降低激励幅度；基于牛顿法的学习规则，并对 Hessian 逆的估计进行谱截断以自适应学习率、加快收敛并降低过冲；使用带未知约束函数的安全滤波器防止控制丧失。

Result: 使用 F-16 高保真模型和实验获得的涡流模型验证了 APOGEE 的有效性；该方法无需建模未知函数与领航飞机特性、飞行条件、侧风及涡流湍流之间的关系。

Conclusion: APOGEE 能在无模型条件下实现安全、低阻的编队飞行制导，改善飞行品质并进一步降低燃油消耗。

Abstract: This paper presents a model-free autonomous guidance architecture for minimal drag of a trailing aircraft in formation flight. Realizing the fuel savings resulting from such a formation requires learning and tracking a time-varying vortex while avoiding locations where the aircraft experiences an abrupt rolling moment disturbance. A guidance architecture for fuel-efficient safe flight, called Adaptive Plateau-seeking Optimal Guidance with ModulatEd Excitations (APOGEE), is proposed herein. Key features of APOGEE are its ability to modulate the amplitude of the excitation required to learn the unknown objective and constraint functions, to adaptively adjust the learning rates, and to keep the flight safe during the search for the optimal formation. A threshold-gated modulation reduces the amplitude of excitation when the objective function reaches an acceptably large value, thus improving flying qualities and further reducing fuel consumption. Furthermore, a Newton-based learning rule, whose estimate of the inverse of the Hessian is spectrally clamped, adapts the learning rates to the local curvature of the objective function in order to accelerate convergence and lower the chance of overshooting the optimum. Finally, a safety filter having an unknown constraint function is used to prevent a loss of control event prompted by the above mentioned disturbance. The efficacy of APOGEE is demonstrated by using a high-fidelity model of an F-16 jet and an experimentally obtained vortex model. Being model-free, APOGEE does not require modeling the dependence of the unknown functions on the characteristics of the leading aircraft, the flight condition, the crosswind, and the vortex-induced turbulence.

</details>


### [486] [MVDC Power Cables for Future Wide-Body All-Electric Aircraft: A Research Journey from System-Level Requirements to Modeling, Design, Fabrication, and Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33410)
*Babak Porkar,Mona Ghassemi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文综述面向未来宽体全电飞机的中压直流（MVDC）功率电缆研究，覆盖飞机级需求、建模、设计、制造与低压电性能测试，并提出从需求到可制造原型的开发框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来宽体全电飞机需在严苛热和电条件下传输兆瓦级推进功率，要求轻量化配电系统，因此需要研究MVDC电缆的架构、设计与绝缘性能。

Method: 基于飞机级功率流与单故障研究确定±5 kV配电架构和1 kA设计目标；采用电-热-气流耦合模型分析多层多功能绝缘、导体几何、双极间距、导管配置与强迫对流；开展常压至18.8 kPa下粘接平板和绕包电缆原型的局部放电与击穿实验。

Result: 研究确定±5 kV架构和最重载回路1 kA目标，揭示绝缘界面、绕包方法、电缆几何与安装条件对紧凑设计和电性能的作用，并区分预测载流能力与实测绝缘性能。

Conclusion: 这些研究形成连接飞机需求与可制造原型的开发框架，并指出飞机适航合格鉴定所需的电、热、机械与耐久性综合评估。

Abstract: Future wide-body all-electric aircraft require lightweight electrical distribution systems capable of delivering megawatt-scale propulsion power under demanding thermal and electrical conditions. This article reviews our research program on medium-voltage direct-current (MVDC) power cables, from aircraft-level requirements through modeling, design, fabrication, and low-pressure electrical testing. It connects successive investigations and explains the decisions guiding their development. Aircraft-level power-flow and single-contingency studies establish a +/-5 kV distribution architecture and a 1 kA design objective for the most heavily loaded cable circuits. Coupled electrical, thermal, and airflow models examine multilayer multifunctional electrical insulation, conductor geometry, bipolar pole spacing, duct configuration, and forced convection. Flight-phase studies distinguish higher-current takeoff operation from lower-current operation at reduced cruise pressure. Experiments progress from bonded flat specimens to wrapped cable prototypes, examining fabrication methods, partial discharge, and dielectric breakdown at atmospheric pressure and pressures down to 18.8 kPa. The results highlight the roles of insulation interfaces, wrapping method, cable geometry, and installation conditions in achieving compact designs with improved electrical performance. Together, these studies provide a development framework linking aircraft requirements to manufacturable prototypes. Predicted current-carrying capability is distinguished from measured insulation performance, and the combined electrical, thermal, mechanical, and endurance evaluations needed for aircraft qualification are identified.

</details>


### [487] [Optimization of a Hybrid Solar-Biogas-Battery Energy Storage Microgrid: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33593)
*John Elomunait,Jesse Thornburg*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文对乌干达索罗提地区的混合可再生能源微电网SIREM进行技术经济优化，证明其在电网接入扩展中的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乌干达东部等低收入地区缺乏可靠电网电力，索罗提地区家庭电网接入率仅16.7%，需要可行的电网扩展方案。

Method: 构建集成聚光太阳能发电与储热、沼气联合循环发电和磷酸铁锂电池储能的混合微电网，使用Xendee优化软件和6年NASA POWER数据进行技术经济优化。

Result: 最优配置为37 MW CSP、70 MWh熔盐储热、5 MW CSP汽轮机、6 MW沼气CCGT和10 MWh电池系统；年供电61.3 GWh，IRR为42.91%，投资回收期2年，发电LCOE为0.1991 USD/kWh，负荷服务LCOE为0.3752 USD/kWh，较纯电网供应节省32.2%，年出口28.8 GWh。

Conclusion: 混合可再生能源微电网在撒哈拉以南非洲的电网扩展中具有可行性。

Abstract: Low-income regions like eastern Uganda often lack reliable grid power. This paper presents the techno-economic optimization of the Soroti Integrated Renewable Energy Microgrid (SIREM), a hybrid renewable system for grid-access expansion where Soroti District household grid access stands at 16.7\%. The microgrid integrates concentrating solar power (CSP) with thermal storage, biogas combined cycle generation, and lithium iron phosphate battery storage. Using Xendee optimization software with six years of NASA POWER data, the optimal configuration comprises a 37 MW CSP field, 70 MWh molten-salt storage, a 5 MW CSP turbine, a 6 MW biogas CCGT, and a 10 MWh battery system. The design delivers 61.3 GWh annually with a 42.91% IRR, 2-year payback, and levelized cost of electricity of 0.1991 USD/kWh generation (0.3752 USD/kWh load-served), achieving 32.2% total savings versus grid-only supply while exporting 28.8 GWh annually, demonstrating the viability of hybrid renewable microgrids for grid expansion in sub-Saharan Africa.

</details>


### [488] [Impact of the Performance of Autonomy and Communication Subsystems on the Level-of-Safety of Partially Autonomous Machine Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33629)
*Yutian Pang,John-Paul Clarke*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文建立解析模型，将部分自主机器系统的安全水平表示为自主子系统与通信子系统联合性能的函数，并给出平均干预间隔MTBI与通信可用性之间的帕累托权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估常将自主子系统和通信子系统独立评价，但系统整体安全取决于二者联合表现，尤其是人类干预能否在时限内完成。

Method: 用MTBI、紧迫度U、复杂度C描述自主子系统，用可用性P_A和延迟ε描述通信子系统；定义临界比ρ=(C+ε)/U，在指数时间假设下推导闭式安全模型及恒定安全水平下MTBI-P_A权衡，并给出远程驾驶飞机示例和参数估计仿真流程。

Result: ρ决定权衡形状：ρ=0.01时完美链路可将所需MTBI降低两个数量级；ρ=1时仅减半。模型可在选定保障等级下表述安全预算合规性。

Conclusion: 联合建模能更准确刻画部分自主系统安全并指导自主性与通信性能协同设计；可通过仿真估计参数并用于安全预算评估。

Abstract: The level-of-safety of a partially autonomous machine system depends on two subsystems: the autonomy subsystem that manages the system between human interventions; and the communication subsystem that enables those interventions. These subsystems are typically evaluated independently. We model the level-of-safety analytically as a function of their joint performance. Three parameters characterize the autonomy subsystem: the Mean Time Between Interventions (MTBI); the urgency $\mathcal{U}$ or mean time within which an intervention must be completed to avoid failure; and the complexity $\mathcal{C}$ or mean time to understand, decide on and execute it. Two characterize the communication subsystem: its availability $P_A$ and its latency $\varepsilon$. A dimensionless criticality ratio $ρ=(\mathcal{C}+\varepsilon)/\mathcal{U}$ prescribes the shape of the Pareto tradeoff between the MTBI and $P_A$ at a constant level-of-safety. At $ρ=0.01$, a perfect link lowers the required MTBI by two orders of magnitude. At $ρ=1$, it only halves it. Under exponential timing assumptions the model is in closed form, and compliance with a safety budget can be stated at a chosen assurance level. We illustrate it for remotely piloted aircraft with assumed parameter values and propose a simulation procedure to estimate them.

</details>


### [489] [Online Identification Can Replace a Floor-Plan Prior on Unseen Buildings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33656)
*Elias T. -H. Shieh,Chun Fu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需目标建筑运行数据、无需逐楼调参的通用HVAC控制策略：利用楼层平面图先验初始化每个区域的一阶灰箱模型，并通过在线辨识和规划器生成控制指令，在多个仿真场景中显著优于PID和ASHRAE Guideline 36基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Smart Buildings Challenge要求仅凭建筑元数据和传感器流，对未见过的办公楼与天气运行同一套HVAC控制策略。研究动机是解决新建筑缺少运行数据、难以逐楼调参的问题，并探索楼层平面图先验与在线自适应能否替代建筑特定数据。

Method: 每个区域使用一阶灰箱模型，初始系数由楼层平面图计算，并用递归最小二乘在线更新；由规划器和闭式映射将模型转化为设备指令。控制器无目标建筑预运行数据，仅有少量在开发场景设定的全局常数。评估包括生成的验证集、真实年份天气的压力集、固定后一次性评分的留出集，并与PID、ASHRAE Guideline 36两种实现比较；还做了消融实验和在BOPTEST第二仿真器上的迁移测试。

Result: 控制器得分为PID基线的0.145、0.159倍，留出集为0.095倍，并在每栋建筑上均有改进。相对ASHRAE Guideline 36，每套场景得分为基础版的0.60至0.71倍、部分调优版的0.83至0.96倍；调优版在54个场景中赢1个。加入5°C防冻目标后，压力集上对调优版优势缩小至1.4%，六栋建筑中一栋差0.2%。消融显示，同时移除楼层平面图先验和在线辨识会在验证、压力、留出集分别损失28%、20%、42%，远大于两个效应之和；任一种建筑特定信息来源可恢复大部分损失。在BOPTEST单层办公楼中结果不迁移：开启辨识时两种先验结果相似，但仅用比赛仿真器拟合常数的楼层平面图先验最不稳定。

Conclusion: 结果表明，楼层平面图初始化的自适应控制可在无运行数据但有图纸的建筑中作为有前景的控制方案，但其跨仿真器泛化性有限，需在真实建筑中进一步验证。

Abstract: The Smart Buildings Challenge asks for one HVAC control policy that runs office buildings and weather it has never seen, from the building's metadata and sensor streams alone. Our controller sees no data from the target building before it runs and is not tuned per building; its few global constants were set on development scenarios. Each zone has a first-order grey-box model that starts from coefficients computed from the floor plan and is updated online by recursive least squares, and a planner and a closed-form mapping turn the models into plant commands. On two sets of buildings and weather that we generated, a validation set and a stress set with real-year weather, it scores 0.145 and 0.159 times the starter kit's PID baseline, and 0.095 times on a holdout built after all versions were fixed and scored once. It improves on every building, also against our two implementations of ASHRAE Guideline 36: per set it scores 0.60 to 0.71 times a basic version and 0.83 to 0.96 times one partly tuned on the public leaderboard, which wins one of 54 scenarios; with a 5 °C frost target for empty zones on both, the margin over the tuned version shrinks to 1.4% on the stress set, where one of six buildings is 0.2% worse. In an ablation on a reduced-order model, removing both the floor-plan prior and online identification costs 28%, 20% and 42% on the validation, stress and holdout sets, far more than the two effects combined: either source of building-specific information recovers most of what is lost without both. On one office floor in a second simulator, BOPTEST, this does not carry over: with identification on, the two priors give similar results, but the floor-plan prior alone, with constants fitted on the competition's simulator, is the least stable arm. These simulation results motivate testing floor-plan-initialised adaptive control in buildings that have drawings but no operating data.

</details>


### [490] [DynaSeek: Large Language Model-Driven Hybrid Dynamic Model Discovery for Grid-Tied Inverters from Limited Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33661)
*Hongwei Zhen,Chao Shen,Jianfeng Niu,Xin Xiang,Wuhua Li,Mingyang Sun*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出DynaSeek，一种由大语言模型驱动的框架，用于从有限端子测量中辨识电流限幅并网逆变器的显式混合微分-代数方程（DAE），以支撑逆变器主导电力系统的大信号稳定性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有辨识方法难以同时处理不可测的内部控制器记忆以及饱和引起的模式切换，仅凭可访问的端子波形难以准确发现逆变器未知控制方程。

Method: DynaSeek结合物理约束的符号骨架合成与联合数值估计：在多孤岛经验档案中同时估计共享模型参数和各记录特定潜初始状态；并建立跨记录状态闭合性和跨窗口一致性两类结构诊断，依据诊断反馈进行变维潜状态扩展及电流限幅/抗积分饱和细化。

Result: 控制器硬件在环（CHIL）实验和闭环系统级仿真表明，DynaSeek相较符号与神经基线将暂态轨迹重构误差降低1至2个数量级，并能准确保持参考临界切除时间。

Conclusion: DynaSeek能够从有限测量中构建统一未饱和调节、电流限幅与故障后恢复的自包含混合DAE，从而在内部控制器不可访问时实现对逆变器的可靠大信号稳定性评估。

Abstract: Discovering the unknown governing equations of grid-tied inverters from limited measurements is essential for the stability analysis of modern inverter-dominated power systems. However, existing identification methods struggle to jointly resolve unmeasured internal control memory and saturation-induced mode transitions from accessible terminal waveforms. To address this challenge, this paper proposes DynaSeek, a large language model (LLM)-driven framework for discovering explicit hybrid differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) of current-limited inverters. The framework integrates physics-constrained symbolic skeleton synthesis with the joint numerical estimation of shared model parameters and record-specific latent initial states across multi-island experience archives. Furthermore, two complementary structural diagnostics evaluating cross-record state closure and cross-window consistency are established to detect structural deficiencies across distinct input histories and transient stages. Guided by diagnostic feedback, DynaSeek directs variable-dimensional latent-state expansion and current-limiting and anti-windup refinement to yield self-contained hybrid DAEs unifying unsaturated regulation, current limiting, and post-fault recovery. Controller-hardware-in-the-loop (CHIL) experiments and closed-loop system-level simulations demonstrate that DynaSeek reduces transient trajectory reconstruction errors by one to two orders of magnitude compared with symbolic and neural baselines while accurately preserving reference critical clearing times, enabling reliable large-signal stability assessment of inverters with inaccessible internal controls.

</details>


### [491] [Shared-Harmonic Characterization and Robust Orientation-Selection Certification for Directional Sensing Under Anisotropic Target Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33737)
*Mingyu Kim,Daniel J. Stilwell,Jorge G. Jimenez*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文研究方向性传感器部署后的朝向问题：何时朝向会显著影响检测，以及历史数据选定的朝向在未来目标运动变化下是否仍可靠。作者提出AID框架，并用AIS船舶交通数据验证其预测能力和稳健性证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方向性传感器常依据历史目标轨迹确定朝向，但部署时未来轨迹不确定；因此需要判断朝向对检测的实际影响，并评估历史选定朝向在未来目标运动偏移下是否仍然可靠。

Method: 提出placement-aware的anisotropy-induced detection（AID）框架，用局部可见目标方向分布与传感器轨迹入射响应共享的谐波模式刻画朝向敏感性，并给出保留谐波朝向响应的精确RMS解释；引入sensor-induced directional discrepancy，推导未来朝向遗憾的条件界，并在未来传感器相关偏移位于给定差异半径内时给出稳健朝向选择的充分证书；使用路易斯安那州Terrebonne Bay附近2025年AIS船舶交通数据验证。

Result: 历史AID与留出集朝向敏感性高度相关（r=0.908）；在四种角度响应宽度下，AID解释朝向敏感性变化的R^2=0.920，而仅目标各向异性为R^2=0.239；在名义阈值下，350个位置中有316个被经验分类为朝向有用，且这些位置在五个留出窗口上均保持高于阈值的增益。

Conclusion: 朝向敏感性由局部目标方向分布与传感器轨迹入射响应共享的谐波模式主导；AID能有效预测留出朝向敏感性，并可通过差异半径下的条件界与充分证书支持稳健朝向选择。

Abstract: Directional sensors are often oriented using historical target trajectories, while future trajectories remain uncertain at deployment. This letter addresses two post-placement questions: i) when orientation materially affects detection and ii) when a historically selected orientation remains reliable under future target-motion shift. We develop a placement-aware framework for anisotropy-induced detection (AID), showing that orientation sensitivity is governed by harmonic modes shared by the locally visible target-direction distribution and the sensor trajectory-incidence response. The resulting AID measure admits an exact RMS interpretation for the retained-harmonic orientation response. We then introduce a sensor-induced directional discrepancy, derive a conditional bound on future orientation regret, and obtain sufficient certificates for robust orientation selection whenever the future sensor-relevant shift lies within a prescribed discrepancy radius. Using 2025 AIS ship-traffic data near Terrebonne Bay, Louisiana, historical AID is strongly correlated with held-out orientation sensitivity ($r=0.908$). Across four angular-response widths, AID explains orientation-sensitivity variation with $R^2=0.920$, compared with $R^2=0.239$ for target-only anisotropy. At the nominal threshold, 316 of 350 locations are empirically classified as orientation-useful, and all retain gain above the threshold across five held-out windows.

</details>


### [492] [Asymptotically Efficient Finite Impulse Response System Identification without Noise Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34039)
*Zichen Liu,Biqiang Mu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对未知或重尾噪声下的有限脉冲响应系统辨识，提出基于核密度估计的自适应非参数最大似然型估计器 eMLE 与 epMLE，并给出一阶牛顿-拉夫森实现，理论上达到渐近有效，仿真中优于 LS 和 LAD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典最小二乘和最小绝对偏差等估计器在噪声分布未知、重尾或含离群值时，要么对异常值敏感，要么统计效率低；因此需要不依赖噪声分布先验知识且渐近有效的估计方法。

Method: 利用核密度估计构造两类非参数最大似然型估计器：估计最大似然估计器 eMLE 和估计剖面最大似然估计器 epMLE；用一致初始估计的残差近似似然，避免参数化噪声假设；并开发计算高效的一步牛顿-拉夫森算法。

Result: 在温和正则条件下，eMLE 和 epMLE 均具有一致性、渐近正态性，并达到 Cramér–Rao 下界，从而实现渐近有效；一步牛顿-拉夫森算法在不损失渐近效率的情况下实现这些估计器；多种噪声分布仿真表明其在鲁棒性和精度上优于 LS 和 LAD，常可匹配 oracle MLE 性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的自适应非参数最大似然型估计方法能够在未知或重尾噪声下实现稳健且渐近有效的 FIR 系统辨识，并为实际计算提供高效实现。

Abstract: Efficient identification of finite impulse response systems under unknown or heavy-tailed noise remains a challenge in system identification. Classical estimators, including least squares (LS) and robust alternatives like least absolute deviations (LAD), are often sensitive to outliers or statistically inefficient when noise characteristics deviate from their underlying assumptions. To address this, we propose a novel class of adaptive estimators that achieves asymptotic efficiency without requiring prior knowledge of the noise distribution. Our approach leverages kernel density estimation to construct two nonparametric maximum likelihood-type estimators: the estimated maximum likelihood estimator (eMLE) and the estimated profiled MLE (epMLE). These estimators approximate the likelihood using residuals from consistent initial estimates, avoiding parametric assumptions on the noise. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that, under mild regularity conditions, both eMLE and epMLE are consistent, asymptotically normal, and attain the Cramér--Rao lower bound, thereby achieving asymptotic efficiency. Additionally, we develop computationally efficient one-step Newton--Raphson algorithms that implement these estimators without sacrificing asymptotic efficiency. Extensive simulations across various noise distributions confirm that the proposed methods outperform classical LS and LAD estimators in both robustness and accuracy, often matching oracle MLE performance.

</details>


### [493] [Passivity Shaping over Frequency Bands: A Differentiable Optimization Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34236)
*Alberto De Luca,Pol Jane-Soneira*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于频带无源指数、广义KYP引理与双层优化的控制器参数整定方法，用于提升变流器主导电网的稳定性，并在跟网型变流器和多变换器微电网两个案例中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源转型用电力电子变流器替代传统惯性同步机，带来新的电网稳定性挑战。无源性为互联电网子系统稳定性评估提供了组合式输入输出框架，但在特定频段内调节控制器以满足无源性要求仍主要依赖工程经验、直觉或试错。

Method: 首先利用广义KYP引理，将任意频带上的无源指数建模为参数化半定规划的最优值；其次通过包络定理推导该最优值对控制器参数的解析灵敏度；最后将这些要素嵌入双层优化框架，以最大化无源指数为目标整定控制器参数。

Result: 在复杂度递增的两个案例中验证了所提方法：跟网型变流器和多变换器微电网。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但表明该优化整定方案可在上述场景中应用。

Conclusion: 该文为特定频段内的无源性控制器整定提供了系统化的优化方法，减少对直觉和试错的依赖，有助于提升变流器主导电网的稳定性分析与设计能力。

Abstract: The energy transition replaces traditional inertial synchronous machines with power electronic converters, introducing new grid stability challenges. Passivity provides a compositional input-output framework for assessing stability in interconnected grid subsystems, yet tuning controllers for this property over specific frequency ranges - a practical requirement in converter-dominated grids - still relies largely on practitioners' experience, typically based on intuition or trial and error. We address this gap in three steps: (i) we formulate the passivity index over arbitrary frequency bands as the optimal value of a parametric Semidefinite Program (SDP) using the generalized KYP (gKYP) lemma; (ii) we derive analytical sensitivities of this optimal value with respect to controller parameters via the Envelope Theorem; and (iii) we embed these elements in a bilevel optimization scheme that tunes controller parameters to maximize the passivity index. We validate the proposed method on two case studies of increasing complexity: a grid-following converter and a multi-converter microgrid.

</details>


### [494] [On the Grouping-based RIS-aided Multi-user Networks: A Graph Theoretic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34243)
*Udit Raj,Priyadarshi Mukherjee*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出一个基于图论的框架，用于分组式可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的多用户无线网络中的RIS-用户关联问题，并研究理想与实际相移模型下最优关联的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在RIS辅助多用户网络中，RIS-用户关联对性能至关重要；但实际RIS相移模型与理想模型存在差异，可能导致基于理想模型得到的最优关联在实际场景中不再最优，因此需要分析两者一致性的条件。

Method: 将RIS-用户关联建模为图匹配问题，分别考虑理想RIS相移模型和实际RIS相移模型；推导保证理想RIS下最优RIS-用户关联在实际RIS场景中仍唯一最优的条件，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证。

Result: 给出了使理想RIS模型下的最优RIS-用户关联在实际RIS模型下仍保持唯一最优的条件，且大量蒙特卡洛仿真验证了所提框架的重要性。

Conclusion: 所提出的图论框架能够有效刻画和保证分组式RIS辅助多用户网络中的RIS-用户关联，并为理想与实际相移模型之间的最优关联一致性提供理论条件。

Abstract: In this letter, we propose a graph theoretic framework for grouping-based reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-aided multi-user wireless networks. By considering both the ideal as well as the practical RIS-based phase shift models, the aspect of the RIS-user association is formulated as a graph matching problem. Thereafter, we derive conditions, which on satisfying, guarantee that the ideal RIS-based optimal RIS-user association remains uniquely optimal even in the practical RIS-based scenario. Finally, extensive Monte Carlo simulations validate the importance of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [495] [MIMOS: A Toolbox for Multivariable Modal Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34390)
*M. van der Hulst,R. A. González,K. Classens,P. Tacx,N. Dirkx,J. van de Wijdeven,T. Oomen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了开源MATLAB工具箱MIMOS，用于从多变量频率响应函数中辨识物理模态模型，并在振动隔离基准和晶圆台原型上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂多变量系统的分析与控制需要准确且具有物理可解释性的模型。

Method: MIMOS采用两阶段方法：首先从实测频率响应估计加性输入输出模型，然后通过信息加权投影恢复物理模态结构；工具箱集成了频率响应预处理、交互式模态初始化与细化，并支持比例阻尼和一般粘性阻尼。

Result: 在公开的6×8振动隔离基准和7×17晶圆台原型上的实验表明，MIMOS能够处理涉及数千个参数的辨识问题，并估计出准确的最小阶物理模态模型。

Conclusion: MIMOS为多变量模态系统辨识提供了一种实用且可扩展的工作流程，能够有效获得准确的物理模态模型。

Abstract: Accurate and physically interpretable models are essential for the analysis and control of complex multivariable systems. This paper presents the Multivariable Identification of Modal Optical and mechatronic Systems (MIMOS) toolbox, an open-source MATLAB toolbox for identifying physical modal models from measured multivariable frequency response functions. The two-stage approach first estimates an additive input-output model from measured frequency responses and subsequently recovers the physical modal structure through information-weighted projection. MIMOS implements this approach in a practical and scalable workflow combining frequency response preprocessing, interactive modal initialization and refinement, and support for proportional and general viscous damping. Experimental results on a publicly available $6\times8$ vibration isolation benchmark and a $7\times17$ prototype wafer stage demonstrate the capability of MIMOS to effectively handle identification problems involving thousands of parameters and estimate accurate, minimal-order physical modal models.

</details>


### [496] [Passive Fault-Tolerant Antenna Stabilisation for Ship-to-Shore Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34411)
*Antoine Thibault Vié,Mikkel Reinholdt Hansen,Roberto Galeazzi,Dimitrios Papageorgiou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出一种被动容错控制方案，将天线安装在船载六自由度机械臂上，通过多屏障自适应超螺旋滑模控制同时实现天线对准和高度调节，提高船岸定向通信链路的指向与升沉补偿精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 船岸定向无线电链路需要天线持续对准岸站，但船舶升沉会改变天线离海面高度，进而改变多径干扰和接收功率。传统稳定云台虽能进行姿态补偿，却很少考虑容错能力。

Method: 采用被动容错控制，将天线安装于船载六自由度机械臂，以同时调节对准和天线高度；通过反馈线性化将机械臂动力学解耦为受扰动积分器；每个通道采用多屏障自适应超螺旋滑模控制器，并将嵌套屏障与容错控制性能区域关联，以处理离散时间实现中的采样间屏障穿越。

Result: 仿真条件下，该方案相比单屏障设计获得更优的指向精度和升沉补偿精度；单屏障设计往往在精度或约束保持方面存在妥协。

Conclusion: 所提方案能够在离散实现和故障条件下实现性能的平滑退化而非约束丢失，为船载定向天线对准与升沉补偿提供了一种具有容错能力的控制方法。

Abstract: Directional ship-to-shore radio links require continuous antenna alignment with the shore station, while vessel heave induces variations in antenna height above the sea surface, thereby altering the multipath interference governing the received power. In conventional stabilised gimbals, attitude compensation is provided, whereas fault tolerance is rarely considered. To address these limitations, a passive fault-tolerant control scheme is proposed, whereby the antenna is mounted on a ship-mounted six-degree-of-freedom manipulator, enabling simultaneous regulation alignment and antenna height. Through feedback linearisation, the manipulator dynamics are decoupled into perturbed integrators, each controlled by a multi-barrier adaptive super-twisting sliding-mode controller. The nested barriers are associated with the performance regions of fault-tolerant control, such that inter-sample barrier crossings under discrete-time implementation lead to graceful performance degradation rather than loss of confinement. Under simulated conditions, superior pointing and heave accuracy is achieved compared with single-barrier designs, for which either precision or confinement is compromised.

</details>


### [497] [Travelling-Wave-Based Protection of DC Hubs in Bipolar HVDC Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34445)
*Rahul Rane,Victor Daniel Reyes Dreke,Wilhelm Winter,Aleksandra Lekić*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于平稳小波变换的直流故障检测与分类方法，用于含专用金属回线的三端双极MMC-HVDC系统，并通过RTDS硬件在环平台验证实时可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三端双极MMC-HVDC系统含直流开关站和互联直流断路器，需可靠、快速地检测直流故障并区分极对极、极对地及极对金属回线故障，以支撑直流保护与断路器动作。

Method: 利用线模电压的小波细节能量进行故障检测；利用极电压和金属回线电流的小波细节能量进行故障分类；在集成RTDS与嵌入式处理硬件的实时HIL平台上，针对不同故障类型、电阻和位置的母线与电缆故障进行验证。

Result: 结果表明该方法具备实时实现可行性，并刻画了故障位置和行波传播对暂态能量及保护响应时间的影响；同时评估了极电压与金属回线电流细节能量特征在区分故障类型方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于SWT的故障检测与分类方法可用于三端双极MMC-HVDC系统直流保护，能够区分主要直流故障类型并满足实时硬件在环实现要求。

Abstract: This paper presents a stationary wavelet transform (SWT)-based method for DC fault detection and classification in a three-terminal bipolar modular multilevel converter (MMC)-based HVDC system with a dedicated metallic return (DMR). The system incorporates DC switching stations (DCSSs) with interconnected DC circuit breakers (DCCBs). The method uses line-mode voltage wavelet detail energy for fault detection and wavelet detail energy derived from pole voltages and DMR current for fault classification, distinguishing pole-to-pole, pole-to-ground, and pole-to-DMR faults. Its performance is evaluated using a real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) platform integrating an real-time digital simulator (RTDS) with embedded processing hardware. Busbar and cable faults with varying fault types, resistances, and locations are investigated. The results demonstrate the feasibility of real-time implementation and characterize the effects of fault location and travelling-wave propagation on transient energy and protection response time. The effectiveness of pole-voltage and DMR-current detail energy features in distinguishing fault types is also evaluated.

</details>


### [498] [Decentralized Control Barrier Function Filters for Frequency Containment With Inverters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34558)
*Damola Ajeyemi,Emiliano Dall'Anese*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文为输电系统中的跟网型（GFL）逆变器设计安全滤波器，通过补充一次调频来约束发电-需求不平衡后的频率最低点和最高点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的理想滤波器需要集中式和模型化计算，难以在实际逆变器中实施，因此需要可分布式部署的安全滤波方案。

Method: 采用简化机电模型和CBF构造理想凸二次规划（QP）滤波器，使可接受频率集合前向不变；随后利用对偶近端形式和双时间尺度实现，得到可在各逆变器本地运行、仅依赖局部频率和频率变化率（RoCoF）估计的分散动态滤波器，并推导其与理想CBF滤波器状态轨迹距离的界。

Result: 所推导的界量化了滤波器时间常数、初始化、负荷变化和频率估计误差的影响，并可估计可能的频率越限；在IEEE 39节点系统的高保真电磁暂态（EMT）模型中验证了方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的分散动态安全滤波器能够在仅使用局部信息的情况下逼近理想CBF滤波器的频率约束效果，并为实际部署中的误差和越限风险提供量化评估。

Abstract: This paper addresses the design of safety filters for grid-following (GFL) inverters in power transmission systems. The goal of the filters is to constrain frequency nadir and zenith following generation-demand imbalances, by supplementing primary frequency control. Using a reduced electromechanical model and control barrier functions (CBFs), we define an ideal filter through a convex quadratic program (QP). The ideal QP filter renders the set of admissible frequencies forward invariant; however, its direct implementation is impractical, as it requires centralized implementation and model-based computation. We then use a dual proximal formulation and a two-time-scale implementation to obtain decentralized dynamic filters that can be implemented at each inverter and use only local frequency and rate-of-change-of-frequency estimates. To assess the performance and the ability to regulate frequency, we derive bounds on the distance between state trajectories under the dynamic and ideal CBF filters. The bounds quantify the effects of the filter time constant, initialization, load variation, and frequency estimation errors, and provide estimates of possible frequency-limit violations. We validate the proposed method on the IEEE 39-bus system using a high-fidelity electromagnetic-transient (EMT) model.

</details>


### [499] [Grey-Box Experimental Identification of Reduced-Order Models for Grid-Forming Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34566)
*Marcelo Cardenas,Stephan Kenzelmann,Matteo Saviozzi,Federico Silvestro,Fabrizio Sossan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种灰盒系统辨识方法，用于辨识和验证构网型变流器的降阶模型，并在统一流程下比较三种降阶技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构网型变流器需要可靠的降阶模型，但时域拟合最优的模型未必能准确反映小信号稳定性所需的模态特性，因此需要比较不同降阶辨识方法的综合表现。

Method: 采用灰盒系统辨识框架，在统一辨识流程下比较三种降阶方法：带频率截断和参与因子的奇异摄动法（SP-PF）、基于能量残差的奇异摄动法（SP-Energy）以及平衡截断法（BT），并使用实际组件的实验数据进行验证。

Result: BT的时域拟合效果最好，其次为SP-Energy和SP-PF；SP-Energy更能保留辨识所得全阶模型的关键性质；BT使主导模态最接近稳定边界且对参数变化最敏感；SP-Energy在拟合质量和模态保留一致性上优于SP-PF。

Conclusion: 时域拟合最好的模型不一定能最可靠地表征小信号稳定性的模态特性；在本案例中，SP-Energy在精度、物理可解释性和模态保留之间提供了最佳折中。

Abstract: This paper proposes a grey-box system identification for identifying and validating reduced-order models (ROMs) of grid-forming (GFM) converters. Three reduced-order modeling techniques are compared within a common identification procedure: singular perturbation with frequency cutoff and participation factors (SP-PF), singular perturbation with energy residuals (SP-Energy), and balanced truncation (BT). Testing is on experimental data with real-life components. Results show that BT achieves the highest time-domain fit, followed by SP-Energy and SP-PF; SP-Energy better preserves key properties of the identified full-order model; BT places the dominant mode closest to the stability boundary and exhibits the highest sensitivity to parameter variations; SP-Energy outperforms SP-PF in both fit quality and consistency of modal preservation. Findings suggest that the model with the best time-domain fit does not always provide the most reliable representation of the modal properties for small-signal stability, with SP-Energy offering the best compromise between accuracy, physical interpretability, and modal preservation for the considered case study.

</details>


### [500] [Gaussian Processes for Optimal Space-Filling Input Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34712)
*Máté Kiss,Yuhan Liu,Maarten Schoukens,Roland Tóth*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯过程的空间填充输入设计方法，用于非线性系统辨识实验设计，使激励信号在模型参数空间中更均匀分布，从而提升模型泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统辨识所得模型质量高度依赖实验数据质量；非线性系统辨识对建模误差和外推误差敏感，因此需要设计能充分覆盖关注运行范围的实验输入。

Method: 采用基于高斯过程的空间填充输入设计策略，在非线性逼近器的参数空间内实现空间填充分布；并将该方法与实验设计最优性理论（V-最优和D-最优设计）相联系，以根据实验目标调节信号的信息含量。

Result: 仿真实验表明，与传统非空间填充实验相比，使用空间填充信号训练得到的模型在关注区域内具有更好的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 空间填充输入设计可改善非线性系统辨识模型的泛化能力，并且通过与V-和D-最优设计理论结合，能够针对实验目标定制激励信号以最大化信息内容。

Abstract: The quality of a model resulting from (black-box) system identification is highly dependent on the quality of the data that is used during the identification procedure. As nonlinear system identification is sensitive to modeling and extrapolation errors, having experiments that explore the considered operation range of interest are of high importance. The Gaussian-Process based space-filling input design strategy introduces an experiment design technique that aims to achieve a space-filling distribution within the argument space of a (nonlinear) approximator used for modeling the true system. Experiments carried out on simulation examples show that models trained with space-filling signals generalize better over the region of interest compared to models obtained from non-space-filling experiments. Moreover, the method is connected to the optimality theory of experiment design (V- and D-optimal design), allowing the experimenter to tailor the designed space-filling signal to maximize its information content with respect to the experiment objective.

</details>


### [501] [Azimuth Pointing and Momentum Management for a Lightweight High-Altitude Balloon Payload](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34817)
*Yorgo Abou Haidar,James Richard Forbes,Andrew Higgins,Benedetto D'Agnillo,Justin Albert*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: ALTAIR项目用高空气球搭载积分球作为人工校准星，为地面望远镜提供光度校准；本文提出并验证一种保持积分球出光口方位指向精度的姿态控制架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 积分球出光口近似朗伯分布，为使地面望远镜接收的光强与出光口法线方向差异小于1%，载荷方位需保持在望远镜视线±8°以内，并至少连续维持30秒。

Method: 采用被动稳定、机载姿态确定和动量轮主动方位控制，并通过飞行架枢轴处的第二电机进行动量卸载；碳纤维惯性臂抑制偏轴摆动。姿态由速率陀螺、加速度计、磁强计和双天线GNSS载波相位融合确定。还使用包含电机动态与限幅、传感器噪声及飞行数据风扰的高保真仿真进行执行机构选型和控制环调参，并开展地面测试、仿真和两次飞行试验。

Result: 仅使用动量轮时，上升段记录到53个30秒区间满足方位指向在目标±8°以内，均方根误差为3.7°；最长连续窗口为7分55秒，指向RMSE为5°。仿真结果表明，增加枢轴电机进行动量管理可显著提升性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的指向架构可通过地面测试、仿真和飞行试验验证，动量轮单独控制已能实现多次30秒±8°指向保持；加入枢轴电机有望进一步改善动量管理和指向性能。

Abstract: The ALTAIR (Airborne Laser for Telescopic Atmospheric Interference Reduction) project provides photometric calibration for ground-based telescopes by flying an integrating sphere as an artificial star-like calibration source on a high-altitude balloon. Because the angular distribution of light from the exit port of the sphere is approximately Lambertian, the payload must keep its azimuth within $\pm8^\circ$ of the telescope line of sight. This condition bounds the fractional difference in light intensity from that along the exit-port normal to below 1%. The bound must be held for at least 30 s at a time. This paper presents a pointing architecture that combines passive stabilization, onboard attitude determination, and active azimuth control using a momentum wheel, with active desaturation through a second motor at the flight-train pivot. Carbon-fiber inertial booms reduce off-axis pendulating motion sufficiently for azimuth control to be treated independently. Attitude is determined by onboard fusion of rate gyro, accelerometer, magnetometer, and dual-antenna GNSS carrier-phase measurements. A high-fidelity simulation of the payload, including motor dynamics and limits, sensor noise, and wind disturbances generated from flight data, is used to size actuators and tune the control loops. The payload avionics, flight software, power management, controls, and real-time ground telemetry systems are developed in-house. The system is evaluated through ground testing, simulation, and two flights. With the momentum wheel alone, 53 intervals of 30 s pointing within $\pm8^\circ$ of the target azimuth are recorded during ascent, with a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of $3.7^\circ$, and the longest uninterrupted window lasts 7 min 55 s with $5^\circ$ of pointing RMSE. Simulation results suggest significant performance improvements from adding a pivot motor for momentum management.

</details>


### [502] [Adaptive Control Barrier Functions for Nonlinear Singularly Perturbed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34866)
*Prashanth Krishnamurthy,Farshad Khorrami*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对具有奇异摄动和参数不确定性的非线性系统，提出自适应控制屏障函数（CBF）框架，以同时保障慢子系统和快子系统的动态安全约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBF 是施加动态安全约束的灵活高效方法，但现有工作难以处理同时具有奇异摄动和参数不确定性的非线性系统，因此需要发展自适应 CBF 框架。

Method: 先针对慢子系统建立鲁棒性性质：若慢 CBF 条件带安全裕度满足，则对足够小奇异摄动参数 ε，慢子系统保持在安全集的 O(ε) 邻域内。随后给出快慢联合安全的条件，利用在线参数估计评估降阶慢模型及快慢 CBF 条件，并通过状态相关鲁棒裕度处理估计模型与真实降阶模型间的参数失配。

Result: 论文给出了慢子系统安全和快慢联合安全的理论条件，并通过两个参数不确定性系统仿真验证框架：一个合成二阶时间尺度四阶系统和带快速转向率执行器及避障约束的单轮车。

Conclusion: 所提出的自适应 CBF 框架能够在存在参数不确定性和奇异摄动的情况下保障慢子系统及快慢联合系统的安全约束。

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) have emerged as a flexible and efficient approach for enforcing dynamic safety constraints. In this paper, we consider a class of uncertain nonlinear systems with singular perturbations and develop an adaptive CBF framework for such systems to enforce safety constraints on both the slow and fast subsystems in the overall singularly perturbed nonlinear system with uncertain parameters. We first develop a robustness property showing that if an adaptive controller for the slow subsystem satisfies the slow CBF condition with an appropriate safety margin, then for sufficiently small values of the singular perturbation parameter $\varepsilon$, the slow subsystem remains within an $O(\varepsilon)$-neighborhood of its safe set. We then consider the more general case of safety constraints on both the fast and slow subsystems and provide conditions under which joint slow-fast safety is achieved despite the parametric uncertainties. The reduced-order slow model and the slow and fast CBF conditions are evaluated using an online parameter estimate and the parameter mismatch between the estimated and true reduced-order models is addressed via a state-dependent robustness margin in the CBF inequalities. To illustrate the proposed framework, we present simulation studies for two systems with parametric uncertainties: a synthetic two-time-scale fourth-order example system and a unicycle with a fast turn-rate actuator and an obstacle avoidance safety constraint.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [503] [Partitioning and Merging in Phase Unwrapping: A Systematic Review of Methods and Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33194)
*Antoine Moevus,Max Mignotte*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文系统综述了二维图像和三维体数据中分区式相位解缠方法，重点梳理单元构建方式和合并策略，并基于PRISMA 2020纳入149项研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相位解缠广泛用于雷达干涉、磁共振成像和光学计量；当图像过大或难以整体解缠时，许多方法会将其分区处理，但此前缺乏对这些分区方法的系统综述。

Method: 遵循PRISMA 2020，检索OpenAlex、IEEE Xplore、Web of Science和Scopus四个数据库（2026年10月1日），从1800条记录去重、筛题摘、补充引文检索并阅读298篇全文，最终纳入1987—2026年的149项研究；归纳单元构建方式（固定瓦片、自适应瓦片、数据驱动区域、采集 imposed 子孔径/切片/场景等）及四类合并方式（各单元解缠后合并、按无跳变区域整数合并、求解过程中合并、外部参考合并）。

Result: 综述明确了单元构建与合并是两个独立决策；合并规则决定合并相位是否与实测相位保持一致；多数测试同时改变两个决策，难以判断各自贡献。研究还提出支持内存、速度或精度主张时应报告的内容。

Conclusion: 该综述旨在记录和分类分区式相位解缠方法而非进行排名；强调需区分单元构建与合并策略并规范实验报告。该综述未注册，也未获得特定资助。

Abstract: Phase unwrapping underlies radar interferometry, magnetic resonance imaging and optical metrology. When an image is too large or too difficult to unwrap in one piece, many methods cut it into units, unwrap each unit, and merge the results. To our knowledge, no systematic review had brought these partitioned methods together. This review gathers them, for two-dimensional images and three-dimensional volumes. It describes how the units are built: fixed tiles, adaptive tiles, regions computed from the data, or pieces imposed by the acquisition, such as subapertures, slices and scenes. It then classifies how the units are merged, in four classes: after each unit is unwrapped, through one integer per jump-free region, during the solve, or through an external reference. Three findings stand out: building the units and merging them are two separate decisions; the merging rule decides whether the merged phase stays congruent with the measured one; and most tests change both decisions at once, so few results show which one helps. We state what a study can report to support a claim on memory, speed or accuracy. Our aim is to document the methods, not to rank them. Following PRISMA 2020, four bibliographic databases (OpenAlex, IEEE Xplore, Web of Science and Scopus), searched on 1 October 2026, returned 1,800 records. After removing duplicates, screening titles and abstracts, adding a citation search and reading 298 full texts, we included 149 studies, published from 1987 to 2026. The review was not registered and received no specific funding.

</details>


### [504] [Diagnostically Meaningful, Privacy-aware Synthetic Chest CT via Class-Conditional Latent Sampling in Diffusion Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33234)
*Johannes B. Thalhammer,Kacper Ogórek,Tina Dorosti,Sebastian Peterhansl,Daniel Frey,Zijin Huang,Theresa Hiu,Tobias Lasser,Daniela Pfeiffer,Franz Pfeiffer,Florian Schaff*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种基于扩散自编码器的类条件合成胸部CT生成框架，并加入潜在空间距离过滤以降低复制训练样本的风险；合成的肺栓塞CT图像在诊断分类任务中接近真实数据表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学AI发展依赖大规模标注数据，但隐私法规限制数据共享；合成医学图像若能在降低患者数据泄露风险的同时保留诊断信息，可能缓解这一限制。

Method: 在公开RSNA 2020肺栓塞数据集上训练扩散自编码器，通过类特定核密度估计采样潜在表示生成PE阳性和阴性图像，并拒绝潜在空间最近邻距离低于阈值的样本；用真实、合成及真实-合成混合数据分别训练ResNet-50分类器，进行10次独立运行，并在留出真实测试集上用AUC和DeLong 95%置信区间评估。

Result: 合成数据训练模型AUC为0.862（95% CI, 0.851-0.874），略低于真实数据模型AUC=0.872（95% CI, 0.861-0.883）和混合数据模型AUC=0.865（95% CI, 0.855-0.876）；差异有统计学意义（p<0.05）但绝对差异较小。对38,000张合成切片的最近邻复制检测未发现真实训练图像的直接复制。

Conclusion: 合成CT图像保留了用于图像级肺栓塞分类的诊断相关信息，同时采取了增强隐私意识和降低与真实患者数据相似度的措施。

Abstract: Large, well-annotated datasets are essential for developing medical artificial intelligence models, yet data sharing is often restricted by privacy regulations. Synthetic images may help address this limitation if they preserve diagnostic information while reducing the risk of reproducing patient data. We developed a diffusion autoencoder-based framework for class-conditional synthetic chest CT generation that incorporates latent-space distance filtering to reduce the likelihood of regenerating training samples.
  A diffusion autoencoder was trained on the public RSNA 2020 Pulmonary Embolism (PE) dataset. PE-positive and PE-negative images were synthesized by sampling latent representations from class-specific kernel density estimates. Samples with a nearest-neighbor latent-space distance below a predefined threshold were rejected. To assess diagnostic utility, ResNet-50 classifiers were trained across 10 independent runs using real, synthetic, or mixed real-synthetic datasets. Performance was evaluated on a held-out real test set using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), with DeLong 95% confidence intervals (CIs).
  Models trained on synthetic data achieved an AUC of 0.862 (95% CI, 0.851-0.874), only slightly lower than models trained on real data (AUC = 0.872, 95% CI, 0.861-0.883) and mixed real-synthetic data (AUC = 0.865, 95% CI, 0.855-0.876). These differences were statistically significant (p < 0.05) but small in absolute terms. A nearest-neighbor copy-detection analysis of 38,000 synthetic slices found no direct copies of real training images.
  These findings indicate that the synthetic CT images preserve diagnostically meaningful information for image-level PE classification while incorporating measures intended to enhance privacy awareness and reduce similarity to real patient data.

</details>


### [505] [Conformal Risk Control for Sentinel-1 Flood Maps under Event Shift and Local Recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33235)
*Izzath Nisfer,Rahim Iqbal,Shazan Shaheed,Asfi Ahamed,Muhammadu Ilham,Dileesha Manamperi,Thimira Sahan,Sandareka Wickramanayake*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文考察在双时相Sentinel-1洪水制图中，保形风险控制（CRC）阈值在限制漏报风险与控制映射面积之间的权衡，并评估其在不同事件和地区间的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CRC可在可交换性假设下限制漏报有标注正样本的风险，但过低的漏报风险可能导致洪水映射面积过大；作者希望量化该权衡并检验跨事件阈值校准的可行性。

Method: 使用冻结的双时相Sentinel-1预测器、403个专家标注来源组，并进行十次可评估的留一事件交叉验证；比较源域校准阈值与局部重新校准，报告组损失、超额预测面积、达到风险目标的事件频率及不同标注组数量下的结果。

Result: 目标风险0.10时，索马里平均组损失为0.1726，尼日利亚（四组）为0.1985；其余八个折选择零阈值并将所有有效像元标为洪水，超额预测面积为标注正面积的3.15–20.55倍。559/570次计划划分可局部重校准；十个标注组时正阈值达到观测风险目标的事件频率为0.95%，二十个组为8.00%；五十个组时巴拉圭24/30次探索性重校准同时满足条件，而印度和美国均无。

Conclusion: 结果表明漏报风险应结合映射面积、校准可行性和事件特异性结果共同报告；由于标签包含永久水体，损失未单独隔离新淹没土地，跨区域阈值校准仍面临显著挑战。

Abstract: Conformal Risk Control (CRC) selects a threshold to limit missed labeled positives under exchangeability, but low omission risk can come at the cost of an excessively large flood map. We examine this trade-off with a frozen bi-temporal Sentinel-1 predictor, 403 expert-labeled source groups, and ten evaluable leave-one-event-out folds. At a target risk of 0.10, source-calibrated thresholds produce mean group losses of 0.1726 in Somalia and 0.1985 in Nigeria (four groups). The other eight folds select zero thresholds, labeling every valid pixel as flooded; their excess predicted area is 3.15-20.55 times the labeled positive area. Local threshold recalibration is feasible in 559 of 570 scheduled splits. The equal-event frequency of meeting the observed risk target with a positive threshold is 0.95% at ten labeled groups and 8.00% at twenty, using different predefined event pools. At fifty groups, exploratory recalibration meets both conditions in 24/30 Paraguay splits and none in India or the United States. Labels include permanent water, so the loss does not isolate newly flooded land. The results show why omission risk should be reported alongside mapped area, calibration feasibility, and event-specific outcomes.

</details>


### [506] [NeuroRefine: Six-Head MLP Content Conditioning and Qwen Refinement for Faithful fMRI Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33309)
*Runqi Xu,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 论文提出NeuroRefine：用fMRI导出的低层图像直接条件化精修过程，并通过六个单隐层MLP头预测内容提示，引导冻结的Qwen-Image-Edit-2511模型重建所见图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Brain-IT流程的低层分支能较好勾勒轮廓，但后续扩散模型经常错误生成颜色、物体身份和布局，存在有损瓶颈。

Method: 以fMRI导出的低层图像作为条件，使用六个MLP头分别预测场景、主体类别、数量、颜色、物体和布局提示，指导冻结的Qwen-Image-Edit-2511；在930个NSD共享概念上用Brain-IT指标评估，并分离低层与语义因素，追踪提示头的皮层来源、因果损伤和fMRI噪声上限。

Result: NeuroRefine的CLIP图像余弦为0.755，高于Brain-IT enhanced的0.735，图像更锐利，2-way识别不变；布局一致性从0.638降至0.541，以换取语义保真和纹理。标准评估面板具有多因素性，高PixCorr可与完全不同内容共存。

Conclusion: 低层图像提供的是显式空间先验而非无损布局；精修在语义保真和纹理上更优，但会牺牲部分布局一致性。应分别解读低层和语义因素，方向误差留待未来工作。

Abstract: Reconstructing seen images from fMRI has advanced through diffusion models, but the current state-of-the-art Brain-IT pipeline still has a lossy bottleneck: its low-level branch outlines the figure well, yet the diffusion model that follows frequently mispaints colour, object identity and layout. We move one step backward and condition the refiner directly on the fMRI-derived low-level image, using six one-hidden-layer MLP heads (scene, main-subject category, count, colour, object, layout) to predict the content prompt that guides a frozen Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model. On the 930 shared NSD concepts, scored with Brain-IT's own metric code on the same ground truth, NeuroRefine reaches a CLIP image cosine of 0.755 against 0.735 for Brain-IT enhanced and produces markedly sharper images, while the saturated 2-way identification is unchanged. The low-level image supplies an explicit spatial prior rather than a lossless layout: refinement trades some layout agreement (0.541 against 0.638) for semantic fidelity and texture. We then show that the standard panel is multi-factor: a high PixCorr can coexist with completely different content, so we read the low-level and semantic factors separately and quantify where they disagree. Finally, we trace the cortical sources of the prompt heads across subjects and report their causal lesion profile and the fMRI noise ceiling. Direction errors are left to future work.

</details>


### [507] [PICE: Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution Toward Self-Evolving Medical Image Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33626)
*Yifan Zhu,Jie Xu,Zeju Li,Yi Guo,Yuanyuan Wang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文提出PICE框架，用于在无法访问历史影像数据的情况下，让医学图像分类器持续适应新疾病类别，同时保留旧知识并控制参数增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床中的医学图像分类器需要不断纳入新疾病类别，但隐私和数据共享限制导致历史患者数据不可用；同时，为每个新任务单独增加容量会造成模型线性增长。因此需要在不保留历史图像的前提下保留旧病种知识，并仅在必要时扩展模型容量。

Method: PICE围绕“保留什么、何时演化、如何演化”设计：用原型统计记忆保存既往疾病知识；对新任务评估其与记忆重建的历史参考的兼容性，兼容时复用最接近的适配器，不兼容时新建适配器；通过更新记忆并用高斯伪特征重校准统一分类器来完成演化；推理时用记忆相似性指导任务无关的适配器选择与融合，从而覆盖所有已学疾病类别。

Result: 在Skin8、Kvasir-V2和Path16上的实验验证了PICE的有效性。Skin8上新任务准确率较SOTA提升7.60%，旧任务保持71.10%准确率，同时额外可学习参数减少18.51%。

Conclusion: PICE能够在无需访问历史图像的情况下，兼顾知识保留、新任务适应和参数增长控制，支持医学图像分类器随新诊断类别出现而持续演化。

Abstract: Medical image classifiers in clinical practice must continually evolve to accommodate emerging disease categories while maintaining reliable classification of existing conditions. This is challenging because privacy and data-sharing restrictions limit access to historical patient data, while assigning dedicated capacity to each new diagnostic task causes linear model growth. Effective evolution requires preserving prior disease knowledge without retaining historical images while expanding model capacity only when necessary. To this end, we propose PICE, a Prototype-Informed Conditional Model Evolution framework organized around what to preserve, when evolution is needed, and how that evolution is realized. PICE preserves prior disease knowledge in a prototype-statistical memory. For each incoming task, it assesses compatibility with historical references reconstructed from memory, reusing the closest adapter when compatibility is sufficient and instantiating a new one when evolution is required. PICE then realizes evolution by updating the memory and recalibrating the unified classifier with Gaussian pseudo features, thereby integrating new knowledge into the cumulative diagnostic space. During inference, memory-derived similarities guide task-agnostic adapter selection and fusion, enabling prediction over all learned disease categories. Experiments on Skin8, Kvasir-V2, and Path16 demonstrate the effectiveness of PICE across diverse clinical scenarios. On Skin8, PICE achieves a 7.60\% improvement in accuracy over the SOTA method on new tasks, while maintaining 71.10\% accuracy on previous tasks. It also reduces additional learnable parameters by 18.51\%. These results indicate that PICE improves classification while balancing knowledge retention, adaptation, and parameter growth, supporting continual model evolution as new diagnostic categories emerge without access to historical images.

</details>


### [508] [Interpreting Speckle Effects Through Neuron Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33632)
*Shubham K. Singh,Hare Krishna*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 论文利用可解释性方法分析SAR预训练模型中散斑噪声的影响，发现对散斑敏感的神经元并不是模型恢复场景所依赖的神经元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 散斑是SAR成像固有的乘性噪声，会降低预训练SAR模型性能，但模型内部如何受其影响尚不清楚。

Method: 研究SARMAE模型，使用可解释性方法识别对散斑选择性响应的神经元，并通过激活修补和合成已知反射率场景精确测量重建恢复效果。

Result: 模型中有38个散斑选择性神经元，但将其恢复为干净值并不能改善重建；第一MLP的恢复/注入效应最大，其中另一组64个神经元可恢复44.1%的相关性损失；保持散斑选择性神经元为噪声值时仍保留96.5%增益，而固定三个解码头会移除37.4%；在ImageNet预训练MAE中第三MLP块最有效；在Sentinel-1和Capella图像上该64个神经元也能改善重建，但土地覆盖分类仅恢复整个第一MLP有明确增益。

Conclusion: 对散斑响应最强的神经元并不是模型用于恢复场景的神经元，散斑鲁棒性相关的关键计算位于不同的神经元集合和层中。

Abstract: Speckle, the multiplicative noise inherent to synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging, reduces the performance of pretrained SAR models. We use interpretability methods to examine its effects inside pretrained vision models. We identify neurons that respond selectively to speckle and test whether correcting their activations improves reconstruction. We study SARMAE, an Earth observation model pretrained on a million-scale SAR dataset. Synthetic scenes with known reflectivity allow us to measure recovery precisely. The model contains 38 speckle-selective neurons that track speckle's value distribution. Restoring these neurons to their clean values does not improve reconstruction. Activation patching across layers shows that the first MLP has the largest restoration and injection effects. Within this layer, a different set of 64 neurons recovers 44.1\% of the correlation loss on held-out scenes. When the speckle-selective neurons are held at their noisy values, 96.5\% of this gain remains, while holding the values of three decoder heads removes 37.4\%. In an ImageNet-pretrained MAE, restoration is most effective in the third MLP block. On manipulated Sentinel-1 and Capella images, the same 64 neurons also improve reconstruction, whereas for land-cover classification, only restoring the entire first MLP yields a clear gain. The neurons that respond most to speckle are therefore not the ones the model uses to recover the scene.

</details>


### [509] [Evaluating Cine and Tagged MRI-to-Speech Synthesis with Complementary Metrics and MRI-Free Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33786)
*Karlo Vrancic,Fangxu Xing,Jiachen Zhuo,Maureen Stone,Jerry L. Prince,Jonghye Woo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该文提出一个评估框架，用于检验动态MRI（cine MRI、tagged MRI及其组合）能否为语音合成提供超出无MRI基线模型的声学信息，并指出仅用Corr2D无法证明模型从MRI中恢复了语音信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究将动态MRI转换为log-mel频谱图，并用预测与真实频谱图的二维Pearson相关（Corr2D）衡量MRI所包含的声学信息；但Corr2D未与保留基本声学结构的无MRI预测器进行校准，因此难以判断模型性能是否真正来自图像信息。

Method: 在固定语音合成网络的条件下，比较四种训练输入配置（cine MRI、tagged MRI及其组合等）与两个无MRI对照：静态平均频谱基线和时间对齐的队列模板；采用留一受试者交叉验证，在44名受试者（18名舌切除术后）的两条语句上评估Corr2D、倒谱距离和ESTOI，并对cine MRI测试多种位置编码、编码器时间注意力模块及与指标匹配的训练目标。

Result: 无MRI的队列模板在Corr2D上达到0.745和0.664；不含时间信息的静态基线达到其87%至89%。没有任何训练配置在Corr2D、倒谱距离或ESTOI上超过队列模板，八种配置中有七种在Corr2D上显著落后；cine MRI的结果在多种位置编码、时间注意力模块和匹配训练目标下均成立。cine与tagged MRI在受试者内存在一致差异，但差异方向取决于评价指标。

Conclusion: 单独的绝对Corr2D不能证明模型从MRI中恢复了声学信息；两个无MRI对照是可复用方法，任何研究都可用自身训练录音计算，模型相对对照的增益才能衡量图像所贡献的信息。

Abstract: Relating tongue motion measured with dynamic MRI to the speech it produces could inform rehabilitation after glossectomy. Prior studies have translated cine or tagged MRI into log-mel spectrograms and used the two-dimensional Pearson correlation between predicted and recorded spectrograms (Corr2D) to quantify the acoustic information captured by each imaging modality. However, Corr2D has not been calibrated against MRI-free predictors that preserve basic acoustic structure. Our contribution is an evaluation framework for speech synthesis from cine MRI, tagged MRI and their combination; the synthesis network is held fixed. On identical leave-one-subject-out folds, we compare four trained input configurations with two MRI-free controls: a static mean-spectrum baseline and a time-aligned cohort template. Across 44 subjects (18 after glossectomy) producing two utterances, the cohort template, which never sees an MRI, reached a Corr2D of 0.745 and 0.664. The static baseline, which contains no timing, reached 87 to 89% of that score. No trained configuration outperformed the template on Corr2D, a cepstral distance or ESTOI; seven of the eight fell significantly short on Corr2D. For cine MRI this held across three positional encodings, an encoder temporal-attention module and a training objective matched to the metric. Cine and tagged MRI differed consistently within subjects, although the direction depended on the metric. Absolute Corr2D alone therefore does not show that a model recovers acoustics from the MRI. The two controls are a reusable method: any study can compute them from its own training recordings, so a model's margin over them measures what its images contribute.

</details>


### [510] [SpiderSkel: Sub-Pixel Multi-Tangent 2D Skeletonization from Inscribed-Disc Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33805)
*Zhexian Zhou,Lian Ren,Xiao Feng,Sebastian Scherer*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: SpiderSkel 是一类无需训练的二维骨架化方法，基于多切线内切圆几何，在19个公开基准、11,323张图像上实现精确拓扑、全连通与精确重建，并提供高效增量更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素网格离散化会扰动中轴所依赖的边界接触几何，导致骨架在连通性、重建保真度和紧凑性之间存在张力。

Method: 提出 SpiderSkel 系列方法：采用保留并列最近边界点的 tie-aware 精确欧氏距离变换；由内切圆切线接触定位亚像素中轴候选；利用接触角跨度过滤候选；再通过连通性感知细化完成骨架。并设计三种变体的增量计算引擎。

Result: 在19个基准、11,323张图像上，单一固定参数在每个图像上均满足精确骨架拓扑、全连通和精确逐对象重建拓扑；三种变体是唯一同时满足这三项性质的方法，并在严格亚像素重建 Dice 与压缩率上相对22个基线均达到 Pareto 最优。增量引擎在23,040个编辑步骤中精确复现完整重算结果，前景编辑中位延迟15.4-18.1 ms，画布编辑4.3-4.4 ms，画布编辑加速达33.0倍。

Conclusion: SpiderSkel 通过多切线内切圆几何和并列距离信息，在无需训练条件下统一了骨架拓扑正确性、连通性、重建保真度与紧凑性，并具备高效的增量更新能力。

Abstract: Skeletonization reduces a binary shape to a compact medial representation, but pixel-grid discretization perturbs the boundary-contact geometry underlying the medial axis, creating tension among connectivity, reconstruction fidelity, and skeleton compactness. SpiderSkel is a family of training-free two-dimensional skeletonization methods built on multi-tangent inscribed-disc geometry. A tie-aware exact Euclidean distance transform retains tied nearest boundary sites rather than collapsing them to a single label; medial candidates are localised to sub-pixel positions from the inscribed disc's tangent contacts, filtered by the angular span of those contacts, and completed by connectivity-aware refinement. Across nineteen public benchmarks comprising 11,323 images of shapes, retinal vessels, cracks and roads, and document images, a single operating point fixed across datasets yields skeletons that, on every image, have exact skeleton topology under the component/hole certificate, remain fully connected, and have exact per-object reconstruction topology. The three SpiderSkel variants are the only evaluated methods to satisfy all three properties across every category; within each category, every variant is Pareto-optimal with respect to all twenty-two baselines in strict sub-pixel reconstruction Dice versus reduction rate. Incremental engines for all three variants reproduce the skeleton of a complete recomputation exactly across 23,040 verified edit steps, with median update latencies of 15.4-18.1 ms per foreground edit and 4.3-4.4 ms per canvas edit, and speedups reaching 33.0-fold on canvas edits.

</details>


### [511] [PRISM: Perceptual Rate-Controllable Extreme Image Compression with Visual State-Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33839)
*Md Adnan Faisal Hossain,Fengqing Zhu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: PRISM 是一种极低码率生成式图像压缩方法，用单一模型同时连续控制码率和合成细节水平，并通过解码顺序对齐的视觉状态空间上下文模型提升率效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式编解码器虽在超低码率下感知质量高，但通常每个码率需单独模型，且无法控制合成细节量；同时 Mamba/SSM 上下文模型的扫描顺序与解码顺序不一致，且每次解码从空状态重启，丢弃已累积上下文。

Method: 提出 PRISM：单模型提供两个连续控制旋钮，即遍历率失真曲线的码率旋钮和调节合成细节的真实感旋钮；设计视觉状态空间（VSS）上下文模型，引入解码顺序对齐（DOA）扫描，使每个潜变量由汇总所有已解码上下文的状态预测，并采用跨 tap 状态传递，用前一 tap 的摘要初始化下一 tap。

Result: 实验表明 PRISM 优于可变码率和固定码率编解码器；在相同 FID 下，相比最强基线平均节省 22% 码率，同时获得更高 PSNR。

Conclusion: PRISM 验证了单模型、双连续控制用于极低码率图像压缩的有效性，并说明解码顺序对齐和状态传递的状态空间上下文建模能显著提升率效率与感知质量。

Abstract: Generative codecs built on pretrained diffusion priors achieve high perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates (below 0.05 bpp). However, most methods still require a separate model for each bitrate, and offer no control over the amount of detail synthesized. Their rate efficiency also depends on the entropy model, where Mamba-based state-space models (SSMs) have recently improved autoregressive context modeling. However, conventional SSM scans are not aligned with the decoding order, and each decoding pass restarts from an empty state, discarding context accumulated in previous passes. We propose PRISM, an extreme image compression method that addresses these limitations. A single model provides two continuous controls: a rate knob that traverses the rate-distortion curve and a realism knob that adjusts the level of detail synthesized. Its visual state-space (VSS) context model introduces a decode-order-aligned (DOA) scan, which predicts each latent from a state that summarizes all decoded context, and cross-tap state carry, which initializes each tap with a summary of the previous one. Experiments show that PRISM outperforms both variable-rate and fixed-rate codecs, requiring on average 22% less bitrate than the strongest baseline at equal FID while also achieving higher PSNR.

</details>


### [512] [Weakly Conditioned Diffusion Model Augmentation for Prostate Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34230)
*Chibike Ugbam,Muhammad Bilal,Jia Wu,Shafaq Murad,Rizwan Qureshi,Hazrat Ali*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于掩码条件扩散模型的前列腺MRI合成数据增强框架，通过生成与解剖结构一致的T2加权图像来改善分割模型的边界精度并减少过度分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI分割的深度学习模型在有限且异质的数据上训练时泛化能力不足，容易出现边界错误和过度分割。

Method: 采用2.5D弱掩码条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），通过通道拼接将训练折中相邻二值掩码堆栈作为条件，生成与条件解剖结构一致但组织外观多样的T2加权MRI体积，并将其按一定比例混入nnU-Net训练数据。

Result: 在LUND队列中，使用23%合成数据从头训练nnU-Net，将每例平均假阳性体素数从11,102降至10,757；在MSD前列腺队列中，使用20%合成数据增强的模型取得平均交叉验证Dice 0.9094，较基线0.8935提升1.59个百分点，并将平均假阳性体素数从4,201降至3,229，减少23.1%。

Conclusion: 两个队列的实验表明，掩码条件DDPM增强可在数据受限场景下减少过度分割错误并改善边界贴合度。

Abstract: Deep learning models for prostate MRI segmentation often struggle to generalize when trained on limited heterogeneous data, leading to boundary errors and over-segmentation. We present an augmentation framework using mask-conditioned synthetic and diverse T2-weighted MRI volumes to improve boundary precision and reduce over-segmentation. We employ a 2.5D weakly mask-conditioned denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) via channel concatenation. The diffusion model conditions on stacks of adjacent binary masks from training folds. The model generates T2 volumes consistent with the conditioning anatomy while diversifying tissue appearance. We evaluate the proposed approach on two cohorts of data: (i) the LUND probe cohort (n=432) for strategy selection and training nnU-Net from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix, and (ii) the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) prostate cohort (n=32) evaluated with a 20% synthetic data mix. For the LUND cohort, we found that training an nnU-Net model from scratch with a 23% synthetic data mix reduced the mean false-positive voxels per case from 11,102 (baseline) to 10,757. On the MSD cohort, the augmented model with a 20% synthetic mix achieved a mean cross-validated Dice of 0.9094, improving over the baseline (0.8935) by 1.59 percentage points and reducing mean false-positive voxels by 23.1% (4,201 to 3,229). Experimental results on both these cohorts suggest that mask-conditioned DDPM augmentation can reduce over-segmentation errors and improve boundary adherence in data-constrained settings.

</details>
